tei:div.tei:p: ce rtso ca gyi — sgod+ngha jici ji— ri — nesna —tsho —lha wa/shāchirisnye rirdzi 4 ji ri dzi ske mocho treci rna phyo ske 6 ru rtse d+ku ru tsho — ’gyi 9 rdo jiju — ñca 4ci sna ji— paṃ sdunererme ci ji sbyi sgro tsā satre wa stacho dz+wa tre rī ༷ rdo 0 ci ci—dzetrī sto tsho 4 rdo dze sbralker+sā tram̐— ca ru 5ོ༷gro ༷ — ci ts+tsha rngu ske ‘ ji (ri two d+ku tshiri3༷ ci ā+o trī ji+o / kyi/ dzirtsechod+kurke dhed+ngha— ṅka gi rngo snye —byu —trewirngo——spyocilhasmu ༷ñca— rishādzā — 9—sgyurtso4ri gyi sgo bhetre rī chica cho ji gyu — rdzo re3tshacisdodzo7 — ci cu ci chi—mi rme ske 4 riju tshucheru sirī—cilke4— tre 3 /ri r+shasgyu che — ri nerjo/ ned+ngha skyi — ci rtsa —: drornya ‘ci 4rtsodri smra tho ‘4rī4 nāru byu — ci ju ri 7’ na.oṃs tsūju〉 tsho —ci zhete 3sdu rī 4sto snyeri+o ci chi sdu tsho rkocicho r+sha k+ṣe 5 ci rici ci ༷2treni r+shaXme chi ṇ+ḍaṃkhrinya rnyi smor+sha du6tram̐9 nguhūṃciri tsho k+ṣe7—sgyur+sha ru sti ci ru r+ṣa rici dze——/sarmeji byuspu+otsho+o lha — ri—rid+kudzā dī sgyu dz+wa dze—rje ci snoḥkhricishārwa dzha —rdopa ri ca sto sduri dz+raribye~Xrdoṣe tsho ji ca— rnachid+ngha rdo rtso bo4ji— tsā rgya ma tshos brartsems/ chi ri rdo dzo—r+sha—du dzo sto rīsto k+to cho nga 2 lce — / tsu zirdzoske rirmi — d+ngha chi ri— cirici ri4 rīrī wa’ snyegyi rī niriri ji sku chi 4༷——ji cigyi 4 ri ñca riri rī pa4 2chi byu —ga —mi rigs dpo skunakhangaka 4 4ca ci shā
/ / san chig sems kyi me togabacu nyagling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos brtsams mi rigs dpe skrun4 khang /
pa las pa'i chiba' ma'i /ba bral lha

dkar chag yab rje rje btsun bla ma la la 'ur bstod pa pa ṭu'i mgul rgyan gser gyi me tog ces bya ba/ ( 1 )bstod pa don dang ldan pa las brtsams te spel mar bsngags pa dgyes zhal 'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i zla sring ngag gi rang gdangs zhes bya ba/ (15)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la bstod pa 'jigs mdzad bzhad pa'i rol mo/ (30)rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa bde chen lang tsho rgyas pa'i sbrang chang zhes bya ba/ (34)drang nges rnam 'byed la bstod pa zla sring mgrin khyim rtsen pa'i rang sgra/(37)thun min chos skyong chen po la bstod pa 'chi bdag bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba/ (39)ba ri lo tsā ba'i lo rgyus kyi don 'grel snyan tshig byu ru'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba/(42)rlabs dkar bu mo mdzes ma we na si'i lang tsho'i me tog la cung zad bsngags pa 'dod myos bung pa'i yid 'dzin/ (52)bsil ljongs shing rta rnam gsum gyi ya gyal kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi bla sgrub byin rlabs char rgyun byo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/1

(60)kun mkhyen bla mar phul ba'i zhu yig 'jam dbyangs 'dzum pa'i me tog ces bya ba/ (66)khri chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung du phul ba 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba/ (68)bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu 'phrin dbyangs can ngag gi rang sgra zhes bya ba/ (70)khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu yig rdzogs ldan ngag gi rang gdangs ces bya ba/ (72)khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs drug pa chen por ched gsol zhu bskul dbyangs can dgyes pa'i do shal zhes bya ba/ (74)bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba zhu bskul ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba/ (76)thog ma'i zhu yig dge legs 'od snang 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba/ (78)brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i zhu yig bung ba rgan po'i mgrin dbyangs zhes bya ba/ (81)bstan pa'i srog shing bse mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu bskul gser snyan sim pa'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ (83)khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs drug pa chen por zhu 'phrin du phul ba snyan bskul dung gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ (85)bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du gsol ba snyan 'a phrin li shi'i me tog ces bya ba/ (88)khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba snyan bskul mes po'i 2

rgyang glu zhes bya ba/ (91)khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba snyan bskul dung zla'i lang tsho zhes bya ba/ (93)khong 'jam pa'i dbyangs mchog gi zhabs stegs su phul ba'i zhu mchid bsung zhim spro ba'i chu skyes zhes bya ba/ (96)khong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du phul ba'i 'phrin yig rig byed ngag gi gling bu zhes bya ba/ (98)man ngag zhu bskul dang 'brel ba'i snyan 'phrin ma li ka'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/ (100)pha rgod rje btsun bla mar phul ba'i zhu yig snyan bskul tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ (102)zhu yig don ldan me tog 'dzum pa'i ljon bzang zhes bya ba/ (105)gus gsol thugs rje'i gru char 'jo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ (107)bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs drung du gsol ba khu byug gzhon nu'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba/ (108)khri chen mchog gi zhabs skyes su btegs pa gdung sel sman gyi myu gu zhes bya ba/ (110)zhu bskul snyan dbang sim pa'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ (112)zhu 'phrin bsung zhim 'thul ba'i me tog ces kyu ba/ (115)snyan bskul gdub kor sil sgra/ (117)zhu mchid dkar mdzes lha reg (120)bslab tshig snying gi thur ma/ (122)zhu mchid mchod pa'i me tog (124)zhu gsol ngang mo'i mgrin glu/ (125)3

tshozhu gsol dung gi rang sgra zhes bya ba/ (127)zhu bskul gling bu'i snyan 'gyur/ (129)rgyal sa nas phul ba'i zhu gsol snyan bskul ut+pal gsar ba'i chun po/(131)snyan bskul mtsho ldan gdu ba'i sil sgra/ (134)krang gya zhabs drung sprul ba'i sku rin po cher phul ba ting ting shag gi rang sgra/(136)bya lam mdzis pa'i ut+pal/ (138)rje btsun sgrol mdzad lha mo la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa at+pal zhes ri riri migazhon nu' rna tshar/ (140)g.yang 'gugs ut+pal dmar po'i kyo ba/ (146)bstod tshig me tog dmar po'i rna rgyan/ (148)bsngags tshig ut+pal dmar po'i nyag phran/ (152)mtsho ldan ma la phul ba mtsho skyes gsar ba'i do shal/ (154)sa bstod sa dbang btsun mo'i mgul rgyan/ (160)bsngags tshig dga' skyed ut+pal dmar po'i gdengs ka (162)'phrin bskul ut+pal dmar po'i 'phrul zhags zhes bya ba/ (165)bde zhus dang 'brel ba'i zhu gsol mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i do shal/ (166)zhu don nyams dbyangs su sdeb pa bung ba'i gshog glu/ (168)snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyin byed rdo grub rin po che bzhi bar phul ba byin rlabs gru char bsu ba'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba/ (170)thar thor ldum gseng me tog (172)'ardom bstod shes rab myur stsol/ (174)

mthong thos mtshan phyed dga' ma'i 'gro 'ong / (181)gnyid kyis bzi ba'i 'khrul lab/ (185)spyi lo 95rab rgyan shing phag lo gsar skabs phul ba'i zhu yig kun byed sems kyi rang mdangs/ (187)yan lag bdun pa kun mkhyen dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ (189)gdung 'bod thugs rje'i gru char 'jo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/ (191)ka rtsom sha tsha'i gros 'debs/ (194)bla ma'i thugs rje gnad nas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gsang gsum byin rlabs 'gugs pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/(196)brtan gsol tshe dpal yongs 'du'i ljon pa zhes bya ba/ (199)bshes gnyen chen po rje sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du phul ba zhu bskul lha rnga'i sgra dbyangs ces bya ba/ (201)bshes gnyen chen po bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog gi zhabs drung du phul ba snyan 'phrin dung zla'i rang mdangs ces bya ba/ (203)bshes gnyen sang ga'i mtshan can gyi drung du phul ba sems kyi de nyid gsal byed ces bya ba/ (206)yongs 'dzin sagi'i mtshan can gyi zhabs drung du phul ba'i zhu 'phrin don ldan ngag gi me rtog ces bya ba/ (208)mkhas dbang dam pa shar gdong sprul ba'i skur phul ba re don bung ba'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba/ (210)rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang po bsam 'grub la phul ba don ldan ngag gi me long zhes bya ba/ (212)dpyod ldan tshul khrims rgya mtsho la phul ba dung sems mtshon pa'i gling bu zhes 5

bya ba/ ༷ (213)dran dbang a bh+yaḥ la phul ba lha grogs dgyes pa'i do shal zhes bya ba/ (215)smra dbang 'jigs med theg mchog la phul ba lha rnga'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/(217)gnas brtan bzod pa don grub la phul ba nang gi de nyid mtshon pa'i zla 'od/(219)bstan pa'i gsal byed ldong sprul ba'i skur phul ba dri bral ngag gi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ (221)snang grol 'jam rdor la phul ba mkha' lding rgyal po'i gshog rlabs ces bya ba/(224)shis tshig legs tshogs bsdu ba'i khab len zhes bya ba/ (225)gnyan thog sprul ba'i skur phul ba dri za'i pi wang zhes bya ba/ (226)kun byed 'thib dwangs res mos kyi zhu 'phrin ko ki'i rgyang glu/ (227)smra dbang bstan 'dzin ye shes la phul ba sgyu ma'i glu dbyangs ces bya ba/(229)pad+ma rig 'dzin la phul ba bung ba'i gshog rlung zhes bya ba/ (231)ka bsgrigs nya nyung bsres pa'i po tsi (232)brtan gsol tshe dpal bum bzang / (236)zhabs brtan smon tshig mya ngan med pa'i yal 'dab ces bya ba/ (238)smon tshig dge legs char 'bebs rdzi (241)zhu gsol mya ngan med pa'i 'dzum mdangs zhes bya ba/ (242)rlabs sgra'i thog tu bris ba'i smon tshig (243)6
zla zer gsar skrun skabs bris pa'i shis tshig legs tshogs myu gu/ (244)mkhas dbang nam mkhar phul ba dza ti'i me tog ces bya ba/ (246)smon tshig lhag bsam glog 'od/ (248)

yab rje rje btsun bla ma la la 'ur bstod papa ṭu'i mgul rgyan gser gyi me tog ces bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/tshogs gnyis spyod pa rlabs chen shar ri'i rtser/ /rgyal sras dpa' po smra ba'i zla ba 'dzegs/ /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /rje btsun bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras rgyu skar phreng / /phreng bar bstar dbus zla med snying stobs che/ /che ba'i blo 'chang gang gis mi 'gran pa/ /pa sangs thugs ldan rgyal sras chen po rgyal/ /blo bzang dbyangs can ngag gi dpal mnga' ba/ /grags pa'i rdza rnga phyogs kyi mdzes mas brdung / /dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi mgos gtugs pa/ /khyod kyi zhabs la bdag kyang phyag bgyid do/ /do zla srid zhi'i khams na rang grib las/ /rnyed min rdo rje rnon po'i lha'i cha lugs/ /lugs mthun dor te dras drub glegs bu'i rgyan/ /nyer 'chang bsil ri'i ston pa der dad do/ /mi dman brtul zhugs mchog gis legs bsdams shing / /rnam dpyod ches phra thub pa'i gzhung lugs kun/ /zhib mor 'byed la zla dang bral gyur bas/ /gcig tu sgrub la dgyes pa 'di rmad do/ /rmad do tshogs gnyis chu gter mer ba'i 'jings/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed ri bos srub pa las/ /rmad byung mdzad bzang zla ba gsar ba'i ris/ /rmad byung bcu gnyis bdag po'i zla ru 'gying / /mgon po de yi yon tan rgya mtsho che/ /'byams klas gyur ba'i gting mtha' ji tsam 1

zhes/ / mthu chen rnams kyang khyogs la 'phyang 'gyur na/ / bdag ltas cung zad dpog pa'ang ga la nus/ /'on kyang 'di na shugs drag dad pa'i mes/ /snying gi chu gter khol ba 'dzinargyubyed pa/ /'di dag gdung sel spobs pa'i rnga yab rtses/ /chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te gar bgyid do/ /'di nyid phyir na 'jig rten gzhan du yang / /'di lta'i mgon gyis nam yang mi gtong zhing / /de yi legs bshad bdud rtsis 'tsho gyur zhes/ / rang don la gus re ba'i zhags pa yis/ /bdag gi snying ni yang dag drangs gyur cing / /shes ldan dad pa rab dkar ngang mo'i tshogs/ /dpag yas yon tan 'o ma'i chu gter la/ /rab dga' rgyas pa'i slad du 'dir 'bade do/ /so ga char sprin rgyas pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo me tog do shal dgod/ /rma bya gzhon nu rol ba'i rtsed 'jo byuston/ / 'di dag 'jig rten ya mtshan ci yang byed/ /mkhas rnams yid kyi brtan pa nyams byed pa/ /dam pa'i spyod pa rmad byung brjod pa'i gtam/ / skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len bsgrags pas kyang / /thub rnams yid ni ci yang chags par 'gyur/ /gzhon nu nyid dang nges pagru 'byung ba'i tshul/ /don chen gnas la dka' ba lhur blangs pas/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /'di dag ngo mtshar gtam gyi gleng gzhi yin/ /yin min rnam par 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod rum/ /yin lugs shes nas dad pa'i rlabs 'khrigs pas/ /yin la yin par bsngagasi pa'i gzegs ma dkar/ /yin min dpyod pa'i mthu ldan gzigs mor byo/ /kha ba'i ri tshom spungs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /yon tan phra tshom mdzes pa'i 'jam dbyangs shig /mdo sngags 'bru tshom spungs pa'i byed po ru/ /'og min lnga tsho ma rin chen skas las babs/ /yon tan mtha' dag dag pa'i zhing mang nas/ /kun gzigs stobs bcu bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas/ /nang byan chud pa pa ṭu mkhas rnams bcas/ / bskal ba bye bar bar med brjod kyang min/ / mthun snang 2

snang ngor tsong kha kha ba'i ljongs/ /yul gru gru 'dzin 'dzin ma'i sar babs pa'i/ /ge sar sar gnas rgyal sras sras po de/ /bsod nams nam 'phang 'phang mtho'i dpal du shar/ /lte mtshal mtshal gyi thigs pa dbyig ldan mar/ /zags las las ldan 'gro ba'i spyi nor du/ /ljon shing shing lor 'phos pa'i rgyal sku'i ris/ /'bum phrag phrag blangs sa 'di'ang skal ba bzang / /bzang po'i bskal bar bar med smos ci zhig / skabs re re 'gar byung zhes sgra'i khron par/ /ma son son pa'i skabs bral dril chen sgras/ /nor 'dzin 'dzin ma lim bu'i tshal du bsgrubs/ /rig gsum gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gar/ /rmi lam lam nas pha mas gsal mthong zhing / /'jigs mdzad mdzad chen bye ba'i shing rta ches/ /kun rig rig pa'i dpa' bor dngos mjal gsungs/ /dgung grangs grangs nyung me ru bab pa'i tshe/ /hor rgyal rgyal bo'i bla mchod karma ba/ /sha rdzong rdzong khrod bzhugs pa'i drung khyer nas/ /gtan khrims khrims lnga srung ba'i dge bsnyen bzhes/ /sngon smon smon pa'i mgyogs 'gros nyer drangs pas/ /tshogs zung zung gi 'phang lo'i shugs bskyod de/ /mi ring ring min bsus pa'i gzhon nu zhig / bshes gnyen gnyen gyur de yi bang du babs/ /dgung grangs grangs ldan gser rir babs pa'i dus/ /bya khyung khyung chen rgyal kha'i mkhar lding bar/ /don grub grub pa'i khyu mchog rin chen drung / /'jigs byed byed po'i dbang sgos smin tshul mdzad/ /dad brtson dran dang bag yod shes bzhin dang / /brtul zhugs mchog dang blo gros dpag dka' ba/ /ring nas 'dris pa'i yid gcugs grogs rnams kyis/ /gzhon nu nyid na'ang mdza' ba ma btang ngo / /lus kyi myu gu dang por gyur ba yi/ /gnas skabs der yang yon tan me tog ni/ / dpag med dri bzang rdzogs pa'i snying po can/ /'di lta'i ngo mtshar su yis bsam mi bya/ /rab byung byung ba brjod pa'i mi rdzogs pa'i/ /ston mchog mchog gi tshab tu legs 3

bzhengs te/ /ngur tshos tshos ldan na bzas nyer bklubs tshe/ /mdo rgyud rgyud sde'i don mthun mtshan yang gsol/ /dbang po rab zhi dul pa'i dpal gyis ni/ /tshangs spyod kyis rgan lha yi drang srong yang / /mi bsrun byis pa ltar mdzad gzhon nu de/ /'dir ni gangs can sa yi thig ler gyur/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu snying rje'i zla ba de/ /thun mtshams ngur smrig gos bzang 'dzin gyur ba/ /de yi mod la khyim gyi skyed tshal du/ /'dod pa'i ku mud la dga'i rtse dga' btang / /na tshod tshod babs bcu drug cha gang ba'i/ /bsil zer zer phreng stong gi dra ba can/ /kun phan phan bde'i kun da 'dzum pa'i gnyen/ / bslab ston ston pa'i bka' bzhin dbus gtsang brtol/ /thog mar mar dwags bka' brgyud bstan pa'i bdag / chos rje rje ba tsun grags pa byang chub drung / /ches zab zab chos mang gsan tshal du phebs/ / dkon mchog mchog skyabs 'dzin las gso dpyad sbyangs/ /chos grwa grwa chen snye thang bde ba can/ /yon tan tan tig 'phyur ba'i rgya mtsho'i gam/ /byamasazuchos chos lnga'i ya gyal mngon rtogs rgyan/ / rgyan 'grel 'grel rkang sbyar pa'i pha mthar brgal/ / dgung grangs grangs thig bab pa bcu dgu'i steng / /yul dbus dbus kyi gsang phu bde ba can/ /snar thang thang chen ngam ring gtsang phyogs sder/ /grwa skor skor mdzad grags snyan g.yu 'brug ldir/ /bod na na yam tsam min grags che ba/ /'gro kun kun nas dga' ba'i dpal mnga' ba / / de slob slob ma'i rtser son red 'da' ba/ /gzhung go go mthar gtugs pa'i bla mar bkur/ /mngon mdzod kun btus dbu ma rnam 'grel nges/ /nges par rgyan drug gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnad/ /gnad la ma reg khol bton phyogs re yi/ /yi rang byed pa'i lugs la phyi phyag btsal/ /chos grwa grwa sa chen po rtsis thang sogs/ /bshad grwa grwa tshogs mang sa phal che bar/ /'dul mdzo da mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phyer ma zad/ /dbu tshad tshad bral dka' bzhis gra skor brjid/ /snying stobs zla ba rdzogs pa de yi 4

snying / /bde gshegs bstan pa bdud rtsi'i dpal la chags/ /legs bshad lam du blo gros gom pa ni/ /rtag tu ngal gso med par khyodakyis bkod/ /dge legs rtsa ba bshes gnyen nyin byed kyi/ /legs bshad 'od stong ma lus 'thungs gyur ba/ /dam chos sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan dbang po de/ /skal bzang bung ba kun gyi nyer 'tshor gyur/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs gdug pa'i sbrul gyi lce/ /bskyod pa'i zlos gar lta bur gzigs pa de/ /yul la mngon 'dod sred pa'i 'ching ba ni/ /mi gtsang mngal gyi rgya dang mnyam du grol/ /nu ma mngon dga' pad+mo'i bzhin ras can/ /lus phra'i mig zur 'phangs pas chags ldan bzhin/ /thub pa'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dog pas kyang / /khyod thugs rkang drug ldan pa'i brtan pa phrogs/ /mi bzad rigs pa'i sder mo phyogs kun gyi/ /rgol ba glang chen spyi bor ngal gso ba/ /khyod kyi rnam dpyod yangs pa'i khyon gyis ni/ /mtha' dag shes bya'i tshad kyang nyung ngur byas/ /khyod kyi rab dkar grags pa'i do shal gyis/ /phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i mgrin pa skal bzang byed/ /mgon khyod bsngags pa'i brel ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /bya ba kun la chags bral blangs pa bzhin/ /nyer bzhi bzhi drug dgung lor babs pa na/ /yar klung klung chen 'bab khog rnam rgyal dgon/ /ched phebs phebs 'bras tshul khrims rin chen mdun/ /kha che che ba'i paṇa chen sdom rgyun bzhes/ /ches skyid skyid shod tshal gyi gung thang sder/ / bka' bstan bstan pa'i btsas su 'gyur ro cog / zhib gzigs gzigs rtog mdzad pas sngar las lhag /mkhyen rab rab kyi mthar rtsen klong du brdol/ /ljags rtsom rtsom snga dge 'dun nyi shu ba/ /blo gsal gsal ldan bgrod pa'i them ldan skas/ /mngon rgyan rgyan 'grel dang bcas rnam bshad che/ /gser phreng phreng bstar so gcig steng mjug grub/ /cher grags grags ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan las/ / skar rtsis rtsis kyi go don ri mor bcas/ /phyi nang nang las khyad thon gzhan bcas kyi/ /5

dus 'khor 'khor phyogs ma 'dzings thugs ngor bkra/ /dgung grangs grangs gnas yar klung mon mkhar gyi/ /bkra shis shis brgya 'dzum pa'i gdong 'jags skabs/ /'khor slob slob ma'i nan ngor nyin gcig la/ / rgya skad skad gsal bco lnga'i gzab bshad 'byams/ /'di 'dra 'dra min bod du ma mthong sprin/ /'phags yul yul gyi rtse mor ma grags gtam/ /gsang mdzod mdzod du ma shong 'phyur ba'i rlabs/ /blo chen blo yis ma zin mkha' ru brdal/ /dbus gtsang gtsang ma'i zhing gi bshes gnyen kun/ /na tshod tshod mi mthun par phul byung gi / rnam dpyod dpyod ldan yid 'dzin 'di ci zhes/ /mi dal dal med gleng bas ljags 'dab ngal/ /shes rab rab ldan stag tshang lo tsā bas/ /bsngags tshigatshig don rmad byung bzod gsol bcas/ /phul 'dir 'di na tshig gi nus pa dang / /nges don don gnas mkhas pa'i khyad chos mang / /gtsang phyogs phyogs phebs rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /dngos su sugang las lhag byin rlabs shing / /zab chos chos kyi skyes stsol dbu ma pa/ /phug nor nor bu'i gter kha rdol der mjal/ /bu ston ston pa'i bu chen gong gsum pa/ /gsang sngags sngags 'chang khyung po lhas pa'i zhabs/ /zhabs pad pad ma'i 'khri shing gus bsten 'bras/ /'bras bzang bzang po'i rgyud sder nang byan chud/ /dgung lo lo grangs bshags lha'i grangs rdzogs par/ /yid dga' dga' ba gdong du dbu ma bar/ /zhu grogs grogs bcol sngags dang dbu ma la/ / mkhyen gter gter brgya byos pa'i thugs nges 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs snyan gsung gis legs bskul nas/ /tshe gang gang 'gol dben pa'i ri sul du/ /sgrub la la 'ur brtson pa'i thag bcad de/ /sku 'khor 'khor gtso brgyad khrid 'ol khar byon/ /rig sngags 'chang gi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho che/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i rlabs phreng cher g.yo zhing / /rim gnyis dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar rol ba can/ /dngos 6

grub rin chen bye ba'i gter gyur te/ /bdag don la chags rab dkar dge ba'i gshed/ /sred pa'i lha min snying rje'i lto bar ni/ /nyid kyis zhi mdzad khyod thugs drang srong che/ /ma lus rnam dpyod yangs pa'i zhal du drangs/ /mang du thos pa'i 'dren byed stong ldan zhing / /blo gsal 'chi med tshogs kyi ral ba'i rgyan/ /theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dpal la dbang sgyur ba/ /thub bstan yongs 'du'i bdag po'i go sar bsgyings/ /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba gtsor byas te/ /te bor blo yul las 'gongs bsags sbyangs mdzad/ /mdzad chen rdzing phyi'i jo bor zhig gso'i las/ /las kyi 'khor lo'i phul dgongs mthar 'don gnang / /dgung grangs grangs son so brgyad phyag rdor dngos/ /nam mkha' mkha' dbyings mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi/ /gdan sa sa yi thig le lho brag byon/ /mkhakhre chen chen por chos bka' gsan res gnang / /skabs zhig mdokledang sngags kyi dka' ba'i gnad/ /gnad kyi mthar thug zab cingakleches phra'i skor/ /skor gcig sgro 'dogs gcod phyir shing gi rir/ /phebs dgongs dgongs bshol 'u cag sku bsod che/ /gnyal gyi phyogs phebs rngog lo chen po dngos/ /dngos slob gro lung bstan rim chen mo gzigs/ /gzigs rtogs zhib mdzad lam sgron gzhung gi don/ /don zab bka' dgongs bye ba'i nying khur 'khrungs/ /dgung grangs grangs yol zhe gcig rwa grong dgon/ /dgon der dbyar bzhugs dar ma rin chen rje/ /rje yi drung phebs zhing 'dir gzhes pa'i bar/ / bar med zhabs bsten 'khor slob mgon mdzad bzhugs/ / gnyal smad rdzong du gser phye 'bum pa mchod/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos dge 'dun bsnyen bkur mdzad/ /mdzad bzang 'dul bstan nyams pa gzhir bslangs te/ / te bor skye tshogs 'phral yun dge la sbyar/ /sangs bskyangs sangs bskyangs bco brgyad rab byed 'grel/ /legs gzigs gzigs pa'i mtshams sbyar klu'i dbang po'i/ /mthar thug thug med 7

lta ba'i gal 'gangs kyi/ sgro 'dogs 'dogs thag mkhyen rab ral —gris gtubs/ /mtshan 'dzin 'dzin pa'i dmigos getad mkhar zhig pas/ /ston la ston par shes pa'i dad pa'i shugs/ /shugs drag drag tuji'aphyur ba'i thugs drangs nas/ /legs bshad legs lam gsal ba'i snyingatshupo brtsams/ /rgya gar kha spu can gyi kha nas kyang / /rgya lam re 'ga' thon minakāsom nyi'i gnas/ /rgya bod mkhas rgu'i kha la smra bcad rgya/ /rgya yis btab 'di phyis 'byung dkon pa'i rgya/ /dgung grangs grangs dkyil babs pa zhe drug skabs/ / ar chen chen po byang chub ye shes kyi/ /gdan sa sa yi bkra lekhos rtsed lding du/ /chos rje rje btsun nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms/ /bka' gdams gdams pa'i chu bo stong 'dus pa'i/ /'brom ston ston pas phyag btab rwa sgreng gi /gangs seng seng ge'i brag tu brdzus pa'i zhol/ /gsung rab rab kyi mthar thug lam rim brtsams/ /dgung lo lo grangs zhe dgur babs pa'i dus/ /'ol kha kha ba'i ljongs kyi byams gling du/ /gsang sngags sngags kyi rgyud sde'i lam gyi lus/ /cha tshang tshang bar 'gag sgril sngags rim mdzad/ /bstan dang ston pa tshad mar sgrub pa'i gzhung / /gzhung gi mthar thug mdo dang sde bdun kun / /kun nas thar 'dod skyes bu'i 'jug ngogs su/ /su dang gang gis mi bzlog thugs nges 'khrungs/ /nga gcig se shing shing gi ra ba'i tshal/ / chos sdings sdings su dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i skabs/ / mkhas grub grub ba'i gtsug nor dge legs dpal/ /thugs sras sras de drung bcar dbu khyud bris/ /rigs tshogs tshogs kyi nang nas bsil zer dbang / /rtsa shes shes byed 'od brgya'i dra ba can/ /rnam bshad rnam par brtsams tshe gser btso ma'i/ /mdangs bkra bkra legs 'grel rkang yang yang gzigs/ / der brten rtsa she'i rigs pa phra mo rnams/ /rnam par ma 'dres phyag mthil rdzas ltar gzigs/ /gzigs pa ji bzhin rigs pa'i rgya mtsho'i mtshon/ /mtshon bral legs bshad snying pos kun 8

bzod mnan/ /snga rabs rabs dang rim byung mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /'gal ba ba lang bgrod pa'i phrang dog mor/ /ci bya bya thabs bral bar gom 'khyor tshe/ /dkyel yangs yangs pa'i lam chen khyod kyis btod/ /klu thogs thogs bral rigs pa'i ral gri'i so/ / phyogs chos chos min pham byed nyi zla'i 'od/ /'phags dbyig dbyig gi char 'bebs thos pa'i mdzod/ /rgyan drug bdun par bzhengs pa khyod gcig bu/ /zla grags grag sa pa mtho ba'i lta ba'i rlabs/ /yon shāka shākya'i sras po'i spyod pa'i dar/ /ka shi'i sgom rim rim can gzugs grub pa/ /bod na bod kyi mig dpe khyod las gang / /brgya phrag phyag mdzod brtsigs pa'i dpe mang yang / /yang dag ltar snang 'byed pa'i lam yig gang / /gang du khyod gsung las gzhan go la'i khyon/ /khyon yangs srid pa'i khyon na btsal byas dben/ /mtshan snyan snyan pa'i ba dan mthar brkyangs pa/ /'dzam gling gling 'di'i ra bar ma chud pas/ /yid drangs drang srong che de tsi nā'i yul/ /gdan zhu zhu 'bul bang chen gong mas brdzangs/ /rgya yul yul brtol dgag bya che ba dang / /dgos pa pa na las kyang chung gzigs nas/ /byams chen chen po'i thugs mnga' shāka ye ba/ /tshab tu du ma'i thabs kyis gtong gnang mdzad/ /nga gsum cho 'phrul 'phrul zla'i bco lnga'i nyin/ /dge 'dun 'dun ldan stong phrag brgyad brgal ba/ /zhal grangs grangs 'dzoms lha mchod mi mchod kyi/ /mchod sprin sprin sna'i ru 'dzings mdzad chen bskyangs/ /sku rjes rjes 'brang 'khor slob ches mang bas/ /'brog ri ri bo'i mgul du 'dul ba dang / /mthun par par gyi ri mo'i mdzes khyad can/ /rab dge dge ldan rnam rgyal gling 'debs mdzad/ /ches gsang gsang ba kun 'dus rim pa lnga/ rab gsal gsal ba'i sgron me pha rgyud dang / /bde mchog mchog gi 'od gsal rtsal 'don pa'i/ /sbas don don gsal ma rgyud gzhung mang brtsams/ /brtsam rim rim bzhin bshad pa zhib rgyas re/ /re ba ji bzhin gnang zhing 9

rgyud sde yi/ /yi dam sgrub ma dbang ma thob dang lhan/ /lhan tshogs dgag bya cher dgongs tshogs khang bzhengasato /dgung lo mtha' rtsa son pa re gsum bar/ /bar med dngos kyis gdul bya'i don sgrub mthar/ / mthar yang bu chen rnams la rten gyi skal/ / skal bstsal chos sde 'debs pa'i zha la chems bzhag / dpal ldan gsung rab kun lalta ba'i mig /dri med rigs pa'i 'dren byed stong ldan pa/ /khyod kyi dngos stobs rigs pa'i lag nyal gyis/ /mthar 'dzin ri bo ming gi lhag mar mdzad/ /bzod dka' rigs pa'i dri bzhon rlung shugs kyis/ /ma lus phyogs kyi go skabs la gnas pa'i/ /log pa'i gzhung lugs sprin tshogs kun bcom ste/ / phan bde sbrang rtsi'i gnyen gcig mkha' la mdzes/ /dri med rigs pa rnon po'i mtshon 'chang ba/ /khyod kyis rtsub mo'i sbyor ba rgyang bsrings kyang / /smra ba'i song ge kun gyi nga rgyal gyi/ /ral ba ma lus cig car yol lhung / /bde gshegs bstan pa'i sa chen khyod kyi ni/ /legs bshad dpung ba 'i ka ba la brten pa/ /theg mchog 'khor los bsgyur ba khyod kyi bka'/ /dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi mgo bos 'dzin/ /mi dman rgyal ba'i sa bon snying rje'i khams/ /shes rab yum gyi lto bar bsam gtan gyi/ /bde drod snyoms par brten pas legs smin pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob sras 'di bskrun/ /snying rje'i zla ba rdzogs pa'i gzhon nu ni/ /lhag bsam kun gsal mdzes ma'i phang ba las/ /rmad byung brtson pa'i mgyogs 'gros rab blangs te/ /gzhan don shar ri'i ba gam rtse la 'dzegs/ /de tshe dam chos ku mud bzhad pa dang / /mnyam du thub bstan gos dkar gyon pa'i lus/ /gzigs nas sa gsum 'gro 'di mun bral zhes/ /dgyes ldan rgyal ba kun ni btang snyoms mdzad/ /rtsod dus 'phrog slad ched du 'ongs pa yi/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin rdu khor yug ri bo'i khongs/ /ma lus khyab par bslab gsum rgyal mtshan ni/ /khyod grags snyan pa'i ba dan 10

bzhin du btsugs/ /de phyir dus mthar legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i gnyen/ /thub pa'i nyi ma ma lus zil gnon pa'i/ /sa gsum 'od mdzad 'gro ba'i bla ma gang / /khyod dang mtshungs pa'i snang ba gzhan yod min/ /re gsum rab byung bdun pa'i so gsum pa/ /sa mo phag lo'i bcu ba'i nyer lnga'i nyim/༈ /nyin byed dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhad dang lhan/ /lhan cig mi phyed skyil krung mnyam bzhag ngang / / ngang las mi g.yo stong gsum rim gyis thim/ /thim mthar thams cad stong ba 'od gsal nyid/ /nyid las mi gzhan don dam chos kyi sku/ /sku thugs gcig tshogs bar do longs skur bzhengs/ /legs bshad 'od dkar stong gi drwa ba can/ /thub bstan ku mud mdzes pa'i gnyen gcig bu/ /glo bur nyid du zhi ba'i dbyings su nub/ /sa gsum 'gro 'di cig car mun pas khyab/ /ring nas khyod la brten pa'i skye bo 'di/ /yid la mya ngan me lce'i sbyin sreg dang / /bzhin la mchi ma'i rgyun gyi dag byed dag / sdug bsngal bsam gtan drag pos rtse gcig bsgrubs/ /blo gsal 'chi med tshogs kyi 'dod dgu'i gzhi/ /mkhyen brtse'i grib bsil phyogs kyi mthar 'gro ba/ /sngon med yongs 'du'i dbang bo dbyings su 'dzegs/ /thar 'dod yid kyi gdung sel su zhig bsten/ /thub bstan gangs ri'i stod g.yogs ni/ /cig car nyid du lhung ngo zhes/ /lha rnams skrag pa'i cho nge bzhin/ /sprin bral nam mkha'i rnga chen brdungs/ /chu gter du ku la yi gos/ /mya ngan rlung gis rlabs bskyod pa'i/ /ljon shing spu long g.yo ba can/ /nor 'dzin lus 'di ring zhig 'dar/ /'jig rten kun gyi lta byed ni/ /lhung bas yid kyi brtan nyams te/ /kun gsal mdzes mas mu cor du/ /chu 'dzin smad g.yogs rgya mtshor dor/ /de yis skabs gsum lha rnams ni/ /ngo tshas bab col gyur ba bzhin/ /'phrog byed bla gos bkra ba yis/ /nam mkha'i bu mo khyab par bsgribs/ /kun rtog rlung gi bzhon pa kun/ /ma lus bcom pas skrag gyur te/ /mtha' dag dri 11

bzhon g.yo ba ni/ /stobs ldan bzhin du sa 'og zhugs/ /mgon 'dis chos sku mngon du mdzad— pa na/ /bdag cag btang stoms 'odug par mi rigs zhes/ /mtho ris pad+mo ma lus lha rnams kyis/ /mkha' la gtor ba'i rnam 'phrul ci yang byas/ / khyod thugs zhi ba'i bdud rtsis myos mthong nas/ /mngon dga' rgyas pa'i zla rba'i sku la 'khyud/ /de tshe de yi rjes 'brang rgyu skar tshogs/ /rang gnas btang ste mkha' las lhung ba bzhin/ /mgon po khyod kyis bdag cag rar+pā btang ste/ /phun tshogs sku yi sgyu mas brid gyur kyang / /mya ngan lcags kyus yid kyi gnyis 'thung ni/ /gtong ba min zhes kun gyis cho nge byas/ /'on kyang bla ma mchog gis sku gsum gyi/ /go 'phang rgya chen mngon du mdzad do zhes/ /bdag cag yid la gdung ba ci ltar rigs/ /slar yang tshul der dad pa lhur byos shig / de lta ra zhing 'di'i gdulabya rdzogs pa'i skabs/ /skabs gsum dga' ldan lha yul byams pa'i drung / /drung ba kun las 'jam skepal snying bo'i mtshan/ / mtshan gyi rgyud stong snyan pa lha'i bur sprul/ /dus ring ring nas brtse chen 'chings zhags kyis/ /ma btang btang snyoms mi mnga' pha gcig der/ /sras gcig gcig chog rgyal bo'i rjes zhugs nas/ /ngag 'dab 'dab rnon g.yo ba'i gar gyis mchod/ /srab med seng chen mtha' med gangs ri'i spor/ /bar med 'phyo ba'i 'dzad med legs bshad rgyun/ /ngoms meda'athung bas do med lu4brtas pa/ /dri med lugs 'dzin zamed sras de rgyal/ /smra ba'i seng chen mkha' ru 'phyo zhes gangs can pa rnams mgrin gcig smra/ /'phags bod gzhung brgya'i mgrin rgyan nyil ba'i mkhas mang ral ba'i gdan du 'phags/ /dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge mi'i zol gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mkhas pa'i dpal/ /dge legs dpal ba dge ldan bstan pa'i srog gi ka chen bskal mthar dge / khyed kyi yid la ring nas gnas bcas mun pa'i lag 'gro gdug pa'i lce/ /gnyis pa dang bcas chags 12

dang sdang ba'i glog phreng g.yo ba ltar rno ba/ /dge legs srog 'phrog chen po'i dug gis myur du khyab byed rmongs pa ni/ / rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bum pa las 'ongs legs bshad bdud rtsis 'phrog gyur cig / rma bya dag gi rna ba la/ /dbyar skyes sprin gyi sgra dbyangs bzhin/ /dam pa'i skye bo ma lus pa/ /dam pa'i spyod tshul thos pas tshims/ /de phyir tshig gi dog pa ni/ /spyod tshul rdzogs pa'i dri bzang can/ /phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rna ba la/ /'khyud par rtsom pa bdag gis byas/ /chen po'i gtam gyi sbyor bas kyang / /dman rnams yid la zug rngu ni/ / phrag dog me yis btsos pa bzhin/ /zhum pa dag dang lhan cig 'byung / /nyi ma'i 'od zer 'thungs pa yi/ /pad gzhon kha yi bdud rtsi la/ /khros pa'i bung ba glang chen gyis/ /'gram pa'i chang la 'thung bar rtsom/ /de lta na yang bdag gis ni/ /dam pa ri dwags mig can gyi/ /zur phud dag la 'os pa gang / /ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba bkod/ / gang gi blo gros blo yi bang mdzod ni/ /legs bshad rin chen bye bas gang gyur ba/ /blo chung tshad kyis bgrang bar mi dpyod pa'i/ /snyan ngag 'byung khungs de las 'di nyid 'ongs/ /gang zhig zab yangs chu gter bzhi yi tshad/ /shes ldan su zhig chu thigs grangs kyis bgrang / /de ltar khyod kyi yon tan phung bo'i tshad/ /bgrang bas mthu chen kun kyang sgyid lug 'gyur/ /'on kyang lho phyogs dri bzhon gyis bos pa'i/ /rkang 'thung me tog rgyas pa'i snye ma bzhin/ /mgon khyod yon tan pad+mo'i dri bsung gis/ /bdag yid bung ba'i brtan nyams mu cor gyur/ /de phyir rje btsun bla ma'i yon tan gyi/ /rin chen 'byung gnas dad pa'i 'jug ngogs der/ /tshig gi 'bab stegs rim par spel ba yis/ /bdag blo'i dri ma bkru ba 'di brtsams so/ /yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo khyod nyid la/ /yid gnyis the tshom bral ba'i mtheb mdzub kyis/ /dad gsum srad bur bstar ba'i me tog phreng / /sku bzhi'i bang rim 'dzegs slad slar yang 'bul/ /dge ba 13

'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag / gang gi mtshan yang bskal bar rnyed dka' ba/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshos khyod zhabs kyi rdul/ / 'bral med gtsug phud rgyan du bsten par shog / der ni sgo gsum bya ba kun gyis kyang / /khyod mnyes bgyid pa 'ba' zhig lhur blangs nas/ /de yi mthu las thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ /khyod gsung bdud rtsis ro yis 'tsho bar shog /theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing byang chub sems/ /yang dag lta ba'i gnad dang rim gnyis la/ /'khrul med nges pa rnyed nas brtson pa yis/ /khyod gsung sgrub pa snying por byed par shog/ces kha ba ri ba'i ston pa bla na med pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen po la rnam thar mdzad rjes dang 'brel bar shas tsam bsngags pa/ dad pa'i 'jug ngogs kyi yang ngogs mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba'i nang lugs pa dag gis rmi lam du yang bkra lam mer mkhyen yang dgos la mkhyen kyang mkhyen phyir 'di 'drar re mi dgos mod/ gzhan dad pa che zhing thos bsam la lag rjes mi chung ba'i gzur gnas dag la dad pa'i gsos dang / rang gi yid yab rje'i rnam thar la phyogs pa'i lag char dmigs te gsung byin rlabs can gyi tshig khar len pa'ang bskal ba bzang rgu'i rtse mor reg pa'i ded pas mtshams sbyar te/rang gi ngag rtsom phreng ba dang nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gyi don bsdu'i tshig rgyan char byas na sa 'bri ba po ni/ 7'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i zla rgyan zla mdzes ngag gi 'dab mar 'bod pas 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i dbang pos byang chub chen po mngon du mdzad pa'i dus kyi char/ bsam gtan gyi spyil chung blo bzang bzhad pa'i 'od khyim nas sbyar ba skye kun bla ma 'jam dpal snying pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 14

bstod pa don dngasdan pa las brtsams te spel mar bsngags pa dgyes zhal 'dzum dkaragayo ba'i zla sring ngagagi rangagadangs zhes bya ba/sngo bsang tha grur gsang gsum rgyu skar 'bum/ /ji snyed mos pa'i chu mtshor de snyed du/ /'gog med 'char ba'i 'phrul ldan drang srong che/ /bu ram shing bas 'jig rten rgyal gyur cig / mtha' bral stong dbyings dbyings kyi mkha' las 'ja' tshon tshon lnga'i rang mdangs ji bzhin bzhin legs nyams kyis sgeg pa'i sku/ /snyan 'jebs legs gsung gsung rab mkhyen pa'i nying khu khu ldan mthar 'dzin gdung 'phrog 'phrog byed dbang po'i gad rgyangs gsung / /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'khor yug yongs bskor sa 'dzin 'dzin ma'i phreng ring do shal shal ldan phra rdul mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos dngos su byis pa'i tshul ston ston pa mchog der sgo kun kun nas 'dud do brtse bas skyongs/ /dmar ser 'od kyis 'dzum pa'i me tog tog mdzes lnga phrag zur phud ldem/ / mkha' ltar sngo ba'i ral gri mkhar gdengs gdengs kas mi shes dra ba gtubs/ /ut+pal sngon po'i mal du 'phred nyal nyal thabs glegs bam zab don mdzod/ /mdzod la dbang bsgyur rgyal kun yab gcig gcig chog tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs/ /'o ma'i chu gter bkra shis ri mo'i gnyer mas yongs bzung do ra ru/ /'o ma'i mdangs 'dres shel dkar lcug phran phra ldem nyams kyis sgeg pa mo/ /'o ma'i bcud 'dzin mtshe mas 15

snyems pa'i ljon pa'i bu mo yid 'phrog ma/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i g.yo min thugs kyang g.yo ba'i mig yangs mgrin khyim 'khyug / sor rtog ye shes rang mdangs rdzogs kyang byu ru'i khu ba lan brgyar 'thung / /srid zhi'i legs tshogs gzugs su smin yang brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud 'jib la rings/ /lhan skyes li shi'i bsung zhim ldang yang gsar skyes ut+pal gnam rur 'tham/ /dbang gi rgyal mo rgyal ba'i yum des da dung dung sems thag pas chongs/ /mar gad 'khri shing gsar ba'i lang tsho tsho ru chags pa'i mtshan gyis spa/ /tsi nā'i bu mos btags pa'i dar zab zab ris 'bum gyis gzugs 'dzin sbid/ /ring nas 'gro la rjes chags zur mda' mda' lnga'i byed pas mi zin pa/ / rgyal kun yum gyur tā re 'phags ma ma lus 'gro ba'i ma des skyongs/ /dbyangs can drag khros drag mo'i skur bzhengs dmag dang zor gyi las la dpa'/ /mi sdug gzugs dang gzugs mdzes rnam 'gyur gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs ston/ /sgrub la snying nye snying gi dwangs khrag snyan rgyud srung ba'i bya ra ma/ /'dod khams bdag mo bdag gi gam du nam rgyun sdod la mel tshe gyis/ /mdo lugs bstan pa bstan pa'i snying bo klu sgrub klu yi dbang bo'i lta/ /sngags kyi snying bo snying bo'i dwangs bcud bcud ldan pha ma'i rgyud kyi srog / sgyu 'od zung 'jug zung gi zab gnad gnad don sus kyang ma thon pa/ /gsal bar phye 'di 'di na gzhung 'di'i brjod don don gyi snying po lags/ /bstan pa kun gyi kha na grag kyang bstan pa dngos de gang yin bskal/ /snying po snying la bcings khul smra yang yang dag don la mgo bo 'thom/ /bstan dang bstan pa'i snying bo ngos bzung gsal bar mdzad tshul las brtsams pa'i/ /legs bshad legs lam gsal ba'i sgron 'dir sa gsum 'di na do zla gang / /gang zhig rbashad dang sgrub pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bla na med/ /smra dang gzigs pa'i mchog gyur ba/ /rten 'byung gsal mdzad de la 'dud/ /'dud do yab rje dam pa'i 16

lugs/ /lugs mchog bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser/ /gser ltar dag pa'i rang lugs la/ /la 'ur 'di nas skye kun 'dud/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo/ /ji snyed rgyal bas gsung ba kun/ /gang du gzhol zhing 'bab pa'i gnas/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di kho na/ /na yam tsam min 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs can mgrin chags gsum ldan tshul/ /tshul tsam ma yin dngos kyi zhabs/ /zhabs zung gtsug thob skal ba sbom/ /ci phyir zhe na 'gro kun gyi/ /rgud pa'i skyon mang drungs 'byin pa'i/ /sman dang rigs sngags rgyal po yang / /chos tshul 'di las gzhan na gang / /gang du bskal ba bye ba'i bar/ / bar med btsal kyang rnyed min pa/ /pa sangs khengs 'phrog mtha' bral lta/ /lta de yab rje'i thugs bcud de/ / de phyir rgyal ba ston pa yi/ /bstan la 'od byed nyi ma dang / / 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin zla ba yang /mtshungs pa med pa khyod du nges/ /nges par rnam grol zhi gling du/ /du ma'i thabs kyis 'gro 'dod kun/ /kun nas zhi sgo gnyis med lam/ /lam 'di las lhag zur bas dben/ /zhi lam de bzhin nyid ston pa'i/ /sa mkhan rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ /chos kyi rjes 'gro dad pa'i sgo / mi mnyam che ba'i gter du nges/ /nges don dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /zin med bya bar zhen log skyes/ /skyes sbyangs rnam dpyod mi dman pa/ /pa ṭu'i blo can de 'dir 'jug / 'phags yul mkhas rnams gzur gnas pas/ /rang blo'i stobs bzhin grub mtha' 'dzin/ /'di na thams cad dbu ma'i gral/ /bsnyegs kyang blo yis ma lcigs pas/ /pas zhes byed pa'i tshig sbyar phyir/ /phyir zhing 'brel med smra ba kun/ /kun nas grub mtha'i rwa ba'i nang / /nang du ma chud phyi na 'phyan/ /skye na mtha' bzhir nges kyang de/ /khegs phyir skye ba yod min la/ /tha snyad blo yis snang ba ni/ /'a khrul phyir don du mi 'gyur zhes/ /zhes su mgrin ripa mthor btegs te/ /te bor skad gseng mthon po yi/ /yi mug 'chor ba'i 17

gtam smra ba/ / ba lang long ma'i brtul zhugs smad/ / rang bzhin med la bden bzhi dang / /skyabs gsum las 'bras la sogs pa/ /med par thal ba dngos smra'i gtam/ /dang du len bzhin dbu mar smra/ /smra ba gzhan kun bab col du/ /smra tshe smra ba'i zla ba khyod/ /smra mkhas bye ba spa bkong ba'i/ /skyab zla med gad rgyangs brjid/ /dngos smra rigs pa'i lugs 'dzin pas/ /bden stong rigs pas bkag nas dor/ /'di na rigs pas 'gog bzhin du/ /'thad par sgrub pa kye ma ho/ /ho zhes mya ngan tshig gi mjug / mjug mar btags pa'i gsum ldan bdag / bdag legs 'dod pa'i lugs min tshul/ /tshul mthun tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'doms/ /kha cig chad par dogs pa yis/ /ma skyes mi 'gyur ltos med bdag / bkag tsam dbu mar 'khrul ba yis/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi gcig tu 'gyur/ /'gyur med dad pa brtan po yi/ /yi rang me tog 'bum brtsegs nas/ / nas kyi zil dngar legs gsung bcud/ /bcud du 'thung na snying po myang / / la la dgag bya'i mtshams kyi 'ben/ /gtad med phyogs char gcod pa yis/ /stong bar 'khrul yang 'char sla la/ / rten 'brel bshig pa smad pa'i gnas/ /gnas dang gnas min dpyod pa'i rtsal/ /rtsal ldan khyung chen gshog pa'i rlabs/ /rlabs ldan rgya mtshos mi bsgrunabyā pa/ /pa ṭu chen po'i mal de dro/ /rtag chad gnyis ka'i g.yang sa la/ /'jigs phyir dbu mar 'jug dka' yi/ /dgag pa'i phyogs gcig tsam nyid na/ /de ni gang las dbu mar brjod/ /brjod na pha mtha' mi rdzogs pa'i/ /brjod bral a ma'i gshis lugs de/ / de bzhin brjod la ljags yangs 'dab/ /'dab ma thung na gzhan gyis ci/ /de phyir mkhyen pha'i gter gyis kyang / /snang stong nye ring mi bya zhes/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis las/ /khyod kyi thugs ni yongasahosu bzung / /bzung btang gzod nas ma dmigs der/ /der 'dzin 'ching ba ngang gis zhig /zhig pa dngos por 18

'dod pa 'di/ /'di na dbu ma'i grub mtha'i rdzong / /phyag rdzogs gsal stong 'dzin med ces/ /'gro 'ong gzugs can ltar med dang / /'byung 'jig rags pa'i mi rtag tshul/ /mthong bya ma mthong brgyal 'dra'am/ /'am zhes 'dam nga'i tshig sbyar rjes/ /rjes su da dung 'phro skyong bzhed/ /bzhed don rin chen gter gyi kha/ /kha 'byed gzong rnon 'di na brdar/ /gzugs su ma grub gsal rig tsam/ /myong la bden mthong rlom 'chang zhing / /phyogs glang grags pa sogs kyis kyang / /de nyid ma mthong smra ba mtshar/ /mtshar mtshar gzugs kyis 'dren byed 'khrul/ /snyan snyan phang 'gros thos 'dzin bslad/ /'dra 'dra mo yis sems brid pa/ /de de'i rjes 'brang blun po'i phul/ /kha cig ma btsal skyong bar rlom/ /la la btsal kyang skyong tshe stor/ /bzung yang dpyod med 'jog sgom tsam/ /lta la mkhas pa min par gsungs/ /gsung 'di ris su ma bor bar/ /bar med zhib mos blos dpyad tshe/ /tshe 'di ma zad tshe rabs phreng / /phreng bstar sa lam ang mi 'khrugs/ /nyams myong brda yi chig thang de/ /phan 'ga' srid kyang gol ba mang / /dgag sgrub sbyor ba kun tshang ba/ /khyod gsung thar 'dod yongs kyi gsos/ /gsos 'di skabs re tsam min par/ /gsos sman ji bzhin rgyun bsten na/ /na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa'i me/ /me lce bcil la bsil ba'i chu/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jigs pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed dag ni/ /stong dang rten 'byung don gcig par/ /gsung mchog mtshungs pa med par bzhed/ /bzhed don 'gang gshog legs bshad don/ /don bzhin legs ston dam pa'i zhabs/ /zhabs pad legs bsten bsags dang sbyang / /sbyang ba mthar son des de rnyed/ /ston pa mchog der bstod pa'i sgo/ /kun gyi bla mar gyur ba yang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung gsungs pa ru/ /klu sgrub zhabs dang khyod kyis gzigs/ /gzigs pa mthar thug klu sgrub kyi/ /gzigs gang da dung ma nyams pa/ /pa tra'i ris ltar mig gi 19

lam/ /lam mer bkra ba khyod kyi drin/ /shas cher stong la mos blo yis/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung 'gog byed pa/ /snang bas bsgribs pa de dag gi /blo mun stug po gang gis sel/ /sel byed nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /sel bya mun pa'i ba gam 'jig /sel dka' nang gi kun khebs dpung / /sel la legs gsung nyi ma rno/ /lta bas rang bzhin btsal ba'i byir/ /ma rnyed pa yis khegs 'gyur la/ /ma rnyed gdags gzhi 'gog min pas/ /rjes kyi ming tsam lhag mar mthong / /mthong dang ma mthong yon tan kun/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab phyir/ /phyir zhing rnam 'byed blo'i rgya mtsho/ /mtsho chen rnyog pa bral te skyil/ /ming tsam der yang bya byed kun/ /bsnyon med myong bas 'grub pa yi/ /rjes 'gro'i skyon yon blang dor kun/ /brtson pas spyod pa rnam par dag / dag dang ma dag sems kyi 'phrul/ /'phrul 'dis yag nyes ci yang bzo bzo med bcos med chos nyid gshis/ /gshis su chams brdal rtsa ba rul/ /snang stong rim pas chad rtag mtha'/ / sel ba grub mtha' kun 'dod kyang / /bzlog ste smra ba 'di kho nas/ /brgyud ma'i klan ka mtha' dag bsal/ /bsal bar bya ba ci yang med/ /med phyir bzhag par bya ba yang / /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /lta ba'i 'gag 'di mthong na grol/ /bdag bstan rgyu 'bras rtogs pa'i phyir/ /gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar/ /'gar yang mi bde ma mchis pas/ /lta ba'i dpyad pa yongs su rdzogs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang gsung don/ /don bzhin klu bskyangs zla ba'i lugs/ /lugs bzang mchog dang mi 'bral bar/ /bar med rmi lam na lngadzā smon/ /dpyad gzod shegapa ma grub cing / /phyi don snang ba bsnyon med pas/ /kun gzhi rang rig yod min la/ /don dang zhig pa dngos por sgrub/ / sgrub dang sun 'byin gshog pa'i rlabs/ /rlabs sdeb shugs kyis mi zin pa/ /pa sangs lam la nyulaba'isatha'/ /mtha' med lta ba'i rang mal zin/ /mdor na ngo bos stong 20

ba dang / /phan tshun brten nas btags pa gnyis/ /'gal med grogs su shar ba yis/ /rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad par gzigs/ /gzigs pa sgrib med me long du/ / du ma'i bden gnyis shes bya'i rdul/ / rdul grangs las 'das shong ma zad/ /zad nas yungs 'bru'i zla ru yib/ /nyon mongs 'ching gcod klu sgrub kyi/ /lta ba'i ral gri 'dzin byed pa/ /sgom pa'i dpung pa brtan po'i thabs/ /mtha' yas sa sde bzhin du gsungs/ /gsungs gcig gis kyang du ma'i 'gro/ /'gro kun so so'i rang skad du/ /du mar go bas do med 'phrul/ /'phrul 'di srid pa'i khong nas yar/ /bod sgom gzhung du mi 'tshol bar/ / med sar 'bad pas 'tshol zhing skyong / /drod rtags phra mos rlom rnams kyi/ /sgom pa'i man ngag dpe zla min/ /min la yin par sgro 'dogs blo/ /blo bral gnyug ma'i ngang du yal/ /yal rjes med snang stong ba'i mdangs/ /mdangs lnga'i 'ja' tshon 'gog med snang / / mdor na lta sgom spyod pa'am/ /rnam dag lhag pa'i bslab gsum srol/ /gzhan las ches cher 'phags pa yis/ /rgyu yi theg pa nyin mor byas/ /byas pa drin lan mi gzo ba/ /ba lang spu med rkang 'gro'i khyu/ /khyu bzhin 'khrigs kyang rgyal bstan la/ /la 'ur phan pa mchis so lo/ /dkon pa'i mchog gyur dri bral nor bu bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tog tu brjid/ /sa gsum gsal ba'i sgron me'i snang bas snang byed dkyil 'khor mog por btang / /mkhas rlom ri dwags mthar byed gdong lnga gcig pur gangs ri'i sil na rgyu/ /rgyu mtshan mchog tu shes nas dad pas dad phyag me tog lan brgyar brtsegs/ /rigs gsum li khri'i gos bzang bzang bo'i dkris pas mkha' dbyings dmar 'od chags/ /bstan pa'i snying po gsal mdzad mdzad bzang snyan pa'i rol mo mtha' na 'khrol/ / gangs ljongs grags ldan mkhas mang mang po'i lan bur zhabs skyes 'khor lo rtsen/ /blo bzang grags pa'i grags snyan snyan pa'i ba dan mthar yang mtha' na 21

'phur/ /bsil ri'i ra bar srab med seng chen chen po'i ngang tshul can dag gis/ /'phrin las rin chen khyon yangs gdugs dkar dkar 'jam dbang phyogs rgya mtsho'i khar/ /brdol ba'i grib ma snum po lase gzhan gzhan— na 'chag sa ma rnyed pas/ /khyod zhabs la btud rnam kun skyabs— gsol gsol 'debs dbyangs kyis dus rnam brel/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi/ /dbang dang dam tshig lam dang 'bras/ /kun la gol ba'i mtha' bkag ste/ /gsang ba'i gnad kun rdzogs par bkral/ /bkral ba zab gsang theg pa'i gnad/ /gnad bzhin ma nor lam gyi rim/ /rim par bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam phreng / / phreng ldan gangs ri'i ra bar spungs/ /bden med snang stong lha sku sogs/ /pha rol phyin dang 'og mar yang / /grags pa tsam las 'dus pa'i gnad/ /bdag byin brlabs sogs rim pa yi/ /yi rang me tog 'bum brtsegs pa'i/ /yi dam lha yi zhal lung chus/ /yi ga 'gag pa'i mkhas rlom khyur/ /yi gar 'phrod pa'i legs bshad brdal/ /sbas don snang med gyur ba na/ /rgyud don 'phags pa yab sras kyi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin gsal mdzad de/ /pha rgyud kun gyi srog rtsa bzung / / bzung btang ka nas ma dmigs pa'i/ /bzung med tsom 'jog ha shang gis/ / bzung ba'i gna' bo'i lugs ngan srol/ /srol ngan gsub pa'i phyag rgyas btab/ /phyi nang phyag rgya'i spros pa las/ /gang gis rgyas gdab de nyid don/ /ma mthong rnams kyang mig phye ste/ /ma rgyud gnad la shid zan btang / /btang bzhag 'gro 'ong dang bral ba'i/ /btang snyoms ngang du cham 'jog pa'i/ /btang ba'i sngon med gsar bshad kyis/ /kha ljongs kha 'bab klung chen byos/ /bde stong zung 'jug smra ba na/ /de nyid ya gyal gcig gyur pa'i/ /bden gnyis dbyer med gtam 'di yang / /khyod kyis 'jig rten gsum du bsgrags/ /bsgrags pas bsil ri'i mkhas pa'i khur/ /khur 'dzin snga phyi'i 'phang ldan khri/ /khri phrag zhabs zung 22

nor bu'i lcid/ /lcid du dbab pa'i 'jig rten mnan/ /gsang sngags 'jig rten spyod pa dang / /lta ba yid byed bkag tsam du/ /rgyur tshe dbang po'i tog gi drung / /dam bcas bzhin du khyod kyis gsos/ / gsos pa'i grags snyan srid pa'i khong / /khong bur ma chud yar ba'i shugs/ /shugs can sred med bu yi rtsal/ /rtsal gyis ma 'gran ngo tshas gab/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed pa ru/ /lung bstan pa yang mchog 'di ste/ /gang las khyod ni rjes dran pa'i/ /yon tan zla dang bral ba'ang 'di/ /'di na nyin mtshan khor mo yug / yug gcig mdo sngags zung 'brel bstan/ /bstan pa'i ba dan srid rtse ru/ /ru mtshon lta bur bsgreng la 'dun/ / thub dbang chos kyi nyi ma de/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su gzhol gyur nas/ /ring zhig 'das te chos kyi sras/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khyod nyid 'khrungs/ /'khrungs sa mdo khams smad du 'khrungs/ /grags pa dbus gtsang ljongs su grag / dbu sngags ya ma bral ba'i dbu/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'dzugs pa gang / / bag yod brtul zhugs lhag bsam spyod/ /bde stong ting 'dzin mtha' bral lta/ /thub bstan mtha' dag gdan gcig tu/ /rdzogs pa'i srol 'di khyod kyis phyes/ / phyes pa'i srol 'dir 'jug mkhan phyis/ / shar nub rgya mtsho chen po'i bar/ / bar med gtibs pa'i zhwa ser lugs/ /lugs 'di khyod las gzhan sus phyes/ /deng dus yab rje'i srol bzang yang / /snyigs ma mun pa'i rdul gyis khebs/ /ltar snang bshes gnyen du ma yis/ /skye bo nyam nga'i g.yang du khrid/ /khrid pa'i 'jug ngogs ma nor lam/ /lam yig yab rje'i gsung rab mig / mig bu dam pa'i bshes kyi mgon/ /mgon du tshogs na dka' las ci/ /kye hud dge ldan bstan pa 'di/ /dpal dang 'byor bas rab rgyas kyang / /bshad dang sgru ba pas ches phra ba/ /bsam gyin snying nas shes pa 'phyo/ /'phyo bar ma zad 'phar zhing ldang / /ldang ba'i mi tshad 'gas yang srid/ /srid pa lnga bdo'i g.yo 23

'phrul 'di/ /'di na tshad mas lung gis zin/ /zab rgyas chos kyi de nyid don/ /ji bzhin 'doms pa ches dkon yang / /'khrul bral khyod gsungs glegs bam rnams/ /gdung sel dbugs dbyung mchog sbyin 'gyed/ /'gyed 'di deng dus ja thug gi / 'gyed las ngo so chung na yang / /yang yang 'gram pa lag skyor gyis/ /'gyed kyi rin thang bsam gzhig gnad/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa mthar thug dang / /dbyer med gyur ba khyod kyi bstan/ /gang du ji bzhin gnas pa der/ /rtag tu skye ba 'dzin par shog /shog ces zhal 'dzum zla ba'i zer/ /zer mdangs dang 'grogs gsung gi gdangs/ /gdeng ldan thugs kyis rjes 'dzin slad/ /slad mar tshig gi me tog 'thor/ /phyogs rer ma gyur thos pa'i chose/ /bsam dang sgom pas nyams blangs nas/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang po/ /tshang la ma nor rnyed gyur cig / cig ces smon pa'i mtshams sbyar nas/ / nas snye'i tshul mtshungs mgo dud de/ / de ltar bstar ba'i tshig gi phreng / /phreng ba yab gcig phyag tu 'bul/ /rtag tu 'jam dbyangs bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung lta bas rgyas btab pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam gyis/ /byang chub bde blag thob gyur cig / gsal gsal mkhyen rab rab kyi mthar thug thug pa med pa'i ye shes nyid/ /mdzes mdzes bzhin lag lag pa'i gzhu bzhin bzhin bzang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lam lam legs bkra bkra legs mtshan dpe dpe zla bral ba'i lus 'chang ba wal wal gnas lnga lnga phrag rig gzhung gzhung bzang snying gi bcud du phobs/ /rigs gsum mgon po mgon med mgon du lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /skyabs gsum ngo bo ngo mar bzhengs pa bho ṭa'i yul gyi thams cad mkhyen/ /gnas gsum don kun don bzhin gzigs pa bod na bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /khams gsum rgyal ba rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang grags pas slar yang skyongs/ /sdeb legs legs bshad rtsom pa'i dbul yang gang la gus pa'i bstod pa'i phreng / /phreng 24

ring ring mo'i bskal ba'i mthar yang yang bskyar rjes su 'dzin slad du/ /du ma ma li'i bsung zhim 'thul ba'i tshig rgyan sor mo'i bstar ba'i phreng / /phreng ldan gangs ri'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig mgrin pa cung zad bsrings te phul/ /yab rje'i zhabs sen sen mo'i me tog bde chen 'khor lo'i tog tu ldem/ /zab rgyas legs bshad bshad pas mi longs longs spyod 'khor lo'i ze'u 'brur chags/ /mdo sngags thub bstan bstan pa'i yang snying snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor 'khyil/ /yab rje 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /gna' bo'i phyogs glang dpa' bo yis/ /spel mar bstod pa ya mtshan phul/ /phul gyur de yi rjes zhugs nas/ /spel ba'i lad zlos 'di na 'khrab/ /rten 'brel mgo nas 'grig pa'i phyir/ /mgo mjug tshig ris sgra mtshungs byas/ /thog mtha' bkra shis phun tshogs slad/ /mjug thog zung ldan rgyan gyis spud/ /don zab 'jam mgon mdzad rjes la/ /bstod phyir don gyi ros mi dman/ /zung zhig mnyam du gshib de'i na/ /spel ba'i don gyis 'di mi stong / /byis pa'i me tog 'thu ba'i dpe/ /'dir bkab de slad go rim bral/ /bsgrim pa'i tsher mal rgyang bsrings nas/ /gang shar g.yang mo'i bal 'jam brdal/ /ston pa dang bor skyabs bcol ba'i/ /gzur gnas mkhas pas ngo sor byed/ /byis pa'i mun mda' sne gcog slad/ /dam pa'i gsung gi ra bas lcibs/ /zi skud rtsid skud lhan bsgril ba'i/ /'jam tsub do mi mnyam na yang / /gdong gi 'dzum mdangs phar phyogs pas/ /bsngags tshig lags phyir 'gal bas btang / /za nyal ma gtogs mi shes pa'i/ /za byed mche ba gzengs na yang / /zwa tshod kyis 'tsho mi la'i bu/ /bu ngar nyam nga yod re skan/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis bye ba'i snying bo snying rje'igater chen chen po'i gzugs/ /mkhyen rab rab gsal ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'phrul ldan rab dwangs dwangs ma'i gzugs/ /gsang 'dzin 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor bdud dpung 25

dpung bcas rab 'joms lajoms pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs grub grub dang mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rgyan drug gcig 'dus 'dus zhal gzugs/ /gzugs legs yi ge'i ris su smin pa mdzad rjes rjes su dran pa'i gtam/ /gtam gzhan go skabs ring du 'phrog dzorgyud mangs rgyud du bkug pa'i glu/ / glu chung ko ki'i khengs pa mthar skyel skyel mas bor ba'i bu chung ngag / ngag dbang lha mo dga' ba'i ngag de de ring ngag mgrin mtsho nas rdol/ /rdol gtam ma yin don dang ldan pa bsto da tshig ngag gi gzegs ma'i lce/ /lus med stong ba'i dbyings su brkyangs pa'ikhadaka'atshoganagagatub pa'i ral gri'i so/ /dge dbang dpa' bo'i bcud mar gshib me'i rgyal pham gcig tu ma nges pa/ /mtsho ldan rkang gdub sil sgras byin dbab ngag 'dab snyan ngag gter du grub/ /grub bdag bu mo'i yid 'phrog lang tshos grub gnyis nor bu'i gru char bsnyil/ /snyan rgu'i phang 'gro'i phang bar bkug sgra'i snyan 'jebs ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo/ /snying la mdza' ba shub pur bzlo ba 'i snying gtam 'phral yun bya ba'i gros/ /zla ba'i sring mo snying gitshodabul sel zla bral spobs pas da dung 'khyud/ /bkra shis 'o klung mkha' nas byos pa'i rgyun bzang 'dzin mar g.yas su 'khyil/ /a nu'i ngag rig dbu ba'i 'khri shing ling ling rtse ba'i nying khu can/ rki/ thabs mkhas dran dbang gdengs can bye ba'i 'jug ngogs ma dros mtsho chen gyi/ /do zla lho rgyud 'dzin ma'i sde chen mngon dga' gnyis pa'i ka chen rmad/ /rmad byung dbyangs can rgyud stong rang sgra smra dbang 'bum gyi rnar 'jebs pa'i/— /rjod byed nyi zla'i 'od kyis ma yin gsang gsum 'dab brtsegs ba ku la/ /la 'ur kha 'byed rnam dpyod g.yon mig ro ldan kha chus legs bran tshe/ /bstod tshig brjod don mngar mo'i sbrang chang blo gsal rkang drug dpal du bskyugs/ /mi ring dus kyi rabs 'di'i stod/ /dbyangs can mgrin rtsen dan ṭi'i spun/ /gong chos rigs 'khrungs snyan ngag sdong / / rgya 26

mtsho sprin gyi me tog 'dzum/ /de yi kha las lud pa'i chang / /mtsho ldan ngag rig bsung zhim dang / /'thab pa'i legs par bshad pa'i snying / /snying gi grogs po'i snying gi dwangs/ /dwangs ma spel mar spel ba'i tshig /tshig bcad don zab tshig gi ris/ /ris med mkhas pa'i mig gi lam/ /lam bzhin bris pa'i lam ded nas/ / bstan pa'i snying po gsal mdzad tshul/ / tshul las legs brtsams bstod pa'i gting / /gting mtha' mi mngon rgya mtsho las/ /las kyi skal byin las su byas/ /'di nas bzung ste nam mkha' srid/ /srid lam dub pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku/ /sku bzhi'i rgyal sar myur reg smon/ /smon gnas yid bzhin 'grub la mthun pa'i grogs/ /grogs dan rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin/ /byin tu 'khrigs pa'i legs tshogs gru char 'bum/ /'bum phrag bskal mthar bsnyil ba'i shis gyur cig / slar smas pa/ ral gri'i 'dab phreng g.yo ba'i lha de de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung bstan ltar/ /ltar snang bcos ma'i tshul las rab 'das 'das dang ma byon rgyal ba'i dngos/ / dmar ser ngur smrig gos kyis nyer mdzes mdzes sdug chog mi shes pa'i gzugs/ /rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag bdag nyid chen pos slar yang skyongs/ /ka mad yi ge'i srol 'byed chen po thon mi'i zhabs kyis bcags pa'i yul/ /kha ba'i 'dab ma lhab lhub g.yo ba'i chos ldan 'phags pa'i gdul zhing 'dir/ /ga shal rgyan can 'phags mas rjes bzung chos rgyal lo paṇa skar tshogs dbus/ /nga yi bla ma blo bzang grags de nya rgyas dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i zla/ / ca co mi mnga' ma 'dres grangs ldan zla med legs bshad srid pa'i mig / cha lugs zhi dul spyod pas nyer mdzes u pa li dang skabs phye dka'/ /ja mdangs li khri'i rba rlabs drag 'phyur rjes 'brang mkhas mang 'dus pa'i zil/ /nya yi tog ldan sder bcas ma bzod rim pa dgu yi 'og tu bros/ /ta tha ga ta'i gsang ba'i 27

mdzod 'dzin rgyal sras snying stobs chen po nyid/ /tha ma rab 'bring kha lag mnyam pa'i mi yis btums pa'i rgyal ba'i sku/ /da lta nas bzung kun gzigasago 'phang lag rtser reg pa de srid du/ /na rga 'chi ba'irte'ajigs chen ya ngas mnar yang khyod dran mi nyams mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar dri bral khrims kyis yid kyi yol go 9rtag tu gang / /pha rol 'gro la mi bzod snying brtse theg chen theg pa'i skas la 'dzegs/ /ba ris 'o bzho zla ba'i dgongs mthil mig stong bgrad pa'i lag nyal rtses/ /ma lusangargud pa'i ru sna stong 'dren gti mug 'khrul 'khor rdul du rlogs/ /tsatshotur rgyud sde 'byung ba dkon pa u dam wa ra'i me tog tshal/ /tsha zer brgya ldan thub pa'i nyi ma zhing 'dir gzhes bzhin 'dzum bkrol nas/ /dza ti'i 'khri shing rgyu yi theg pa bsung ldan rkang 'thung dang bsdebs te/ /wa ler bdag blo'i ra ge'agengs pa'i sngon med dga' bdes yid myos mdzod/ /zhwa mo gser mdog rtse mo rno zhing leb mo'i rna ring grub pa'i mtha'/ /za nyal 'gro 'dug don chung zong gi rin du 'jal ba'i blun po'i khyu/ /'a 'ur ngang la mi tshe mthar skyel mdo med mdo stor smyon pa'i rigs/ /ya mtshan yab rje'i shul bzhag legs bshad don ma go yang sngas la brtsigs/ /rwa rnon mkhar gdengs mchog thun dngos grub mdzod la dbang bsgyur lha mchog zhabs/ /la 'ur gus bsten 'jam mgon thugs bcud 'jam dbyangs zhal bcud legs gsung kun/ /sha rus zhig bar spong klog las kyis mtha' ru 'don kun yang srid kun/ /sa gsum bla ma 'jam dpal snying po 'jam dbyangs zhi khros rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /ha cang snyigs ma dgun gyi reg byas ha lo'i bkrag mdangs 'phrog pa'i dus/ /a ti sha yi phyag srol rma med a ru ljon pa'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /blo bzaborgyal ba rgyal ba'i legs gsung blo gsal dpyid gyur nyi ma che/ /nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du nam yang nub pa med par smon/ /kun gzigs rgyal mchog rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku tshe 28

mthar 'khyol bzhed don 'grub/ /kun snang snang mtha'i yang srid nyi gzhon gzhon nu'i grags pa mtha' ru khyab/ /khyab bdag bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa yab sras nyi zla zung gcig gis/ /thub bstan pad tshal dus kyi mthar yang nyams med skyong bas mdzes gyur cig /ces 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po la bstan pa'i snying bo gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa don dang ldan par 'khril te spel mar bsngags pa 'di ni/ deng dus kyi mkhas rlom mun pa mun nag gi nang du rna spu bsgyings te kha bshad kyi hung sgra dgod pa'i 'ug pa'i brtul zhugs can dag gi rna bar 'gro min dang mig la mdzes min lta don ci/ rang blo yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo'i mdzad rjes dang legs bshad la tshe rabs kyi phreng bar goms slad dang /skal mnyam gzur gnas re zung der bkri ba'i cha rkyen dang / gzhung byed pa po rang nyid ngo ma log par bdag cag gi mgon du byon pa/ 7'jam dbyangs bla ma rdo rje 'chang drug pa chen po thun mong snang tshod du nye zho med par dgung grangs don gcig tu phebs pa'i dga' ston dang / kun mkhyen drug pa chen po dgung grangs zhe dgu'i gegs sel du kun slong rnam par dkar ba'i mtshams sbyar te gcig 'thus su 'bul ba po ni/gus 'bangs gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am zla sring 'dzum pa'i lang tshor 'bod pas spyi lo 95rab rgyan 17shing phag lo'i smin zla 10pa'i tshes 25dge bar rma klung dal gyisdoṭa 'bab pa'i g.yas zur gar 'dug mtsho ldan mdun sa 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i gur khyim nas sbyar ba dza yan tu/ / 29

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chenarba la bstod ba 'jigs mdzad bzhadaya'i rol mo/༄7/ /na mo gu ru dza ya su ma ti kirti ya/ bcu drug bgrod byed cha tsam g.yo ba'i gar dang lhan cig dngos 'dzin rang gzugs gdon du langs pa'i dregs pa'i ra'/ ba sa la bting / /so bzhi'i 'dzin byed gan bub gzengs pa'i shes rab mtshon gyis ma bsnun par yang 'phar 'dar bdud sde'i don snying 'dzin ma'i phra ru bkod/ /dgu phrag yan lag dang po'i dkyil 'khor 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i rmongs pa des bskyed bdud dang dam sri'i zungs khrag dmigs med dbyings su rngub/ /khams gsum ma lus bde dang stong ba tha mi dad pu'i stobs kyis dbang bsgyur 'jigs pa mtha' dag 'jigs 5ra byed pas dge legs stsol/ /zhi ba'i lus can mkhyen gter gzhon nu gzhon nu'i nyams kyis sgeg pa gang / /ba spu gcig kyang g.yo 'gul med bzhin bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor cher 'khrugs te/ /mthing nag char sprin dus rlung rlung gis drag tu g.yo ba'i sku dkyil las/ /rdo rje'i me 'od 'od kyi dra bas gti mug smag rum bshigs la 'dud/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i gzi 'od stong phrag dus gcig 'bar ba'i ma he'i zhal/ /srid zhi ltag 'og gnam sa'i khyon yangs tshod 'dzin med par gdangs gyur ba'i/ /bde dang stong ba zung du 'jug pa'i dbugs kyi 'phro 'du gcig gis kyang / /'gro kun sku gsum gzhal med khang du mi ring yud kyis 'dren la 'dud/ /dmar nag me lce tshangs chen gnas mched bden gnyis rwa rtse mkhar gdengs pas/ /lus med sngo bsangs gting 30

mtha' ral ba'i drag shul rno myur zol sbyor gyis/ /tha mal snang zhen phra rags bdu da kyi srog gi rtsa ba snying gi gong / /cig car thal byung thog ltar 'bugs mdzad bdud sde'i gshed gyur de la 'dud/ /'jigs rung dus mtha'i me yi ral ba kham nag dud sprin 'phyur ba'i khyon/ /drag po'i dus rlung 'tshub ma'i shugs kyis stong ba'i dbyings su bskyod pa ni/ /lus med sngo bsangs tha gru'i khyon kun bsreg phyir cher 'bar bskal ba'i me/ /ci yang med rtse'i mig 'dzin tog tu 'phyo zhing khyab pa lta bur 'dud/ /char sprin kacig steng gnyis brtsegs 'dra ba'i grib so'i gnyer ma shig shig tu/ /g.yo ba'i brang dang ldir ba'i lto ba lhun stug mchog rab sa 'dzin ngos/ /mi rus rgyan dang khrag gi zhag snum thal chen tshom bus ngar blud de/ /byug pa'i sgrib g.yogs gzod nas bral ba mi sdug gcer bu'i sku la 'dud/ /zhe sdang ma lus stong chen chos sku'i dbyings rum mthon por rgyas btab phyir/ /phud kyi sgra sgrogs dkar nag ngag 'dab glog ltar 'khyug pa'i phrag bar nas/ / gnam sa bar lag 'thab pa'i dug rlangs reg gcod ral gri'i so rnon can/ /lto 'gro nag po'i mchod phyir thogs kyi 'jigs rung rgyan can khyod la 'dud/ /bdud dang log 'dren gdug can la sdigs sdigs mdzub gdengs pa'i gzi byin la/ /phyogs bcu'i stobs chen khro bo kun kyang kun nas sngangs shing 'dar gyur nas/ /phyag mtshan ma lus sa la dus gcig gcig tu 'chor ba'i 'jigs zil can/ /khro bo'i rgyal bo kun gyi dbang phyug dbang gis rnam par bsgyi ngas la 'dud/ /gsang ba'i ling ga ling ling gar bsgyur rnam par rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /drag po gau ri'i chung ma dang bcas khams gsum rnam rgyal mthu stobs kun/ /rdo rje'i me char rtsa ba rul ba'i rtsa sbur dang 'phrad gzhob sreg bzhin/ / thal ba'i rdul du brlag par mdzad la thal sbyar gzhi gsum gus pas 'dud/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla kun tu nga snyam khengs shing dregs pa yi/ /nga ros 'gengs pa'i lha chen 31

rnams kyang lus po sig sig 'dar gyur nas/ /tshugs mi thub par kha bubs 'gyel steng 'jigs pa med pa rdo rje'i bro/ /'khor mthar chem chem brdungs par mdzad pa'i 'khor ba'i 'dam las drangs la 'dud/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor mun pa brtsegs pa'i mchod sdong las byung zhugs 'phreng gis/ /nyams pa bdun ldan sdig can ma lus lhag med gzhom dang lhan cig tu/ /rnam 'byed mkhyen rab drag cing rtsub pa rdo rje'i me yi tsha tshas kyang / /rab rmongs lag pa brkyang bskums mi mthong mun pa'i 'phrul 'khor bshig la 'dud/ /rab snyan bzhi lhag drug cu'i dbyangs kyi yan lag kun tshang gsung gi gdangs/ /sdig can mi dang mi min 'byung bo'i rang phung gshed du babs gyur nas/ /'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor brtan mi tshugs par dum bu stong du gtor mdzad pa'i/ /drag po'i ha ha'i 'phrog byed stong gi gad rgyangs dus gcig sgrogs la bstod/ /zab zhi spros bral chos kyi dbyings dang gnyis min gcig tu ro gcig pa'i/ /bde chen thugs la yang dag mtha' las rnam kun bzhengs pa mi mnga' yang / /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' ru zhen pa'ijilog par 'dren pa ma lus pa'i/ /khong gi rkang dang snying gi khrag dron cig car rngub par mdzad la 'dud/ /de ltar rgyal kun ye shes lus can sems 'joms rmongs sel mkhyen gter dbang / /phyi nang phra rags lus 'joms gshin rje'i gshed du bzhengs pa 'jigs mdzad lha/ /lha mchog khyod la kha tsam min par snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /bdag la che gsal myur zab shes rab bzhi zung spobs pa'i gter mchog stsol/ /deng nas bzung ste phyi mtha'i bar gyi lus ngag yid gsum bya ba kun/ /kun tu gzigs pa lha mchog khyod kyi gsang ba gsum gyi nga rgyal la/ /la 'ur gnas te zhi dang dbang dang drag po'i rig sngags la 'bad na/ /na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa'i bcom par 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab stsol/ /mdor na 'di nas phyi ma'i tshe rabs rab dang rim pa thams cad du/ /32

blo bzang 'jam dpal zhi khros rjes bzung bka' sdod las gshin rnam gsum bcas/ /'bral med rtag tu brtse bas dgyes bzhin lus dang mgo bzhin rtag 'grogs mthus/ /sa gsum bla ma 'jam dpal snying po'i go 'phang dam par myur 'dzegs shog / ces byin rlabs legs tshogs spungs pa'i bang mdzod/mchog thun dngos grub brtsegs pa'i ba gam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la bstod pa 'jigs mdzad bzhad pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di'ang skye rabs phreng rgyud du lha mchog mi'i srid par zlos pa/ 7kun mkhyen bla ma sku 'phreng drug pa chen pos rma chu rdzong zhang khag tshor chibs zhal bsgyur skabs/ gus 'bangs gling sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i zla rgyan du 'bod pas spyi lo 95rab rgyan shing phag zla shrītshes 10la rang spyil 'jigs mdzad dgyes pa'i gur khang nas bris te phul ba bla ma blo bzang 'jam dpal zhi khros rnam kun rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ d+dhi baṭāng nājigāsasnredu snib gāstanā mkha' ru lung rtogs snros k+shi k+ṇi ṭā 'bar/ /mkhas btsun grub dz+wa'i g.yas 'khyil mtsho ru rigs smra 'bum gyi ngang mo rtsen/ /dbyāng rgyug brgyad ldan khri 'phang rgyan du zhabs sen zla ba'i lang tsho ngom/ /'jam dpal dbyangs can bzhad pa'i 'dzum zer skye kun gtsug dang mi 'bral smon / /33

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma labastod cingagasol ba rī 'debs pa'i rab tu byedapa bde chen lang tsho —rgyas pa'i sbrang chang zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru badz+ra wa ra hi/ in+d+ra ni la'i 'khri shing mjug brgya ba'i/ /lang tsho'i chang gis sbag pa'i kha sbyor sku/ /dran pa'i mod la snye ma'i bdag po'i mal/ /yud kyis zin mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal/ /chos dbyings kun khyab phang las glo bur du/ /dmar 'od ling ling rtse ba'i mtshams sprin gyis/ /'dod pa'i zur mdas bsnun na khyod dpe ru/ /'os pa rgyal yum dga' mas rnam kun skyongs/ /snang la rang bzhin bral ba 'ja' tshon lus/ /dmar snum byi ru'i sgeg mor langs pa'i 'phrul/ /'phrul ldan sgyu ma'i bu mo'i 'phrul 'khor 'dis/ /thub kun yid kyang ston mkha'i ba dkar gcung / /rjes chags lhan skyes dga' ba mchog gi thugs/ /sgrib bral yang dag mtha' las mi ldang yang / /mdzes sdug gcer mor 'gying ba'i phra ldem sku/ /srid zhi'i khyad nor bye ba'i tshang nas 'phur/ /bser bus ma bdas dbu skyes lan bu'i nags/ /sta gris ma gtub sil bur bkrol ba'i mtshan/ /mun pas ma byug stang zil gsar ba'i gos/ /byed pos ma bcos sked mtshams ltad mor bshams/ /gangs ri'i mdangs gsal mig kong mche ba bsnol/ /kha rgyan pa tra rtse rgyan chu gser phang / /mtshan dpe'i me tog 'dzum pa'i rigs lnga'i ris/ /mdangs lnga'i 'ja' tshon smad la khengs pa mtho/ /byur dmar lan brgyar phyis pa'i byad kyi 34

khyim/ /ut+pal 'dab mar 'phya ba'i rtse mo'i spyan/ /dag pa mkha' spyod phyogs gzigs zur gyi mda'/ /sgrub por 'phen 'di lus med drang 'gro'i lhag /mchu sgros pad+ma dmar bo'i lding khang nas/ /tshems phreng gangs ri'i bu mo phreng bsgrigs par/ /ljags 'dab bung ba'i 'phur lding gar dang lhan/ /gsang don rgyud mangs thos 'dzin dpyid du 'bebs/ /rab yangs brang ngos rab dog myos bum 'bur/ /rab rgyas phrag bar rab myos ze'u 'bru 'dar/ /rab phra'i sked par rab mangs lan tshar rtse/ /rab rmongs drungs 'byin rab mdzes dga' mas 'khyud/ /phyag zung glog gi gar ma'i yal 'dab rtser/ /'tham pa'i gri thod chags ldan gzhon nu'i snying / / yab mtshon kha ṭ+wāṃ phrag bkal mdzes pa dang / /'thab pas srid 'di'i dpal kun g.yang du len/ / pad nyir srid zhi'i mthar zhen dus dbang gi / nu ma mgo rgyab bltab pa'i dpral ba'i ngos/ / pad rag 'dren du drangs pa'i thabs shes zhabs/ /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i dbyings la rtag tu rol/ /ā li kā li dag pa'i skam po'i phreng / /'og pags nyil nyil bskyod pa'i dril chung sgra/ /dga' ba'i ba spu langs pa'i khyim ston pas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bde ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /la lar tha mal lcug ldan lang tshos 'grogs/ /lan rer sa dbang btsun mos yid sems 'gugs/ /rnam kun dngos med thogs bral dwangs ma'i lus/ //lhan skyes bde ba'i mal na rtag tu gzim/ /tsi nar gnam bskos sa yi tshangs pa'i snying / /bho ṭar bod rje btsan po'i phyag gi nor/ /lha yi me tog bang gi mkha'i pad+mo/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma dgyes pa'i gzungs mar ldem/ / de ltar leb mo'i lce yis lcogs tshod kyis/ /che ba lam tsam brjod nas da dung yang / /ka phreng dkrugs mar bsdebs pa'i phang 'gro'i glus/ / shas tsam gsol 'dir snyan gyi bu ga rkyongs/ / nga khyod med par kun la byams brtse'i rgyun/ /kha ba'i klung bzhin 'bebs pa'i rje btsun mar/ / ga ler rnam kun chad med gsol 'debs 35

na/ /ka ba'i ngang tshul ji bzhin rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /ca co 'khrul ba mi mnga' grags stong gsung / /ja 'dab rgyas pa'i dpal 'phrog snang stong sku/ /cha shas mtshan ma kun bral bde stong thugs/ /nya mo chu la 'khyug pa'i phyag gis bsu/ /da lta zab rgyas gdamasapa'i 'bru mdzod che/ /tha shal dus kyi byi ba'i nyal zos byas/ /na ro'i gsang mdzod mkha' spyod sgrub skor yangaka /ta re'i thugs rjes sked pa ma chad tsam/ /pa ra rnam par gnon pa'i gsung gi gdangs/ /ba 'o ltar mngar zab don sbrang ma'i chang / /pha rol smra 'dab g.yem ma myos pa'i glus/ /ma lus yid dbang 'phrog la rings pa cho/sa/ /tsha zer can dang rum byas chu skyes 'dzum/ /wa ler bzhad pa'i lhan skyes dri bsung gis/ /tsa ri tra sogs nyer bzhi'i bung ba'i khyu/ /dzaḥyig lcags kyus dbang med grogs su khug / zhwa kha dmar ser ru mtshon gzengs pa'i grwas/ /za ldan lus med mdzod kyi sbo/ phyes te/ /ya mtshan gces pa'i nor skalu phangs med du/ /'a cag lag tu byin pa'i gtam de rangs/ / sa dkar rdo tshar yab sras gral ring nyul/ /la li ta bar e waṃ dga' 'khyil sbug / ra me shwa ras steng 'thung mig yangs mas/ /sha 'jam reg bdes 'khyud bzhin 'dir yang mdzod/ /ha cang bstod pa lce yis mi khrol kyang / /a mṛ ta yi yon tan lhun rdzogs mar/ /ha las ngang nas cung zad bsngags pa'i dges/ /a thung nges don dga' ma'i zhal mthong shog / ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa bde chen lang tsho rgyas pa'i sbrang chang zhes bya ba 'di'ang spyi lo kha6rab gnas me byi zla ṭ+wāṃtshes 10la ṭā ki ma bde chen gsal ba'i sgron me'i bzhed skong du 7 gsang don smra ba'i ljags 'dab cung zad yangs pa mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni tshul gnas aṣ+pe sa ras bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i zhal bzang mngon du 'gyur par shog cig gu / 36

dranganges rnam 'byed la bstod pa zla sring mgrin khrim rtsen pa'i rangasgra/ na mo gu ru badz+ra tik+ṣa ya/ 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i rtse phran rtse/ /gser zhun gser 'od chags pa'i cod paṇa 'phrul/ /bstan te bstan pa'i bdag por slar bzhengs pa/ / rgyal ba rgyal ba'i dbang por lan brgyar 'dud/ /blo bzang legs bshad srid na dkon pa'i rnor/ /snying po'i dwangs bcud snying la byo ba'i gtam/ /dri za'i na chung ngag 'dab bkug pa'i gdangs/ /'di 'dra mes po'i ngag las gzhan sus thon/ /'og ma'i grub mtha'i blo yis ma reg pa'i/ /thal 'gyur dgongs don mchog rab lhun po'i khar/ /sangaso bskyangs zla bar bgro gleng byed 'dod tshe/ /legs bshad them skas 'di med thabs cis bgrod/ /sher mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel mdo yi don/ /klu thogs lung zin shing rta'i thugs kyi mthil/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal chab gaṅgā'i klung / /'thung te slar bskyugs legs bshad legs lam mig/srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /mthar 'dzin gdung ba 'phrog byed bsil ba'i char/ /blo gros pad+mo 'byed la nyi ma'i 'od/ /skal ldan rma bya'i rna bar dbyar rnga'i grogs/ /yongs 'dzin blo gter nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /dbu sems gzhung brgya'i gong 'og sham bu g.yo/ /lung rigs rtsibs mas bkyag pa'i rgya khyon can/ /legs bshad rin chen gdugs 'di srid zhi'i rgyan/ /rma snyogs zab yangs 'phags bod gzhung gi mtsho/ /rnam 'byed gser mig 'khyug pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /ngam nag dgag sgrub rlabs lce 'thab pa'i 37

phang / /zab don khyad nor spungs 'dis 'dod pa 'jo/ /smra ba'i rgyal po'i nyin bzhin gdams pa'i bcud/ /ma god thugs gsang bum par bsdus pa'i zil/ /yi ge'i ris su 'khyil ba'i gzhung 'di ko / 'phral yun skom pa sel ba'i mkhar nyal chu/ /rgyan drug gzhung chen phyogs su 'khyil ba'i grwar/ /thun min khyad chos brgyad kyi 'dab ma'i bar/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i ge sar lang tsho can/ /gzhung mchog pad+ma dkar po'i 'khri shing brjid/ /snga rabs dran dbang 'bum gyi sgra'i khron par/ /rmi lam na yang ma son skye med don/ /mthar 'dzin rim 'phrog bden don dung gi dbyangs/ /sa gsum yid brtan 'phrog pa'i dri za'i glu/ /tshul gnyis shing rta'i bzhed gzhung rin chen gyis/ /yongs gtams thugs gsang dpal be'uzhi me long las/ /rtogs pa'i mtshar gzugs 'bum 'char glegs bam 'phrul/ /dpyod ldan mig yangs lan bu'i tshal na rtse/ /phas rgol glang bo stong gi myos bum 'bur/ /lung rigs 'phrog byed dar ma'i ngar skad kyis/ /tshal bar 'gas pa'i gzhung bzang rgyal mtshan gyi/ /dpal yon srid na mtho 'dis yid rab dwangs/ /ma rtogs grwa zur med pa'i mu khyud nang / /dpyad gsum dag pa'i gser sbyangs rtsibs stong gis/ /som nyi'i ra ri gcod pa'i gzhung chen gyi/ /'khor lo srid mthar bsgyur la slar yang gus/ /de ltar yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo yi/ /legs bshad snying por cung zad bstod pa'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu yab rje'i legs bshad 'phreng / /mgrin pa'i rgyan du 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog /ces 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po'i thugs kyi bcud byung ba'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba la cung zad bsngags pa zla sring mgrin khyim rtsen pa'i rang sgra 'di'ang spyi lo kha6rab rgyan 17me byi zla ṭ+wāṃtshes 15la 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs 7gling sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung ngag gi me tog tu'ibod pas sbyar sda dza yachu/38

thun min chos skyong chen po la bstod pa 'chi bdag bzhad pa'igad rgyangs zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ru dza ya su ma ti kirti ya/ two chen kun bzung nyi ma gzhon nu'i grags p+ta nam mkha'i mtha' la 'khril/ /'jirngogs dz+wad dazom pa'i rdos kyi ba dan srid pa'i sa 'dzin tog tu btsugs/ /༵ga daṭāng dbyāngs ldan mgrin par bsus pa'i ngag ṭīg khu byug myos ma'i gdangs/ /gdangs su 'gugs p+ta'i 'phral yun 'asprod 'asnro 'gro khams rnya mardo'i 'dren pa rgyal/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug rwa rtse rnon po chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i mkhar/ /brtse chen nyin byed bye bas 'khyud pa'i mtshams sprin ral ba'i gdengs ka rkyongs/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i dmar zlum 'dren byed dug gsum gdug pa'i mel tshe ba/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bka' nyan pho nya mun pa brtsegs pa'i mchod sdong rgyal/ /gti mug mun pa'i ba gam 'jig byed mche rnon gangs ri'i mtshon cha'i sbubs/ /ljags dmar dus mtha'i zhugs kyis bzung bas nyams pa'i srog dbugs dus gcig tu/ /stong chen chos sku'i dbyings su rngub pa'i khro 'khrug bzhad pa'i ma te'i gdong / /mig gi bdud rtsir lan gcig 'thung bas 'og min them skas yud kyis 'dzegs/ /mig sman mdangs chags lto ba'i dkyil 'khor lto 'gro nag po'i do shal 'khyug / zung gnyis 'dzin byed dbyug to ral gri lcags sgrog sbrul zhags mtshan mas brjid/ /sku dkyil sngo bsangs dga' ma'i tha grur rus rgyan rgyu skar tshom bur rtse/ /khyod nyid rnam kun skyabs su bsten bdag byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan mdzod/ /gsang 39

ba'i ling ga drag tu 'greng bas bde chen lang tsho ches cher 'bar/ /sbrul rigs phyag zhabs gdu bur bcings bas ye shes rang mdangs lhag par rgyas/ /zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskums gar gyis 'gyings pas srid zhi'i dregs ldan 'gyings bag smad/ /khyod dran de tshe mtha' bral lta ba mthar 'dzin mthar byed mtshon rnon stsol/ /sna tshogs pad nyir nyams pa bdun ldan zhing bcu'i dgra bo'i mi sdug gzugs/ /'dam ltar brdzis pa'i sar nyal steng na mun pa'i gos gyon lhun po bzhin/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bka' gtsigs rdo rje phrag tu lci ba'i bstan srung khyod/ /dran tshe nges 'byung tshul khrims dag pa'i g.yar dam sde mo snying la phris/ /srid zhi'i mdzes sdug snying bor chags kyang mi sdug gzugs kyis sa gsum dngangs/ /sgrub po dkyus ring zur mdas bsus kyang dgra la khrag mig gzegs ma tsub/ /zag med bde ster pad+ma rgyas kyang sbas don sna rtse'i ze'u 'bru phra/ /gsang ba'i yum chen ma mo zung gis legs nyes 'byed pa'i drang thig mdzod/ /rab rnon rtse gsum nyams pa'i srog rtsa rtswa rul lta bur gcod la rno/ /bde skyong thod khrag khrag gi zham chu chu rgyun lta bur 'khyil la yangs/ /khartsosbyor bdun ldan zung 'jug khyad nor nor du skyug pa'i ni'u le/ /'tshir ba'i yum mchog mchog zung gnyis la la 'ur dang ba'i sems kyis 'dud/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma 'jam dpal snying po'i lugs bzang dri med lugs mchog dang / /'jam dbyangs legs bshad 'jam dpal zhal chab dri bral lung rigs dri zhim can/ /'jam mgon zhabs skyes 'jam pa'i chu skyes snying la 'dab brgyad snying po bzhin/ /'di nas bzung ste 'di snang 'gag mthar yang srid phyi mar yang mjal shog / ltadu dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung zab gusrung rtogs pa klong du gyur/ /nyi ri'i bsung 'thul blo bzang legs gsung ngag lta ngag gi dpal du chags/ /naXg sdo brtsegs pa'i ri bo ltar brjid lha mchog mchogagi lhar brten na/ /rtswagagasum des bskyed ni mo'i 40

mtshon ltar ltar snang nāg༈'i phyogs pham mdzod/ /sgrub pa'i shing rta kril ldun nyer 'tshor rkang ba badh+wad pya lta bur brjid/ /ldu bh+yaḥXbazhi byā dge ldan snyan brgyud dga' tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan du lham/ /rījam dāpal zla sring lhan du 'thab pa'i gtsag rgyan nor ba srid na 'tsher/ /bdag kyang skye ba'i phreng ba raX cas cesakun tu 'jam dbyangs zhi khros rjes 'dzin byos/ / ces thun min chos skyong chen po la bstod pa 'chi bdag bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs ces bya ba 'di'ang 'jam dbyangs zhi khro bka' sdod dang bcas par ring mo zhig nas mchog tu mos pa'i ldom bu ba/7 gling sprul ming 'dzin skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am 'jigs mdzad dgyes pa'i ral grir 'bod pas dgos dbang zhig la brten nas rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus tshes dge bar bris pa bka' srung dgyes pa'i snyan shal du gyur cig gu/ / / tsho41

ba riyo tsā ba'i pho rgyus kyi don 'grelasnyan tshig byu ru'i zhagizhibazhasabyab / ༄7/ /bla ma dang rgyal yum rig byed dbang mo dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/ / 7dge legs yongs 'du'i dga' tshal yangs par sor rtog ye shes sgeg mo'i gar/ /byu ru'i 'khri shing mtshan dpe'i me tog dpal gyis yongs bzung sdug gu ma/ /dpag bsam yid kyi 'dod pa kun 'jo re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /srid zhi'i mdzes gzugs dga' mar ldem pa rgyal yum rig byed dbang mos skyongs/ /khyod mtshan dri yi gos can sman mchog su yis lan gcig bzung tsam gyis/ /mi bzad dus ring rgud pa'i sbrul gdug lnga ba'i lam du mthar byed na/ /ngo mtshar gsang gsum yon tan mtha' dag rna ba'i bcud du grub pa yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub bye ba'i dga' ston gegs med rgyas pa smos ci 'tshal/ /mthun pa'i dri bzhon dal bur g.yo ba'i tshul dang mthun par rjes 'gro yang / /dus las cung zad yol ba med pa rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs bzhin/ /'gog med rgyal dang de sras bcas pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyang / /gdul bya gang na ji ltar bdog pa'i bsod nams mthu dang lhan cig spyod/ /sngon tshe 'dzam bu gling zhes grags pa'i ba dan mngon mtho gling gi mchog / blo ldan skye bo skal ba bzang po gcig min du ma rol ba'i sa/ /rgyal bo'i khab sogs grong khyer drug gi 'dab ma g.yo ba'i rgya gar yul/ /chos srid 42

dri bzang phyogs su rdzogs pa'i lta na sdug pa'i skyed tshal na/ /grags pa phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung sa dbang lhan skyes rol ba zhes/ /rab dkar bsod nams mu khyud rab mtho sde bzhi'i lang tsho dar drags pas/ /rang sar snyems pa'i rgyal phran bye ba'i lugs zung lan bu'i 'dab ma la/ /gser sbyangs rkang gdub sil sgra sgrogs pa'i 'khor 'gro'i nye bar rtsen pa byung / /dga' ba brgya ldan lha chen drung na dpal gyi g.yang 'khyil dpal mo'am/ /zla ba'i cod paṇa bde 'byung mdun sar gangs ri'i bu mo gangs mdangs bzhin/ /de yi btsun mo gnang chen zla bzhin phul byung dga' ma'i phul gyur ma/ /sa chen yangs pa'i rgyal khams skyong ba'i grogs su legs byas grogs kyis thob/ /dga' ma de yi mdzes sdug gzugs ni thig le mchog mar mchog dman bral/ /rab snyan ngag gi bre 'gyur dbyangs ni mtsho ldan rgyud mangs rgyud las snyan/ /mnyes gshin thugs kyi dkyel yangs mtha' ni sngo bsang tha grur tha mi dad/ / phongs pa'i 'gro la gtong ba'i phyag ni gser shing yal 'dab yal ga'i spun/ /'on kyang lan tshwas sbags pa'i chu bo lan mang 'thung zhing skom pas gdung / /nags kyi me lce rlung gis 'bar zhing me yi phreng ba mched pa ltar/ /'dod ldan 'dod pa'i yul gyis bkug pas sems pa nam yang ngoms bral bas/ /mdzes sdug mdzes ldem lang tshos myos pa'i bu mo gzhan yang khab tu bsus/ /snga ma ma ral gsar ba'i gos la 'phyor sgeg sgeg mo'i mtshar du brtsi/ /gzhal med rin bral nor bu'i rgyan yang dus yun ring na ring du 'dor/ /mtshar sdug yid gcugs mdzes ma'i grogs kyang 'grogs yun dal na dal bur spang / /e ma srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' la yid brtan brtan pa'i nges pa ci/ /me tog phreng mdzes snga ma ma snyigs me nā ka yi rgyan 'os kyang / /gsar ba gsar ba'i rgyan cha 'dogs la gsar mo dga' ba chos nyid bzhin/ /rgyal bu dga' ba'i yid kyi shing rta rta mchog 'gros las bang skyen pa/ /smin legs na chung gsar ba'i 43
