phyogs su su yis 'gog thabs mede parane+elhung / /dge ma chags bral drag po'i dka' thub thub par dka' ba'i mya nga na la/ /nan gyis sbyor ba'i thub pa ji bzhin bzhin gyi phun tshogs nyams bzhin du/ /mi dbang 'dod pa'i zla ba chu shel shel ltar bsil ba'i reg bya las/ /gnang chen btsun mor gdung ba'i me char char bzhin tsub pa'i na zug spros/ /chagasapa ma spangs chags bral dang blang btson rar chudalapa'i btson bus min/ /'dod yul shas cher 'dod pa'i zhugs kyis yid gdungs bud shing me yisangamin/ /dus btab ma tshogs dus ring 'gyang ba'i sdug bsngal nad kyi zug jus min/ /'khor ba'i gnas su 'khor ba de srid 'dod pa dka'abyuzhing mi 'dod rnyed/ /des kyang kye ma chun ma'i ming can drang srong dmod pa'i ma7mo 'di/ /rna ba'i rjes skyes rwa rtse ji bzhin bdag gi gong du brgal lo snyam/ /yidal zug rngu'i kun rtog pir gyis yeng yang bris pa'i mtshan ma ltar/ /rab dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i bzhin la nag nog ra ri'i dri ma chags/ /de tshe de la 'bangs mo'i tshul can blo ldan blo yi 'dab grol mas/ /chen mar blangs pa'i bu mo 'di ni khyod la gnod pa'i khyab bdag min/ /nyid kyi bde dang mi bde'i gnas skabs bya ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum la/ /dbang bsgyur sa bdag rgyal bo gang nyid dbang du sdud pa'i thabs bya 'os/ /mi min rgyu ba lha min 'dre yi tshong 'dus kun tu btsal byas na/ /de lta'i rig sngags zab mo shes pa'i rig 'dzin ma'ang yod dam snyam/ /gdung ba'i yid dang khong du chud pa'i sems kyis phongs pa mi sel bas/ /brtan pa skyed cig bdag ni mi ring de yi ched du sgogro'o zhes/ /smras te tshong 'dus 'dus tshogs mang ba'i srang du khad kyis byin pa na/ /mig yangs bu mo cung zad ngo 'dzum dar babs lang tsho tshad babs shing / /lus kyi sha rgyas brjid bag dang ldan chu 'dzin 'o 'dzin rgyas pa can/ /ras bzang dmar bo'i oṃrag bkrag can lus la tshul dang ldan par bgos/ /g.yas na seng ldeng dmar 44

bo'i 'big byed lcug phran yal 'dab sor mos gsor/ /g.yon na 'od ma bkug pa'i gnam ru lhun chags sku yis rten byed pa/ /rigs lnga'i nang nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i rtags mtshan lhag dang bcas pa zhig / 'dren byed yul gyur gtam gyi go skabs thog bar dal bus gleng ba na/ /gnyis ka'i 'dod pa'i gdams zab yod par rnam nur bral ba'i yid ches te/ /re ba'i gtam snyan 'brug gi sgra dbyangs bdag mo mdongs mthar gsol ba yi/ / mngon dga' rgyas pa bsam gtan bde bas mi 'gran mod la rig 'dzin ma/ /pho brang khab tu phu dud dang bcas dal min nye bar spyan drangs te/ /chen po la 'osartsobakur ste rnyed pa kun bzang sprin gyis rab mchod rucing / /nang gi rang bzhinatshochu nang rde'u bzhin sgrib med gsal ba'i gdung shugs kyis/ / sa yi dbang phyug 'dug mi tshugs par dbang du byed pa'i cho ga ni/ /yang dag mdzod ces gcig min lan mang nan tan chen pos snyan du gsol/ /snying la sdug pa'i rig 'dzin ma des rig sngags 'ga' tsam btab pa yi/ /'bras chan sha kha ra dang bcas pa'i mngar gsum zas kyi snying po zhig /lag tu gtad de sa bdag rgyal bor 'di ni tshom med sbyin mdzod dang / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin thogs pa med par 'grub ces bdag mo de la gdams/ /phral la dbang med chags pas drangs kyang phugs sems zab pa'i mnyes gshin gyi/ /gzhung bzang phyi thag 'grog yun ma dor g.yon mig ma des rgyal bo'i skur/ /gnod kyis dogs pa'i zangs kyi sgrom bu so sor dbye dka'i kha sbyar du/ /dam por bcug nas pho brang gam 'khyil nye ba'i gting ring mtsho la bskyur/ /de ru gnas bcas gnyug mar gnas pa klu yi rgyal bo rgya mtsho skyong / /las dbang btsan po'i lcags kyis bskul ba'i sngags btab bza' ba de mthong zhing / /sred pa'i 'ching zhags dam pos bcings pa'i de la nye bar longs spyad tshe/ /dbang byed dga' ma'i sngags kyis bskul bas ma tshugs mi yul bgrod snying 45

'dod/ /de yi srod nas gdengs can bdag po mi dbang gzugs su rol ba yis/ /mtshan re bzhin du nye bar btud cing dga' ba'i dngos po kun gyis bstabs/ /des kyang rang gi bdag por 'khrul bas rtse dga' nyasas su myong ba las/ /dga' dang sdug bsngal brgya yi snodagyur srid pa skye ba'i mngal khur bzung / /de tshe khyab 'jug lha min dpung la 'khrugs shing khros pa'i nga ro can/ /sa gzhi skyong ba smin 'khyo ga g.yo ldan gtum zhing drag pa'i rgyal bo yis/ /rnam pa gcig min du mar bsdig4shing su dang gang la rgyus med pa'i/ /nal bu pha ma'i rigs gnyis sun 'byin tshul lugs min pa 'di ni ci/ /'bangs kyi phun tshogs yar zla'i byin dang 'grogs pa rgyal bo la gnas shing / /rgyal bo'i dpal ni khyo rigs btsun zhing ma 'chal gtsang ma'i rigs laltos/ /dpal dang phun tshogs ma lus rim min cig car 'joms pa'i phra men ma/ /'di ni mi ring chad6pa dra ga pos lus ngag yid gsum brlag par 'os/ /bkra mi shis pa'i sna nag ma 'di rna bas tho4kyang mi spro na/ /'dren byed lam du mthong ba lta ci 'gyangs min da lta khowā ru/ /'jig rten 'di ru snang ba min pa'i lnga ba'i lam du sgrol cigaces/ /drag po'i chad pa mkha' dbyings chag pa'i gnam rdo'i dum bu bzhin du babs/ /de nas skrag pas ci bya gtol med bzhin gyi me long mdangs nyams shing / /zi nag 'od ldan skud pa'i skra grol mchi ma'i thigs phreng do shal cas /rdzun min bden pa'i yus kyis 'dar pas dal med brtsegs pa'i dbugs 'tshang ba/ /mya ngan gyis non gdung ldan btsun mos snying nas zhu ba 'di ltar phul/ /kye ho zla ba'i phreng ba 'di snyed mtshan gyi 'khor lo re re bzhin/ /brtse ba'i thugs dang dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa nam yang ma chad na/ /de ring shin tu lugs dang mi mthun tshul dang mi ldan bsnyon 'ding ba/ /'di ltar mdzad pa ma dā na yis khyod thugs myos te ma 'khrul lam/ /'bangs kyi phun tshogs dar ram min pa 46

sa dbang rgyal por gnas pa yang / /de yi bka' khrims nya ga ji bzhin yo med gtsang ma'i drin las yin/ /nyes med nyam chung skyabs med bdag la tshod med thub chos 'di 'dra na/ /chab srid yangs pa'i bka' khrims snyoms bkye gru char gzegs ma gang du song / /nyam chung bdag ni zam 'og chu ltar khyod kyi dbang gyur 'bangs mo ste/ /lhan skyes lus 'di so sor phral nas dum bur gtub kyang khyod nyid dbang / /'on kyang rgyal gsung las dang 'bras bu'i bden pa nam yang mi 'chol zhing / /dus gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan ldan lha yi dgongs pas mi khrel lam/ /ces pa shar dang nub kyi ri ltar bar thag ring ba'i 'gal ba'i tshig / de nyid thos tshe blon 'bangs sder bcas shin tu’ha las ngo mtshar zhing / /'jam min cher rtsub khro bas 'khrugs pa gtum drag sa bdag rgyal bo yang / /skad cig nyid du thag chod dka' ba'i rtse gnyis the tshom khyogs la 'phyang / /dwangs khrag byug pa'i dmar ba'i bzhin ldan mchu yi sgros pad rab bsdams shing / /khro zhing 'gyu ba'i mig 'bur glog zhags stong dbyings mkha' la cher bgrad nas/ /thung min ring zhig bsam blo btang nas mjug mthar mdang gi mtshan mo yang / /kho bo khyod gam 'ong ngam zhes ni rig ldan ma der nan tan dris/ /des kyang zob dang g.yo sgyu med par gtan tshigs bcas te gsol ba na/ /khyod kyi smra ba drang bden yin tshe deng yang sngar bzhin 'ong ba'i rigs/ /de tshe —de yis nye bar spyad pa'i dngos po che phra ci rigs zhig / ma nyams zungs dang da ko don 'di bden min gsal bar 'gyur zhes smras/ /srod la mi bdag zol brdzus ltar snang snang bzhin stong ba de 'ong bar/ /bden min sgyu ma'i gzugs su snang yang ci mi snyam par bden bden ltar/ /lhan cig 'grogs pa'i rtse dgas dga' ba'i dga' ston nyams su myang ba na/ / bcos gzugs de yi rin bral sor gdub don ldan dgos pa'i don du blangs/ /pho brang 'khor yug rgyanaspyophreng rgya chen gzhal dka' nor 47

bu'i bye brag kun/ /mog mog por byed 'bar ba'i gzi 'od 'od tshogs 'thab pa'i bkrag mdangs can/ /dri med nor bu'i phra tshom spungs pa'i 'gran med sor gdur+pā de bstan pas/ /rgyal po 'byor bas snyems pa'i khengs pa yud tsam yun la thung ngur byas/ /de mthu mthong pas sngangs shing skug pa chabs gcig 'dres pa'i ngo tsha dang / /rang gi spyod pa 'khrul ba'i gnongs dang sngar byas nyes pas 'gyod pa sogs/ /'du shes sna tshogs g.yo bas dri bzhon dus rlung drag po'i rjes 'gro bas/ /mi dbang brtan pa gcig sar mi sdod shing bal 'phur ba'i gnas su bkod/ /e ma khyod ni rnam sad lha yi grogs mo mi yul 'phos pa ste/ /lag pa'i mthil reg bsam 'phel nor bu blun zhing rmongs pa bdag ges bor/ /lha chen sum rtsen dga' zhing bde ba'i lam nas ci dgar ma bgrod par/ /kho bo'i khab 'dir bag phebs bzhugs pa dga' ma khyod ni thugs rje che/ /nang gi rang bzhin nyi ma'i rdzas bzhin gsal bar mngon du ma gyur ba'i/ /phral la gang byung zla bzhin ma yi so phreng bstan pa'i 'dzum zer gyis/ /gna' bo'i dus nas da bar slu ba 'dod ldan spyi yi ngang tshu la te/ /bdag la deng nas 'khon 'dzin dgongs khrel til tsam med pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ /ces ni snying nas bzod par gsol ba'i sprin dkar g.yo 'dra'i rnga yab rtses/ /khro ba'i yid kyis 'phur lding 'dres ma'i sgra ldan sbrang bu bsal ba dang / /lhan cig mnyes gshin yid 'bab tshig gi chun pos blangs pa'i bsang gtor gyis/ /sngon goms chags pas 'bar ba'i4kun rtog rab tu bsil ba'i go skabs phye/ /mchu sgros mngar ba'i sbrang rtsis myos pa'i zim zim mig gi bung ba g.yo / /'jam mnyen sor mo'i pad 'dab phreng ba 'o 'dzin rgyas pa'i ze'u 'brur zim/ /mu tig dkar po'i do shal gzhan mtshungs bde drod dngul chu'i thigs phreng can/ /khyo shug phan tshun mdza' ba'i rtse dga' nam yang gtong min skal bzang myong / /dben pa'i mal du glo nyal kha brda sos dal gleng ba'i 48

'bel gtam las/ /ngo mtshar gsang gsum bye ba'i gter grol rig sngags rgyal mo'i mthu mthong ste/ /dge ma khyod kyis nam 'phang mtho ba'i sngon bsags legs byas skal pa yis/ /bdag kyang rgyal yum bcom ldan ma dang mi ring myur du mjal srid dam/ /zhes smra de tshe bsod nams mthu brtas sa yi dbang phyug bzhed pa bzhin/ /ri dwags mig can lha gcig btsun mo'i snyan 'jam tshig gi mtshams sbyor gyis/ /rig 'dzin dbang mo rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khab tu nye bar spyan drangs te/ /'dud pa sngon byas yid mthun 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin gyis bar med gtibs/ /de yi byin rlabs yongs 'du sa brtol kho lag rgyas pa'i sa bone ni/ /sa skyong thugs kyi sna tshogs chu skyes skye rung do rar smin pa las/ /nyams rtogs dpag bsam ljon pa'i khyon yangs mkha' dang mnyam par brdal ba'i rtser/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i dkar dmar me tog srid pa'i pha mthar ci yang bzhad/ /ma rgyud dung phyur bye ba phrag drug rtsa bshad saṃ brtag gur gsum sogs/ /bla med sbas chu'i ngam nag rgya mtsho'i 'jings gnas dri med nor bu'i dpya/ /'di yi man ngag klong du gyur ba'i ded dpon gru gzings mchog gi mthus/ /skal bzang 'jig rten yangs pa'i 'gro ba'i zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod gyur/ /byur dmar gser zhun cod paṇa mdangs 'dres rim byung brgyud pa'i thugs bskyed kyis/ /sa bon grung bo dbyig 'dzin dga' mas gar khyab lto bar nar son pa'i/ /zab don stong gi bkrag bsung 'thab pa'i ut+pal gsar ba'i dga' tshal rum/ /bag phebs ngal bso'i dbugs 'byin thob 'di gzhan min mtshungs med bla ma'i drin/ /dkon mchog bstan la phyag rjes zab pa'i chos kyi sgron me zhi dbyings su/ /re zhig gzhol mthar 'jigs med thugs bskyed mkha' la rtag rtsen nyi zla zung / /bstan pa'i dpal du dus gcig shar bas pad tshal ku mud 'thab pa'i kha/ /phye tshe dbang mo'i gdams zab sbrang rtsis kho bo'i yid bum ci yang phyug /49

'jigs bral dri med dung zla'i 'dzum bag 'gro mang bde 'byung ral ba'i rtser/ / rnam kun chags pa'i skal bas mi gtong bstan pa'i dpal du cher 'tsher te/ /dbang lung man ngag ga bur thigs pa'i rdul snyed slob tshogs rgyud phyug nas/ /zung 'jug sa la skar mda'i rjes 'gror ma gyur de srid bzhugs pa gnad/ /skye ba'i phreng par khyod zhabs bsten dang khyod gsung nyan pa los kun gyi/ /mchog tu bzung ste nor bzang rtag ngu'i snying stobs sa 'dzin phrag blangs na/ /sku bzhi'i grong du ngal bso bgyid par sdug pa'i ma yis bu bzhin du/ /dgyes brtse'i phyag gis 'dzin pa'i skal ba bskal ba'i mthar yang bsnyel mi 'tshal/ /bzang po'i legs smon dar la babs pa'i bcu drug cha gang skye bo la/ /rkyen ngan kun khebs mun pa'i dpung yang 'od dkar gsal ba'i grogs su 'gro/ /srid 'byor kun dga'i la kha'i na bun rjes bsnyegs 'ching bu tshol ba'i sar/ /nges legs zung 'jug gdengs ka bdun pa'i gtsug rgyan bsam 'phel nor bu rnyed/ /e ma 'di lta'i ngo mtsher gtam gyi rgyud mangs dus mthar brdungs pa yang / /skal ba bzang rgu'i rtse ru 'dzegs snyam dga' spros ches cher g.yeng ba yi/ / smra mkhas dbyangs can bye ba'i snyems 'phrog dge dbang dpa' po'i rigs sras zhig /shugs 'byung mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur 'a di 'khri shing yal 'dab lhag ma'i lhag / rmad byung gdams ngag brgyud pa'i byung ba 'od 'tsher mu tig gsar ba'i 'bru/ / /sgro skur dman lhag gzu lum nya phyis lcibs kyis nam yang ma bslad par/ /sdeb legs phul byung tshig gi phrengari bar rnam dpyod sor mos spel pa 'di/ ma god ma bri rnal 'byor ma mchog mnyes pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gu / 7ces khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'gag med longs spyod 'khor lo'i sbubs las shar mar rdol ba rdo rje'i tshig gi do ha'i don 'grel snyan tshig byu ru'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di'ang khong gi dgongs pa'i gtad so ji bzhin 'tshal dka' na'ang lo rgyus kyi babs ang ka ma 50

'khrugs par nyid kyi gsung gzhir bzhag tshig cung zad je rgyas su btang yang gsung byin rlabs can gyi tshig dngos brgyud ci rigs kyis ma chad pa'i khul byas/ yul bab dang bstun pa'i tshigs bcad re zung gsar bsnan bcas/ mgon po de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rang gzugs de ma thag pa bdag cag gi mgon du byon pa/ 7 mtshan brjod par dka' ba rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs bla ma rdo rje 'chang drug pa chen po bka' drin gzhal mtha' med pa gang gi sku tshe yun brtan/ mdzad 'phrin yar rgyas/bzhed don lhun grub bcas la ched dmigs kyis spyi lo 94rab gnas shing khyi'i bod zla 7pa'i yar tshes bzang por mgon po gang gi bka' drin gyis rnam kun 'tsho ba'i dge sbyong gi gzugs brnyan dwa ri dra 7gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i zla rgyan rig byed dga' ba'i lang tshor 'bod pas— gar 'dug mtsho rmen mdun sa nas bris shing / zla de'i mar ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i nyin mjug grub par bgyis pa bla ma rig byed dbang mos skye kun rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /7'jigs bral lung gi snye ma rab mtho lus med sngo bsangs lan bur 'khyud/ /bstan la phan pa'i mdzad bzang yal ga khyon yangs sa chen tha grur g.yo/ /'phrin las dbang gi me tog 'dzum pas bsung zhim brtan g.yo'i lan bur 'dzegs/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal gyis phyug pa'i byu ru'i 'khri shing a ho rmad/ 51

rlabs dkar bu mo mdzes ma we na si'i lang tsho'i metog la cungawad jisngagasab 'dod spyos bud ba'iyid 'dzin/ rdzo li khri'i char gyis sbags pa'i gzugs sku'i lhun/ / lhun stug mtshan dpe'i me tog spungs pa'i dpal/ / dpal stug sku yis mtshon min ngag gi lha/ /lha mchog snying gi ga 'ur rtag rol mdzod/ /'dod pa'i 'khri shing chu gter dga' mar bsnun pa'i sngon med zla ba'i gdong ldan ma/ /—'dod ldan yid 'gugs dkar 'jam lang tsho'i lcug phran sngon med pad+ma rnam rgyas ma / /'dod myos yid la dus ring 'thibs pa'i mun 'joms sngon med nyin byed na chung ma/ /'dod bral rgyal dang de sras bskrun pa'i yum gyurabyu sngon med zla mdzes me tog ma/ /'jig rten khams kyi sgra dbyangs gcig 'dus nas/ /dga' ma'i lus su langs pa'i smin legs ma/ /be+eḍūr pi wang brdung la dga' ba mo/ /ro 'dzin thang du rtsen la ngag mdud shigs/ /gang gi gsang gsum sgyu ma bye ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs 'dzin khyim du lhung ba'i ngo mtshar gzugs/ /gzugs legs yi ge'i ris su shar ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs su grub 'dis dga' ba mi skyed su/ /bsam med se'u bcus smras pa'i nges med ngag /thos mang thos 'dzin dpal du mi che yang / /skal mnyam deng rabs gzhon nu na mnyam tshos/ /rna ba'i ut+pal byed la ci cha yod/ /ces shis tshig khu byug mgrin glus sngun bsus te gang gleng na/ nyi zla'i rna cha ngom pa'i sngo bsangs dga' ma'i zhabs/52

mar gad khu bas byug pa'i dbyibs mdzes ri bo'i bar/ bsil dwangs dri ma med pa'i zab yangs rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ chu skyes mgo lcog ldem pa'i rkang 'thung phreng ba'i grib/gtsang chab lhung lhung 'bab pa'i ngos 'jam brag ri'i zom/ lha dang grub pas bsten pa'i rang byung phug pa'i rum/ mdangs lnga'i dar zab smad pa'i dbang gzhu'i ri mo'i gur/ /ne co'i sgro thul lhod pa'i 'jam ljang g.yu lo'i gdan/ mig la ya mtshan ltad mo dri za'i bu mo'i 'khor/ thos 'dzin sim pa'i myos pa'i rnar snyan yid 'bab glu/yid la bde ba'i mchog ster phun tshogs 'byor ba'i dpal gang yang ma tshang ba med pa/ci yang mig la snang ba'i bkod pa lhun rdzogs dag pa'i gnas/ nyams dga' zhing bkod legs pa/ sems spro zhing yid dung ba'i dbus na/ na mnyam bu mo'i rgyan gcig na zla gzhon nu'i dga' grogs/ na tshod mthun pa'i skyo grogs/ na spang mtshams kyi chu skyes/ na gi spos kyi sdeb sbyor/ na le sham gyi drod can/ na kra'i grong gi nor bu/ na raḥmi yi gtsug rgyan/ na bza' gos kyi nang bcud/ na gzhon 'gugs pa'i kyo ba/ na yol skyong pa'i byams ldan/ na tsha srung ba'i sman shing / na rim mkhas pa'i mchis brang / na re 'grogs pa'i phyi thag na yig bco lngas bskor ba'i/ na chung 'od kyi snye ma/ rlabs dkar rkyong ba'i sras mo/ sgra dbyangs tshogs pa'i mig yangs/ ljon pa'i yul gyi mna' ma/ bsil ri'i ljongs kyi kong jo/dmar po ri yi nang rten/ lha gcig chu yi pad+ma/ gsar tshes dung gi zla ba/ gsar 'dzum khri gdugs nyi ma/ gsar gad snying gi chu skyes/ gsar 'thul lhan skyes dri bsung / gsar chags sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar/ gsar 'bus sman gyi myu gu/ gsar ldem gzugs kyi rkang 'thung / gsar grag ko ki'i gre 'gyur/ gsar mo yid kyi 'ching thag gsar sems 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ gsar ba stobs kyi grangs rdzogs/ mdzes ma brgya yi mdud 'dzin/ dga' ma stong gi nang snying /gnyen 'bangs skyong ba'i ma ma/ mi mthun 'joms pa'i tsher ma/ blo mchog ster pa'i a ma/ yid dbang 'gugs pa'i mdzes ma/ lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma/ zas zhim stob pa'i ja ma/skom dad sel ba'i chang ma/ lci yang 'jal ba'i rgya ma/ dpal stug rgyal ba'i bskyed yum/ badz+ra ti k+ṣa'i sbyor yum/ tam bu ra yi rtse grogs/ dga' ba'i tshal gyi 'khri 53

shing / ldum ra'i pad+ma/ mtsho'i ngang mo/ mig gi bdud rtsi/ yid kyi thig le/ na chung ma'i khyu mchog 'di su yin/ mtsho byung ma'o/ 'di la yon tan ci yod/ blo las 'gongs so/ cung zhig smos ngang / bltas na mdzes/ bsnam na zhim/ reg na 'jam/ 'grogs na skyid/ nyal na bde/ spyad na sim mo/phal ba'i blo yi ra ba las/ / 'gongs par ma zad kun mkhyen gyi/ /mkhyen pa'i zhags mig las yar ba'i/ /zla bzhin ma 'di su'i bu mo/ gzhan yang / mtshar sdug gdong —gi zla gzhon ngos kyi dkyus ring ut+pal 'dren byed kyi zur mdas chags can gyi yid dga' ma gzhan gyi phyogs su lhung ba las dbang bral du 'dzin/dad mo'i lang tsho'i skye 'bras yag pa'i gzhon nu'i grogs der khyod yid rjes su chags pa'i spu long dang rab tu myos pas dmar ba ni ke shu'i me tog gi grogs su sdeb/ smin ma sol ba'i 'khri shing bkug pa'i dbang gzhur 'phya ba'i snyan gong kun+da'i na chung lhag lhag dgod cing rtse dga'i myos pa 'dzin/ 'khyil legs snyan shal zung gi sner dpyangs pa'i gzi 'bar nor bu'i phra tshom spungs pa'i rna rgyan gyis gzugs 'dzin rab rib byed/sgros legs bim pa'i mchu la 'o byed pa bsrung phyir dbyibs mdzes dri 'dzin so ba krong nger langs/ stang zil dbu skra'i lan bu ma li gsar ba'i phreng bas phyed bcings byas par zhim pa'i dri bsung 'khyil/ dpral dbyes ston zla'i me long gis spobs pa'i ku mud grol/ bkra shis bum pa'i mgul bar gser g.yu mu tig gimagrin rgyan nyil/mkhur tshos byu ru'i me tog las chags pa'i rang mdangs shar/ pad rag khu bas byug pa'i so skyob las mngar ba'i sbrang chang lud/ ldad byed thags bzang dung gi nyag thag ljags dmar glog gi bung ba'i 'khril bar nas zab don dbyangs su gyer bas gzhig dka'i mdud rgya bkrol/ yangs pa'i brang ngos su bcud ldan dkar 'dzin shel bum 'bur zhing 'phrang dog pa rnam 'byed shes rab kyi lus stobs dar phyir nu 'dod kyi bu la ci dgar snun pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ gzhu mo'i 'chang bzung ltar phra zhing ldem pa'i sked skabs stong chen dbyings su rgyas btab pa'i phra rags kun rtog gi spros mtshan rang ngor sangs pa'i 'od gsal rjen par ston/ chu shing ltar mkhregs pa'i brla'i phrag bar du snying po mngon par 'greng zhing rdul gyis cung zad sbags pa'i pad+ma rab tu rgyas pas reg 54

bya'i myong mkhan la bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i dus ston bshams/ byin pa bags kyis phra bas e na ya'i mdzes pa 'phrog sor mo dra bas sbrel pas ngang ba'i snyems pa pham/ rin chen gdu bu'i sil sgras 'gog snyoms bsam gtan las slong / sgrib min du ku la'i stod g.yog gis tsi na'i bu mo skyengs/ rnam bkra pañca li ka'i smad sham gyis 'ja' tshon gyi mdangs la smad/ bgrod byed mnyam pa'i tsog bu'i 'dug stangs kyis sbas don gyi sna rtse gab/ dmar zhing snum pa'i bcad skye/ 'bur zhing gsal ba'i 'khor ris/ 'jam zhing mnyam pa'i zhabs mthil sngo zhing dwangs la mer ba'i chu gter gyi klong na ldem zhing g.yo ba'i pad+ma'i ze bar dal gyis 'god pa'i dga' ma'i rtse/mdzes ma'i phul/ gzhon nu ma'i mchog na chung ma'i rgyan gcig po 'di'i mdzes pa'i gzugs/ snyan pa'i ngag byams pa'i yid/ ngad pa'i dri/ mngar ba'i ro/sim pa'i reg bya/ 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' la 'gran nus pa/ brtan g.yor ma dmigs/'khor 'das kyi khyon na mi dmigs/ srid zhi'i khams 'dir dmigs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ u mas mi 'gran/ dpal mos mi do/ legs brjod mas mi mtshon no/chags can yid kyi yol go ral/ / chags bral thugs kyang shing bal bzhin/ /g.yo ba'i 'dab ldan yid srub mda'/ /'jam por 'phen 'di su'i dga' ma/ /gzhan yang skra lo mun pa brtsegs pa'i mchod sdong gi gseb na/ dkar gsal zla tshes kyi mdzes sdug khong nas bzhad pa'i dus ring rmongs mun gyi ba gam gzhi nas 'jig dar la babs pa'i lang tshos yid kyi chu gter khol/ dus la babs pa'i bya bas ba spu'i skug phran g.yo/ snying la sdug pa'i mdza' grogs lag pas dam du bcings/ 'dod pa'i myos pa'i nyams kyis yid kyi gser mig 'dzin/ gnyis dga'i khyim gyi mtshar sdug gis gzhon nu'i 'khri shing langs/ gzhom bral rlung gi rang bzhin gzugs su shar ba/ srid zhi'i mdzes gzugs kyi phung bo gcig tu tshogs pa'i snying bcud ma/ dri za'i na chung stong gi dkyil na 'jo sgeg gi sgyu 'phrul dpag yas ngom pas dpral ba'i mig snying gi dum bu/ mig 'gugs byed kyi lcags kyu/ yid 'ching byed kyi zhags pa mo 'di nor rgyun ma'i zur nas brkus/ tam bu ra'i bang nas phrogs te longs spyod 'khor lo'i khyim du bag mar thob/ grogs su bkug gnyen du 55

bsgrigs/ dga' mgur rol/ tshim med du sbyor/ ngoms med du spyod pa'i rtse dga'i mtha' ni/ 'khor bsgyur gyis mi zin/ mes po'i mi dpog brgya byin gyis mi mthong / dbang phyug gis mi rtog go 'o na sus myangs/ bdag gis so/ rgyu gang gis/ sngon smon las so/ dgos pa gang zhig mtha' med do/ de lta'i dga' ston gyi yo lang gi sprin sna 'dzings pa'i ltad mos thub kun mnyam bzhag las bslangs/ rgyal sras 'gro don la g.yel/ thos sgrog zhi bde'i ro la chags pa btang ste/ 'dren byed mi zum/ smra byed mi 'gul/kun byed mi 'phro bar shing bzhin du gnas so/ /dar drags lang tsho'i chu skyes kyi/ /mtshar sdug ge sar sprang gi chang / /'jib 'dod bung ba'i khyu sdud pa'i/ /g.yon mig ma 'di su'i pho nya/ /gzhan yang / pad rtsa ltar dkar ba'i 'dzin byed kyi yal 'dab g.yo zhing 'phar bzhin pi wang gi yu bar 'tham pa chags can gzhon nu pho mo pha na tshun rtse ba dang tshul mtshungs pa'i sdeb bar nas rgyal gsung rnam pa thams cad pa'i brjod don ma lus pa gdangs su len nga/ra bre'/ bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams su phal ba'i sgra gzhan rgyu ba'i go skabs 'phrog sprin dkar gsar ba'i dum bu la rjes su 'gran pa'i 'o 'dzin zung gi 'og 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog gi rdul tshogs rang ngor sangs shing / gnas lugs rjen cer gyi rang zhal rang mal nas ngom par co 'dri ba'i nam mkha'i mdangs 'dres pa'i rgyud stong / shes nyon bag chags dang bcas pa'i bslad pa gzod nas ma zhugs pas thogs rdugs med pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngos la brtan g.yo'i ri mo mtha' yas bkra lam me/ bkrag 'bar re/ gsal sangs nger shar bas rab 'byams gtsug lag pad+mo'i sbubs rgya cig char 'byed pa'i blo gros nyi ma chen po snying la rdol ba'i sbyor ba brtsams/dga' ma yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu ma/ /mdzes ma mig dbang 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ma/ /pad+ma bung ba sdud pa'i lang tsho ma/ /g.yem ma dga' ba'i ba spu langs pa ma/ /e ma de las kyang ches ha las pa zhig ni/ gangs mda' mdung gi mchod rten/ mtsho ga gor gyi yon chab/ chu ga gug gi dra ba/ brag za zur 56

gyi gtor ma/ ri ra rug gi zhal zas/ mdangs lnga'i me tog thags su btags pa'i za 'og gos kyis bklubs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi steng / chu 'dzin lang long gdugs su phub pa'i dngul dkar pa tra'i rgyan cha ngom pa'i sngo bsangs kyi 'og lam rgan po'i thod ris ltar phyogs nas phyogs dang / mtha' nas mtha' ru bris par 'brug 'bras kyi khyim mtshes/ 'phags yul gyi 'dab ma/ bod yul gyi gong ba/ bod phrug gi pha ma/ 'bangs kyi snying / 'jig rten gyi mig bstan pa'i srog chos srid kyi mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i 'dren pa/ sprin mthing sngon gyi phang bar 'khyil zhing ldir pa'i g.yu 'brug dgung nyi zla dang lhan du bskyod cing 'phur ba'i mkha' lding /nags tshang tshing gi rdzong du gra 'dzum ngom pa'i ri bkra/ mtho zhing dkar la brjid cing ring ba'i ke la sha'i sa 'dzin tshar du bsgrigs pa'i mgul/ gnam ka med kyi 'og nas srab med du 'phyo zhing lding ba'i seng chen/ tshogs gnyis kyi lus rtsal rdzogs/ snying stobs kyi g.yu ral gsig blang dor gyi 'dren byed rno/ mi 'jigs bzhi'i mche ba gzengs/ bsdu bzhi'i sder phreng brkyangs/ phyin drug gi mjug ma bskyod/ lhag bsam gyi lus dkar/ lta ba'i bongs mtho/ sgom pa'i ngang brtan/ spyod pa'i 'gros zhib/ thugs kyi dkyel che ba gang gis 'jigs pa med pa'i ngar skad rgyang nas bsgrags pas/ thogs med kyi gnam ral/ thogs bcas kyi sa yom/ sra ba'i brag zhig brtan pa'i ri 'gul/ rtsi shing gi lus 'dar/ rang phyogs kyi dpal spungs/gzhan phyog sa kyi srid 'thor/ che rlom gyi sder chags phra mo rnams rang snang gang shar gyis rgyu ba'i skabs med par/ 'bangs su bsdus/ mnga' 'og tu bzlums/ ci gsung la nyan pa'i cho 'phrul stong gi dbyar rnga ches cher ldir bas/ rang srid ring nas nyams pa sor chud/ snga srol lnga lam du bsnyegs par shid zan btang / thub bstan lung rtogs kyi 'od stong dgung nas shar/ sna tshogs grub mtha'i pad tshal thang nas bzhad/ mkhas rgu dgyes pa'i gad mo khong nas dgod/ skye rgu dga' ba'i glu skad lhang lhang grags/ bzang rgu 'gugs pa'i khab len phyogs su brkyangs/ ngan rgu gtor ba'i skyogs kyis gnam brdib/ /mtsho dkrug sa steng 'og bsgyur ba'i drung na lha chen khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu dang / 'dzam gling ge sar gyis dgra bzhi cham la 57

phab pa'i gna' gtam yang bye'u dmag sa lis bdas nas dpa' skad dgung du 'then pa'i byis chung gi ngang tshul bzhin byed pa'i gnyen 'gugs dgra 'dul gyi gtam lab ring mo re zhig ngal gso ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba/gangs ri'i sul nas 'bab pa'i chu rgyun rgyun bzang rgya mtsho'i klong du rol/ /rol sgeg cho ga rdzogs pa'i na chung chung grogs gzhon nu'i rum du rol/ /rol rnyed lang tshos mtshon min zla mdzes mdzes sdug ldad byed ra bar rol/ /rol rtsed mig gi 'phrul rtsen phyag sor sor mo rgyud stong phang bar rol/ /mkhas pa'i yid la rab dga'i me tog 'dzum/ /gzhon nu'i yid la chags pa'i spu long bsu/ / na chung kun dar bsil ba'i zer phreng gis/ /'khyud tshe dkyus ring 'dab ma'i mig zhags 'phen/ /tshogs gnyis dbyig 'dzin lto las legs bltams pa'i/ /dkar 'jam 'dab ma'i 'dzum grol pad dkar ma/ / nag mo'i khol dang phur bus legs btus nas/ / dge dbang dpa' bo'i mgrin ba'i rgyan du byin/ /de las mkhas rgu'i ngag 'dab gcig nas gcig / brgyud pa'i nyams brgya'i 'khor lding bung ba mo/ /kho bo'i mgrin sbubs dri za'i dga' tshal la/ /chags pas snyan tshig byo ba'i gter du grub/ /dbyangs can kha ru ma bos ngang gis 'ong / /rgyud mangs sor mos ma bskul rang sgra snyan/ /tshig phreng ched du ma yin shugs 'byung glu/ /rang blo'i mthu las ma yin lhag lha'i byin/ /'di smras de yis 'di nas phyi mtha'i bar/ /bar med lnga rig nor bu'i gter kha la/ /la 'ur longs su spyod pa'i rnam kun mkhyen/ /mkhyen gnyis lang tsho'i dpal dang rtag 'grogs smon/ /'di na la la ri dwags mig can ma'i/ /skye gzugs 'ud kyis bsngags pa'i snyan ngag kyang / /deng dus skye bo'i kha na gling bu bzhin/ /ches cher snyan pa'i ba dan mthongs su 'dzugs/ /bgrang ring bskal bar tshogs gnyis goms pa'i 'bras/ /dus ring phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs kyis/ /yun ring 58

bstod pa'i rjes zhugs tshangs sras ma/ /de ring bsngags 'di de dang do mi mnyam/ /de phyir de zhabs yun ring bsten pa dang / /de yi zhal chab snying la bskyil pa dang / /de dbyer ma mchis bshes gnyen mchog bsten te/ /de yi go 'phang dam par myur reg shog / 'di grub mtsho ldan 'phags ma dgyes pa'i byin/ /dro 'jam nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'grogs pa'i/ /sngo bsangs dga' ma'i rab dkar me tog gi / zol gyis gtor ba'i sngon med dga' bdes bzi/ /tshul 'di bsam zhing 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /bka' drin che'o mtsho byung zla zhal ma/ / ces smra ston dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rmad byung gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan las sku'i me tog gi mtshar sdug gtso bor byas te cha tsam bsngags pa 'di'ang /'phags ma nyid la blo rtse gnyis pa med par gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i thugs rje las/ yongs su grags pa dang ma grags pa'i snyan ngag smra ba'i mid pa cung zad yangs pa/ rang bzhin skyes thob kyis snyan ngag pa'i gral du 'tshang ba 7 gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i zla rgyan du 'bod pas mgrin pa gzengs su bstod de/ go sla ba'i dmangs khrod kyi phal skad dang mthun par chu sprel lo'i nag zla'i yar tshes dge bar sug bris su bgyis pa dza yachu/

bsilaltongs zhing rta rnamagasum gyi ya gyal kun mkhyen dri med 'od ther gyi bla sgrubasbyin rlabs char rgyun byo ba'ispren phung zhes bya ba/rang mdun mtha' dbus gnyis bral 'od gsal dbyings / /rang snang 'ja' sprin mdangs lnga'i gur khyim klong / /rang rig 'du 'bral med pa don gyi lha/ /rang ngor rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dal/ /sde bzhi'i lung gi glegs bam zhal phye bzhin/ / bu ram shing ba'i gdung 'tshob ngag gi dbang / /mtshams sprin gsar ba'i rtse dga' nyams smad pa'i/ /rnam gsum rung mthun na bza' mdzes par gsol/ /grwa zur yongs dag thig le nyag gtsig zhal/ /rjes chags brtse chen dkar dmar lang tsho'i 'dzum/ /sgom 'khyil thabs shes spyan zung brdal khyab mkhar/ / zim med gu yangs yan par hur re gzigs/ /blos byas gzeb kyis ma gab theg rtse'i don/ / dmar rjen ston pa'i dmar gsal paṇa zhwa'i rtse/ /rno zhing mtho ba chos dbyings mthongs zug pa'i/ /rtsod bral theg pa'i dka' mdud gzhig la rings/ /ched 'dzin bcos ma'i 'khyog spyod las 'phags pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i phra tshom spungs pa'i smyug phran skur/ /sems nyid rtog tshogs chu khur 'dzings pa'i sbubs/ /ther bud rang mal ngal bso'i phyag rgya brjid/ /shes dang shes bya mi phyed glegs ral rten/ /srid zhi'i skyon gyis ma reg pad ma dkar/ / lhan skyes bsung zhim 60

'thul ba g.yas g.yon gyi/ / mnyen lcug phyag sor rtse na g.yo zhing ldem/ /nyams rtogs chang gis bzi ba'i shugs 'byung glu/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i khyim du sgra ldan mas/ /rgyud mangs grogs bsdebs ye babs gnyug ma'i don/ /don bzhin ston la bskal ba'i mtha' yang thung / /mkhyen gnyis lang tsho rgyas ba'i lus phra ma/ /shes bya'i gzhon nur 'khyud pa'i rtse dga'i ros/ sim pa'i bde dgas myos pa'i snying gi gtam/ /shub pu'i ngag gis snying gi bu la gdams/ /nyes brgya'i 'dam gyis ma 'bag pad dkar ltor/ /sems gnyis zla nyi'i gdan la bskal ba'i mthar/ / g.yo min bdun ldan khams su lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhig bral skyil krung rnam bzhi'i mdud pa dam/ /rang rig ka dag gzhi klong yangs pa'i sbubs/ /rang gdangs ma 'gag skyabs kun 'dus pa'i sprin/ /thugs rje'i shugs kyis gang 'dul sprul ba'i gar/ /bsgyur mdzad dpal mgon bla mas gzigs shing dgongs/ /mkhyen no mkhyen no bla ma mkhyen no/ /gzhi dbyings ka dag gi klong nas/ /lhun grub 'gag med kyi tshom bu/ /gang 'dul thugs rje ru shar ba/ /sku gsum dbyer med mgon mkhyen no/ /gting bral 'khor ba yi rgya mtsho/ /drag tsub sdug bsngal gyi rba klong / /las nyon 'dzin khri brgyas gtibs las/ /skyob pa'i dpung gnyen du re'o/ / bslab gsum rnam dag gi bum par/ /thos sgom 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi/ /thar ba'i srog zung du 'gugs pa'i/ /byin rlabs dga' ston rang stsol shog / ma smad theg chen gyi gzhung lam/ /thabs shes shing rta'i 'gros myur mos/ /bsgrod de sku bzhi yi srid la/ /'gying ba'i dpal dang g.yang khug shog / bla ma'i man ngag gi gru bo/ / gus rtag brtson pa'i dar 'phyar bzhin/ / gsang chen chu gter 'jings bsgrod de/ /grub gnyis nor bu'i gling slebs mdzod/ /khyad par gzod bral gyi rig pa/ /btang bzhag bral ba yi ye shes/ /rig stong ka dag gi nang dbyings/ /shun bral rjen pa ru ston cig / 'dzin med khyod 61

thugs kyi mkha' la/ /rtsol med theg pa'i don rta bdun/ /'gog med bkra lam gyis shar ba/ /nub med bdag rgyud la 'pho mdzod/ /dri med mdangs ldan gyi rgya mtshor/ /dri med rigs sngags 'chang pad+ma'i/ /dri med zab gter gyi mnga' bdag /dri med 'od zer khyod min nam/ /mtshungs med klu sgrub kyi lta ba/ / rmad byung zhi ba 'tsho'i spyod pa/ / mnyam sbrel mtsho skyes kyi rang lugs/ /nyams med skyong ba'i khur med dam/ /dran bzhin gdungs dbyangs kyis 'bod pa'i/ /bu la thugs rje'i shugs phyung ste/ /dgongs pa car phogs su sprod pa'i/ /g.yar dam ri mo bsub phod dam/ /de ltar gsol btab bla ma'i gnas gsum du/ /bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gi mdog /rim dang cig car rang gi gnas gsum thim/ / dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi'i dri ma dag / sku bzhi 'grub pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ /slar yang bla ma rang 'dra zhig / dgyes bzhin thim pa'i rang sems las/ / gud du ma dmigs bla ma'i zhal/ /blta bya lta byed bral bar lta/ / ces don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal la ci nus su blta ba'i ngang nas/ /'dzam gling ྾/ rig stong dbyings kyi bla mar rnam kun tu/ /'du 'bral skad cig med par gsol btab mthus/ /byin rlabs 'od snang 'phos pa'i blo gros 'dab/ /yongs bkrol khyod dang skal ba mnyam byin rlobs/ /sogs kyi gsol 'debs dang / i āḥm hā gu ru badz+ra dha ra bi ma la rasmi sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ/ sogs mtshan sngags ci 'grub bzla/ mjug mthar bsngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs pa dang 'dod don du gsol ba gdab pa dkyus gcig tu bya ba ni/ ring min khyod kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i skus/ /zol min rjes su bzung ba'i de ma thag /lam min gol shor phrang las yongs grol nas/ /thun min theg pa'i gsang mdzod rang brdol shog / lta ba'i rtsal thon sgom pa'i rang sa zin/ / spyod pa tshul 'chos tsher ma'i dong nas thon/ /'bras bu re dogs phub bral nang dbyings su/ /gtan srid zin pas 'khor ba dong sprug 62

shog /snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang / /mngon gyur sgyu ma'i rol bar 'byams klas te/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun rigs stong chos nyid kyi/ /gshis su lhun rdzogs dag mnyam chen por shog /spros pa'i sprin tshogs dwangs pa'i 'od gsal mkhar/ /zhal phyag mtshan ma'i gzeb bral chos kyi sku/ /'pho chen sgyu tra'i gar mkhan bla ma'i zhal/ / nam 'dod 'dren byed bcud du yongs smin shog / grags stong skye 'gag med pa gsung gi gdangs/ /ā di ka di'i sprin phreng rol mo can/ /gzhom bral shugs 'byung snang sems bsgyur ba'i gsum̐ng / /thos 'dzin dpal du nyams med rtag 'khrol shog /ma bcos ka dag kun bzang dgongs pa'i gshis/ /ma byas ye grol bya bral zang ka'i sbubs/ /ma bsgom lhun rdzogs rang ngor rang sangs don/ /ma rtogs 'khyams kun gdod ma'i gzhir grol shog / de ltar brtson zhing brtson pa'i phan yon kyang / a ti bkod pa chen po las/ gang gi lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa pas/ /bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma log na/ /bsod nams brgya phrag stong gi char mi phod/ /bzlas pa'i rim pa sa ya dung phyur bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gsum brjod na ni/ /nus pa 'bum phrag char yang mi phod do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bskal ba'i bar du yang / /gang gis 'du 'dzi spangs nas sgom pa bas/ /bla ma snying gi dkyil du shar ba tsam/ /bsod nams brgya phrag nyi shu'i char mi phod/ /ces dang / o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas/ pi wang gling bu'i gdangs ltar snyan pa yi/ /nyin mtshan dus drug rnams su gsol ba thob/ /ces dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po te lo bas/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ / ces dang / dam pa rgya gar gyis/ bla mas bskyal na gang 'dod sa ru slebs/ /rkang glar mos gus phul cig ding ri ba/ / zhes dang / sa paṇa chen gyis/ bskal ba stong du pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /mgo dang rkang lag bdog pa gtong ba'i tshogs/ /bla ma'i lam phyadis skad cig gcig la sdud/ /ces dang / rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun de/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma'o/ zhes dang / paṇa chen bzhi 63

bas kyang / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las/ /gang gi ba spu'i bu ga gcig tsam yang / /bdag cag bsod nams zhing du legs bsngags pas/ /skyabs mgon thugs rje can/ zhes sogs bka' mdo rgyud dang / mkhas grub tshad ldan gyi lung mtha' yas phyir/ dal ba don ldan du byed pa'i gang zag dag gis bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog tu byas nas zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i go 'phang ring min lag rtser 'gugs pa'i thabs la 'bad par rigs so/ /slar smras pa/ gna' po'i mkhas grub thugs bcud gang ga'i rgyun/ /brgyud —ldan dam pa'i gshong bur legs brgyud de/ /bdag blo'i dpal du 'khyil ba'i gdams pa 'di/ /'di na dus kyi mthar yang 'od du 'khyug / dge 'dis tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan/ /tshang la ma nor skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /nyams su blangs pa'i sa lam rim bgrod de/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i rgyal thabs myur gnon shog / tshe rabs phreng par dpal mgon bla ma yis/ /'bral med rjes bzung theg mchog zab rgu'i ro/ /lce thog smin pas bla ma'i go 'phang la/ /ma reg de kun 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog / ces bsil ljongs shing rta rnam gsum gyi ya gyal/ kun mkhyen chen po dri med 'od zer gyi bla bsgrub byin rlabs gru char byo bo'i sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di'ang / sngon dus kyi bka' gter gsar rnying gi dam pa du mas mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha 'dren byed kyi yul du ma son cing / phyis kyi mkhyen kong mi pham sogs snga 'gyur shing rta ba dag gis mdzad pa'i dpe rgyun khungs btsun yod mod kyang ma rnyed stabs/ snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo ba'i skabs 'dir/ 'di 'drar mos brtson phran trem byas kyang bsod nams rgya cher bsags par ma zad/ sngon dus mchims phu dpal gyi nags khrod du klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po gang nyid/ 'du 'dzi rgyang bsring / bya ba dgu phrug tu btang ste rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas/sku'i zhal bstan/ gsung gi dbugs dbyung / dgongs pa'i chos mdzod gtad pa'i lo rgyus kyis yid drangs mur/ skul mkhan mi rgan kun byed rgyal pos yang yang nan ngor dang / rang gis kyang bag chags re 'jog 'dun gyis yid la gang shar du/64 —
/tshos sdos dgye

kun mkhyen bla mar phul ba'i zhu yig 'jam dbyangs 'dzum pa'i me tog ces bya ba/bla gter 'jam dpal dbyangs dang kun tu bsdung / /'jiXgs gīd thugs stobs btsan pos thuXb dbang gi/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pur/ /shar ba nges don sdos sdi ྅ ma'i drung / /mtshan ldan dam pa'i zhabs sen srid zhi'i nor/ /spyi bor reg pa'i skal bzang sngon smon mthus/ /thob kyang sems la yar skyed med pa'i khar/ /phyi phyir 'di snang dbang gyur gang des mchid/ /legs tshogs bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ /legs lam bgrod la gus rtag brtson pa'i 'dab/ /legs bskyod khrims ldan ngang mo 'bum phrag gis/ /legs par gang ba'i rdzogs ldan dus kyi char/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i chu mgo rje bla ma'i/ /dge legs 'dzad mtha' med pa'i gsung rab mdzod/ /dge bar 'grel la 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'dzum/ /bzhad pa'i grags dkar bho ṭa'i ljongs na mtho/ /thub bstan kun gsal sgeg mo mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /'phags yul mkhas grub bgrang yas skar tshogs dbus/ /klu yi thugs sras sangs bskyangs zla ba'i zhabs/ /la sogs skyes rabs 'od dkar phreng bas mdzes/ /bka' bstan bye bas bstan bya mthar thug pa/ /dak+ton pa'i mardog gyur bsam 'phel nor bu'i tog / dang po'i gnas su bsus pas 'phral yun gyi/ /bzhed rgu 'gyub pa'i rtsa ba gting nas tshugs/ /blo bzang bstan la 'jigs pa med pa'i rtsal/ /rtsal rdzogs thub kun lung rtogs bstan pa'i gdugs/ /gdugs dkar mkha' mthar 66

brdal mkhas chos kyi rje/ /rje khyod zhing 'di'i nyi ma gzhon nu gcig / 'di na yab rje 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying 'khrul bral lugs bzang khur/ /khur du 'khur la spos kyi glang po'i stobs/ /stobs su rdzogs pa khyod las gzhan na gang / /de slad sku thugs mi phyed skyil mo krung / /bskal pa'i mthar yang bshigs min 'phrog byed khrir/ / lham mer bzhugs zhes gsol 'debs dung gi dbyangs/ /lhag bsam dbugs kyis bskul 'di brtse bas gson/ / rnam kun brtse chen kyo bas mi gtong bar/ / rnam dag bstan mjal thos bsam sgom pa kun/ /rnam par 'gran bzhin 'phel pa'i bdag sogs 'gro/ / rnam kun gzigs pa'i sa la myur reg mdzod/ / zhu gsol don zab ut+pal dmar po'i phreng / /sdeb legs snyan 'jebs tshig gi bsung zhim can/ /skyes su thogs pa'i ngang ba'i bu mo zhig / gang drung 'o ma'i mtsho chen bsnyegs te 'phur/ / ces ra ba rgyan lcags rta lo'i chu stod zla ba'i 'du khang ston mo mjug rdzogs pa'i tshes 4dge bar gus 'bangs kyi gral mthar spyod pa'i ban rgan gyi na ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang 'jigs med grags pa zung gis/ sne ring / rten 'brel chen mo'i dpe dang bcas bkra shis 'khyil du gus pa bla na med pas phul ba dge/ ci ri 67

khri chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabasadrungadu phul ba 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba/ 4 byu ru'i lcug phran mtshan dpe'i me tog spungs/ /ud pal sgro ldan brtan g.yo'i snying la gzir/ / brtse chen kyo bas srid zhi'i legs tshogs sdud/ /dbang gi rgyal mos mdzad 'phrin 'phyur bar mdzod/ /mi 'jiXgs thugs bskyed shar ri'i ba gam nas/ /dri gīd lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin pa1 zla/ /mkhas mang dbyāng sgyug ral ba'i mdzes rgyan du/ /'gog med 'phags pas bstan 'gro'i kun da 'dzum/ /legs mdzad shing rta bdun gyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /thub bstan lha lam dga' bskyed nam mkha'i nor/ /mkhyen dpyod tsha zer 'od rnon 'bar ba'i gzis/ /chos srid pad tshal bzhad pa'i mtha' ma rig /legs byas zong gis nyos pa'i mchod sdong che/ /mthong bas dus ring duḥkha mthar skyel ba'i/ /mthong grol mdzes sku lta ba'i mi ngoms par/ /phyi nang gsar 'tshes dben bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /tshems dkar dung gi thag pa'i 'phrul bar nas/ /ljags dmar glog gi rtse dga' dang 'grogs te/ /dpal gyi mgur nas zab rgyas dam chos dbyangs/ /sgrogs pa'i gsung la 'gag pa med lags sam/ /shes nyon sgrib pa'i g.ya' yis gos min pa'i/ /bden gnyis chos tshul gzigs pa'i a dar shar/ /mtha' klas shes bya'i gzugs kun skad cig mar/ /'char ba'i thugs la sgrib pa med lags sam/ /dran dbang tshogs chen 'du ba'i sum rtsen gyi/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang 68

rnam par lhod byed pa'i/ / rgyal mtshan mthon por mtshan don mthun pa'i khrir/ /mi pham mgon bzhin lham mer bzhugs lags sam/ /dga' ba brgya ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin zhing / /bsang gzhung 'dzin mar bkra shis g.yas 'khyil sde/ /lung rigs dbyangs kyis mtshan yang nyin bgyid pa'i/ /chos kyi khri la zhabs sor bkod lags sam/ / /khyod ni ring nas rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /'gro kun 'khor mtsho nyam nga las sgrol slad/ /mngags pa'i mi dang btsugs pa'i shing lags na/ /'khor mtha' ma stong de srid rtag brtan gsol/ /ring nas kun rtog mgyogs 'gro'i rgyu ba kun/ /dbu ma'i dbyings su sim pa'i dwangs ma'i skur/ /bgres rgud bral yang tshur mthong bdag cag ngor/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med mgon bzhin bzhugs/ /snyan dbang gser gyi pad mor yang nas yang / /yid la brnag pa'i zhu gsol bung ba'i dbyangs/ /brgyud mar bsgrags kun thugs kyis mi bskyud par/ /re ba don ldan mdzod ces slar yang gsol/ / de lta'i zhu mchid 'khor lo'i lag can khyod/ /bkra shis 'o mtsho g.yas sa 'khyil ba'i gling / /gling bzhi'i dbas na rigi sbyo riri byelhun po ltar 'phags der/ /'phur nas don ldan tshig 'di sgrogs shig kye/ /brjod bya'i don zab ri mo g.yas su 'khor/ /rjod byed snyan tshig mdangs lnga'i cod paṇa dpyangs/ /zhu 'phrin skye ba lnga ba'i dung gi dbyangs/ /khri chen chos kyi rgyal bo'i snyan du 'bud/ /ces lcags rta lo'i 'du khang ston chenatshomajug grub pa'i zla 6tshes 4dge bar dga' ldan zhing gi snang brnyan spus legs dang dar bcas bkra shis 'khyil du gus phul/ / 69

bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyizhabasadrungadu phul ba'i zhu 'phrin dbyangs can ngagagi rangasgra zhes bya ba/ sa skyong rigs su mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad/ /sa gsum bla ma'i lugs bzang spel ba la/ /sa steng 'di na 'gran bral chos kyi rje/ /sa yi nyi ma gang zhabs gtsug na mdzes/ /sa 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i khur/ /sa 'di ma stongasu de srid mi 'dor ba/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug dam pa'i zhabs stegs su/ /sa la mgo bo dud pas phyag bcas gsol/ /sa rnying la sogs dri med rgyal ba'i bstan/ / sa 'dir rta mog spu bzhin mtha' yas kyang / / sa 'dir dge ldan lugs bzang pad+mo'i tshal/ /sa yi mdzes rgyan gcig gyur deng gi char/ / sa gsum rnam 'dren rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i/ / sa steng yongs khyab bstan pa dbang gi rgyal/ /sa rdul gyis bkab phyi dor bgyid pa'i las/ /sa gsum rgyal kun bgros te khyod la byin/ /sa 'dir dus 'khor lugs bzang spel ba la/ /sa dbang rigs ldan sras po 'jam dpal grags/ /sa 'dir ma bos phebs pa khyod nyid ces/ /sa steng skye bos mgrin gcig sgrogs pa khyod/ /sa yi gzhi 'dir thub bstan skyong ba la/ /sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje slar byon dang / /sa bzang ma ti rnga/ṇa chen ji bzhin du/ / sa 'dir grags pas khyab bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /sa gsum skye 'gro'i bde skyid ku mu ta/ /sa yi zla ba khyod nyid shar ba'i mod/ /sa la ngo mtshar byin ster 'dab ma'i sbubs/ sa 'di'i rgyan du 'byed bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /sa dang lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mchog gi sku brnyes kyang / /sa khyab 70

yid can don du da dung yang / / sa bcu'i rgyal sras tshul bzung bzhugs lags sam/ /sa 'di'i 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor/ /sa chen gzhir 'khod skye 'gro'i don slad du/ /sa chu khams la 'phrod dang mi 'phrod dang / /sa rong dog sar phebs pas ma ngal tam/ /sa yi nyi zla bzhad pa'i rdo rje yi/ /sa chen khyon khyab 'phrin las gdugs dkar po/ /sa 'dzin rtse mor 'degs pa'i thugs stobs kyis/ /sa 'di ma stongs de srid bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /sa steng rnyed dka'i bstod 'grel rnam gnyis dang / /sa dge'i mkhas pa'i thugs bcud dbang lha'i rgyun/ / /sa/ 'di gser gyis bkang yang rnyed min pa'i/ /sa lam myur bsgrod gdams pa'i dga' ston zhu/ /zhu gsol 'od 'khyug dri med gser gyi phreng / /zhu tshig lhag bsam dag pa'i srad pu la/ /zhu tshul gus 'dud sor mos legs brgyus 'di/ /'di bzhin nyid kyi phyag gi mkhrig mar chongs/ / bal ldan lo'i zla tshes dge bar gus zhabs pa bstan 'dzin rgya tshos gus phul/ 71

khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyizhabasadrungadu phul ba'i zhu yig rdzogasaldan ngagagi rangagadangs ces bya ba/'jiXgs gīd chos tshul gdong lnga 'bar ba'i khrir/ /zhabs sen ma snyigs me tog gsar ba'i phreng / /'god la bstan paX'i dbyāng phyug gcig gyur ba/ /khri chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad mor/ /lus kyi lcang sdong bsten tshul 'bras bu'i khur/ /bral yang skabs 'gar dad shugs dri bzhon gyis/ /reg tshe yal 'dab ldem pa'i lha phyag dang / /gsol 'debs dbyangs kyis brel 'dir re zhig gson/ / legs byas kun gsal mdzes ma'i lto ba las/ /legs thon rgyal bstan nyi zla zung gi gzis/ /legs lam pad dkar tshal dang kun da'i kha/ /legs par 'byed la phyogs pa deng gi char/ /bkra shis dal 'bab bshad sgrub chu bo'i rgyun/ /bkra shis g.yas 'gros 'khyil ba'i mtsho chen por/ /bkra shis dran dbang gser nyas gar bsgyur ba'i/ /bkra shis chos kyi sde chen ga la bar/ /rig smra seng ge rnam bsgyings lung rigs kyi/ /ral ba phyogs su gsig pa gcig min par/ /brgya phrag bung tshang rdol ba'i khyu 'khrigs der/ /phas/ rgol glang po 'jug pa'i go skabs gang / /der ni 'phrog byed kyis btegs khri 'phang khar/ /nyes brgya'i tsha gdung 'phrog pa'i bsil zer can/ /dpag yas yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs khyod/ /grangs med 'phags tshogs rgyu skar dbus na brjid/ /dge ldan rang lugs dri med pad dkar tshal/ /dge bar 'byed mdzad dge 'dun phun tshogs sogs/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma rim byon gyis/ /dge legs lhan du zlum pa khyod las gang / /72

mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i gdengs ka'i rgyan/ /bgrang yas chos tshul bsam 'phel nor bu'i tog / khyod gcig kho na'i phrag tu gtad pa ni/ /don kun grub pa'i mi pham dbu la bzhin/ /de slad rnam dag chos rgyun ltag chad kyi/ /rdzing bzhin chad la nye ba'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /thugs mkhar byams dang brtse ba'i sprin dkrigs te/ /'dzad med chos char 'jo mdzod gdams pa'i gter/ /dpag med gdod nas 'gro kun 'khor mtsho las/ /sgrol la zhum med thugs bskyed sra ba'i go / phrag tu bzhes phyir cher snyigs zhugs kyi stobs/ /ci tsam mched bzhin thugs stobs lhag par bskyed/ /ring nas las rlung bag chags brgyad cu'i dpung / /stong chen dbyings su sim pa'i 'od kyi sku/ /gzhig bral ther zug khams su lhun rdzogs kyang / /mos ngor tshe mtha' yas bzhin brtan bzhugs gsol/ /zhu 'phrin 'phrin yig yig phreng phreng bstar ba/ /snyan tshig tshig rgyan rgyan bzang bzang po'i shal/ /gang thugs thugs rjes rjes 'dzin 'dzin slad du/ / gus slob slob tha tha mal mal du bris/ / ces lcags lug lo'i gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi zla tshes dge bar gus slob kyi gral mthar dbang ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho—sa gus pa bla na med pas phul ba mgi lam̐/ /73

khri chen 'jamapa'idabyangasadrug pa chen por chedagasol zhu bskul dbyangs can dgyesapa'i do shal zhes bya ba/ 'jam dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo ngur smrig gi gar bsgyur/ /sa gsum bla ma 'jam dpal snying po yi gdung 'tshob/ /dkon pa 'i mchog gyur legs bshad rin chen gyi gter mdzod/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i gsal byed sgron me der 'dud do/ /gang de'i mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo yi mdud rgya/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis lhod por song ba yi lag rjes/ /dbyangs can rgyud mang stong gis tshig don gyi cha la/ /'gran pa'i go skabs yongs btang 'jam dkar gyi bstod tshig / tshig don rmad byung dge dbang dpa' bo yi rjes 'gro / 'gro kun rmongs pa'i gnyid slong skye ba lnga'i sgra dbyangs/ /dbyangs can thugs mdzod las bton zab rgyas kyi gnad tshang / /tshang la ma nor legs bshad multiḥka'i phreng mdzes/ /mdzes sdug blo gros lang tsho gsar ba yi mgrin rgyan/ /rgyan drug gcig 'dus 'jam dbyangs bla ma yi legs bshad/ /bshad pas pha mtha' rdzogs min zab don gyi bang mdzod/ /mdzod 'di'i khyad 'phags khyad chos brjod yul las 'das so/ /de la 'gran bzod rig byed lhag pa'i lha'i bstod pa/ /gsang gsum yon tan cha shas kun rdzogs pa'i nya rgyas/ /tshe rabs phreng bar rjes 'dzin smon tshig gi zer ldan/ /bdag blo'i kun da 'dzum pa'i dpal yon du stsol cig /snyan snyan tshig gi 'dab ma 'bum phrag tu bzhad cing / / zab zab don gyi zil mngar sprang rtsi yis gtams pa'i/ /gsal gsal blo ldan bung ba dbang med du 'gugs pa'i/ /74

mdzes mdzes bstod dbyangs uta pal mgul rgyan de stsol cig / thugs kyi mkha' dbyings brtse chen mthing sngon gyi sprin las/ /las can zhing sar mdo sngags dam chos kyi char rgyun/ /rgyun par babs pas bdag rgyud tha rgod kyi zhing sar/ /sar gnas dpa' po'i nyams rtogs myu gu de skyer smon/ /e ma dam pa'i mgon khyod yun ring du zhabs brtan/ /a la rig grol 'dus sde bshad sgrube kyis brel langs/ /e ma zab gsang gsung gi bdud rtsi la rtag rol/ /a ho bkra shis dga' ston srid mtha'i bar spyod do/ / zhes gang gi mthu byin yongs 'du'i grib bsil la gcig tu spyod pa'i gyi na ba zhig gis 7bkra shis 'khyil nang bstan slob grwa 'go tshugs pa'i dus tshes dge bar gang dran thol byung du bris pas tshe rabs kun tu mgon po gang gis dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin cing / 7 gal don re 'bras lag rtser smin pa'i rgyur gyur cig bkra shis/ dge'o/ / / /

bla ma 'jam pa'idabyangs kyi zhabasadrungadu phul ba zhu bskul ngagagi 'od zer zhes bya ba/rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro bsdu yi byed po/ /khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas ngur smrig gi gar bsgyur/ /gdul bya'i zhing du dus gsum rgyal kun las lhag pa'i/ /skyabs gcig bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bo ru mchod do/ /yid can 'gro ba'i legs smon sngo bsangs ma'i phang bar/ /bar med 'od stong 'gyed pa'i gzugs sku yi rta bdun/ /bdun ldan kha sbyor rigs brgya'i mes po ru bzhengs par/ / bar chad mtshan ma —snang ngor bral 'di rang dga'o/ /mtshan ldan dam pa'i zhabs sen zla tshes kyi ri mo/ /bsam sbyor dag pas mig 'dzin gtsug rgyan du bkur bas/ / snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod la ci dga' ru spyod tshe/ /dben sa yab sras skyengs te mkha' spyod du bzhud snyam/ /bslab gsum dag pa'i rtsa brtan yongs 'dus kyi yal 'dab/ /gzhan phan sems mchog g.yo ldem me tog gi phang phung / /zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'bras bzang gis dud pa'i/ / bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib bsil 'di skyid pa/ /sngon yang skye 'phreng gser ri'i phreng ba yis mdzes shing / /da yang lung rtogs nor bu'i bang mdzod la dbang bsgyur/ /chos dbyings klong nas thub bstan bdag po ru bzhengs pa/ /khyod zhabs bsten pa bdag cag dga' bas bro los rdung / /dmar ser li khri'i lus 'chang mkhyen rab kyi lha mchog / mchog dman 'gro la sman phyir bshes gnyen rdzur zhugs te/ /te bor zab don snyan rgyud zla sring ma'i mgrin dbyangs/ /dbyangs su 76

'khrol 'dis nged cag skyid pa'i glu los len/ /'phags bod brgya phrag gzhung lugs ba ku la'i 'dab ma/ /khyod thugs rnam 'byed na chung 'gram chang gis bran tshe/ /dka' gnad sbubs brgya lhug lhug bkrol ba yi gzigs mo/ /'di mthong dran dbang 'bum sde'i mdzes pas gar los 'khrab/ /gal che'i gsol don ni/ bkra shis dpal gyi dal 'gro 'bum phrag tu 'khyil ba'i/ /khyad 'phags chos kyi sde 'di bdag gir rang mdzad nas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i dbyangs snyan snyan dgu ru 'khrol te/ sa gsum mya ngan med pa'i dga' ston la sbyor mdzod/ /bod rgan mkhas dang grub rlom gzhan dag gi 'ud kyis/ /rang blo'i rtsal gyis bzhag ba'i sna tshogs kyi grub mtha'/ /'dren byed lam du mdzes ster dbang gzhu yi ri mos/ /sgrun min 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i rang lugs 'di rmad do/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i lugs bzang dar khyab du spel slad/ /dkon mchog chos kyi gsang mdzod sa gsum du sgrogs mkhas/ /nges pa don gyi bstan pa'i sgron me yi bka' rtsom/ /don ldan bstod pa'i bshad lung smin rgyas rang stsol mkhyen/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i gdung 'tshob/ /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal bstan 'gro yi dpung gnyen/ 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i su war ṇa'i khri la/ /'jigs med skyil krung chu gter g.yo med du bzhugs gsol/ /zhu 'phrin dbyangs can dga' ma'i phyag sor gyi 'phrul 'degs/ /bdag mgrin longs spyod 'khor lo'i tam bu ra'i dbyangs dang / /mnyam du bsdebs tshe snyan dbang mdzes byed kyi mchod sprin/ /sprin phung lang long dbus nas g.yu 'brug bzhir ldir song / /de ltar khri chen chos kyi rgyal po yi drung du/ /yid la brnag pa'i zhu don glu ma mgur phul 'dir/ /spyan zung bung pas rol ched stong min gyi rten du/ /'jam mgon thugs bcud lha lnga'i snang ris bcas gus tso btegs/ /77

thog ma'i zhu6godage legs 'od snang 'dren pa'i skya rengs zhes bya ba/'dīgs gīd stobs bcu'i dbang phyug brnyes kyang smre gāzang bstan pa'i rgyal byed mtshan/ /gsum ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zol gyis 'dzin la dāpal lhan grags pa yi/ /rjes 'gro zab rgyas dasgom dz+was ston la srid 'dir do zla ma mchis pa/ /lus can rgyu mardo'i skyabs mchog zung gis rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las rmad/ /gang gi gsung gsang rin chen mdzod kyi sgo/ /rījigs snred rnam dpyod mchog gis legs phye ste/ /ṭīgs tshul 'bum gyis smra la thogs med p+ta'i/ /sh+lau gh+ris mchog mnga' mchog sprul dam pa'i drung / /mi dman skal ba bzang po'i 'jam mgon bstan/ /bskyan pa'i yang snying 'adz+rīn pa'i gral ring du/ /du ma'i mdo sngags chos tshul rgyu mardo'i bcud/ /bcud du 'thung ba'i go skabs rnyed na yang / /rnam dag chos kyi snying po ma lon par/ /rnam par grol pa'i lam bzang rgyab bskyur nas/ /rnam g.yeng ngang du mi tshe mthar son pa'i / /rnam kun sdug la sbyor ba'i dge sbyong des/ gus pas zhu gsol ni/dge bcu'i lugs bzang dar ba deng gi char/ /dge legs 'dab brgya'i 'dzum bag cher ngom pa'i/ /dge ldan bshad sgrub bstan pa'i pad dkar tshal/ /dge mtshan brgya ldan nyi ma khyod kyis phyes/ /skye 'gro'i bsod nams zung gis legs bskrun zhing / /bskal mang goms pa'i thugs bskyed rgya mtsho las/ /legs 'khrungs lung rtogs cha shas kun rdzogs pa'i/ /smra ba'i seng ge 78

bde 'byung gtsug rgyan khyod/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe ra ris sgrib g.yogs dang / /yongs bral lnga rig ga bur thigs pa 'bum/ /legs par spro bas skal bzang kun da'i tshal/ /'byed la rings pa'i gtam snyan sprin gyi dbyangs/ / thos 'dzin lam du son pa'i de ma thag / bdag yid mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gyi bum bzang las 'ong ba'i/ /legs bshad yon tan kun ldan gang ga'i rgyun/ /mkhyen rab rig pa'i gshong bur legs brgyud de/ /gdul bya'i 'phral yun 'dod pa 'jo ngos nas/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha ba'i/ /'khrul bral bstan pa'i khyon yangs gdugs dkar po/ /mtha' bral lta dang gsang chen theg pa yi/ /'od 'bar nor bu'i tog ldan khyod kyis bsgrengs/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo'i 'jam mnyen phyag sor gyis/ /nyams 'gyur stong ldan rgyud bkug gdangs snyan pos/ /kun rmongs drungs 'byin rig pa'i ye shes nyis/ /thub bstan pad tshal 'byed bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /mdo sngags rig gnas lam gsum 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /lhag med mkhyen dpyod zhal du nyer gsol te/ /slar yang legs bshad gsar ba'i 'dod 'jo bas/ /sngon med dzā hu gnyis pa khyod las su/ /deng dus rnam par dpyod pa'i gom gcig gis/ /'phags bod gzhung brgya'i dbyig ldan khyon gzhal tshe/ / smra dbang 'bum gyi spobs 'phrog pad dkar mig /srid pa kun tu btsal kyang khyod las gang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i kun gsal yangs pa'i ngor/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthing sngon sprin bsdus te/ /'chad rtsom rtsod pa'i gru char 'bum 'jo ba'i/ /thub bstan nor 'dzin g.yu yi lang tshos sgeg / de tshe/rgyal kun dgyes pas gad mo dang / /lus med dpung bcas mya ngan khur chen pos/ /gdungs ba'i 'o dod 'bod pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin khyab pa mngon sum yul/ /'di na khyod yon dran pa'i dad shugs kyis/ /lag pad spyi bor zum dang 79

chabs gcig tu/ /khyod zhal zla gzhon mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /'char bar smon bzhin lus sems bde bar bdog / slad nas ring min khyod zhabs dbang gi rgyal/ /ral ba'i rgyan bsten yid la dga' bde'i dpal/ /ster byed zab rgyas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i chab/ /bdag snying bum par bskyil ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /khyod ni ring nas phra rags bdud kyi g.yul/ /bcom ste sku bzhi'i rgyal sar dbang bsgyur yang / /tshur mthong mos ngor rags sku'i za ma tog /bstan 'gro'i dpal du g.yo med bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /rgyang ring rta bdun 'od kyi pad tshal bzhin/ / thag ring yul gyis bskal yang brtse chen gyis/ /nam yang mi 'dor bka' glegs rten ldan gyi/ /nor bu'i phreng ba spyi bo'i rgyan du zhu/ /tshe rabs phreng bar 'jam dpal snying bo'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying 'khrul bral dge ldan lugs/ /lugs bzang mchog dang nam yang mi bral zhing / /'gro khams rgya mtsho 'dren nus thugs smon 'tshal/ /de lta'i zhu gsol lus mdzis khu byug khyod/ /lha reg dar gyi 'dab ma nyer skyod de/ /mi rigs slob grwar bshes gnyen gser ri ltar/ /brjid pa'i drung du zla tshes dge bar 'phur/ / 80

brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i zhu yig bung ba rgan po'i mgrin dbyangs zhes bya ba/two baṭīng grags pya yi bstan la phyag gi rjes zab pa/ /'aṭīgs snred tsho bslab gsum gyi nor bu'i za ma tog 'od 'bar/ /thub chen lung rtogs kyi gāstan p+ta'i rgyal byed mtshan 'dzin pa'i/ /dabhāng phyug brgyad ldan gyi mgon po dar cig 'dir gson dang / /sku tshe phreng rgyud du 'jam dbyangs bla ma yi lugs bzang / /nyams med skyong ba yi thugs stobs sra ba'i go bgos des/ /deng yang mdzad 'phrin gyi 'o mtsho kun gsal ma'i lan bur/ /'phyur ba'i bdag gi bshes gangaci der tshig 'ga' 'di zhu'o/ /phral yun 'dod pa kun 'jo ba'i zhabs sen gyi nor phreng / /dad ldan sa chen gyi rdul la co 'dri ba'i gtsug tu/ /bkod de bgrangs yas kyi bskal bar g.yo med lhun chags na/ /nged cag thugs rjes rang bzung ngo dgyes brtse yi mnga' bdag / bskal bar thos dka' zhing thos na sgrub dka' ba'i gdams zab/ /grub na tshe gcig la sangs rgyas lag gtod kyi man ngag / blo bzang snyan brgyud kyi dbyig gi char chen rang byos na/ /nged cag slob ma'i sar bzhag go 'jam mgon gyi gdung 'tshob/ /na rga 'chi ba'i rgyu bgrangs ring bska la ba'i gong spangs nas/ /zhi bsil myang 'das kyi sa la mchong gcig gis byin khyod/ /tshe dpag med mgon bzhin srid pa ji srid du bzhugs na/ /nged cag ze ba'i don bsgrubs so rgyal sras kyi khyu mchog / mkha' ltar sngo ba yi ral gri mthon mthing gi lcang lo/ /lhan cig stong dbyings su rgyas btab ngur smrig gi gos can/ /gangs ri'i shing 81

rta che rgyal ba gnyis pa'i srol bskyangs des/ /nged cag mgu bar rang byas so 'atwom da3ngs mi'i sha tshugs/ /bzhud sngu'i rdo rje yi thugs ba.e/da kun gsal gyi pha mtha'/ /gcod la mkha' lding gi rgyal bo'i 'dab gshog gi rtsal ldan/ /thugs sras khyuXng chen khyod thub bstan mdzes rgyan du brtan na/ /nged cag byi'u chung kun skyabs so nyam chung gi srog khebs/ /bu ram shing ba'i bstan lho sprin phyug mo yi phang bar/ /gsung snyan 'abhag gi gdangs lung rigs glog gi lce 'thabs te/ /legs bshad char gyi rgyun skal bzang dbyig 'dzin gzhir phabs na/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa'i 'phro bskyang ngo 'gran med kyi slob dpon/ /dran shes rkang 'thung gi lcags ri bar med du bstar dbus/ /tshul gnas rgya staXg gi mche sder rnon po yi rwa bar/ /nyes ltung ri dwags kun lhag med kham du rang bgyis 'dis/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rang bsgrengs so chos 'dul gyi mnga' bdag /lta spyod gtsang ma yi gangs kyi ri sul nas 'gying ste/ /'chad rtsod lung rigs kyi ral ba phyogs mtshams su sprug cing / phyi rgol spobs pa'i rtsal snying dang lhan cig khar bton des/ /yab rje'i bzhed don rang bsgrubs so zla med kyi sdeng chen/ /sngar nas yang yang du gsol ba'i re don gyi sbrang rtsi/ /bdag sems bung ba yi dpyid du nam zhig la stsol snyam/ /nyin zhag sor mo yis bgrangs phyir re don lag smin na/ /gus phran thugs kyi dkyil bzung ngo snying rje yi gter chen/ /khyung 'brug stag seng dang sbyar ba'i zhu mchid kyi tshig 'ga'/ /'ga' zhig kha nang du gang yong smyug gu'i mchur bskyon te/ /te bor mdo sngags kyi gdams pa'i dga' ston rang stsol bar/ /bar med smon pas mtshams snar bzhin yar tshes la gus phul/ / 82

bstan pa'i srog shing bse mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabasadrungadu phul ba'i zhu bskulagaser snyan sim pa'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/d+mā bzung chos tshul zla bral srid pa'i mig / gang thugs mkhyen rab nam mkha'i grwa gcig tu/ /nyams med 'dzin mkhas dpyal ldun thub pa'i gdung / /yongs 'tshob dharma badz+ra'i zhabs pad mor/ /'khrul bral lung rtogs bstan pa'i gang gā ma/ /rnam dpyod bum pa'i bcud du 'dzin pa'i skal/ /thob kyang rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i rgya mtsho cher/ /byings pa gang des gus pas mchid 'di gsol/ /rgyal gsung zla ba gsar ba'i mgon bcas pas skye 'gro'i bde skyid kun da 'dzum dang lhan/ /lnga rig pad+ma'i sbrang rtsir yid chags pa'i/ /shel gyi 'dab ldan 'phur lding gar gyis brel/ /pur rgyal bod kyi tshig rgyan byu ru'i phreng / /rang rigs dga' ma'i mgrin pa sgeg pa'i phul/ /dus su ster la chos dbang grags pa'i zhabs/ /kan lho'i gser ldan lto ru slebs sam ci/ /sum rtsen grong khyer sa la babs pa'i grwar/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang zil gyis mi reg pa'i/ /lta na sdug der sman pa'i rgyal bo khyod/ /lham mer g.yung drung gshis su lhun chags ngos/ /'jam mgon thugs bcud snyan brgyud gdams pa'i gter/ /khyod thugs bang par god med phyogs rdzogs pa'i/ /ris bral gdul bya'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /dus 'dir khyod las srid na dmigs su gang / /dri bral shel dkar ltar 'tsher sgra ldan ma/ /khyod mgrin 83

bcu drug pad mo'i 'ad ba sbubs su/ /ci dgar rol de'i snyan tshig rgyud mangs stong / /shugs 'byung ri mo gsum pa'i do rar rtsen/ /gser mngal can gyi blo yis ma zin la/ / grags pa'i mu khyud mig gis mthong min pa'i/ / khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i gam na shes bya kun/ / nam langs rgyu skar dpe min gzhan gyis phongs/ / slad kyang tshangs pa'i sras mo 'dzum 'chor zhing / / dran dbang bye ba'i khengs pa phyir snyil byed/ /mdo sngags rig gnas legs bshad rtsom pa'i khur/ /khur du bzhes te rgyal bstan skyong bar bskul/ /ring nas snang gsum mgyogs 'gro zad pa'i dbyings/ / mdangs lnga'i gzhon nur 'tham pa'i sgyu drwa'i gar/ /dkar dmar gur du 'khyug pa'i rdo rje'i skur/ /gzhom rgud bral yang mos ngor bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /yan lag bkra shis grangs rdzogs rmā klung ṇ+ḍa/ / drag zhan skye bo'i gser mig 'dus sdod dz+rīng / / bsam dngos dpal yon wu ba'i 'dzum dgod par/ /zhabs zung bkra shis re kha khod ces gsol/ /'phags bod bcu phrag rig pa'i gter mdzod las/ /nyin bzhin slob pa'i grwa ru rang gi skal/ /len la rings pa'i rang rigs gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /tshogs gsum rmang gzhi brtan pa'i thugs smon 'tshal/ /zhu mchid lhag bsam lus dkar ngang ba mo/ /don ldan snyan tshig dar dir mgrin pa'i rnga/ /brdung bzhin lha reg dar gyi 'dab bskyod de/ /rnyog bral 'o ma'i mtsho chen bsnyegs te 'phur/ /'di'ang rma chu rdzong bod rigs slob 'bring tshugs nas lo 'khor 1rkyalon pa'i dga' ston du gdan 'dren gyi brda yig dang chabs gcig tu/ lcags rta lo'i smin zla'i tshes dge bar 'du gsum pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos gus pa chen pos btegs/ /84

khri chen 'jamapa'i dbyangasadrug pa chen por zhu — 'phrinadu phul ba snyan bsku'adungagi 7 rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ 'jigs bral mtshungs pa med pa ngag gi dpal/ /dpal stug bstan pa'i dpyid du ngur smrig zol/ /zol bral lus can khams dang rjes mthun pa/ /pa ra rnam gnon dbang bcus phyug pa'i zhabs/ /lo gsar gsar tshes tshes grangs bzang po'i dus/ /dusga cikun kun tu du ma'i 'gro ba'i khams/ /khams bzhin bzhin gzigs gzigs pa zla med zhabs/ /zhabs pad pad dkar dkar 'jam bsung 'thul drung / /bstan zhabus sdod kyang bstan la bya bas dben/ /chos par 'dzin kyang chos min las kyis brel/ /rgya chen gzhung lugs rgya ru ma chud pa/ /mtsho mā gnas pa'i mtsho skyes skam pos mchid/ /blo bzang gsung rab rab mchog mchog gi don/ /rnam 'byed shes rab rab 'byams 'byams klas pa'i/ /don bzhin legs ston ston pa mchog nyid kyi/ /bka' drin slar yang yang yang yang bskyar dran/ /dge ldan lugs bzang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dge / legs mdzad legs lam lta ba'i mig ltos legs/ /dpal ldan mkhas kun dgyes pa bskyed pa'i dpal/ /char bzhin 'dod rgur 'jo ba'i dus kyi cha ra/ /dmigs med brtse chen zhags pas mtha' klas 'gro/ /'gro 'ong mtshan ma'i rtogapabral bcings pa'i mtha' mtha' med kun gsal tha grus mtshon mirna na/ /rmen —ra phal blos gzhal 'dod gad mo'i 85

gnas/ /dwangs shel mkhyen rab gtsang ma'i me long grwar/ /grwa zur ma nyams mtha' dag shes bya'i ris/ /ris med kun tu 'char ba'i mkhyen rab 'phrul/ /'phrul 'alha cidus gsum gzigs —pa kun —gyi gshis/ /'khyil legs snyan gyi bu gar snyan brgyud dbyangame/ /dbyangs can rgyud mangs dbyangs kyang nyams smad byed/ /byed po'i dzug skyes hūṃs kyang do mirno pa/ /pa sangs ltar dkar thugs kyis 'gro la 'doms/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang nam mkha'i mtha'/ /mtha' med kun tu khyab pa'i 'phrin las rlabs/ /rlabs ldan chu gter bzhis kyang sgrun min phyir/ /phyirazi zhing khyod la dad pa'i spu long ldang / /bslab gsum bcud kyis gang ba'i za ma tog / tog ldan ngur smrig ga shal g.yo ba'i dkyil/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thre bsdu'i byed po gang / /gangs ri'i spo na gangasda seng dkar mo brozhin/ /zab rgyas mdo sngags chos rgyun lha rnga'i sgra/ /sgra 'dzin dpyid du stsol la bsil ri'i ljongs/ /ljongs 'dir tsong kha ba dang khyod gcig bu/ /bu ramā shing ba'i gdung —'tshob gcig tu 'khums/ /de slad zhabs skyes gser sbyarngos 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsibs stong mu khyud 'phrog byed ral ba'i blar/ /bla rer brime 'di srid pa ma stong bar/ /bar med bstan 'gro'i gsorme su bzhugs zhes gasnel/ /dmar ser rgyu 'bras bstod ṭi ka mes po'i glu/ /glu ru len la srid zhi'i khyon 'di ru/ /ru mtshon rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan 'dzin/ /'dzin ma'i gzhi 'dir deng dus khyod nyid tsam/ /de slad sngar nas yang yang zhus pa'i don/ /don gyis mi stongs yid kyi snyim pa'i nang / /nang nyams bcud du smin tshe dga' ba'i gar/ /gar 'dug mtsho byung mdun sar gar gyis rtsen/ /re don 'bras bus mi 'dor sems kyi re/ /re ba ji bzhin skong la rnam kun re/ /rosas btang snyoms mi mdzad bsam pa'i re/ /re skong dbang gi rgyal po khyod la re/ /re ba brgyad kyi nan gsol yi ge'i ris/ /ris su phab pa'ikhyed po gyi na ba/ /ba glang brtul zhugs 86
'dzin pa'i ser gzugs nyid/ / nyid la dad pa'i lha phyag brtsegs bzhin phal/ /༄chu sprel gnam lo gsar bzhad tshezla 1 sa 1la phul/ /chi ci — — ci — ri — nga ca —ngasnyedi— — r+sha 87

tsho ru — bla.a 'jam parme dbyangs kyizhabasadrungadugasol ba snyan 'grina.ā+o zhi'i me tog ces bya ba/'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /'jigs bral lung rtogs bstan pa'i gser gyi gdugs/ /'dzin la zla bral ris med 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /skyabs gcig phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs pad+mor/ /mi phyed dad pa'i chu gter 'khyil ba las/ /'bum phrag rlabs phreng brtsegs pa'i dad phyag dang / /mig 'dzin yon por 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas/ /don ldan dge ba'i mchid 'di gus pas gleng/ /'gro 'di'i legs byas nam mkha'i mthongs yangs por/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /nye zho chu khur g.yogs kyis sgrib bral zhing / /phan bde'i tsha zer stong 'bar deng gi char/ /bskal mang goms pas tshogs gnyis chu gter che'i/ /phang ba las thon gzugs sku zla shel khams/ /mdzad bzang ga bur thigs pa stong 'dzags pas/ /bstan 'gro'i rgud mun 'phrog la rings lags sam/ /mkhas mang bde 'byung gnag snum ral klong du/ /bgrod byed zla tshes ri mo nyer bkod de/ /dbang khrid man ngag gru char 'jo ba yis/ /gdul bya'i myu gu bskyed la dgongs lags sam/ /ston pa'i zhal skyin jo bo rnam gnyis sogs/ /dbas gtsang chos kyi zhing gi ༄mchog gsum rten/ /rten gsum byin rlabs dri bsung ngad 'thul bar/ /bar med mchod pas thugs ngal ma gyur tam/ /zla med mkhas dang grub pa yongs 88

kyi rje/ /rlabs chen lung dang rigs pa'i dpal gyis mtho/ /thub pa'i bstan 'dir thub dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /mkhas btsun yon tan dpal gyis brjid pa khyod/ /yab rje 'jam dpal snying po'i lung rtogs bstan/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar rgyal ba dang / /de sras 'phags pa'i lan brgyar bsngags brjod kyi/ /rol mo'i me tog 'thor ba'i tshul dgongs te/ /mtha' med mkhyen rab lha yi rdzing ring las/ /tshad med byams brtse'i sprin sngon g.yos pa las/ /'dzad med dbang khrid man ngag gru char rgyun/ /ngal med 'jo ba thugs rjes mi bskyud zhu/ /khyad par dkon mchog rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dngos/ /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me mchog / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bstod 'grel rnam gnyis kyi/ / bshad lung smin rgyas yid kyi dpal du zhu/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i mkhyen rab 'bar/ /bho ṭa'i ljongs kyi mkhas kun gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyan drug gcig 'dus rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /mdo sngags gsung rab gdams pa'i dga' ston zhu/ /sa chen tshad ma bzhi ldan gāng ga'i rgyun/ /dge ldan legs bshad 'bum phrag chu klung dang / /'grogs te gang thugs rgya mtshor legs bsdus pas/ /dbang gi lha mo'i man ngag yongs rdzogs stsol/ /mdor na stobs bcu'i go 'phang la reg bar/ /mnyes gshin thugs rje'i 'ching thag dam po yis/ /skad cig tsam yang lhod min dge ba'i bshes/ /mdzad de khyod mnyes kho na bgyid par smon/ /gal ches/ nan gsol/ 'phral yun 'dod rgu gang las 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /gang sku mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar yid bzhin nor/ /chos srid rgyal mtshan rtse mor rtag brtan zhing / /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i lang tsho dar drags shog / gdod nas tshe dang ye shes dpag med lha'i/ /ngo bor mngon sangs rgyas kyang bdag sogs ngor/ /lung rtogs 'bras bu'i khur dud rags sku'i ljon/ /nyams med grib bsil snum pos 'gro 'di skyongs/ /ched gsol gsol btab bden tshig dung 89

gi groru nye pho dbyangs/ / dbyangs ldan phang 'a 'a rgyud las ra 'a sa glu/ / glu snyan risnyan dbang sim ster mawo pa'i sbrin/ / sprin dbyangs dal bar dgod 'di ru'adi nas phal/ — / — ༄ ci— —— — ca— — — cisne — ci kyi — rta ri — ci sgyu —— —ri —— ci — — — — — tsho90 ri— —

khri chen 'jam pa'idabyangs kyizhabasadrungadu phul ba snyan bskul ches bo'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba /ka ma la ltar dag pa'i mdzes sku r+shalta bas mi ngoms tsam pa ka/ kha ba'i ri dbang ji bzhin rab dkar dkar gsal tshem phreng 'dzum pa'i kha/ /ga tsam 'di zhes pha mtha' yongs bral bral min thugs kyi lha'i gāng ga/ nga yi skyabs gcig dbyangs ldan lha mor ring nas rtse gcig gus pa nga / /ca cos dbyangs sgrogs tam bu ra min chos kun gedangs su 'gugs pa'i glu/ /cha lugs ma nges mi mo'i tshul min rlung gdangs sngags su shar ba'i gzugs/ /ja chang zag bcas bde bas mtshon min zag bral dga' bde'i dpal ster yum/ /nya lto ba ltar cagasang mtha'i lam gyis rtsal rdzogs gdong lnga'i dbang por mdzod/ /ta re 'phags ma 'phags bzhi'i sras skrun g.yu yi lang tshos sgeg pa mo/ /tha dad ris med ris bral 'gro 'di thugs rjes mi gtong mdza' na mo/ /da ri dra yang dra bas spud pa'i mkhas rgu'i khrir 'jog lha'i bu mos/ /nā ro ba bzhin zung 'jug rin chen gan mdzod thang mar brdal bar mdzod/ /pa tra'i ris med 'dab ldan mda' rnon rnon po snying rje'i gzhur sbyar te/ /pha rol dpung med bdag 'dzin sbubs brgya brgya phrag 'bigs la ches dpa' zhing / /ba lang ltar blun blun po'i phul yang yang bskyar ma hā paṇa ṭi tar/ /ma thogs thogs med klu sgrub dang mtshungs zab rgyas sbrang rtsis yid gtams mdzod/ /tsa ri'i yul kun kun du nyul de'i nang gi mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zhal/ /tsha zer can 'grogs ku mu da bzhin mjal bar dka' zhing a thang chad/ /dza ya kun 91

'dus 'dus khyod man ngag 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal lung gis/ /wa ler sems kyi rmongs mun mthar skrod gnas lugs dga' mar nyer 'khyud mdzod/ /zhwa ser lugasabazang gsal ga'i sgron me 'jigs med rig brgya'i spyi dpal che/ /za byed rwa bar zhedabyangs can hūṃmu khyod 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsos sman du/ /'a cag gsol ba'i las 'dir dgongs te dbang phyug brgyad ldan gdong lnga'i khrir/ /ya mtshan zhabs sen nor phreng nyer bkod 'jigs bral phyogs las rnamamo rgyal mdzod/ /ra chen rdo rje grags ltar mngon mtho nag phyogs brag rir gnam lcags thog /la li ta ltar grub pa'i spyi mes man ngag bdud rtsi'isto gter la debang / /sha wa ri ltar 'phrin las —rnam bzhi'i chu gter rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo/ / sa ra ha ltar do ha'i thol glus sa gsum rna ba'i bcud len mdzod/ /ha sa badz+ra kune mkhyen chen po'i thugasatshobaskyed ha ri tsan+dan byin/ /a ma rgyal yum 'phags ma'i 'phrin las lhun mospub a ru rnam rgyal mthu/ /mthutshuchen dgra lha'i dbang phyug mched lnga'i mthu stobs bskol ba'i zhugs phreng gis/ /thubakhasabazhed bzhed gro lhun gyis grub cing mdzad 'phrin snang bas sa khyab mdzod/ /shing stag lo gsar ga sar ba'i tshes la la lung nyul ba'i sauto bas/ /—bas mtha'i khang bar bar med kun rtog rtogs pa'i phreng ba yi ge'i ris/ /ris med rgyal bstan bstan pa'i srog 'tsho 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal bo la/ /la gor sgo kun kun nas btud de de ltar gus gsol re zhig dge /de lta'i zhu yig 'khor lo'i lag / lag tu mchod pa'i skyes thogs te/ /te bor gsol ba'i zhu 'phrin 'di/ /'di nas khyer la lan grur song / /de na bdag gidage ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen mchog rab lhun po'i zla/ /zla bral yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogag /rdzogs sangs rgyasader phyag kyang phul/ /phul te zhu tshig tshig gi phreng / /phreng bar bsgrigs pa snyan rgu'i gtam/ /gtam’du byo sa la rim par zhus/ /zhus pa'i lan yang dgos zhegagasol/ / 92

khri chen 'jimapa'idabyangs kyizhabasadrungadu phul ba 9snyan bskuladung zlablu lang tsho zhes bya bo/'jigs med rig brgya'i— byed po mchog gi— 'phrin las rta bdun 'od rnon gyis/ /rnam 'byed thub dbang bstan pa'i 'dab stong lung rtogs yon tan bcud rdzogs pa/ / rgyas pa'i thabs la gcig tu dpa' ba dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal ba'i sras/ /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal grags snyan rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab gang de yi/ /zhabs sen rnyog bral srid zhi'i mchod sdong che/ /gtsug gi rgyan du thob pa'i gyi na bas/ /dga' dad spro bas nyer bskul sor bcu'i 'dab/ /snying khar bkod de slar yang gsol ba ni/ /bzhi tshan bcu dang klu yi nyag ma yi/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis mthar thug 'khos dman bdag / bdag po nyi bu'i pho nyas ma slebs swo nga / /gang gsung bdud rtsi 'thung bar mchog tu dad/ /dadatshopa'i chu gter drag tu 'phyur ba'i rlab sa/ /rlabs phreng dgung du 'phyo ba'ismodad— phyag 'bum/ /'bum phrag du mar brtsegs pa'i gus pa'i nyams/— /nyams 'gyur dang bcas gsol 'dir yud tsam dgongs/ /bci75 ldan ljongs kyi mkhas mang rgyu skar khrod/ /nya rgyasazla bzhin mkhas btsun yon tan gyis/ / mngon 'phags 'jam mgon smra ba'i zla ba yi/ /don ldan bstod pa'i bshad lung zhib rgyas zhu/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa'i rim lnga yi/ /rnam gzhag gsal ston rgya bod shazhung brgya'i tso rna bcud/ /bcud lda na lung rigs man ngag za ma tog / tog gyur rin chen sgron ma bdagatshol zhu/ /'phags pa'i yul du gsalakob rnam gnyis zhes/ /nyi 93

ltar yongs grags ya gyal sgron gsal don/ /dkyus zur bsdus mtha' bzhi'i 'grel zhib tig gzhung / /grags pa'i ba dan g.yo ba'i bzhi sprags zhu/ /bde mchog sbasasnachu'i rtsa mtsho las thonachidīpa'i/rgyudalda—na rkun gsal ma/na ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ /gsang don rnume guzhugacho sde/ ma pya'o rnam dālhadarnga bcas/ /zab gsang gdams pas bdag rgyune gong bar mdzone/ /gnyi sa med rgyud kyi mchog gyur dus 'khor lo'i/ /zla med shing rta'i srol 'byed pad dkar gyi/ /mtha' med blo rtsome las thon 'grome /chen māchig / dri medad+ku 'od 'bar me longe bdag la stsol/ /bde gsang 'jiges gsum ya ma brel stome yi/ /smin byedi dbam̐ng dang grol byed bskyed rdzogs khrid/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i dga' ston rtse dga' yi/ /—bdag yid na chung mchoge tsun mgrone pru khug/ 7khyad par rgyal kun sor rtog ge sheme khamesang/ /srid gsum snang ba 'gug pa'i mig yangs mar/ /yongs bzhengs dbang gi lha mo'i phyi nang gsang / /tshorgya gzhung les tshogs cha lag bcas stsol zhu/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu gsum ldan bla ma yi/ / rnam rol dkon pa'i mchog gyur mdo sngags gzhung / /bstan pa'i sgron mer bzhag pa'iri gsung rab phul/ /rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i bshad lung zhu/ /gzhan yang mkhyen rab mkha' klong yangs pa ru/ /brtse chenalosteng rje'i mthing sprin bsdus pa las/ /darbang khrid man ngag lung gi gruspre char gyis/ /bdag rgyud re ba'i dbyig ldan3ga paro mdzod/ /dbyangaspu canamagrin rol dan ḍi'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /rigos ldan dbang mo'i bstod tshig ma li ka / byin rlabs bsung zhim 'thul ba'i phreng mdzes kyis/ /yid kyi khye'u chung smon 'a༄sa don ldan mdzod/ /ji sridariri rgyal nyi zla 'i rna cha dang / /chu —gter ska rags bcings pa de srid du/ /zhabs zung e waṃ mi shigs skyil mo krung / /g.yomed bstan 'gro'i dpal du bzhugs par gsol/ /gsol btabashasnyan tshig tshig gi lang tshos sgeg /don ldan zhu bskul skul tshig glu dbyangs len/ /pad rag mdangs bkra bkra shis lha 94

reg skyes/ / thogs te rnam 'dren 'dren mchog drung du bsnyegs/ / ces dus gsam cig car gzigs pa'i spyan ras bang ba g.yo ba'i rten tsam du 7rdo rje mkha' ༄ ༄'gro'i sku brnyan bsreg dz+ras lha reg dri med bcas zla tshes dge bar gus pa chen pos phal ༄lag sa/ /jitsho ci catsho — — rdzi — — rna cho tre wa 6 tre —— —cirna wa9 — — ci chi stori wa wa 〈ci snye 4— d+ngha— ru ci byurī — ——— — ci — dzi ci 9bye 4

su rme phyog —khong 'jam pa'i dbyangs mchogagizhabs stegs sum̐ phul ba'i zhu mchid bsung zhim spro ba'i chu skyes zhes bya ba/'jigs med thub dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma che/ /thugs bskyed 'phrin las shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar spel dbang phyug brgyad ldan mgon/ /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i drung / /yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dad gsum gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin gral du/ /dbang yang 'di snang sgyu ma'i ltad mo la/ /rnam g.yeng rgya mtshor bying des 'di skad zhu/ /'jam dpal dbyangs gang gang 'dul bshes gnyen tshul/ /bzung te dam chos chos tshul gang gā'i rgyun/ /rgyun bzang gangs ljongs dpal du 'dren pa'i gnyen/ /'jam mgon lugs bzang rgyas pa deng gi char/ /mi dman legs byas dbyig ldan dga' ma'i ltor/ /mtshan dpe'i kho lag rdzogs pa yongs 'du'i shing / /bslab gsum dri bsung phyogs su spro ba yi/ /'dun ldan re ba yongs skong gzugs kyi sku/ /mkha' khyab skye dgu'i dpal du lham me bar/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe rlung gis bskyod min par/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang grib bsil du/ /longs spyod skal ba thob la mchog tu spro/ /'di na yab rje'i rang lugs 'o ma'i mtsho/ /mtsho byung mgrin par rol ba ngag gi dpal/ /dpal ldan mkhas dbang bye ba'i 'jug ngogs gang / /gang la dad pa'i thal mo sbyor bzhin 'tsho/ /skabs kyi zhu gsol/ mkhyen dpyod sprin sngon 'khrigs pa'i ba gam nas/ /lung rigs glog gi rtse dga' dang 96

'grogs pa'i/ / kun byed sems la sngon med bde ba'i dpal/ / ster bas byin rlabs gru char snying la phobs/ /klu sgrub las 'ong rgyud rgyal 'dus pa'i lam/ /lam bzang rim pa lnga yi bshad pa'i srol/ / rgyud dang grub chen dgongs pa gsal mdzad gzhung / /gzhung bzang sgron mes yid kyi smag rum sol/ / rnam med bde ba'i mastog sbyin dus 'khor lo'i/ / rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong gzugs sku/ /sgrub pa'i rnam 'grel chen mo dri med kyi/ /'od 'bar nor ba gtsug gi rgyan du stsol/ / bstan pa'i snying po zab mo stong ba ༄ nyid/ /ljongs 'dir gsal mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa yi/ /bstod pa don dang ldan zhes mkhas pa brgya'i/ /yid dbang cig car 'phrog de'i bshad lung zhu/ /gzhan yang chos tshul sna tshogs khams bzhin du/ 4/'bad med lhun grub stsol la dbang ྅byor khyod/ / gsung gi mdzad pa'i 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrong bar slar yang bskul/ / de lta'i zhu gsol go sla'i tshig gi phreng / / phreng pa skyabs gcig dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i sprirno/ /sbren gyi rol mo ji bzhin —spel ba 'di/ /'di nas lan gru'u grong khyer bsnyegs— /d+ngha wal/ /— mo — — — rī—— wa — — —ci dzha ci wawasta byu — cho ——‘— — — — chi 97 —

— khong 'jam pa'idabyangs kyizhabasasrungadu phul ba'i 'asdina'ag rig byed ngagasdo gling buzhas bya ba/ blo gter 'jam dpal snying po dus kyi mthar/ /'jigs med lung rtogs bstan pa'i rin chen gdugs/ /'dzin la dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'khor lo'i mgon/ —/mgon po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /rnam kun spyi bo'i gtsug— tu gus bsten tekhri / rnam kun smra ba'i 'bab stegs don ldan du/ /rnam par bgyid slad snyan 'jebs tshig gi phreng / / phreng bar spelarwa 'di brtse bas bdag gir bzhes/ /ka chen rnam bzhi'i yon tan kha 'bab klung gis kha min zla bral gsang gsum rgya mtsho che/ /ga nas bsamā kyang thub pa'i gdung 'tshob khyod nyid nga yis gsol ba'i don 'dir yud tsam dgongs/ /ca cos dris dben 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs cha gang zla rgyas snyems pa 'phrog pa'i sku/ /ja mdangs li khris sbags pa'i bla gos bklubs shing nya lto ba ltar bde stong thugs kyi dbyings/ /ta ma la yi klong bzhin 'gro 'ong bral zhing tha dad 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i khams dbang kun/ /da lta'i lag mthil rdzas ltar sa ler gzigs pas nā ro 'phags yul paṇa chen skyengs pa ster/ / pa twa'i ris ltar mdzes pa'i dbyibs bkod phun tshogs pha mtha' yongs bral lung zin chos kyi sder/ /ba spu'i 'khri shing g.yo ba'i dran dbang 'bum gyi ma lus mdo sngags gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnad/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tshad tsam du phyer 'thag tsha zer stong 'bar lung rigs me char gyis/ /dza ya'i 98
