dgongs don pad+mo'i kha 'byed log smra wa skyes brag skya thal brlag chos grwa ru/ /zhwa ser lung rtogs rin chen mdzod sgo dbye dka'i zwa lcags man ngag lde mig gis phye ste/ /'a cage skal bzang3 gdul byar dge ldan snyan rgyud ya mtshan byin rlabs drod rlangs ma yal ba/ /rwa chen rdor grags khams gsum dus dgra'i rgyud don la li'i man ngag mchog gis legs brgyan dang / /sha wa ri yi nag po chen— po'i chos skor sa lo'i dbang cigi lha mo'i gdams zab bzhin/ /ha cang snyigs ma'i rang rtags ches cher ngom tsho geha cazu sngon gyi thugs bskyed go bgos te/ /ha ri tsan dan bsung zhim 'thulta ba'i sku mchog ha lam rdo rje'i khams su lhun chags ngos/ /ha sa badz+ra yab sras mdo sngags gsung rab ha cang dka' 'grel rin chen za ma tog / a nu bhu ti sgra rig 'chad dang thon mi a nus gangs ljongs yi ge'i srol btod bzhin/ /a ma sher phyin dbyings kyi rje mo'i —dgongs don a ru sman gyis mthar 'dzin gdung 'phrog te/ /a don skye ba med pa'i dbyings su ngal gso a ma'i rang zhal mngon du mjal bar mdzod/ /'jigs med lung rtogs bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan rgyan drug gcig 'dus rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad kun/ /kun tu spel la zla bral mkhas dbang dbang phyug ral ba'i mdzes rgyan bshes— gnyen zla shel khams/ /khams gsum 'gro blo'i rmongs mun sel byed byed pos ched du sprul snyam 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal sde/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i gsang mdzod mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yangs poḍi —phye sto stsol bar zhu/ / sne— 99

—‘— mo—na — ri — dze — maṅge ngag zhu༄skuld/ shā 'brelakā'i snyen 'grin ma — ri ri sdika'i —brengamedzes zhesabya sge/ — 'jigs med thugs bsnyed bzang po'i khyung sngon gyis/ / nyer prungs bstan pa'i dar+pāng phyug smra ba'i nyi/ /'jigs bral che dgu'i gtsug na ngal gso ba'i/ /rtsa rmeg phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i drung / /lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gral mjug tu/ / stabs leglus tsam gyis sdod pa'i dbang 'byor yang / /gzhung lugs rgya mtshor blta bas skabs 'phrog pa'i/ /dmus long gyi na ba des 'di skad du/ /rgyal bstan lus phya'i lang tsho ma nyams par/ /bshad sgrub 'dzam dkar g.yo ba deng gi dus/ /rgyul ba'i mdzad pa mchog gis mdo rig ske 6 sngags bstan/ /gsal mdzad khyod mtshungs spyid 'dir dmigs su gang / /gang zhig gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i/ /rnam par rol —te theg gsum lam bkri ba/ /thub pa'i mdo rgyud kun nas lan mang du/ /gsung ba rgyal sus spyi yi lugs srol mod/ /'on kyang skabs bsnan gang la gang 'tsham gyi/ /zab rgyus chos 'khor skye ba lnga ba'i dbyangs/ /srid zhi'i rims nad 'phrog pa'i gdangs snyan pos/ /srid gsum khor yug ma lus khyab par mdzod/ khyad par— sa chen gangs ri las 'ong zhing / /'jam mgon yab sres thugs gsang ma dros mtshor/ / yongs 'khyil dmar po skor bzhi'i ya kyal mchog / zab lam gdams pa'i bdag rgyud smin grol zhu/ /'dis mtshon sngar zhus gdams zab rin chen mdzod/ /gsang 'dzin dpa' po'i yul gyur mtha' klas pas/ /yid kyi bang ba yid bzhin phyur bu ru/ / gtams pa'i bka' drin stsol zhes slar 100

yang bskul/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon khyod bstan pa nam gnas par/ /zhabs pad g.yung drung ngo bor lhun chags te/ /kun mkhyen yab sras gsung 'tshab legs bshad kun/ / kun nas spel ba'i thugs smon rgyun bsring gsol/ /mgon khyod zhabs sen nor phreng tsher—bas sa 'bral med spyi bo'i gtsag tugyi ༄ ༄ legs bsten te/ /'jam mgon legs bshad dar ba'i yul skyes nas/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas 'da' bar smon/ / de lta'i zhu mchid lung stong phyags rdzi'i gling / /dga' dad dbugs kyis bskul bas ma nges sgra/ /snyan pa stomed kyang phra sbom sna tshogs skad/ /'byung 'di rten cing 'brel 'byang dngos stopo'i washis/ / rī ci ci sna 4 — r+sha tre 101

rdzu — cho ge — — — phargod rje btsunarte mararo9 yoba'i zhu6golhan 4 — —tre bskul rdongasapa'ispudabyangarusanas bya ba/ mi comatsho byung byeg gi dbang mo'i —'dzum ldan zhel/ /ji zhal sgo las 'ong — wa dbyangs ldan snyan 'gyur 'bum/ / 'bum phrag rgyud du 'gugs mkhas lhag pa'i lha/ /lha mo rig pa'i 'dod 'jo gtan gyi skyabs/ /ka ma la yi sbubs ltar gtsang bas tshul khrims nyes ltung 'dam gyis gos pa med/ / kha dog dbang gzhu'i ri mo rnam bkras yon tan phyogs dang ris su chad pa med/ /ga nas bsam kyang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab gtan gyi skyabs gcig mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /nga yi snying gi pad+mor rtag bzhugs 'bral med byang chub bar du brtse bas skyongs/ / ca ril lta bur mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos mtha' dag 'gal med grogs su gzigs/ /cha tsam nyes pa'i dri mas yongs dben longs spyod 'khor lo'i mdud rgya grol ba'i 'bras/ /ja lo bzhin du mdzes pa'i brjod bya brjod don gting dpag dka' bas nyer spud pa/ / nya rgyas mdangs ldan legs bshad bye ba'i snyems pa dus gcig 'phrog pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /ta tha ga ta'i bka' dang mi gnyis lung rigs tsha zer 'od kyi gdengs ka yis/ /tha shal ma nges ca co sgrog pa'i ched rtsom phal cher snang bral mog por byas/ /da lta'i dus 'dir mgon po khyod gsung gting mtha' mi mngon chu gter chen po'i 'jings/ /na tshas ma mnar 'du phung bde skabs thos 'dzin dpyid du 102

smin pa'i go skabs zhu/ /pa sangs ltar dkar snying rje chen po'i dgu tshigs zhags pas 'gro kun dam du 'khyud/ /pha mtha' rig min shes bya'i rgyu skar blo mchog blo yi ra ba lasa'agongs gang / /ba kor skad gnyis smra ba dang mtshungs gang thugs shel dkar me long gtsang ma ru/ /ma lus rang gi de nyid ston la gcig tu gzhol ba'i mig 'phrul 'di ko rmad/ /tsa ri yul chen nyer bzhi'i ya kyal ma phyin 'phags bal bgrod byed 'degs 'jog spangs/ /tsha grang ngal ba dang du ma blangs lnga rig dbyig gi mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing / /dza ya'i bstan la phyag rjes phul byung mkhas mang gser ri'i khrod na lhun po'i zla/ /wa ler bsam na dad pa'i chu mtsho drag tu 'phyur ba'i bstod tshig dbu phreng brtsegs/ /zha yig ji bzhin thugs kyi dkyil du zhwa ser lugs bzang spel ba'i thugs stobs brtan/ /za nyal 'du 'dzi'i gnas las ring brgal zwa dang lo ma gyi na'i zas kyis 'tsho/ /'a cag 'gro la thugs rje'i mkha' las zab rgyas mdo sngags gru char 'bum 'jo ba'i/ /ya mtshan byin rlabs snying gi dpal du nyams med stsol cig mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag che/ /ra bas bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'di na tha snyad gtsug lag ra skyes ag tshom tsam/ /la lung kun na lhag mar lus 'di gang gi bka' drin kho nar rag las phyir/ /sha tsha snying nye'i thugs kyis dgongs la zhabs pad g.yung drung gshis su lhun chags te/ /sa 'di slar yang thon mis zhabs kyis bcags bzhin rig gzhung thang mar brdal bar mdzod/ /ha ri tsan dan dri bsung nyer 'thul sku mchog blta la 'dren byed chog shes bral/ /a don skye med dbyings su nyer bkug gsung snyan rna ba'i lam du mi 'bral zhing / /gang snang bde stong ngang las g.yo med thugs yid ro gcig 'dres pa'i dpal la rol/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis snying gi bum bzang yongs su gang bar shog /de ltar byis pa shed ma rdzogs pa'i gom 'gros 'khyar 'khyor rkang pa dum chod du/ /du ma'i zhu don 103

tshang bar byas te phreng bar spel 'dis gang thugs dgyes bskyed de/ / de ring ci tsam min skye dang skye bar zhabs pad gtsag gi rgyan dang mi 'bral zhing / /zhing ༄ 'dir rtag bzhugs gsang gi snang bas blo mig 'byed pa'i re 'bras don ldan ༄mdzod/ / r+sha4 — sna rte tsho wa ——ci — wa chi—sko wa dri wawa—wa ske—cawa ci kā ciwaslo treX— — r+ṣa wa ri — rngu ༷— —skeṭ+wāṃ — — dhe rwa tsho— —— d+ku —ci rmeci — 104

zhuyig donasdan me tog 'dzum pa'i ljon bzang zhes bya ba/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab dmar ser li khri'i rdul/ /mtshar sdug bzhin legs gzugs su yongs shar lha/ /gnyis min gnyis su shar ba'i mgon khyod kyis/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i shes rab snying la phobs/ /ngag dbang dbyangs ldan rig pa'i gter la dbang / /legs bshad dbyangs kyis skye dgu'i 'dod pa 'jo/ /'jigs bral mtshungs med rig brgya'i byed po mchog / khyod min blo gros mchog sbyin gnyis pa su/ /su zhig rang gi ston pa bstan pa yi/ /khyad par ma 'dres phra zhib rtogs 'dod des/ /lnga rig sa gsum gsal ba'i sgron me mchog /btegs na dka' ba med ces mkhas pas gsungs/ /de slad tshe phyed rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi yis/ /de na 'di na med par song zin kyang / /de ring nas bzung mtshungs bral dam pa'i gsung / /gsung gsang bdud rtsir spyod snyam yid la bcags/ /ces rang gi yid la shar tshul 'chal 'chol tshig phreng du bsdebs pa'i sngun bsus te zhu ba ni/ tshogs gnyis chu gter che las legs bltams shing / /rgyal bstan pad+mo'i tshal chen rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /srid zhi'i rgud mun 'phrog ba'i gzugs sku'i nyi/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal du lham mer 'tsho gzhes ngos/ /mkha' khyab gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang / /yongs bstun rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos tshul dbyangs/ /'og min gnas su ldir ba'i las nyon gnyid/ /sad par phyogs snyam bdag yid dga' bas brel/ /'di na dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung yang / /ra ltar gyong ba'i sems rgyud thul 105

min par/ /phyi phyir 'di snang dbang gyur phran ba yang / /lus sems tshogs pa ༄ma gyes bde mur gnas/ /dam pa nyid kyi drung du dam chos kyi/ /bgo skal skal bar 'tsham pa yid kyi gsos/ /gsos sman ji bzhin len par ches spro yang / /ri 2rti phyi nang mthan rkyen 'dzom pa'i skal ba phra/ /'on kyang mtshan bzang cha shas riri sbyi —yongs gang zhal/ /nyes brgya'i gdung 'phrog legs gsang ga bar thigs/ /༄ ༄bden gnyis ris bral gzigs pa'i thugs kyi zer/ /mig ngag snying gi lam du 'bral med smon/ /ring nas phra rags spros pa'i grwa zur kurge/ /chos dbyings thig le gcig rtu 'khyil ba'i skur/ /gzhom gzhig brel yang tshar mthonge bdag ༄cag phyir/ /tshi mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dad gus sprin gyi ba gam las 'phos pa'i/ / zhu gsol don ldan tshig phreng dbyar rnga'i dbyangs/ 'dzam glingacirgyan gcig mkhas dbang chen po'i snyan/ /mdzes pa'i wardad wawa wame shaX shaṃng dewa wal /— /ri 6 — — — ci ri— tsho — —waru wa rici rnga — wa— — ’tsho———— chibhesnyedze skecho pa—wa — rwabyurlo — 106

gusogasopozugaso rje'igrucir 'arjo ba'i ze sprin phung zhesobya go rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs mig mi zum/ /zum med dus kun 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan/ /spyan ras gzigs gang gsum ldan ngur smrig gar/ snye/gar bsgyur thams cad gzigs pa chen po yi/ /zhabs sen dmar snum srid zhi'i mchod sdong che/ /byang chub snying por mi 'bral gtsug bsten zhing / /dad gsum gyis bskul lag pad sor bcu'i 'dab/ /snying khar bkod de gsol ba'i snying bo ni/ /ma rmad legs byas mkha' klong yangs pa ru/ /ma phyis dri bral rgyal bstan 'od stong can/ /kun lgon bshad sgrub gzi 'od stong 'bar ba/ /kun dga'i dpal du ngom pa deng gi char/ /tshogs gnyis bye ba'i dpal las legs bskrun pa'i/ / mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs gang gzugs sku'i zla/ /legs mdzad ga bur thigs pa 'bum 'dzag bzhin/ /bstan 'gro'i kun da'i gnyen du bzhugs 'dis spro/ /'tshams zhu/ slad mar yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan dpung gnyen du/ / du ma'i bskal bar tshe mtha' yas/ ji bzhin/ /bzhin bzang bgrang yas 'khor dbus mdo sngags chos/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin rtag bzhugs gsol/ /gsol btab bden tshig lhag bsam dag pa'i dbyangs/—/dbyangs can phang 'gro'i rgyud las nyer drangs gtam/ /gtam snyan snyan dbang mdzes byed mchod pa'i sprin/ /sprin gyi rol mo 'khrol 'di 'di nas phul/ / — — 107

bla ma 'jarapa'idabhangs kyizhabyasarūngadugasol ba khya byugastanasnyenan //:snyo tu/sa bya ba/— lung rtogs yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /nyes kun ra ri'i dri mas kun tu dben/ /gzhasaphan bdud ri'i zesre phreng 'bum bkye ba'i/ /skyabs gcig smra ba'i zla ba mchog gi drung / / 4 ṭa/sa pas sdon gasbas64/mtshams sprin gyis 'khyud gser gyi sa'adzin mchog /dmar ser gos kyis geyog na khyod sku'i dper/ /mtshungs pa'i grags dkar srid 'di'i sgra'i khron par/ /rtsen pa'i sku mchog g.yo ba med lags grang / /rab snyan don zab gsung gi 'gyur khug res/ /rab 'byams gzhung brgya'i dka' gnad mdud pa'i rgya/ /bkrol tshe mtsho byung phyag gi rgyud mangs phag / yib pa'i gsung la 'gags pa med lags grang / /shes nyonartsonag nog sgrib pas yongs btang zhing / /shes bya'i’gatshozugs kun gsal ba'i a dar sha/ dpal stug rgyal ba'i mkhyen misaske mtshon minasgyupa'i/ / thugs gyul nam yeng gsal sgrib med lags grang / /'jigaso mdzad thub tshul nyer blong tsong kha ba'i/ /dri med bstan pa'i dpyid du shar ba khyod/ /dbang phyug gnag snume ralineba'i mdzes rgyan zla/ /zla bral bstan 'dzin shar ri'i phrag na 'phags/ /'phags bod gzhung lugs mya ngan med pa'i tshal/ /mkhyen dpyod lus phra'i bgrod byed kyis brdegs tshe/ /rang tshul lhug par bkrol mkhas kun mkhyen rje'i/ /thugs sras rgyu skar dbus na pa sangs gza'/ /ring nas thugs bskyed dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 108

ljon/ /rtsa ba brtan pos bzung ba'i grib bsil du/ /nye bar spyod pas dpag yas slob tshogs la/ /legs bshad dus ston 'gyed mkhas khyod las gang / /des na thugs bskyed 'o mtsho 'phyur ba'i rlabs/ /gnam du 'phyo ba'i legs gsung gzegs ma 'bum/ /dpal gyi mgur nas 'thor bas blo gsal gyi/ /ngang mo 'phur lding gar gyis rtsen par mdzod/ /gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /gang de'i bzhed gzhung rin bral nor bu'i shal/ /dran dbang ri mo gsum pa'i mdzes rgyan du/ /ster la smra ba'i seng ge gcig bur mdzod/ /dkon mchog rgyal ba'i chos mdzod sprin gyi dbyangs/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i sgon mer sgrog mkhas mgon/ /mgon de'i rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag bstod 'grel zung / /gus ldan mdongs mtha'i gsos su stsol par mdzod/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos ha sa badz+ra yi/ /dri bral lung rigs rno ldan ral gri'i so/ /smra ngan mgul ba gcod la ches rno ba/ /'phyar la dge legs dpal bzang7 lta bur mdzod/ /khyod ni ring nas 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ /srad dben snyan brgyud 'dzin la rgyal ba dang / /de sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis dbang bskur na/ /slar yang gsol mi dgos kyang dran gsos tshul/ /de slad bkra shis grangs ldan 'phrog byed kyis/ /nyer btegs su war ṇa yi khri 'phang cher/ /zhabs sen byu ru'i phreng mdzes legs bkod de/ /sku tshe tshe mtha' yas bzhin rtag brtan zhu/ /zhu gsol gsol btab bden tshig dung gi dbyangs/ /dbyangs snyan snyan dbangatshomadzes byed tshig gi phreng / /phreng bar bar med bstar ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /sprin gsar gsar ba'i rtse dga' 'dir gzigs shig / 109

—dro tsho khri chen mchogagizhabasatsūsasu btegasabagadungasel ri sman gyi myuguzhasabya ba/ rbeslab gsum gangs ri'i spo na gnas bcas shing / /'chad rtsom g.yu ral stug pos gnya' ba khebs/ /gzhan phan bsdu bzhi'i sder phreng mkhar rkyong ba'i/ /'jam mgon smra ba'i seng chen mchog gi drung / /lo ka chos brgyad 'khrigs pa'i tshang tshing du/ /chos min chos ltar bcos pas spu mdzes kyang / /'du 'dzi'i jigazeb chud 'dab chags lce gnyis pas/ /gang snyan gtser ba'i mchid 'ga' gsol la rings/ /'gro 'di'i legs byas skya rengs kyis bos pa'i/ /rgyal bstan bya lam mdzes dergyan gang sku'i nyi/ /mkhas btsun gzi 'od 'bum gyi gdengs ka can/ /gdul bya'i pad tshal skyong la rings lags sam/ /bstan 'dzin skar tshogs dkyil na mtshan mo'i māgon/ /ma smad yon tan ri dwags gzugs brnyan gsal/ /bskal mang goms pa'i thugs rje ga bur gzegs/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor 'aspem bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /'phags mchog 'jam dbyangs dgyes 'dzum 'od dkar phreng / /bzhad pa'i zer gyis reg pas ngo mtshar 'bum/ /rnam bkra bkra cishis g.yas 'khyil chos kyi sde/ /sde 'di thugs kyi ze'u 'brur bcangs lags sam/ /mos gus chu khur stug por 'khrigs pa'i gseb/ /khyod yon dran pa'i glog gi thag pa dang / /lhug lhug gsol 'debs dbyar lnga ldir pa'i bur/ /rnam kun rjes brtse lhod min gzhes lags sam/ /tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma mas skyed bsrings pa'i/ /phul byung mdzes sku yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /gzhom med ting 'dzin srung 110

ba'i rwa gur nang / /nyams med nyar ba'i las 'dir lhod mi 'tshal/ /kun rtog spros mtshan dwangs pa'i 'od gsal mkhar/ /shin phra'i rlung sems mtshar sdug nyams brgya'i gar/ /bsgyur pas gzugs sku zho 'thung rus pa'i khams/ /mos ngor lha dbang dpal du g.yo med bzhugs/ /nyi zla'i dpal 'phrog mdo sngags bstod ṭika zuro / /dbang lha 'i rjes gnang rgyun bzhugs sgrub skor lung / /rmad byung tshig bkra bstod pa'i bka' rtsom sogs/ /sngar zhus de kun thugs kyis mi bsnyel stsol/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan pad ma'i skud ltar phra/ /rjes 'brang phal cher 'di snang rgya ru tshad/ /de 'dzin skyes bu nam mjug bung zhes ri 1)// //// ri pa //// ///droba' spun/ / ru dgongs tshe mtha' yas ba na mdzod/ /sman ma ga a ru rnam par rgyal ba'i skyes/ /skyes sbyangs blo gros dman pa'i gyi na ba/ /ba glang rnam thar 'dzin des zla tshes la/ /sman pa'i wal po gang gi mdun sar phul/ /— ༷ 111

pha / — —snye ciwa — rī 4 ༷ stong — zhe zhudzi bahūṃl snyanadab—nga smrerme spru/'i rgyusdo mangs zhesda je ba/ — rmye babye5 ngagaci gi dpal kha tshodarmeb—nga— 'argyur sdobyangs rnoṅge darge' ma'i snyems 'uphrog 'jigs med rig pa'i gad rgyungs kyis/ /gleg smre gnyis 'thung stong gi ringam bcatsu myos —rbem rnol dz+nyāng blo gros garmerme lngame ngaga' bsted ngam chos kyi/ / / — ri ri rna na / tsho/ 'ab tsho sne —pad tshal rgyaska pa'i— dran dbang bh+raḥm ra yi khyu tshogs 'dod 'jo lung rigs 'phur lding gar gyis brel/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i nyin byed zla med smra ba'i seng chen 'dren mchog yab sras 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i gsos/ /blo gros snang ba mchog sbyin ngag gi lha/ / lha mchog li khri'i 'od mnga' 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge rgyal ba'i yab/ /yab gcig 'jam dpal dpa' bor gus btud de/ /ngag dbang dbyangs ldan rig pa'i gter la dbang / /gsung dbang smra ston yid 'phrog na chung ma/ / ma lus rgyal kun bskyed yum 'dod 'jo ma/ /ma gcig sgeg mo'i khyu mchog gang de'i zhabs/ /rnam kun mi 'bral spyi bo'i mdzes rgyan du/ /du ma'i byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /kun tu bsten pa'i skal bzang thob pa bdag / bdag nyid chen por 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas/ /gus pa chen pos gsol ba ni/ dge legs 'dzad med bstan pa'i chu gter rgyun/ /dge bar 'bab pa bshad sgrub chu bo 'bum/ /'bum phrag dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar cher dgod pa/ /pa tra'i ris ltar bris pa deng gi char/ /ma smad skye 'gro'i legs byas mkha' dbyings su/ /ma phyis rang 112

gsal sku mchog nam mkha'i nor/ /nor dbyig mdzod kyis khugs min srid zhi'i rgyan/ / rgyan gcig bstan 'gro'i dpal du 'tsho rgazhes ngos/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po ngur smrig gir/ /'jam rmagon rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gsung rab phul/ /phul byung lung rigs tsha zer 'bum spro ba/ /ba dan mkhas rgu'i gtsug na 'khor ba'i gzhung / /gzhung bzang 'bum phrag du ma'i bcud 'dus gang / /gang du su yis ji bzhin 'chad dka' zhing / /zhing 'dir byon pa'i dran dbang smra ba'i kha/ /kha zum nyi mas btang ba'i pad+mo bzhin/ /dbu sems mkhan po'i gzhung brgya 'dus pa'i mtsho/ /mtsho byung mgrin chags mkhas mkhas mig yangs ma/ /ma lus 'gugs pa'i bstan bcos bstan pa'i rgyan/ /rgyan drug gzhung gi dod thub drang nges gzhung / /gang der sngon phyis mkhas mang blo rtsal las/ /nyer thon rnam 'grel rgyu skar grangs mtshungs dbus/ /'jigs med spobs bsnyes rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar spel gang gzhung 'gran zla bral/ /'di ci brjod don don zab mngar mo'i bcud/ /blo chung blo yis myang bar nus min yang / /yang yang bskul ba'i nan ngo mi bzlog par/ /gsal gsal gdams pa'i dga' ston dgyes stsol zhu/ /phyi nang gshin rje mthar byed ma he'i zhal/ /zhal mthong tsam gyis mchog thurna dngos grub gter/ /gter du 'gugs pa'i rgyud 'grel chen mo yi/ /bshad lung mkhas rgu'i yid 'phrog bdag la zhu/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal kun tu bzang po sogs/ /gnyis min gnyis su shar ba'i mkhyen rab las/ /nyer thon dbang khrid man ngag gru char gyis/ /bdag rgyud re ba'i zhing sa brlan par mdzod/ /slad kyang zhabs zung mi shigs rdo rje'i mdud/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal tu g.yo med lhun chags te/ /snyan brjid dam chos dbyangs kyis bdag cag gi /thos 'dzin don ldan bgyid par snying nas gsol/ /gcam bus ma yin zol med dad gus kyis/ /sor bcu snying kar bkod de gsol ba'i 113

do do tshi gi phre spe di di kho bosken/ / na ldan ga nga bar lko ba 'a / /'a nas ma 'gyang 'a ri'adren pa mchog tsho/ mchog gsam 'dus zhal dpal ldanabla ma rje/ /rje btsan — ༄ ༄— —'jam dpal dbyangs dang mi gnyis lto / / gang de'i mdun drung gus pas — — skyes bcas btegs —— — 6 / / cho— wa — sgyu—wa zhe dzha — ci tho tsho ci ci —— — rme ci —rte— — — — 114 rī tsho —

glu zhu 'phrin bsung zhim 'thul ba'i rme stog zhes bya ba/rmad byung bshad dang sgrub pa'i chu gter gang / /gang du bkra shis wu phreng dge mtshan 'bum/ /'bum phrag dang 'grogs g.yas 'khyil chos kyi sde/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang cig char dar 'di rmad/ /daXge legs 'dzad mi shes pa ngag gi lha/ /lha mchog 'astson ldan rgyu mtsho'i spyi dpal du/ /du ma'i gar bsgyur ma 'dris dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen smra ba'i khyu mchog gang gi drung / /'di snang lcags kyi dra ba'i rgyar tshud de/ /'di phyi'i don chen sgrub pa'i thabs bral yang / /rnam grol mkha' la 'phur 'dod ma nyams bzhin/ /rnam par 'tsho ba'i 'dab chags lce gnyis pas/ /sor bcu'i 'dab ma snying kar nyer bkod de/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ /rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po gang / /lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug na mngon mtho zhing / /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang byi dor gyis/ /ngo mtshar gzi 'od 'bar ba deng gi char/ /mkhas mang nags klong stug po'i do ra ru/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sna tshogs me tog can/ /bslab gsum dri bsung khor yug spro ba yi/ /legs byas mthus bskrun gang sku tsan dan ljon/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe rlung gis spyod min par/ /mdzad bzang g.yu yi lo 'dab phang phung du/ /chags pa'i grib snum ngogs su spyod ba yi/ /gyi na ba yang lus sems bde mur mchis/ /'tshams zhu/ slad char bshad sgrub zung gis 'jam mgon bstan/ /'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed go cha cher bgos shing / /'jam dpal dpa' po'i rnam thar lhur bzhes te/ /bstan la gang phan bgyid par ༵1 rdos

bskul/ /bgrangs ring bskal mang gong nas bdud bzhi'i dpung / /lhag med bcom khyod 'khrul bral dge ldan lugs/ / skyong slad yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen tshal bzung phyir/ /'dun ldan rgya mtsho'i dpal du g.yo med bzhugs/ /༄ kun byed sems kyi sore loso 'du byed —4ṅkus/ //batshul tshe phra sbom che chang sna ༄tshogs sgra/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs kyi gling ba'i skad/ / snyan pa med kyang ༄byung 'de rangawa gi gshis/ / ci ——( — ——ri dzā 4 — ji —tre — sgyu byu — ga 116 — r+sha — ne+e — ci — — ga —

snyan bsku'agadub kaur silasgra/'od lnga'i 'ja' zer sbubs na mtshan dpe yi lang tsho/ /tsho ru chags pa 'jam dpal ye shes kyi nyi ma/ /ma rig mun pa'i gshed du 'tsher ba yi zer phreng / /phreng ba bdag snying pad+mo'i do ra ru rtsen mdzod/ /bstod yul phul byung gangs ljongs tshad thub kyi rgyal bar/ /bstod tshul rmad byung mdo sngags thub bstan gyi yang snying / /gsal bar mdzad tshul legs gsung ma li ka'i phreng mdzes/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan du len rnams 'jam mgon gyi thugs sras/ /mkhyen rab pha mtha' mi mngon lha lam gyi ngogs su/ /lung rigs tsha zer stong gis gzhung mang gi pad tshal/ /cig car phye bas khong nas rje bla ma'i mdzad bzang / /bzang por bsngags pa bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di'i khyad chos/ /chos can gtan la phab pas chos nyid kyi rang gshis/ /gzhan gyis ma thon gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ /snga rabs mkhas pas snga nas ma rtogs pa'i gnas de/ /'di na tshegs med 'di zhes lag mthil du stsol pa/ /don bzhin ston pa zas gatreng sras po yi rang lugs/ /don la gnas pa blo bzang rgyal ba yi rnam thar/ /don bzhin bsngags pa bstan pa'i sgron me yi zhal chab/ /don ldan legagobashadatsād 'a di'i rin chen gcig lags so/ /sngon dang da ltar 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab kyi rtsal ku na/ /kugardzogs mkhas mang gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byon yang / /yang dag ltar snang spu ris ma 'dres—par ji bzhin/ /bzhin dang me long ngo 'phrod 'di 'dra rang dkon no/ /'jam glu dpal dbyangs can zung gi mkhyen rtsal gyi rgya mtsho/ /mtsho chen thos bsam sgom 117

pas srub pa yi lag rjes/ /rjes 'brang blo mun 'phrog pa'i snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor/ /'khor yug thub bstan pad+mo'i dpung gnyen 'di ngo mtshar/ /mtshar sdug lung gi 'dab ma 'bum phrag tu brtsegs shing / / mtshar sdug don zab sbrang rtsi lhug lhug tu byo bas/ rke/metsharapo'igo rig tre'i 'dzum grol bstod tshig gi pad dkar/ / mtshar sdug blo gsal d+nghabung ba'i snying sdug grogs los yin/ /grags pe mthar khyab blo bsnazaje gragaso me yi bstan pa/ / pa sangase mdzis pa pham byed lta sgom dnge spyod phyogaso/ /phyoges su ma lhung gru bezhi lam gyis rang 'khyer skabs/ / skobs phyed legome bshade 'de med dmus long gi yang tsho long /rmi/stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog 'phrog byed kyi nga ros/ /dngos 'dzin glang po'i myos bum dum bu ru rmethor dang / / rilhan cig ma yine dgag la gnas 'echa' ba'i bod ston/ / ston che—na gral ringe skragatedangangs 'gran pa bzhin 'phel lo/ / rang rang grub mtha'i ga tsug na rang mthong gi 4 cod paṇa/ /mdangs lnga'i bkrag tu 'bar pa'i mkhas mngagi ljags rtse/ /rkyong bar ma nus zab don dka' ga—nage kyi mdud rbargya/ /khyod mkhyen rig 'dzul sor mos r+pāshigalopa 'di e ma/ / — tsho gsang 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi thugs mdzod las thon pa'i/ / gsang chen rgyud sde'i gnad la gol nor gyimatha' kun/ /kun nas bcad de skal ldan zung 'dzuge gi dga'alton/ /ston brgya dus gcig mthong bas ltad mo 'di a la/ /sngon bsags legs byas mthu las dal 'a byor gyi rten thob/ /sngon smon rnam dag mthu las rgyal bstan gyi sgor zhugs/ / sngon 'bre la zab pas 'jam dpal dbyangs dngo4kyi zhabs gin/ /sngon dang phyis —su rnyed min rnyed pa mchog grub bo/ / mthong grol zla zhal gzugs 'dzin ku mud dang rtag ri 'grogs/ /thos grol gsung bcud sgra 'dzin rkang drug gis rtag spyod/ /dran grol mkhyen brtse sems kyi khye'u chung gi gsos su/ /mi tsanabral gtan gyi skyabs 118

sa thob pa 'di a ho/ / dus kyi mtha' 'dir dus dang tshal bstan gyis ma ri zhu la careg /dus kyi rgyan du 'bar ba'i nyi ma khyod bzhugs tshe/ / dus rabs nyi shu'i mjug zin don yod du bya phyin/ /dusnga dang bsnan te khyod gsung mnyan par rang spro'o/ /lan gru grong khyer 'okhor lo sdom pa yi pho brang / /lan tshwa ma yin yan lag brgyad ldan gyi dal 'gro/ /lan re ma yin dus kun lhung lhung du 'bab 'gram/ /ldan mang 'ong bas don po da lan rang grub song / /tshul min tshul ltar 'chos pā'i sgro gshog gi shun par/ /chos min chos ltar sgrog pa'i khu byag gi ba mo/ /'chor min ya ma'i zhugs pa re zhig la lhod na/ /'og min ༄ ༄ / dorno kun grub pa'i dega' tshal —dang los snyogaso/ /'di smra bo yang 'di nas byaXng chab kyismo bar du/ /drirtse waṃn rdem pa'i brtse bas phyag gis rang bzung ste/ /༄ las kyis mnar ba'i lus can mtha' dag gi rnam 'dren/ /srid gsum bla ma srid zhi'i gtsag rgyan khyod bzhin shog/ dmi mi — byu — — ṅka nga — — wa — — snyo wa ju zlo ne+ewa — ci ṅka — 119

zhu mchidadakar mardzasalha reg —rab 'byams shes bya'i snang brnyan 'bum phrag gzugs/ /mkhyen rub me long ngos la dog med du/ /'char rme dus kyi dmar ser ral gri can/ /khri chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad+mor/ /sdi phyed dad pa'i gang sku zla shel ris/ /yid kyi chu mtshor bkod dang chubasri gcig par/ /'dzin byed snying khar zum pa'i 'dud pa bcas/ /yid la brnag pa'i don 'di gsol la rings/ /mi rtag tshe 'di nyi rgas grib so dang / /'dod yon ldid srubs bu mo'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ /brid de chos don sems pa'i skabs 'phrog pas/ /rnyed dka'i dal rten stong bar zad 'dis 'gyod/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs sen nor bu'i phreng / /gtsug bsten zab rgyas gdams pa'i bcud mngar bo/ /myong ba'i skal ba thob kyang yal bor nas/ /lag stong mchan du bcug 'dis sems pa skyo/ /sngon gyi mkhas mang stag chung bung ba'i khyu/ /mtshan nyid bcu ldan g.yo ldem pad dkar tshal/ /nyul te gdams pa'i bcud 'thung nyams rtogs kyi/ /lus stobs rgyas pas dar dir mgrin glu sgrogs/ /deng dus snyigs ma'i rang rtags cher ngom pas/ /phyi tshul tsam gyi mgo sgur lus kum las/ /gang gsung ris bor bdag 'dra'i slob ma la/ /yon tan myu gu 'bus pa'i go skabs gang / /'on kyang 'du 'dzi lcags kyi gzeb nang du/ / chos brgyad ca co sgrog pa'i bye'u chung bdag / yab mes mkha' lding rjes shul snyog 'dod kyi/ /'dun pa ma lhod de slad gsol 'dir dgongs/ /blo bzang grags pa grags pa'i ba dan dkar/ /dkar 'jam yug gcig bstan la phyag 120

rjes zab/ /zab mo'i don gzigs bho ṭa'i sarba dz+nyā/ /dza ya de la ring mo zhig nas gus/ /de yi bstan la de nyid bzhin/ /mkhes tshul mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum/ /ya bral ma song ya mtshan gnas/ /gnas lnga kun gzigs paṇa ṭi ta/ /dkon pa'i mchog gyur bshesaganyen dbang gi rgyal/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i sgron me mkhas rgu'i rje/ /rje de'i dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs ldan ngag gi dpal la rjes 'gro'i gzhung / /don ldan bstod gzhung don gyi ba ku la/ /dri bral lung rigs sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis/ /phye tshe bstan gnyis gsal ba'i sbrang rtsi'i ro/ /dpyodatshuldan rkang ba drug pa'i dpal du ngom/ /gzhung 'dir don bzhin gzigs pa'i dran dbang 'bum/ /don gnas bsngags pa'i me tog sil ma'i char/ /phab mod deng dus rang bstan de nyid dang / /legs bshad rin thang shes pa ri bong rwa/ /khyod ni sngon rabs dam pa'i lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan bri ba ma dmigs cha gang zla/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i rtsa lag tu/ /'khum phyir rang gzhung 'chad la spobs gzengs mtho/ /de slad bstod pa'i rgyal po yongs 'du'i shing / /sngon byon dam pa'i gsung sgros lo 'dab stug / lung rigs dpe gsum 'bras bzang thang ma ru/ /brdal ba'i gzab khrid stsol ba mi bsnyel zhu/ /slad kyang skyil krung mi shigs lhun chags ngos/ /dpag yas chos tshul 'doms pa'i ljags bskyangs te/ /gser ri'i phreng ltar bsgrigs pa'i sku 'phreng gi / mdzad bzang gcig 'thus skyong bar lhod mi 'tshal/ /gus 'bangs bdag kyang thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /rnam kun mi gtong phyi ma'i rdzogs ldan dus/ /'dus pa dang por gyur te gsung gi bcud/ /myangs pa'i zung 'jug rgyal thabs la reg mdzod/ /zhu yig don gsal ngang ba'i bu mo dkar/ /dkar 'jam srid du ring ba'i lha reg skyes/ /skyes su thogs te kho bo'i rnam 'dren mchog / mchog gi bsti gnas delpe ko ṭar 'phur/ /121

ci —— cho tsho —tre — ru— byu— bslapa tshig snyingadzhaṅger ma/— — lnga —brgya'i marme' hūṃdir 'jam dpalta ṅgezhon sgyuwa/— /lnga ldem zuraci phud dbyings su gab ste/ /lnga bdo'i 'ugro ba skyob pa'i mgon du/ /lnga rig paṇa chen brdzur zhugs mchod do/ /lnga phywarnye bcu gnyis rtse mor brgal ba'i/ /lnga lam rgyang so byed pa'i rgan po/rtelnge lnga phung chu skyes ma 'thor gong du/ ske /lnga zung buslab bya—'i ri mo 'bri'o/ /ka— ye las smon bzang po'i naphro can/ /ka ra'i mngar ldan byang chub lam rim/ /ka shi'i sgom rim snying khur byas te/ /ka ba'i ngang tshul lhur bzhes slobs shig / kha bzhad9 chu ris 'bri ba mang ste/ /kha dog legs kyadrwa stong ba'i 'ja' ris/ /kha mthor slebs tshe bslu ba mang bas/ / kha don mtshungs ba'i dam pa'i rje sa snyogs/ /ga ge mo zhig zab mdog kha dang / /ga bur sman— gyi bsung 'thul zer yang / /ga ler brtag na gtad so bral ba'i/ /gwa can bong bu'i skad la ma nyan/ /nga khyod med par kun la byams brtse'i nga bdag nad sel 'chi med bdud rtsi/ /nga yi bla ma bloji bzang grags pas/ /nga tshor gdams oṃ'i rjes su zhugs shig / ca le ci— ler dal 'byor rten bzab / ’ /cha mi snyomaspu pa'i 'di snang las la/ / ja chu'i 'dam ka med nar gza da pas/ / nya re nye re'i grwal la rgyang khyed/ / ta tha ga ta'i sras su gyur nas/ /tha shal tshul spangs tshutshwakhrims skarags/ /da nang bsdams pa do nub glod pa'i/ /na chang bcos ma'i 'e dzam la zon gyig /pa ri pi ri'i 'a jig rten ———— ra pa //// riri mi'adisnang / /pha mthar —na thabs gang ltarosla yangadi /ba rgan lhas nyal bsam blo 'di ka'i/ /macasaburasgyes dgos pa grub min/ /tsa tur grangasasnanasmochos kyi 122

sdom bzhi/ /tsha nad las nyon gdung ba sel ba'i/ /dza ya'i gsang gi mdo ༄chings lags phyir/ /wa ler sems pa gdams don snying po/ /zhwa yi kha dog ser ram dmar yang / /za ma'i nang na dug lhad med pa/ /'a cag blo bzang rgyal ba'i rang lugs/ / ya yo bral ba'i drang thig 'dir 'jus/ / ra rgan pags pas lhags skyob mi nyan/ /la ring 'go ba'i lag rten bla mas/ /sha tshas thugs kyis garwang ba'i gdams pa/ /sa la zag du mi 'jug sku mkhyen/ /ha cang phun tshogs smin zla'i tshes la/ /ha cang skyid pa pe cin rgyal sar/ /ha cang nyi ma thung ba'i dus sa/ /ha lam tsam gyi bslab tshig 'di bris/ /a ho dge ༄ 'dis 'di nas tshe rabs/ /a ti sha dang 'jam dpal snying po'i/ /a mṛ ta 'dra'i gdams pas 'grangs te/ —/a bh+yaḥbudha'i sa la reg shog / snying las gces pa'i bu la snying gtam/ /shī tshas gros 'debs sha nas bcad 'di/ /nam yang lag du longs dang nam zhig / bden tshig 'di bzhin bden don gsal yong / /'di'ang 16rab rgyan 17shing byi'i zla 1rkyanyer lha'i 'das mchod nyin/gling sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos rang— skyil 'dod rgu 'khyil ba nas bris pa da ge/ 123

— sngu 〉 cho — — — zhu mats+tshad mchodapa'i me tog rig 'dzin bye ba'i dbus na mngon mtho 'jigs med smra ba'i khyu mchog gang / /geng la gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul bkod pas blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /che rgu drogs pa'i gtsug na yongs 'phags 'dzin la dgad phyug brgyad ldan mgon/ /mgon po 'jiges bral phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyali ba'i gdung 'tshob sgod nyid kyis/ / dkon mchog mchog gsumā 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs yab rje'i mdo sngags bstan pa'i gdugs/ /gdugs cadakad lung rigs thur ma brgya yis nyer btegs srid zhi'i bla na g.yo/ /snying stobs dpung ba brtan pos 'dzin mkhas mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags 'bar ba/ /ba dan lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug mdzes rgyal bstan gsal ba'i sgron me des/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mchog gi 'phro bskyangs te/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /snyan brgyud gdams zab bdag rgyud bum pa ru/ /bskyil ba'i bka' drin stsol zhes slar yang zhu/ / 124

zhugasol ngang mo'i mgrin glu/dpal stug bye ba'i 'phrin las rang gzugs ma/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig tā re ma/ /ma ltar brtse ba rgyal yum rje btsun ma/ /ma khyod brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying 'khrul bral dge ldan lugs/ /lugs bzang srog gi ka ba bstan 'gro'i mgon/ /mgon po mchog de'i bzhed don lhun grub mdzod/ / 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug tsong kha ba'i/ /'jigs bral bstan pa 'dzin la mgon po khyod/ /'jigs bral gdong lnga'i btegs pa'i khri 'phang cher/ /'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal thabs 'dzin/ /de phyir mgon khyod zhabs sen byu ru'i phreng / phreng ba lha mi'i gtsug nor dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i dpung gnyen du/ /du ma'i bskal bar bzhugs zhes snying nas gsol/ /zhu gsol re 'bras don ldan mdzad pa'i lha/ /lha chen rnams kyis sku tshe'i bar chad kun/ /kun nas bzlog cing mdzad 'phrin lha rnga'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs snyan srid pa'i khong las brgal bar mdzod/ /khyad par 'jam mgon 'jam dpal snying po yi/ /khyad 'phags legs bshad legs lam lta ba'i mig / khyad chos kun tshang kun dga'i dpal ster ba'i/ /khyad par ma 'dres ma lus 'gro la ston/ /sor rtog ye shes shes rab lha mo'i skur/ /yongs bzhengs dga' ma ma ltar brtse ba de'i/ /byin rlabs zab lam lam gyi rim pa'i gnad/ /gnad zab cha lag lag mthil rdzas 125

zhi lo ru tshe ci nyib na zhu/ / cha phag gnam gsar ba' sa ga ga na/ / zhabs pad ༄ bskal brgyar brtan pa'i smon pa'i tshig / man ngag zhu bskul don dang nyer 'brel ba/ /pa sangs ltar dkar lhag bsam dag pas bskrun/ /pyi — lke tsho zi tshodzo —: — — — ——4 snye — ji tsho— ri —ji ci tsho dzha4 — — rto ci — rdzi ci rtso ci sto tsho— sna — ci 9 wa —— 4 tsho— ci wawawa ske —) sku rī r+sha— rme — 126 — rī ca — — tsho /r+sha —

zhugasoladungagi rangasgra zhes bya ba/skyes sbyangs 'jigs pa med pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lung rigs tsha zer stong 'bar 'od stong can/ /skal ldan blo gros 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i gnyen/ /gsum ldan bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /'jiXgs gīd lung dang rigs paX'i sder phreng gis/ /mkhas rlom gnyis 'thung stong gi klad 'gem zhing / /smra mkhas blo gsal pho gros dpal ster lha/ /lha mchog 'jam dpal dpa' bo gtsug na rgyal/ /rgyal kun gsung gsang zab rgyas gdams pa'i bcud/ /rgyud stong phang 'gro'i gdangs snyan mgrin glu dang / /chabs gcig stsol mkhas dwag dbyāng darmungs ldun ma/ /ma lus sdig sngu'i 'ardud ྅jo gtan gyi skyabs/ / skyabs mchog mchog gsum kun 'dus 'dus pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe tshe mtha' yas/ /ji bzhin bzhin bzang 'khor tshogs tshogs nang du/ /du ma'i dam chos chos char rtag 'bebs gsol/ /ring mo zhig nas phra rags bdud bzhi'i dpung / /dpung bcom shin phra 'pho chen dwangs ma'i lus/ /lus can ngor yang las rlung nyer 'tshe yis/ /gzhig bral gzugs 'dzin dpyid du nyams med smon/ /smon gnas yid ltar 'grub pa'i grogs byed lha/ /lha gcig dbyangs can khros pa dmag zor lha/ /lha chen gur zhal la sogs chos srung gis/ /las 'dir bar med dus kun bsrung skyob mdzod/ /de skad smra ba'i byed po gang gi zhabs/ /zhabs zung gtsug tu bkod pa'i dam chos la/ /la 'ur blo kha phyogs pa'i bstan ming bas bas mtha'i spyil chung nang nas shar mar spel/ /shing glang gnam lo gsar tshes tshes dge 127

bar/ / bar med glog bzhin nyer 'khyug 'khyug pa'i ris/ /ris med bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon mgon de'i drung / /drung du myar mjal smon 'dun 'dun stobacas phal/ /yang na/ shing glang gnam lo gsar ngom dga' ston du/ /du ༄ 0 tshoma'i bskal bar sku mchogodabangacho gi rgyal/ / rgyal bstan yid can dpal du mi g.yo bar/ /bar med dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /ge snang ci —ci — sto ri — d+ngha gyu d+ngha kā — ri — —rī stiwa wa tsho rme d+ku sne rī wa 4ji wa ’ wa drosna— — rte — — ske dzo —ri — —— — 128 — d+ngha — — tsho lke

zhu bskul gling bu'i snyan 'gyur/ 'ardigs gīd spobs pame gter grol dri bral gyi mdzad pas/ /'gran med rgyal ba'i bstan pu'i dpal mgon du bzhugs te/ /ris med yid can sku bzhi'i dbyāng phyug gi grong du/ /lhag med drangs mkhas zla med gtsug rgyan der 'dud do/ /kha ba'i ljongs kyi kha lnga blo bzang gi rang lugs/ /kha bshad mkhan gyi kha chus ma sbags pa'i bstod ṭika/ /kha ba'i mdangs kyi kha dog pham byed kyi brtse bas/ /kha gsal legs 'doms kha rje stong gsum du shong dka'/ /kha dar tsam gyi zhu rten srin skud las phra yang / /kha ba'i ljongs na rnyed dka'i mdo sngags kyi gces nor/ /kha ba'i rdul ltar spungs pa dgyes bzhin du bstsal bas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan mgon po bka' drin rang che'o/ /kha 'bab rnam bzhi'i rgyun la co 'dri ba'i chos 'khor/ /kha che bu ston 'chad par zhugs pa bzhin bskor bas/ /kha ba can gyi seng chen 'jam mgon gyi bka' srol/ /kha ma bri bar dgung du lud pa 'di khyod drin/ /kha gting med par dkar ba'i brtse chen gyi 'o mtsho/ /kha ba ri ba'i 'gro la chad med du 'phyur ba/ /kha che paṇa chen lta bu'i bla ma yi bka' drin/ /kha brgya lce stong gis kyang bsngags pa'i mtha' rdzogs min/ /kha zhabs gting mdzang med pa yon tan gyi rgya mtshor/ /kha zhe med par bstod pa kha phye ba'i me tog / kha nas gang thon tshig gi srad pu la brgyus pa/ /kha yig gis bskor kha g.yang kha ba'i dus phul bzhes/ /kha dog mdzes pa bslab gsum 'ja' tshon mdangs cher 'bar/ /kha zheng che ba gzhan phan sems mchog gi thang yangs/ /kha char ltar bsil thugs rjes las nyon gyi 129

gdung 'phrog /kha min sems kyis bla mar bsngags pa 'di thal lo/ /kha yig so gnyis mtshan bzang grangs tshang ba'i zhu tshig / tshig gi spun bas ma sgrib don bzang 'bras dud pa/ /pa sangs 'od kyis 'khyud pa'i dad gus kyi rang mdangs/ / mdangs su 'phos —'di dgyeme snyobazhes baṃka' drin rang skyongs shog /bka' drin gsab phyir bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi mchod par/ /bka' las mi 'gongs rang nus gang lcogs kyis 'bad palkese/ / bka' gdams bstone pa'i ka chen gzhon —nu slade lta —b.re/ /—rbakarme rborgyude— 'asdon pa'i sras kyi ra thu bo 0ru —rmegyer smon/ / zhebs zung 'argyur rba med rmeramo brag ri ltar lhun chags/ / gsung dbyangs 'argeg —pa med par tshangs dbyangs ltar gdangame snyan/ —/thugs gsang sgrib— pa med pare nyi zla tram̐re 'od gsal/ /sku tshe rgyun chad maid par lha chu'iji rgyun ltar shog— — / tsho cho — wa — chilke — tsho — —ste ri— ta durīsgyu sto tsho sna /tho ni ci — — sko la — — — ri — rmo walke— rī — ḍa ze— bye — the —— — zhe ༷ — rkerkatsho dhi k+ta kā shā ciju /tsā na tsho0 —— di rduri 4 — — — — — ༷ — — — ngh+ru mid+ku7 bye+o tsho she chi me ri sto mi — ci tsho — rdo — cho bye t+ma 4 ci kāske /— cidze 4 khyisku 3 — — ce — ri d+ngha — — ji — tshorke sgyu — d+dha — bi byu cho rwa ya — 130

rgyal me nas phulastoba'i zhubakasnye'akhagan bskyal — — ut+palagasar ba'i tshun be+e/7gyung gi nyi ma gzhon nu'i mdzes hūṃg gi lang tsho/ /dz+wang gi pad tshal bzhad pa'i rtsa lag tu shar ba/ /gsung gi dbang phyug mkhyen gter byug pya yi zhabs skyes/ /gtsug gi rgyan du skye ba'i phreng ba ru 'dzin to/ /ka nas dag pa lhun grub gzhir bzhengs kyi pho brang / /kha dog dbang gzhus dkris pa'i rang snang gi dkyil 'khor/ /ga nas mi mthun myed pa thugs bskyed kyi kho lag /nga khyod ris bral lhun rdzogs rgyal stes 'di dga' ba/ /ca co'i sgra kun grag stong gsang sngags kyi rung sgra/ /cha byad sna tshogs gang 'dul snang stong sku'i rol ba/ /ja chang bzhes spro zag bral ting 'dzin gyi tshogs 'khor/ /nya rgyas gdong ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral de skyid pa/ /ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i man ngag gi gsang gtam/ /tha shal bdag 'drar gab med lhug pa ru bstsal bas/ da lta'i 'jam dbyangs drug pa'i bka' —drin la bsam na/ /na ge nog ge'i zol med zhabs 'degs rang zhu 'dod/ /pa sangs mdangs kyis mi 'gran byams brtse yis bskyangs pa'i/ /pha mtha' brjod la mtsho byung srab mnyen ljags thung na/ /ba glang sha lce leb mos brjod pa ngo tsha 5nga / /ma brjed mtshon rtags tshig gi gzegs ma 'ga' 'thor ro/ /tsa ri'i gnas sogs snyo ṭa'ipas mtha' kun bskor yang / /tsha grang rkang tshegs zhog pa dka' mo zhig gda' ste/ci /dza ya'i bka' dang rnam dbye med pa yi khyod gsung / /wa ler dran tshe sems pa dar cig—yun sosadal/ /zhwa ser grub mtha'i shing rta 'jam mgon gyi zhal 131

chab/ /za zi'i chang gis myos pa'i kha chus lhad med pa/ /'a 'ur ma yin khungs btsun lung rigs rgyud drangs te/ /ya mtshan snying la byos pa'i drin lan de sus 'jal/ /ra ba dkad lo—'i ljongs na9grags snyan gyuches mtho ba/ /la lung kun na dzam bu'i chu gser las dkron sdi/ ṣisha khrag yon du phul ba'i rtag ngus kyang ma thos / /sa dge chu bo gcig 'dres gdams zab des yid tshim/ /ha sa badz+ra yab sras mdo sngags kyi ltegs bshad/ /palka lda 'jam dabhangs gsum pa'i gsung rab kyi rinying khu/ / gye cang gregad+kus snyan che ba rnam gnyis kyi bstod 'grel/ ga.a dzha rgyal sare gnang na de bas skyidā ci zhig /stobs 'ebyoro mnga' thang der ba'i yon bdarge gi khyu mchorge / las deng smonadze lam dag pasne slob tshogs kyi dwangs ma/ /rgo bzhin dad dam brtan pa'i ya rabs kyi yang rtse/ /ci byes lam 'gro'i zhu grogs de las lhadaga' su yod/ /bla ma'i— sku tshe mdzad 'phrin lha chu'i rgyune je ring / /slob mas bam̐sam sbyor dag pas bsten tshul ni je legs/ /dga' ma'i 'phral phugs che phra'i bya ba'i mtha' je brtan/ /mtha' ma'i rgyal bstan bsrung ba'i lcags ri'ang 'dis byed/ /de phyir —'de lor 'di nas gnang ba yi gsung lan/ /blo sems gcig tu gcig dril choge pa yi re lan/ /mi 'gyur zhal bzhes zhal rlangs ma nyamaso'opa'i bka' lan/ci— / mose ldan snyim mdzil snyim pa'i me tog bzhinatsho stsol zhu/ /gnas rdus phun sume tshogs pas nam mkha' la bkra shis/ /ston 'ekhor phun sum tshogaso bas sa —gzhi le gecud rīrgyas/ /dam chos phun sum tshoges pas mkho rgu dang gzhan snang / /kheb len dang nye lcags phye'i ngang tshul ltare 'gyur smon/ci /nejam dbyangs na rim bsti gnas pe jicin gyi grong khyer/ /ḍasum rtsen khengs smad ma 'dres bco brgyad kyi khang brtsegs/ / tsi nā'i rig 'dzin tshodabangartomo bstar chags kyi bzhugs gnas/ /'dzinabazhi lhun grub ba gom bzhi ba'i thog legs spel/ /ces tsi nā'i rig 'dzin dbang mo dang lhan gcig ṭubastod 'grelardo rje gsugagyi snangadhe ba'irtebashad 132

lung rgyal sa nas zhu ba'i gros thag bcad tshe khong nyid la 'bal rgyur/ 7bla ma rdo rje ༄'chang chen po'i slob mtha' pa/ gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am rig byed dga' ba'i lang tshor 'bod pas rig byed mas rig byed ma bskul ba lta bar song ༄ba'i dge mtshan chen pos yid drangs mur las bzhi lhun gyitsho grub pa'i dbang gi gur cikhang ba gam bzhi bar sag las sa bgyis pa dza yachu/ / rig rig ri ji — tsho tsho cho cicirī cho — — ci ske ci wa — — wa ri ci — — — — —— 133 —

zhe — —ḍa — 4 rwa snyaskobasku'akhotshosnanagartsaburte silasgra/ 4 — spre'ajiXgs meXd rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab snang ba'i mdzod/ /zla med bstan paX'i dpyid du bkrag 'bar ba/ /mtshungs med 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbyāng sgyug gi / dri med zhabs skyes rtsibs stong ri mo'i gam/ /ring nas las dang nyon mongs kyag kyog lam/ /brgyud de chos lam 'bab min sems kyi chu/ /dam pas legs bstan 'dzin ma'i gshong drang bor/ /rtsol med rgyug par re ldan des gsol ba/ /bsam 'phel nor bu'i tog ldan bstan pa'i gabyugs/ /bshad sgrub dar sham lhab lhub g.yo ba can/ /srid zhi'i gtsug tu 'khor min khyod byin la/ / rag phyir bskal brgyar brtan 'di snying bo'i don/ /lung rigs gshog 'gyur ngom pa'i gser gyi nyu/ / rnam dpyod gser mig gzhung brgya'i gting na 'khyil/ /'dus sde'i 'chad nyan rgyas pa khyod mthu la/ /rag phyir yan ring bzhugs 'di snying bo'i don/ / lha sngags bdud rtsi'i bcad rga ca ri ringagatams shel dkar byām/ / lha rdzas dar gyi mgul chings kha rgyan can / /dbang bum phyag sor rgyan 'chang khyod gcig la/ /rag phyir rnam kun brtan bzhugs snying bo'i don/ /bstan pa'i sa chen sgeg pa'i chu'i paXd ༷/ /bsung zhim phyogs bral skal bzang bung ba'i mgron/ /bsu ba'i pho nyar 'gyur min khyod nyid la/ / rag phyir yun brtan gsol 'di snying bo'i don/ / ma rig gnyid 'thug las slong chos kyi rtswang / / 'chad rtsom dbyangs sgrogs skye ba lnga ba'i gdangs/ / legs lam g.yas 'khyil mdangs lnga'i cod pan can/ /'bud phyir rtag bzhugs gsol 'di snying bo'i don/ /bslab gsum mdud rgya 134

dam pa'i dpal be'u/ /rgyu 'bras 'gal min theg pa'i khugs so can/ /thab ༄bstan rgyan sdu 'ats+tshang ba khyod gcig phyir/ / tshe mtha' yas bzhin bzhugs pa snying bo'i don/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba la/ / zhum cas /ste/ /ste lha rdo stongathebalta'i sdong gzha sung ༷ /ste)༷ /khye/ da nga — bas —na 'a rnam par tha—ra/ci /nyams da dbang m+bhag brgyad — obakra shis ris/ / chad med srid mthar gsal 'di snying bo'i don/ / nges 'byung lte bar phyin drug 'altor ldo'i rtsibs/ /mtha' bral yang dag lta ba'i mu khyud zlum/ /rim gnyis gser 'od 'khyug pa'i zung 'jug mkhar/ /yud kyis 'phyo khyod yan brtan snying bo'i don/ /snying sdug snying gi dum ba zla sring ma/ /ri ca ri zhubakra legs bkrari shis mtshan ma'i gos bzang can/ /snying don snying la 'bab pa'i sdug gu ma/ /mkhyen gter mkhyen rab gzhon nu'i grogs su bsrings/ /khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du spyi lo 92rab gnas 17chu bya lo'i zla tshes dge bar byāskun 'dri dang chabs gcig tu gus zhabs pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos phul ba rda yachu/ ri— — — — lngo — 4 spre 1 waji sto ci sto — —— — d+kutrī — ci — —/— —wa wa — — wa zhe— rī rtse ne+e — —4 d+ku — — 7 — — ji zlo lke — — ske dze dzo — 135

krang gyazhabasadrung sbrul btubasku rinarba cher phurtswabartangartang5gagi rardasgra/ rgyal babyen 'dzin ma'i khyon na mkhas btsun gdugs/ /lung rtogs dar sham g.yo be'i rgyal byed mtshan/ /chos 'byor sgra da byangs sgrog pa'i g.yas 'khyil dung / /tshe dpal bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum bzang gam/ /thub gsung chu mtshor nyul ba'i gser mig can/ /'jam mgon legs bshad dpal be'u'i mdud pa'i rgya/ /snying gi pad+mar sim des gzhi gsum gyis/ /'dud pa'i gser 'khor btegs te 'di skad zhu/ /dam par 'os pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum phyir/ /mkhas bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa bka' drin zab/ /'on kyang phar phyin dam bca' phar bskyal nas/ /pha yul pha mtha' yangs par skabs bstun phebs/ /gzigs skyong grub nas slar yang thos bsam gyi/ /'phro mthud snga ma'i mdzad bzang ma nyams par/ /chos kyi za ma tog tu 'gyur ba ru/ /chos kyi 'byor ldan khyed la snying nas zhu/ /khyad par bsil ri'i lo ka yangs pa'i tog /tog dkar dngos kyi zhabs skyes rin chen tog /tog tu bkur te bsgo ba'i ngag len pa/ /tog gyur rgyal sras myu gu'i spyod pa'i phul/ /phul gyur gzugs sku'i zla ba yar gyi ngos/ /phul gyur rnam dpyod blo ldan ri bong gzugs/ /phul gyur dang 'grogs bstan 'gro kun da'i tshal/ /phad lhag med par skyong la 'dir yang dad/ /de lta'i zhu 'phrin tshig gi gtos ༄136

chang yang / /don gyi sha tshil brdzangs pa'i tshis mo mo/ / bag yangs ngang nas ༄bzhes te sgrog skad dang / / 'thab pa'i bsang ldan gsang shog chad med rig rig mkhyen/ /zla ṭ+wāṃtshes 2 5dge bar gus pa chen pos phal/༄— — — — dze rngo 5 dzha wa— 1 — ci wa — rkya — chi wapa wa— — tsho — — — rte — — — — —rtso — — 7 — tsho 137

sa bya lam mdzesapa'i.ut+pal/ ne tsho4rke li spu med ngos la grang reg mda' zug pa'i/ /tshokha ba'i dus su kha nas gang thon gyi snyan ngag / ga ler gyer netshe dbyangs can dga' ma de bzhengs nas/ /nga la 'khyud ces mig mdun 'ong ba 'di dga' ba/ /ca co ma yin dri za'i phang 'gro yi rang sgra/ /cha shas kun tshang chos kyi de nyid kun len pa'i/ /ya sdong ldem ldem bskyod pa'i sgeg 'gros kyi na chung / /nya thag chad pas rtsol min grogs thob de skyid pa/ /tā ming rgyal sar ta la'i ljon shing gi phreng ba/ /tha dad tha mi dad pa skor tsho ru bsgrigs grib/ /da lta yud kyis thon pa'i dga' ba yis mi 'gran/ /na mnyam bu mo'i grogs thob me long de dwangs pa/ /pa ṭu mkhas pas rtsod pa'i mig yangs ma'i sor gdub/ /pha rol rgyang du ma song rang gam nas thob pas/ /ba 'o dri bral ltar dkar gtsug lag gi yig ris/ /ma li'i bsung ldan brdal pa'i pha mtha' rang sus rig /tsa ri gnyis pa sku bla spun gsum gyi lha zhol/ /tsha ba'i gdung 'phrog rma chu dal bzhud kyi g.yas zur/ /dza ya'i dgongs bcud lag bstar slob pa'i grwa 'di ko / wa ra ṇa si'i do ru langs na cis mi dga'/ /zha 'theng 'gros kyis slebs dka' rig gzhung gi thang po/ /za zi'i dug hrul brtsegs pa'i sgyid lug gi mal du/ /'a cag ro nyal rgyag pa'i spyod ngan de dor dang / /ya mtshan pha myes dga' ba'i dgod sgra yang los go / rwa dang sug bzhi 'dzugs pas myi zog gi shan phye/ /la lung blun po'i lugs yin rnam dbye la mkhas pas/ /sha thang 'bad pas rig gnas nor bu tshags gyis dang / /sa steng 'gran bral grags pa'i ba dan 138

de sas snyol/ /ha cang mdzes pa med kyang ha lam gyi ka bsgrigs/ /a rogs a ༄ mas gces pa'i slob phrug tsho'i mig mdun/ /mdun rgyab ma log bris pa'i rnam dkar gyi mthu las/nya/las ldan na gzhon slob mu'i bsam rgu'i don 'grub snyam/ /gang shar sde mo gang la thogs rdugs dzodange braldar ba/ /gangs ljongs skyes pa'i gangs ri'i snyan ngag pa zhig gis/ / gang la gang gis mi mtshon dung sems kyi ngang nas/ / gangs ri'i phang bzhad gangs mdangs me tog 'di 'bul lo/ /da bar da tshe rang rigasga gzhon nu ma'i rtsom yig / khra chung khra ril mig gi ltad mo ru son nyung / 'imyos me'i ngag 'dab grol nas myos bam gyi sa — — tre ri gi tsho'o rgyun/ /rang grogasga —gzhon nu 'grangs pa'i rang gsos su 'bebasarī mdzod/ /spyi lo 96spyi zla 1 tshes 27chu tshod rdosteng rma chu rdzong bod 'bring mtho gsum mthar phyin 'dzin grwar snyan khrid stajug legs skyes su 7gling sprul bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am zla sring ngag gi me tog rig byed dga' ba'i lang tshor 'bod pas/— gar 'dug mtsho ldan mdun sa 'jam dpal bzhad pa'i gur khyim nas sbyar ba/ na gzhon pho mo kun gyi ngag 'dab lhug par grol zhing bsam rgu yid smon bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ /sarba marga lam̐/ —ne+e sta —ri rna — 139

’sna ci —4— 4 chikyi rtebatsunaṅgel mdzadelha mo~X bstowa :ngagaso~X sa — shāli tsho — — tsho keri 'debasayasnat+parmegasdon nu'i sdo dzan/rdzi rna a(mū las lhag ('phags mesne snyeṅgebyuwa rje depag bsdome dz+dzan pa'i sdib rbesil du/ —/ka —gdud du —sgyur thusba bsta7dz+wasdog zhedzirne baspe' gdams snga— phyi'i phreng ninge kun/ /ha cang mākhas pa'i rgyal thabagarmu bkod gna'u gtam grags snyane jilo —chen dbyajas/ci /ne kha ba'i yul na kha god kurne gyis ga cig min la na mang sgrogs de rmad/ /sa skyong bu mo ye shese zla ba sa dab nga snying gi thig le ma/ /ga bar dri ldan ga ler ma yin myur bar 'jigs sgrol snying nye de'i/ /sha 'jam sdo ca ri sha sgrib min riseng ras gseng nas sha mdangs mtshan gyi me tog dri/ /nga gcig ma yin nga khyod med par sus bsnams mchog thun mal na myos/ /la ba dkar po'i rdo leb la bzhugs dpung rgyan rtse mo'i rigs sngags mthus/ /ca co sgrogs pa'i lha las rgan pham lha rgyal nga ro'i 'brug ldir bzhin/ /rwa gdengs gshin rje bdud sde'i ra bcad myur ma dpa' mo'i mtshan gyi dbyangs/ /cha tsam sgra yi khron par son pa'i cha shas kun rdzogs sa la reg / ya mtshan sngon smon legs byas mthu las ya tshad dal 'byor rten bzang rnyed/ / ja sdong ldem pa'i bas mtha'i nags su ja skyems gdams zab bdud rtsi 'thung / /'a cag 'gro 'di ngan song ngan 'gro'i 'a 'ur 'bar ba'i me nang nas/ / nya mo lcags kyus drangs pa ji bzhin nya lto ba yi mal du skyol/ /ta tha ga ta'i bskyed pa'i yum gyur ta ming rigs sras kong co ma/ /ta la'i rim byon thugs kyi thig le ta ma lar 140

'thab 'brugasmogi dbyangs/ /ta zig la sogs ma nges yul grur ta la la ltar gsal 'tsher phreng / /ta re mig yangs khyod kyi phyag gis ta la'i phreng ba'i grib tu zhog /za ma lang tsho bya ba'i bor kyang za nyal lto 'greng khengs pa mtho/ /tha shal blo can ma rabs gral rgyugs tha ram ske lo'i ngang tshul can/ /zha bo'i 'gros kyis sa mi chod pa'i zhwa ser rkang 'dren de dag las/ /da lta bkyed na ci ma rung snyam rnam dag smon pa'i mtshams sbyor gzab/ /wa ler yid kyi me long ngos la wa ler 'phags ma'i snang ris 'bum/ /na 'chi'i rgud pa mtha' ru sangs par na rim mkhas pa'i snying sdug ma/ /dza ya gong ma'i yum gcig bsten na dza lang sems kyi gol shor phrang / /pa sangs lam du mdangs lnga'i tshon ldan pa tra'i ris bzhin yal bar mdzod/ /tsha grang khyad bsad byang chub sgrub la tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa dang / /pha myes blo bzang rgyal ba'i thugs bcud pha mthar 'don la dge legs dpal/ /tsa ri tra sogs mig yangs 'du sar tsa mi'i brtul zhugs lhur blangs te/ /ba so'i brkos ris mdzes khyad dod pa'i ba ri lo tsā'i khrir 'dzegs mdzod/ /ma rig mun sel thugs rje'i snang bas ma rtog log rtog mun pa sings/ /ma deg tsems kyi dri ma'i tshogaspu kun ma lus gdams zab chu yis bkrus/ /ma sring khyod kyis rnam kun rjes zungs ma yis bu gcig la bzhin du/ /ma rnying yon tan me tog tshogs kyis ma bzhin rnam kun brgyan par mdzod/ /'phags yul paṇa chen ngag gi dbang phyug 'phags mas rjes bzung grags pa can/ /lha gcig dī bam kā ra'i mtshan mnga' lha mo'i dgyes brtse lnga rig pa/ /bka' gdams —spyi mes 'brom ston chen po bka' yi dbugs dbyung thugs kyi sras/ /la sogs 'phags bod mkhas pa'i gral ring la 'ur bskyang ba'i snyan pa 'phur/ /phyag na pad+mo bod rje btsan po'i phyag mtshan lha gcig chu'i pad+ma/ /rig sngags 'chang ba rgya mtsho'i spyi rje'i rig yum bde chen rgyal mo'i zhabs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtogadabyings su 141

gcod la gzungag ma'i tshul 'dzin glub kyi sgron/rī /phreng ldan gangs ri'i ra ba'i bar rna phreng bzhin bstarabi'i sgyugra gos pa mtho/ /pad dkar 'chung ba dang po'i zhal sgo pad ma dmar bo'i ze'u 'bru las/ /dkar —sngon bstod pa dran dbang yid 'phrog dkar 'jam shog gu'i thang rnyen du/ /mkhyen brtse dri ma med pa'i rtsal las mkhyen ldan mkhas pa'igre gtsug gi nor/ /nor brgyas khug min— sa gsumajidabul sel nor 'dzin me longaji brang du brdal/ / de ltar sngon rabs gtam gyi rgyud mangs de bzhin dad gus‘ sor mo yis/ /legs par brdungs pa'i 'phags ma'i thugs rgyud legs tshogs sgo— brgya lhan phyes pas/ /'phral yun 'dod pa'i re ba skong zhes 'phral du tshig gis dbugs dbyung ba'i/ /rjes zhugs 'dod don gsol ba'i tshig horaga' rjes nas slar yang gus pas zhu / /rmad byung g.yu lo bkod pa'i gzhal med med snang stong ba'i khang mo cher / /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'acan las rang gzugs gzugs legs skyu ma'i na chung ma/ / srid gsum mig gi bdud rtsir yongs 'phrul 'phrul ldan dbang gzhu'i ri mo'i gar/ /'jigs skyob lha mo tā re 'phags ma ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gyis skyongs/ /spang rtogs mthar son dul ba'i dpal gyis dpal stug bye ba'i khengs pa 'phrog /phyogs las rnam rgyal g.yu yī lang tsho lang ling gar gyi 'dab ma g.yo/ /bdud dpung zil gnon 'jigs med —gzi byin gzi 'od khong nas 'bar ba'i nyis/ /rgud pa'i gdung skyob myur ma dpa' mo'i dpa' brtan thugs kyis ring du skyongs/ /sgrub mchog rjes su skyong ba'i zhal ras zhal bzang g.yu yī me tog 'dzum/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gro la brtse bas zur mig zur gyis gti mug ba gam 'jig / nu 'bur bde chen rtsol ba'i bum bzang bum pa bcud ldan 'o mas rgyas/ /'dod rgu'i char —'bebs sgrol ma yum la yum chen sher phyin rdzo bor 'dud/ /'khri shing yal 'dab ltar mnyen phyag zung phyag sor mar gad lhag gsar gyi/ /dngos grub mgron du 'bod pa'i mchog sbyin mchog 142

thun yid bzhin nor bu dang / /skyabs gsum thugs rje bskul ba'i phyag rgya phyagagi ut+pal sdong bur 'chings/ /sa gsum 'dren mchog sgrol ma phum la yum gcig lha mor bltas te 'dud/ /'gying legs sku stod rgyas shing sked skabs sked med gzhu mo'i 'chang bzung phra/ /gnag snum dbu skra'i lan bu nyil zhing nyil nyil gser g.yu'i mgo rgyan g.yo/ /lhan skyes ga bur gsar ba'i dri bsung dri ldan khang ba gzhon nu'i spun/ /thugs rje shugs myur sgrol ma yum der yum gachicig dgo' mar mos blos 'dud/ /lha rdzas gos dang rin chen rgyan rmang rgyan gyi bye brag sna tshogs 'chang / /pad zla'i gdan la sems ma'i skyil krung bskyil te bzhugs pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal/ /'od zer canarnasogs rnam mang 'khor dbus 'khor yug ri dkyililhun po brjid/ /'gro tshogs dbugs 'byin sgrol ma yum la yum mchog mchog der mos pas 'dud/ /de ltare skyabs gcig 'phrin las dbang phyug dbang gis che ba rje btsun ma'i/ /gting mtha' mi mngon yon tan chu gter chu bo rnam bozhi'i mi 'gran las/ /cha shas phra mo phyogs tsam rab brjod rab —gus phang 'gro'i gdengs ka nas/ / slar yang 'dod don —gsol ba'i gdung dbyangs gdung ba'i yus kyis 'di ltar zhu/ /sngon bsags rnam dkar sa bon nyer btab nyer gcig 'phags ma'i mthur nges kyang / /'phral rkyen mi 'dzoms dus la ma babs ma tshang chu lud grogs bral ba/ /rdzas lngegs rten 'a3brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu nus pa mthu can gyur rgalas/ /deng 'dir mngon du 'gyur ba'i phywa g.yang g.yang gi mtsho mo snying la skyil/ /yongs rdzogs lam ston theg mchog dge ba'i dge legs kun3'byung dam pa'i bshesga/ /'dod chung chog shes lta spyod mthun pa'i mthun grogs snying gi ze'u 'brur 'grogs/ /'tshe bral yid 'ong nyams dga' dben pa'i dben gnas sgrub rgyud gong ma'i mal/ /chos ldan mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i phywa g.yang g.yang gi mtsho mo snying la skyil/ /bag med sdig ltung gnas la skrag cing skrag 143

pa'i rnam smin 'byin la sngangs/ /rlabasapachen dge la spro zhing chog bral chog mi shes pa'i 'dun pa dam/ /gdams༅ ngabaltalha la mos gus dag snang dag jipa'i 'khor lor 'byams klas pas/ /las can chos mgo thon pa'i ྾ ྾/ /gsung rab drang nges 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod rnam par4bkya sa'i mig rgyang dang / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i go ba go don 'bigs pa'i gzong kha rno/ /thos don rgyud la sbyor ba'i nyams len nyams rtogs 'gugs pa'i kyo ba'i mchu/ /'gal med grogs su 'khyer ba'i ྾ ྾/ /rgya chen thos pa'i shesakābya'i pha mtha' pha rol sngo bsangasakrong rtser reg / phra zhib bsam pa'i gzhung brgya'i dgongs non dgongs pa'i gtad so gting nas rnyed/ /yengs med sgom ga'i nyams rtogs nang bcud nang gi yon tan khong nas rgyas/ /sa la gong 'phel bgrod pa'i ྾ ྾/ /zab don 'chad pa'i skal ldan re 'dod re ba lhag mar ma lus tshim/ /dgag sgrub rig pa'i rgolangan dpa' snying dpa' ba'i 'dab ma rtse nas gzhom/ /sdeb legs rtsom pa'i dpyod ldan yid dbang yid 'dzin dbyangs can snyems pa 'phrog / thub bstan phyogs brgyar spel ba'i ྾ po/ /bag yod bslab gsum dpal gyis sgo gsum sgo kun thub pa'i kun nas dul/ /ting 'dzin dga' bde'i lus sems las rung las su bkol la shin tu mnyen/ /mkhyen rab soradze+es dka' gnad mdud rgya mdud pa'i khug mgo gzhi nas bshig / bslab gsum bang mdzod thob pa'i ྾ ྾/ /nges 'byung drag po'i srid par zhen sdi zhen kha log la mar zan bzhin/ / bcos min snying rje'i gzhan don khur chen khur du 'khyer la gnyis 'thung stobs/ /yang dag lta ba'i bden 'dzin sbubs rgya khong nas gzhig la rgo ru'i’rtse/ /lam mchog gzhung shing brtan pa'i ྾ ྾/ —/rgya chen thun mong lam gyi rgyud sbyangs rgyud kyi dri ma gzhi nas dag / smin byed rnam dag dbang bzhi'i 'jug sgor 'jug la nā ro'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /dngos grub rtsa ba dam sdom mig bzhin 144

mig gi rno las gces par srung / /rig 'dzin gral mjug zin pa'i྾ ྾/ /phra rags bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor rnal ma'i don la gcig tu dril/ /tha mal snang zhen kun rtog rgyang bsring rgyang min sku bzhi'i na chung 'gugs/ /gang snang snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lo dag gsal ye shes snang char shar/ /gsang chen dga' ston myong ba'i྾ ྾/ /ro rkyang rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar dbu zhabs med par shad kyis thim/ /kun rtog mtshan ma'i sdos tshogs dbyings su dbyings las mi gzhan rang ngor nub/ /mi shigs phra ba'i rlung sems lha sku lha phrug gzhon nu gar gyis sgeg / tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i྾ ྾/ /brtse ldan ma la bu yis 'bod ltar 'bod pa'i ngag gi bang chen pas/ /skyabs gcig 'phags ma'i thugs rje nyer bskul nyer zhi'i dbyings las snyer bslang na/ / pad+ma'i tshal la bung ba'i na chang na mnyam yud kyis rtsen pa bzhin/ ///blo sa re/ spyo rig ri pa /jije ///sti spyo rig ///sags tshogs ngang sa 'du ba'྾ ྾/ /sne rnan gza' klu 'byung bo' ga da pa gnod byed ming gi lhag min zhi/ /nang rkyen rtsa rlung khams kyi 'du ba 'du 'bral med par rang sar stoms/ /gsang rkyen re dogs 'khrul ba'i rnam rtog rnam mang chu khur rang ngor sangs/ /sgrub la bar gcod med pa'i bkra shis bkra legs nyi zla'i mtha' khyab shog /cho pe cin nas bris / / dzo rme — ske 145

ri ri ri — ji — — — mo rdzi 4 — — — ciste garmeng 'gyugs6t+pal/dmerno po'i kyo ba/ tsho — bla ma mchog dang —dbyer me—da thugs rje'i gter/ /'od mtha' yas pa — mo rte 1 — zung bdī rtecan chos kyi skur/ / bede ba'i 7gar mdzad rig 'dzin dabhang mo yi sa/ /burtan g.yo'i dadwos kun 'gugs pa'i las mdzod4 cig / sems —kyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i mkhar/ / glo bur rnam rtog dri mas sgrib pa'i sprin/ /rang ngor sangs pa'i dwangs shel me long —ngor/ /'bum phrag gzugs— brnyan— 'char ba'i phywa g.yang khug /gaslab gsum gtsug labur mtho ba'i spos kyi glang / /lung rigs mche ba dar ba'i khog pa ru/ /nyams rtogs bācud dzhadu smin pa'i gi wang gis/ /nyes brgya'i zug rngu gcog pa'i sto g.yang khug / sngo ldum zos pha'i nying khu 'o ma ru/ /bajibs pa sgeg mo'i sor tse'i 'phrulda bar nas/ / bton te lhan du chags pa lhang po'i zhos/ /snying po'i don mchog rtogs pa'i phywa g.yang khug / nor 'dzin ma mu'i lto las drod gsher rkyen/ /tshogs pa'i nar son g.yu mdangs lang tsho ma/ / tshe srog rdo rje'i khams sgrub dur ba'i rtswas/ /rnam kun tshe la dbang thob phywa g.yang khug / bil ba'i bul min tshe thung 'di nyid la/ /thun mong sgrub pa'i mchog gi dngos grub char/ /char bzhin byos pa'i rig byed phug pa'i nang / /don kun 'bad med 'grub pa'i phywa g.yang khug /ti ma'i grong nyal bsam don g.yas su 'khyil/ /chos kyi dbyangs sgrogs lhag bsam dkar mdangs rdzogs/ /chos rnams ma nor ston la dbang 'byor bas/ /dung gis tshig la dbang thob phywa g.yang khug /li khri'i dmar 'od 'bar ba'i dga' ma'i rum/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'dod ldan 146

gzhon nu'i khyu/ /mtha' dag bsdus te ci bsgos de sgrub kyi/ /khyed srid mtha' ru brtan pa'i phywa g.yang khug / yangs dkar rdo rje'i tsha tshas phyi nang ༄bgegs/ / gzhob thul ma lus sreg par byed pa yi/ / mthu stobs yon tan phan sam tshogs gyur pa'i shis brgyas bgegasmo rnams zhi ba'i phywa g.yang༄ ༄ / — / gyi khug /bcom ldan 'das ma'i 'phrin las lcags kyu yis/ /snang srid dregs ldan mtha' dag dbang bsdus te/ / chos srid dga' ston dar ba'i 'bras ba d+ngha ca ༄la/ /ci dgar longs sa spyod pa'i bkra shis shog / /༄ ci pe cin nas bris/ /thi mo lha rī — — — r+sha — ci rka — — rwa 5 — d+kuwa — smo — ci ci — tsho — 147

— — cho tshoru — bstod tshig me togadamarayo'i rna rgyan/ 'jigs med 'ad+meṅge tshozlos ut+pal na chung ma/ /thub bstan dga' tshal 'dzum pa'i mig yangs ma/ /dbang byed sgrol ma dbang gi lcags kyu ma/ /ma lus shis brgya'i phyug mas shis pas skyongs/ /me tog mde'u'i rtses bskyugs pa'i 'od dmar rdul/ /gcig gis reg pas srid zhi'i legs tshogs kun/ /ma bos ngang gis 'du ba'i cho ga la/ /pad mtshor ngang mo 'jug pa'i do mi yong / /'dab ldan gnam ru bkang bas gzi byin che/ /'dod lha sder bcas ma bzod yid chum nas/ /lus med stong ba'i dbyings su bros pa la/ /ma bsnyad par yang de yi cho lo bkal/ /mnyen lcug kyo ba rnon po'i gug pa'i rtses/ /dregs ldan bye ba'i yid dbang sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /lhag med brngubs pas stag chung ma rangs par/ /za zir bsdig bzhin 'phongs mdas bsnun par rtsom/ /bsung zhim khor yug ldang ba'i 'phrul zhags kyis/ /brtan g.yo'i sum dwangs smin legs yid 'phrog gzugs/ /nor bzang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ma/ /'khri shing yal 'dab re bzhi'i brjod don lci/ /rig byed 'dzin byed rig byed mtshan mas brjid/ /rtse mo'i 'dren byed rtse rnon zur gyi rtse/ /gang la zug gang gang du dbang byas shing / /bgrod byed zung gis bgrod pa gcig sar bgrod/ /chos can 'khor 'das chos dbyings ro gcig pas/ /lan brgyar phyis pa'i byi ru'i me long ltar/ /dag gtsang 'od du 'tsher ba'i zhal khyim du/ /cung gtsigs tshems dkar zla myug mdzes pa ston/ /dkar 148

nag ma 'dres lta byed pad+ma'i 'dab/ /yangs shing chags nyams 'dzum bcas sgrub por gzigs/ /snga phyi med par srid gsum skye bo sus/ /mthong tsam nyid nas yid brtan dbang med 'phrog / thogs reg dang bral sngo bsang bu mo'i phang / /glo bur 'phos pa'i mdangs lnga'i 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dbang gi 'phrin las nyid/ /byad legs zla ba dmar po'i dga' mar 'khyil/ /bdud bzhi rang sar dag pa'i phyag bzhi ma/ /na tshod che phras ma bslad dar bab tshod/ /brtse chen snying rje'i 'gro la rjes chags pa'i/ /rgya skyegs me tog gsar ba'i bkrag kun 'thung / /myang 'das go 'phang ston byed gyen bskyod skra'i/ / rtsa bar rigs lnga'i mtshon rtags thod skam dang / /dbyangs gsal rnam par dag pa'i khrag 'dzag pa'i/ /thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal tshar du dpyangs/ /rtsa phyag bde dang stong ba lhan spyor ba'i/ /'dab ldan dmar bo'i mda' gzhu rna drung du/ /'gengs pa'i rnam rtog zug rngur bsnun pa'i mod/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'i grags pa 'bar/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang / /brtse chen snying rje'i 'gro rnams mi gto nga bas/ /'khor mtsho nas 'dren lcags kyu 'ching byed kyi/ /zhags pas g.yas g.yon 'og gi phyag 'dab mdzes/ /skal ldan 'gro rgyud zag med bde ster ba'i/ /'o chu'i mtshar sdug grol ba'i pad+mo'i rtser/ /chags pa'i brtan g.yo'i don mthun bung ba'i mgron/ /dkrigs pas mtha' la mig stong mig kyang nyung / /nyon mongs spangs shing ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo rna cha rus lnga'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /'gro ba'i dbul sel thod skam rtse'i nor bu/ /la sogs rin bral rin chen rgyan mang 'phyang / /nyon mongs g.yul rgyal stag lpags sham thabs gsol/ /'dod sdang rgyud ldan gdul bya'i rgyud 'dul byed/ /sgrub po rnams la mchog thun dpal stsol ba'i/ /khro chags sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston/ /chos sku'i dbyings na 'khor 'das chos thams cad/ /kun rdzob sgyu 149

ma'i gzugs rol zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ /sgyu mar shar ba'i brtan g.yo'i choṣ+kathams cad/ /'od gsal dbyings su sdud byed g.yas zhabasad+kuskums/ /bdud sde'i tshogs brdzi srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dang / /legs tshogs ma lus cig char dbang sdud pa'i/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung byed pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /nyi gzhon 'bar ba'i 'od kyi gur du 'a gying / /ka nas dgapa'i ye shes rang gzugs ka ma la 'dab spungs pa'i khar/ /kha ngo gyen bstan bdag med bam ro kha na khrag 'dzag snying ga ru/ /ga shal rgyan mdzes tshogasaganyis bzo bos ga ler skrun pa'i spud pa mo/ /nga yi lha mchog bcom ldan ma kyai nga la dbang gi dngos grub stsol/ /ca co'i mtshang bral gsung gi zur rer bzhi lhag drug cu'i yon tan tshang / /cha shas sku la bstan dang g.yo ba'i mtshar sdug 'bum phrag ri mo 'bur/ /ja ne'i nang gi mo mo ltabur mtha' med shos bya'i mtha' kla4chos/ /nya nyung 'dres pa'i nyag nyogadzām yichu rtswa mchog rtse bzhin ma 'dres thugs/ /tā re dmar mo dbang girulas la thogs pa med pa'i zhabs sen rdul—/rnyi /tha shal gtsug tu lamāre lhung ba'i gnam sar dbang byed sa dbang go /da lta gnon pa'i the tsho ma 'phrang grol mig mthong lag zin gna' gtam gzugs/ /na chung byad dang me long gtug na sgro skur g.yogs bral bden don gsal/ /pa tra'i ris 'khrigs stag gi pags rlon sder bcas sham thabs lhodaspre pa'i phrag / pha rol yid 'gugs pad+ma bzhad pa'i mtshan gyi ge saphamyos pa'i khas/ /ba mo'i dpala'adzin srid dang zhi ba'i gzhon nu'i dwangs bcusked gzhib pa'i mur/ /ma lus lha brgya'i gtsug na sgeg pa'i nang dbyings gtan srid snyim par gtod/ /tsa tur grangs ldan phyag gi yal 'dab bcad lce'id+ngha me tog 'dzum pa'i rtser/ /tsha zer can gyis phye ba'i phyag mtshan 'gugs 'ching 'bigs pa'i dri bsung gis/ /dzaḥzhes bos tshe mkho rgu gzhan snang cig car sdud pa'i mdzes ma'i zla/ /wa ler yid mkhar 'gog med shar tshe lhan skyes dbyings su lhan rna 150

bzi/ /zhwa bzhin lha mo dus kun mgo bor rigs kyi bdag por gus bkur rin/ /za 'thung nyi tshe'i bya ba tsam min bstan 'gror gang la gang phan las/ /'a 'ur sgra 'byin phyi zob nang stong gto ba'i rnga khog zhig min par/ /ya mtshan sku thugs zung 'jug dga' ma'i dga' ba'i dga' ston la sbyor mdzod/ /ra ris kun rtog sprin tshogs dwangs pa'i chos dbyings zla bzhin sgeg mo'i zhal/ /la li da ltar sgrib med thugs kyi sngo bsangs lto bar gsal shar nas/ / sha rus gdos bcas rten 'di thogs bral rab dwangs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /sa gsum lus can mchod pa'i rten du lhang nger ma bzhengs de srid du/ /ha cang mtshar sdug srid na che ba dbang gi lha mo rig byed ma/ /a ru sman shing bstar lasa'i gral ring ring mo'i dbur bzhugs lha'i gtso mo/ /'khor 'das legs ts+tshags lcags phye sdud pa khab len gor ma'i ngang tshul can/ /khyod ko snying la snying bzhin bsten no snying gi dpal kun byos shig kye/ /pe cin nas bris/ — 151

rna bsngag5 tshig yut+pal dmar po'ipo〉na phran/ ka ma la yi ze'u 'brur 'ugying ba ka la sha bzhin 'dod 'jo ma/ /kha ba'i rdul mangs brtsegs pa'i lhun bzhin kha la bkra shis 'bum gyi ris/ /ga ler 'bri ba dbyangs can ngag lha ga bur gsar ba'i dri mnam ma/ /nga yi longs spyod 'khor lor rtag rol nga yang khyod dang skal mnyam mdzod/ /ca co'i dri bral gsung gi rang gdangs ca re rgyud mangs rgyud du 'gugs/ /cha shas kun rdzogs snying sdug lang tshos cha ru ma bgos mtha' dag sdud/ /ja mdangs skra lo mthongs su skyod mas ja lo rgyas bzhin yon tan tshogs/ /nya rgyas dung zla'i dpal la reg mdzod nya zla dmar po bzhad pa'i gdong / /tā ming yul du chu yi pad+ma tā re 'phags ma mi mo'i 'phrul/ /tha dad 'gro blo'i khams dbang dang mtshungs tha ma rab 'bring mos ngos gar/ /da nang nyi ma gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i da lta bzhad pa'i ut+pa la'i/ /na mnyam byi ru'i mig yangs khyod kyis na 'chi'i duḥkha ring du skyol/ /pa tshab rnam dpyod mkha' glang 'khrigs par pa tra'i ris 'khyil rig gnas phreng / /pha mes blo bzang rgyal bas legs byin pha jo'i thugs dam zab gsang mtsho/ /ba ri lo tsā'i thugs kyi bcud byung ba 'o lta bur mngar ba'i cha/ /ma lus byams brtse'i sprin rim klong nas ma yis bu la 'doms bzhin mdzod/ /tsa tur rgyud sde'i gsang ba'i mdzod 'chang tsa ri tra yis mi mtshon pa'i/ /tsha zer brgya ldan bstod ṭika nyi ma tsha grang tshad ran rgyal sa ru/ /dza ya'i dgongs don pad mo'i kha 'byed dza ya gnyis pa khyod nyid kyi~X5/2/wa ler yid la dga' bde'i dpal kun wa kha'i chu bzhin byo bar

mdzod/ /zhwa mdangs gser zhun khu bas byugs pa'i zhwa ser skyes mchog gral ring dbur/ /za byed khang bur dbyangs can 'khyug gang zwa lcags rgyas btab mkha' 'gro'i mdzod/ /'a cag dpal du dpal brgya spungs pa'i 'a 'ur 'brug gi gdangs gnon pa'i/ /ya mtshan gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo ya bral 'khor mtha' thug par skor/ /ra yi gzhu bzung khyab 'jug stobs dang ra ma ṇa yis mi 'gran pa'i/ /la ma dum skyesga ut+pal mig yangs la ba ba yi snying nye ma/ /sha khrag 'od skur grol ba'i grogs mo sha kha dmar mdangs chags pa mos/ /sa dge'i gdams zab stong gi nying khu sa 'di'i dpal du spungs par mdzod/ /ha cang snyigs lnga'i rang rtags ngom dus ha sa badz+ra yab sras srol/ /a bh+yaḥmatshan can dam pa'i khyu mchog a ru sman gyi ljon pa ches/ /ha lo'i bkrag bzhin spel ba'i mdzad bzang ha las srid zhi'i mthar rtsen 'dis/ /a ce khyod la dus kun mchod na a mas bu bzhin rjes skyong mdzod/ /bla ma'i zhabs pad g.yung drung gshis su nam yang gzhom bral khams su brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs khyab bstan la 'chad rtsom bya bas brel/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang pad+mo bstan la rab gus sprang rtsis phyug / bstan pa mtha' nas mtha' ru rgyas pa'i dge mtshan snang bas mi gtong shog/ / / pe cin nas bris/153

—— sngu — — mtsholdan7 laphul ba mtshoskyesagasar ba'i do shago g.yu dz+nya rna'u garmepre sdadangasarī lngame— me tog tshom bur gakra ba'i me long du/ /mchu yis ma yin rkang pas 'othung ba'i mar gad gos can ljon pa'i phreng / /tshar du bsgrigs par spu sdug 'dab chags nyal ldang 'phur ba'i rtsed 'jo dad / /mgrin glu kyar kyur sems dang mthun pa'i kha brda yid kyi gdung sel sman/ /rang byung brag ri bzo bo'i lag sor 'phrul ldas thon pa'i sna tshogs dbyibs/ /mthongs su chu 'dzin dal gyis g.yo zhing nyams kyis brjid pa'i la ma log / ngos su na bun dngul mdog bu mo snyoms 'jug gar gyis kya ma kyu/ /khong gseng gcan gzan za byed tsher gzengs sgrub po'i mel tsher rgyug ma 'dur/ /brag ri'i zom nas yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan kun tshang dal 'gro ma/ / sgeg 'gros kyis skyod dar dkar brkyangs pa'i dpal la 'khu bzhin babs pa'i rgyun/ /gshong bar 'khyil ba'i phang bar khrus rtsen yid 'phrog dri za'i na chung dang / /rnam sad myos ma 'gran bzhin rol ba'i ltad mos mig gi bung ba bzi/ /ral nyil 'dzin ma'i gos su bkab pa'i thal ba'i byug pa'i bram ze rnams/ /rnam gsum gos kyi sne mo thod bzhag ngur tsho'i mdangs gsal rab byung ba/ /ma bcos lcang lo ma bsgyur ras dkar dga' ma'i bder rol sngags pa'i tshogs/ /gcig las gcig lhag gangs phug brag skyibs shing rtsa rnams su rang nyams skyong / /spang thang 'jam por ri dwags rtsal 'gran phru gu~X 5twes ma'i 'o ma nu/ /spra dang spre'u'i lus rtsal 'gran zhing mig la ltad mo'i

ston mo 'grem/ /skad snyan sbrang ma'i dar dir glu dang 'phur lding gar 'thab gcig nas gcig / phebs bzhugs mdzad rjes bgrod byed zung rtser sbrang rtsi'i khur thogs rang khyim 'jug / bcud 'dzin chu skyes rang byung dri ldan mdangs lnga'i dbang gzhu 'thor 'dra ba/ /dri 'dzin dga' ma'i 'jam pa'i reg byas dal med bskul bas cher myos te/ /g.yo ldem gar gyis gcig la gcig 'gran lang tsho'i kyo ba rnon po'i rtses/ /bkug par 'tham pa'i ra yig gnyis pa'i khyu tshogs nyi zer rdul la 'khu/ /rdo rgyal khu bas lan brgyar byug pa'i ljon shing yal ga 'dzings pa'i bar/ /kun mthong phyed thon spyod lam bzhi shong rang grub rtsol sgrub nyams dga'i khang / /yid dga' chos 'dzin 'dzin mar 'phos pa'i nyams dro bag phebs dben dgon du/ /du ma'i spong klog bya bas brel ba'i rnam grol sar 'phur grub brnyes mang / /mtha' mthar grong dang grong khyer gtibs pa'i rgya dpangs mig gis bltar mi mngon/ /bar bar mkho rgu'i longs spyod brdal ba'i grangs ka tshangs chen blos mi zin/ /phyogs phyogs gzhung lam dra ba'i bres pa'i mu khyud 'khyud 'khor los mi slebs/ /lam lam rmiyopa'i rmi lam yin nam 'dren byed 'khrul gang bar dbye dka'/ /rlangs 'khor me 'khor nyin mtshan skyod sgras rna ba leb mo'i gong bu 'gas/ /don phyir 'gro 'ong rgyu 'grul 'gros kyis rkang ba leb mo'i mthil 'jam ral sna mang phyag las chu gnyer brtsegs pas 'dzin byed leb mo sul gas ga shur/ /snga phyi'i 'dang bral le los 'da' rnams 'gram palpeb mo sngas bzhag nyal/ /dus btab ma tshogs stag shar gzhon nu lam chen zur na krong nger langs/ /bza' zla ma rnyed zla bzhin mig yangs mabya sgeg mo'i 'gros kyis nyul/ /dka' khag ma rig dar babs pho mo 'bol 'jam mal na bde bas bzi/ /phugs don ma yin mnog chung las kyis 'jig rten 'di na thams cad 'thom/ /kun rig ye shes kun tu 'phrul ba'i rnam pa ma nges sna tshogs su/ /rab 'byams zhing gi 155

rab mang rdul gyi go sa gnon pa'i snod bcud kyi/ /sgyu ma'i yo lang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bkod pa bkod pa'i 'phags pa'i bar/ /yid bzhin rgya mtsho yigadang mthun pa'i —yīd la yid spode'i dpal rab ster/ /ma nges ling ling gar gyis sgeg pa'i g.yotsholden rla bas kyi g.yon mig mas/ /lag pa'i 'khri shing mkhrig mar brgyus pa'i rang byung sgra ldan wu phreng gi/ /rtse dgas gcig la gcig 'khyud mdza'asmob nam yang gtong min skya bar nas/ /rang bde 'dod pa'ir ris yongs btang bsil sbyin dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i khar/ /rgyal kun gsung gi nges pa ma lus hrī yig zla ba zhun ma'i khams/ /las gyur gaphug rlung dwangs ma'i rang mdangs mtsho las byung ba'i mig yangs ma/ /thogs dang reg pa'i spros pa'i mtshan ma dbyings su nub pa'i 'ja' tshon lus/ /sum dwangs chu shel lcug phran ldem pa'i yid 'phrog dri za'i na chung gzugs/ /zla gsar byad kyi me tog ngos la thab4 shes dkyus ring 'dab ma g.yo/ /byur dmar sgros legs mchu yi do rar tshags bzang tshems dkar ze'u 'bru 'tsher/ /rang byung sbyar byung tshugs legs dri 'dzin 'dzin ma'i khyon na btsal dka' ba'i/ /g.yas g.yon 'gram na 'gram pa'i bu mo gcig la gcig 'gran sdug gu sdug / mun pa'i gnam ru zuru mig rnon po'i mda' dang sbyar ba'i rig sngags kyis/ /gzir tshe srid zhi mi shigs chos bdun khams su sgrub kyang mi tshugs pa'i/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo dri za'i mna'o ma ngag la ngag gi dpal sbyin ma'i/ /lang tsho'i chang 'thung gna' deng phyi nang lnga rig smra ba'i mal na myos/ /myos bum 'o ma'i rgyun bzang 'bab pa'i sprin dkar gsar ba'i dum bu zung / /g.ya' dag brang gi me long ngos na rin bral rgyan chas tog tu 'bur/ /snyan shal chu gser rna kore sne tshar tshar tshar gshib pa'i nor bu'i shal/ /mig lha'i gan mdzod lhan du bsgril yame khug min tshogs zudzopha mas byin/ /dbang sngon dbu skyes mes po'i blo yis sul bur gshar ba'i lan bu'i rtser/ /ma ligasar ba'i dri 156

ldan me tog bung ba dga' ba'i skyed tshal du/ /gser sbyangs pa tra zla gsar myu gu phan tshun 'gran pa'i gzigs mo yis/ /rgyal rnams thugs kyang yang dag mtha' las g.yo min g.yo ba'i ngang tshul 'dzin/ /'dzin byed dung gi thag pas 'khyud pa'i zab rgyasadon ston phang 'gro'i rgyud/ /mnyen lcug phyag sor 'phrul gyis bskul ba'i rten 'byung chos sgo brgya 'byed gdangs/ /rna ba'i bcud kun khong nas len pa'i mgrin glur 'thab pa'i rmongs pa'i gnyid/ /bskal mang sad dka' sad pa'i mod la rnam 'byed shes rab nyi ma shar/ /tsog bu'i 'dug stangazlas stangs stabs gcig gis khams gsum yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog /smad sham 'og pags rin chen rtse dgas dbang gzhu'i ri mo'i mdzes pa pham/ /sgrib min srab 'jam gos kyi phyi nas yid 'gugs mtshan gyi mtshar ris gsal/ /gzhon nu'i yid 'dzin ngang ba'i bu mo mgrin pa'i mdud rgya sor rtses shig — / ka dag sems kyi rang mdangs gzugs shar ka ma la yi gdan steng du/ /kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin gsung gi dbang mo kha la smra ba'i dpal ster ma/ /ga bur bsung 'thul mchu sgros bar nas ga ler drug skyes tshangs pa'i klu/ /nga bdag 'joms pa'i rten 'byung zab don nga khyod med par dus kun longs/ /ca la btagasapa'i rgyud stong phang 'gror ca co ma yin chos don dbyangs/ /cha lugs mdzis sdug bsags pa'i nying khu cha shas kun tshang snying sdug dum/ /ja skyems dpal 'dzin ral gri'i 'khri shing ja lo'i dbyibs ldan mkhar gdengs lha'i/ /nya chu'i 'brel bzhin zag med bde bskyed nya zla'i gdong ldan lang tsho ma/ /ta thā ga ta'i gsung gsang gzugs grub ta ma lar 'khyil 'brug gi gdangs/ /tha dad 'gro blo'i khams dbang dang mtshungs tha ma rab 'bring dogs som gnas/ /da lta mig mdun dngos bzhin gsal ston da gdod mi gnas myang 'das par/ /na chung myos ma khyod kyis rjes zungs na mnyam skar dkyil pa sangs mdzod/ /pa tra'i ri mos gzhar yang mtshon min pa 157

ṇa'i rgyun mtshungs kulko rtog phreng / /—pha rol sna tshogs yul rjes 'brang min pha mtha' bral ba'i yon tan mdzod/ /ba ku la 'dab kha chusaji bzhin ba 'o ltar dkar dad pa'i blos/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i ngo bor bsten na ma dang sring bzhin rjes brtsesatshoskyongs/ /tsa tur grub mthe'i yang rtser bsnyegs patsha ko ra bzhin mtho ba'i lta/ /tsha —grang mi snyoms mthar 'dzin gdung 'phrog tsha zer brgya ldan nyi ma'i 'od/ /dza ya'i dgongasatshwag zhi sgo gnyis med dza ya gnyis pa'i zhal skyin gang / /wa ler yid kyi sems rten 'cha' 'o wa skyegarnayothar ring dor mdzod/ /zhwa sedzo'akhrul bralalugs bzang 'a dikāko zhwa mdog tsam gyis chog shes byed/ /za nyal le lo'i dman spyod dngastolen za zi'i bya bar mgo bo 'khor/ /'a cag pha myes shul bzhag khyad nor 'a 'ur ngang du dgraso 'phrog par/ /ya lan snying gi dkyil nasartsosprod pa'i ya lad gzhom med gur du mdzod/ /rwa rnon rtse mo srid pa'i mthongs gzengs rwa rgan pha chos 'jigs mdzad lha'i/ /la bzlas dgyes yum khyod kyi zhabs sor la gor gtsug thob sil sgra'i gdangs/ /sha thang 'bad pa'i ched du ma yin sha khragatwas 'di ma bor gong / /sa dbadzobatsun mo yid 'gugs ma de sa chen mdzes pa'i rgyan du thob/ /ha cang bya dka'i snyan ngag lam nas ha lam tsayo gyis bstod pa'i tshig / a ce khyod la rab dwangs yid kyis a bar skyur gsum ro bro ba/ /'dra min mngar ba'i cha shas kun rdzogs 'dra la mi 'dra'i lab brdol dbyangs/ /dbyangs can rgyud mangs rgyud las 'khrungs sam dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i ngag las 'ong / /'ong dang 'gro ba'i mtshan ma bral yang mos ldan mos ngor lam mer 'ong / /rtse mo'i yon tan mtha' ru 'phyo yang gang la gang 'dul rnam pa'i rtse/ /gzhom bra la rlung gi rang gdangs tsam yang rmongs mun rgyu bcas rtsad nas gzhom/ ༈dgagasal ye shes dga' mar langs pa khyod kyis bdag yid rnam kunaho'akhyud/ /rab dkar las 'dis dam pa'i zhabs/ sen lnga zung lan bu'i rtse mor 'dzum/ /ring nas rjes 158

chags dbyangs can ngang mo mgrin pa'i 'o mtshor ci 'dod rol/ / la rig ngamadzes ma'i byad kyi phan tshogs nor 'dzin me long phang las yar/ /rdzogs ldan ༄gsar ba'i si tā'i lang tshos sa dbang yid mkha' rtag mdzes shog / / /— — — pe cin nas bris/— rī — ri — 159
