sa ṅgestod sa dbang btsun mo'i mgul rgyan/kung si su yis 'gran min rnam rgyal gyi khang bzang / /bkod legame legs pa'i tshad 'jog tshangs chen gyi sug ris/ /sus snang snang ba 'gugs pa dbang mo yi gur khang / /phun tshogs tshogs zung dga' ma'i 'phrul 'di ko dga' ba/ /sngun na gshin pa'i zhing sa ngos mnyam pa'i me long / /g.yu yi khu ba 'thung ba'i khod snyoms pa'i sgeg mos/ /'bru rigs sna lnga'i thon khungs ngar ltos zhes 'gying bar/ /khra chung gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i yid dran med bzi song / /sa dbyibs gzhu mo'i bcad kha tshur 'khor ba'i gzhu rgyud/ /gzhung lam srad bur sna tshogs 'gro 'ong gi rgyu 'grul/ /chad med chu bo'i rgyun la co 'dri ba'i ltad mos/ /sna mang bya ba'i sne kha rang lag tu tshur 'gugs/ /mdun phyogs khang brtsegs bcu drug lha mo yi zol gyis/ /dra mig rgyan cha btags nas sgeg nyams kyis 'gying te/ /rang las le shor med par tshur 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur/ /'gyur khug dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glur blangs kyang rdzogs dka'/ /lha yul sa la bab pa mtsho 'gram gyi grong khyer/ /gnam sngon thang la lhung ba pe ta'e hu'i rgya mtsho/ /rlabs dkar dgung du rkyong pa lha'i bu mo'i mnyen gzugs/ /dbang mo'i byad dang 'thab pa'i rtse dga' 'di mtshar ba/ /dga' ma'i ci bsam gang 'dod 'grub pa yi gter bum/ /dga' spro'i 'ur langs phyi dro dbang dus su phul skabs/ /rig byed grangs ldan gnam 'brug sprin nar mo'i zol gyis/ /ltad mor slebs pa lha dang bla ma yi byin mthu/ /gsar skrun khang bar gter phul bkra shis kyis byin phab/ shad kyis chu khrer 160

bsdad nas rang mal du slebs pa/ /rags tsam shog gu'i thang la mchong lding gi 'gros las/ /zhib par gcig rjes gnyis bsgrigs yi ge'i khur lci'o/ /de ltar lo rgyus phreng ring bstar ba yi nang du/ /'phreng rdog gcig gi 'brel bzhag legs byas kyi mtha las/ /las can mtha' dag 'di nas skye ba'i phreng ༄kun du/ /du ma'i lo rgyus smra la srab mnyen ljags ldan shog /— —‘ pe cin nas bris/ — 161

bsngags tshig dga' skyed ut+paladamar bo'igadengs kan ma su ra su rnye ya/ /'ardigs/ gīd phyogs dus rgyal ba'i ye shes 'phrul/ /banywan la gcig tu sman dz+wa'i bzhin lag skur/ /yongs shar mkhyen brtse'i dbyāng phyug lhag pa'i lha/ /yab yum mi phyed snying gi thig ler zlums/ /two byāsdudu rījigs bral seng chen 'phyo ba'i 'asnyin swās lus snred zad mthar rkyong / /skyun yib gāstan la phan rī'i mdzad bzang grags pabyu'i me tog 'dzin mar brdal/ /zab rgyas swos k+to khri 'phang mthon por dābang phyug brgyad kyi dar lce can/ /'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dh+wal mtshunasrid zhi'i bla na g.yo/ /dpal stug rgyal ba'i skyed yum gcig gyur dpal mo0 do thur+ṣa dga' ma'i gzugs/ /byāde dz+wan ye shes skyed pa'i grogs gyur bde ldan zhiji ri gi ṭā ki'i 'phrul/ /nig 'atwon bye ba'i gzungs mar cher grags rig bye ni dubyedu two mi mor rtsen/ /tā re 'phags ma gcig las gnyis 'phrul tā ming yul gru'i than dpa' rmad/ /rmad byung skye gzugs phun tshogs stong gis rmad/ /smad sham rin chen rgyan gyis 'ja' tshon smad/ /'dab ldan mda' gzhu sbas kyang mtshan gyi 'dab/ /'dab grol dbang gi rgyal mo snying gi 'dab/ /dus kyi lang tsho ma rnying deng gi dus/ ma hā tsi na'i yul du mig yangs ma/ /rig byed stobs 'byor lang tshos snyems pa'i rigs/ /'dzin slad dbang mo'i skye ba'i myu gu 'dzin/ /phul byung zla ba'i gdong ldan dga' ma'i phul/ /mtshar sdug phra skyes me tog 'dab mas mtshar/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem 'dzin byed yal ga mnyen/ /srid zhi'i yid 'gugs na chung srid na srid/ /dri med dri bral ga bur 162

gsar ba'i dri/ /dbu skyes mthongs bskyod rtsa bar tshugs legs dbu/ /'khyil legs snyan shal phun tshogs dung ris 'khyil/ /mdzes ma stong gi medud 'dzin 'dzin mar mdzes/ / dkyus ring ut+pal 'deb ma'i snyems pa'i dkyus/ /'phrog pa'i mig gis brtane g.yo'i dwangs bcud 'phrog / zur gyis lta ba'i ma 'khyog drang 'gro'i zur/ /zur gsum snying gi ka ba 'bigs pa'i zur/ napad rag chu skyes 'dzum pa'i mchu'i sgro4pad/ /phreng bstar dkar gsal dung gi ze'u 'bru'i phreng / / / ro 'dzin bung bas bzung ba'i sprang chang ro/ /'jibs pas kun rtog brdal khyab dbyings su 'jibs/ /sna ma'i r+shatog dri mnam 'tsham pa'i sna/ /chags pa'i mdangs shar mkhur bar skag tshos chags/ /smin 'khyog mun—pa'i gnam ru ri mor smin/ /smin legs gzungs ma yid kyi khab tu smin/ /zla shel 'dzum bag ngom pa'i dpral dbyes zla/ /zla ba'i khu ba 'thung bas ma ngoms zla/ /zla sring gdong las brtan g.yo'i khyon na zla/ /zla bral srid zhi'i dga' ma 4yi zla/ /snyan gong chu skyes sner dpyangs g.yer kha snyan/ /mgrin par dung gi 'khyil ris bum pa'i mgrin/ /myos bum bcud ldan 'o ma'i khur gyis myos/ /snying gi sdu gu ma khyod bdag gi snying / /'dzin byed bgrod byed 'dzum pa'i yal 'dab 'dzin/ /mtsho skyes snying po mngon 'greng yid 'dzin metsho/ /dbang med yid kyirka brtan pa 'phrog pa'i dbang / /dbang mo'i 'phrul 'di kun min khyod la dbang / /lus kyi mdzes sdug zla ba gsar pa'i lus/ /kun da'i na chung stong gi dkar mdangs kun/ /gcig bsdus yid kyi 'ching thag mdzes ma gcig / legs byas zong gis khug 'di e ma legs/ /ngag la dbang 'byor dbyangs ldan dga' ba'i ngag /ngag gi sgyu rtsal bye ba byo ba'i ngag /ngag gi phun tshogs kun tshang khyod kyi ngag / ngag dbang lha mo'i yid 'bab dga' skyed ngag /yid la bstan 'gror sman pa'i lhag bsam yid/ /yid brtan mi rung 'khor bder skyo ba'i 163

yid/ /yid can blo yis dpog min gting zab yid/ /yid bzhin nor ltar gang bsam rgyug pa'i yid/ /lus ngag yid kyi byawā'i dal 'gro'i lus/ /rnam dkar yur lam dra nga bor bzhur ba rnams/ / lhan cig byang chen rgya mtshor 'dres dang lhan/ /zung 'jug dbu phreng tshom bu'i rtse dgas zungs/ /bdag sogs rnams dang skyoba'i phreng bar bdag/ rgyal yum dbang mo'i thurges rjes bdud las rgyal/ /mthar thug 'dod pa'i re 'bras lag smin mthar/ /dga' ma'i go 'phang ring min thob par dga'/ /'dod ldan gzhon nus mdzes ma'i phun tshogs 'dod/ /de yi skye gzugs snyan ngag 'ud kyis de/ /bskal bar bya dka'i tshogs las thob pa'i skal/ /skal mnyam dkyil nas bsngags pa kho bo'i skal/ /mdzes mdzes srid zhi'i mtshar sdug ma lus pa/ /lhag lhag las kyi byed pos gcig bsdus ma/ /snyan snyan phang 'a gror bsdebs pa 'i bstodatshig dar/ /gus bca4 lag pas btegs 'disgodagyes brtses longs/ /zhes dbang phyogs dbang mo rnam gnyis la dman lhag ma shor ba'i bsngags tshig dga' skyed ut+pal dmar bo'i gdengs ka zhes bya ba 'di'ang / /7 'jom dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i me tog rig byed dga' ba'i lang tshor 'bod pas/ /spyi lo rab gnas shing khyi'i sa zla'i tshes dge bar lha mo nyid snang brnyan rjol gyis phebs pa'i midro dbang gi dus su gar 'dug mcho ldan mdun sar sbyar ba rdayāchu/ / / / — 164

'phrin bskul ut+paladamar po'i 'phrulazhags zhes bya ba/byu ru'i lcug phran 'khyug ldem lang tsho'i rum/ /ut+pal gsar ba'i dri ldan pad ma'i 'dzum/ /srid gsum yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu ru/ /rno ba dbang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri za'i na chung 'gyur khug rgyud mangs sgrar/'thab pa'i cha tsam sgrun min gsung gi gdangs/ /zab rgyas chos kyi rang sgras rna ba'i bcud/ /len pa dbang mo'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrib pa'i sprin bral mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i 'od/ /chos dbyings brdal khyab mtha' dang rtag 'dres kyang / /chos can ma 'gag bkra ba'i rol rtsed stong / /gzigs pa dbang mo'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /myur mgyogs dbang gi 'phrin las glog gi lces/ /yid mthun srid zhi'i phun tshogs dregs ldan snying / /lhan du bldag pas yid la brnag pa'i don/ /mi shigs thig ler wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ /ces pa'ang 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am rig byed dga' ba'i lang tshor 'bod pas/ spyi lo 96rab gnas 17me byi'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i 1tshes 1ṭ+wāṃnyin gar 'dug dbang gi gur khang nas phul ba dza yan+ta/ /'di'ang bla ma lhag pa'i lhas tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/ / /165

bde zhusadang 'brel ba'i zhugasol mtsho byung 'dzumapasde doshame/4 lho sprin lang long 'phyur shā'i khang pre ru 'khyug pa'i/ /zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs stong ldir ba/ /g.yu 'brug mthing sprin phang bar bag phebs par bzhugs dang / /'khos dman phadongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar rtse bzhin slebs 'ong / /mkha' dbyings pha mtha' mi rig kun gsal gyi lan bur/ /bsod nams dpal brgyas grub pa'i mkha' lding gi rgyal bo/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'dab gshog ngom bzhin bya lam du bzhugs dang / / bye'u chung rgum bu 'thus nas 'phur lhab kyis slebs 'ong / /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ltor bstar ba'i/ /ljongs 'dir mkhas btsun g.yu ral cher gsig pa'i seng chen/ /—nyams rtogs ngar skad phyogs kyi mthar sgrogs bzhin bzhugs dang / /ri skyes spang— thang yan nas gangs 'dab la 'khor yong / /rkang 'thung g.yu lo rgyas pa'i yal ka lag rkyong bar/ /gzhan phan gra 'dzum ngom pa'i rgyal sras kyi khyu— mchog / ring nas thugs bskyed go cha ma ral bar bzhugs dang / /thugasatsho rje srung ba'i gur 'og mi 'gyang bar bsnyegs 'ong / /don grub dga' tshal dga' ldan lha yul las lhag cing / /bde skyid me tog bde chen zhing khams ltar bzhad der/ /skyabs gcig 'jam dpal skyabs kyi dwangs ma khyod bzhugs dang / /kho bo lha ldan lha mjal grub nas slar slebs 'ong / /de bar brgya phrag legs byas rin chen rdul brtsegs pa'i/ /mchog rab sku mchog bstan 'gro gling bzhi yi mgon du/ /lham mer bzhugs pa gang 166

zhus mdor dril ba'i snying po/ /yin phyir thugs la thugs mtshan dpal be'u bzhin bcangs 'tshal/ /dbang phyogs gser gyi rgyal khab chen po ru slad nas/ /dbang mo mi mor rtsen pa'i zhu grogs dang lhan cig / dbang lha'i bstod ṭika tshig don phul byung gi rgyud mangs/ /dbang bcus phyug gang phyag sor yal 'dab kyis rdungs zhu/ /zhu 'phrin dbyangs can dga' ma'i sor rtse las smin pa'i/ /don bzang gtam gyi phang 'go'i rang sgra 'di gsan tshe/ /thugs rje chu gter 'phyur ba'i dbu phreng gi gos kyis/ /bdag cag rnam kun g.yogs pa'i skyabs 'jug rang nyid mkhyewa/ / — — 167

4 dhe zhu donasnyamasadabyadas susdebapa bung ba'igashog glu/chos dbyings rdobus mthā' mtha' bral glejam dpal gyi dgongs klong / /kun byed sems kyi rang bzhin bzhin lag tu med kyang / /byin rlabs gru char char rgyun nam 'dod dus 'jo ba/ /chos sku'i bla ma ye gnas ye shes de mkhyen no/ /rang gdangs ma 'gag 'gag med rig rtsal gyi phra tshom/ /dwangs gsal mkha' las 'ja' tshon tshon lnga'i mdangs 'phos bzhin/ /grub gnyis gter kha kha gting mu bral lag stsol ba/ /longs sku'i bla ma 'jigs mdzad 'jig dus me mkhyen no/ /gang 'dul thugs rje rje btsun mkhyen gter lha'i rnam rol/ /mtha' klas shes byar srid tshad tshad bzung ni med kyang / /mkhyen pas skad cig cig car lag mthil ltar gzigs pa/ /sprul sku'i bla ma gzhon sgeg gzhon nu'i lus mkhyen no/ /blo bzang bzang po'i grags 'bar rgyal kun gyi zhal skyin/ /mtsho byung mtsho nas skyes pa mgrin sbubs su yib pas/ /legs bshad bshad pa'i mi rdzogs zab don gyi chang gi / dus ston ston zla'i lang tshor 'grogs pa 'di dga' ba/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can bzhad pa'i ngag 'dab lhan spungs pa'i/ /grub 'bras 'bras bzang g.yur za 'phags bod kyi gsung rab/ /mi 'gyur 'gyur med rdo rje'i re khas rgyas btab pa/ /blo brtson brtson pa zhan kyang bam klog gis skyid pa/ /bgrang 'phreng 'phreng thag zad pa'i kha ton cang med mod/ /yab rje rje btsun bla ma'i legs bshad dang 'dris pas/ /phyi mar mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton ltar bzhud tshe/ /tshe 'di 'asnyi 6spyang ngang zad yo kha de los lon/ /sgra dbyangs dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rjes

chags kyi zur mda'/ /rig byed rig pa'i grogs mo'i sgro ldan rtser gshib pa'i/ /dus ring ring mor brtsegs pa'i mkhregs mun gyi ba gam/ /ye shes shes rab nyi ma gzhon nu'i lces bldag song / /bla ma bla na dgyes pa'i sgrub mchod nyag phra yang / /gal 'gas/ 'gag la thug tshe gsol 'debs kyi gling bu/ /snying khong khong nas hūṃgs byang dad gsum gyi sor mo/ /yal 'dab yal tsho rig ra pa //de/ /gri// //nge/ /gri//tsho rigags bskul ba' snyug sbubs gdangs a la/ /dbang lha lha bu 'a 'phrul rtsen pa/ /rig 'dzin 'dzin ma'i skye bo dga' skyed kyi dbang mo/ /zhu grogs grogs su khug pa ston 'khor gyi nyi zla/ / lhan 'dzoms 'dzoms pa'i dpal 'di rab dga'i sas mi mtshon/ /rig byed dga' ma dga' skyed bstod tshig gi phreng mdzes/ /snang mtha' mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter 'khyil de'i/ /legs 'grel 'grel pa mkhas rgud dgyes skyed kyi rol mo/ /rgyal sa sa dbang rim byon bste gnas der 'khrol zhu/ /zhu yig yi gar 'ong ba bzang spos spun/ /zhu 'bras 'bras bzang dud pa dpag bsam ljon/ /zhu tshig tshig rgyan me tog ma rnying ba'i/ /phang phung 'dab ma badzegs pa'i sbrang rtsis mchod/ / — — 169

— — — snga 'gyur bestan pa'i rnyan byide rdogrubu rin— po che bzhi bar phul basbyin rlabasagru char bsu ba'i 'brugasgra zhesabya ba/ — thub dbang bzhi ba'i bstan la thub pa bzhin/ /'phrin las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'phrin yig gis/ /dpal stug bye ba'i dgyes zhal dpal spungs pa/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po gnyis pa'i drung / /lus kyi chu skyes dad gsum sbrang rtsi'i khur/ / ma theg khyod sar phyogs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / /gsol 'debs bung ba'i mgrin glus sdun bsus te/ /zhu tshig me tog gsar ba'i mchod 'dir dgongs/ /dgongs zab pha mtha' mi mngon zla ba'i mar/ /zab don rin chen bye ba'i 'tshang ka'i bar/ /byed po rna ba brgyad pa'i ma byed pas/ /grags pa ma non sngo bsangs rkang rtser yar/ /gna' bor kun mkhyen yab sras nyi zla'i 'od/ /kha ba'i sa 'dzin bstar ba'i 'jig rten phang / /lhung tshe theg rgyal 'phrog byed nga ro'i mtshon/ /rgol ngan snying la zug pa'i gtam de snyan/ /deng char thub bstan nam mkha' mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /bkrag 'bar nyi ma'i tsha zer ma bri bar/ /bstan 'gro gling bzhi'i dpyid du sngar mus ltar/ /'phrin las dpal brgya bzang rgur brtsegs pas spro/ /'tshams zhu/ /da cha kun mkhyen brgyud pa rnam par thar/ /ma god phyag mtshan bzhes pa khyod gcig phyir/ /rjes slob bdag cag khyod bzhin gyur cig ces/ /snying nas gsol 'di thugs kyi ze'u 'brur snoms/ /tshogs gnyis legs byas mkha' la rtag 170

rtsen pa'i/ /mthong grol mtshan dpe'i 'dzam grol gzags sku'i zla/ /phyi nang ༄pha༄nyer 'tshe dgra gcan sgrib pa'i g.yogs/ /nyer grol thub bstan kun da'i gsos su bzhugs/ / de skad ngag la dbang byed dbyangs can ma'i/ / zab rgyas don ston rgyud stong phang 'gro'i sgras/ /rmongs 'thug gnyid las bslang bas blo gros 'dab/ /phye bar re des gus bcas sor rtses btegs/ /ri tsho ri — — 6 — —dzha 171

— —rmo tharathor cimagasengatha tog— tre — 7'jam dpal dpa' bo'i byin rlabs nyin mor byed/ /snying la zhugs pas ris med lus can don/ /rdur med khur bzhes rgyal sra/sa smra ba'i zla/ /zla bral zhi lam ston pa'i mig gcig rgyal/ /dkar 'dzum mdangs kyis rab bkra zla ba'i gardung / /phyin drug sa mos do rar phyogs pa'i mod/ /rang bde'i tsha zer dang 'grogs pad+mo'i tshal/ /snyestas ga'i srog btang 'phang mtho'i mgo bo dud/ /p+lu ldaXn blo yi ra ba las 'gongs shing / /smra dbang smra ba'i spobs pa yongs 'phrog pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas khyod rtag brtan g.yung drung khrir/ /yun nas yun du zhabs pad lhun chags gsol/ /7'jam dpal dpa' bo'i mkhyen rab ral gri'i so/ /rmongs mun dra ba gcod la rno ba'i rdul/ /phyag sor rtse na chags pa'i mi'i mkhyen gter/ /dus kyi zur phud lnga bas dus kun skyongs/ /7mūgo mjug kha zhabs ma gīg pa tra'i mdzes/ /rdza 'gu gang yin ma nges ma ki'i snod/ /yod med gnyis min mtha' bral lta ba'i mal/ /byāde bar legs zin dwab dga'i dpal dh+was rten/ /bstan 'dzin bstan la bya ba'i dben/ /'jigs med 'jigs pa med par bdog / rab rgyas rab 'byor la 'gran bzhin/ /nges don nges par mjal lam zhes/ /lho glung bho ṭa'i 172
〉 da/ /nges med rgya bod sa char ga na/ /ringang sring lhan du 'dzom/ na 17chu bya lo'i dbyug zla 9pa'i khu

'jam bstodashes rab myur stsol/ridhīḥ sprin dkar gzhon nu'i mdzes sdug la/ /rnam par 'khu ba'i lang tsho rdzogs/ /gzhan gsos ba mo'i mgrin dbyangs kyi/ /rjes sa 'gro ba'i rigi bye riri ༅gsung gi gdangs/ /mkha' dbyings pha mtha' 'tshol ba yi/ /zol gyis rgyu ba'i mkhyen rab nyi/ /nyi ltar gsal ba'i 'gro ba kun/ /kun gzigs go 'phang ma thob bar/ /de srid thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /rmongs mun de bskyed rgyu dang bcas/ /dag par mdzod cig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /skye kun 'jam dbyangs bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhir/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas/ /khyod nyid ji bzhin bdag gyur cig / ces pa 'di'ang bsam gtan gyi ngor shā sa nas so/7dge la rab 'dun chos tshal cha bo'i gter/ /'phel ba'i zla gzhon rjo /di ༷ ༷ ra pa ri pa ༷gangs ri' seng chen sdi/ /snying gi rus pa mtshon rtags la0ga pa'i rdis/ /ma nyams dkar 'jam shog gu'i do rar rtsen/ /7'jiXgs gīd sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i mdzes sku bskyan pa0'i dpal du yun ring 'tsho/ /'tsho mdzad be+estur+ya snang zhing mgon dbyāng phyug brgyad ldan nyin mor byed/ /byed po'i blo yis g.yo ba las min zab yangs gsang gsum chu 174

gter che/ /che ba'i blo 'chang smra ba'i seng ge 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /ka ba'i 'degs byed ka nas dag pa'i mchog gi bsti gnas khang bzang bzang / /kha ba'i mdangs bkra kha pad la sogs bkod legs yid 'ong lta na sdug / ga nas bltas kyang ga 'u ltar zlum tsha grang gdung sel khams mthun par/ /nga khyod med snyoms nga yi skyabs mchog mthong ba don ldan 'tsho gzhes ngos/ /7'jiXgs gīd rnam 'dren thub dbang bskyan 'dir bstan sngu'i bdag po gnyis pa bzhin / /bzhin bzang dran dbyāng 'bum phrag 'khor dbus 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gdugs/ /gdugs dkar lung rigs thur ma brgya ldan brgya phrag yon tan dpal gyis mtho/ /mtho ris mes po lha mi'i rnam 'dren gdams zab stong gis sgyug pa'i drung / /7'phags yul dran dbang bye ba'i zhal chab dbyangs can rgyud las 'phos pa'i gdangs/ /gdangs snyan gtsug lag sdid kyi l+līb dpon 'jam dbyangs thon mi'i nyan byed mkhar/ /mkhar nyal tshogs kyis ci dgar 'khrol las deng yang che 'asding chung ba'i grwa/ /gra ma nyams par tshar du bsgrigs 'di mes dbon rnam gsum phyag gi rjes/ /7ka nas spros pa'i sprin tshogs mtha' dag lhag med dbyings nub sher phyin dbyings kyi rje mo smin legs dga' ma'i gar du 'gyu/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs nyi 'od gos 'dzin dbang sngon thor cog chos dbyings mthongs ldem 'ja' tshon smad sham klub pa'i mdza' na mo/ /ga shal rgyan mangs sil sil 'khrol ldan thub gsung gces mdzod stong dang rten 'byung rgyud stong dbyangs 175

kyis stsol ba'i gsang dbang mar/ /nga yis 'dud do thugs rje'i 'od kyis blo ༄gros 'dab stong lhug par bkrol te snyan ngag sprang rtsi 'bad med 'jo shig rwarwa// / d+ngha tsho 4 7 kyān masden mkhyen brtse nyin byed dkyil 'khor khor yug sa 'dzin 'dzin mar yongs 'phags 'phags bod paṇa chen bye ba'i zla/ /zla bral bral min blu med 'phrin las lus can gus 'bangs 'bangs kyi ral bar bar med bkod pa'i zla ba'i byin/ /byin rlabs rlabs chen ga bur thigs phreng phreng ldan bod yul yul dbus sta lusalūs can kun la mchog tu sman/ /sman rgyal rgyal dbang srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan rgyan drug mkhas dbang dbang phyug mgor nyal nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin rtag 'bab shog / ri 7dmigs med brtse ba snying rje chen po'i 'phrul/ /mtha' med 'gro ba'i 'dren par shar ba'i gzugs/ / zla med yon tan gter chen rje bla ma/ /mtshungs med spyan ras gzigs la mos blos 'dud/ /dri med mkhyen pa nyi zla'i dkyime 'khor dang / /'grogs pa'i rtse dgas gtong min thams cad mkhyen/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po gangs ljongs kyi/ /tshad grub 'jam pa'i dbyangs de mgrin sbubs bzhugs/ / phyi nang bdud kyi dpung tshogs ma lus pa/ /'joms mdzad dus mtha'i me yi gzi byin can/ /rgyal kun gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /dbyer med gcig 'dres mi shigs thig lerargyurol/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug na mngon 'phags shing / /rgyan drug gcig 'dus mdzad pa'i cha res kyang / /bstan 'gro'i rgud mun ming gi mthar skyel ba/ /rgyal ba tsong— kha ba khyod bdag gi skyabs/ blo bzang mkhas btsun nyi ma stong gi 'od/ /thub bstan mkha' dbyings mthon por grags pa'i dar/ /'phur ba'i 176

zhabs sen snying gi thig le la/ /'god par gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs/ / rmo 7rig 'dzin dbang mo khyod bsngags mthus/ /'phral phugs bya ba'i chu phran stong / /byang chen snyochu gter rum rol bas/ /don gnyis wu phreng 'dzum gyur cig / — 7las kyis 'brel ba'i dga' ma'i sbubs/ /bde chen zho gsar rtsi blud pas/ /lhan skyes klong du cher myos te/ ci bsam mkho rgu'i sprin phung dkrigs/ /7'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i yab kyi 'jam pa'i zhabs gtsug bsten/ / /mtsho ldan mgrin pa'i gling bu mtsho skyes mgrin rtag rol/ /tsi nā'i rig 'dzin dbang mo tsi ta'i sbubs gab pas/ /legs lam dpal brgya sdud pa'i legs tshogs sgo phyes song / /'di'ang dbang mo bsti ba'i gur khang nas lam du chas khar snga dro'i dus tshod ṭ+wāṃdang skar ma 40steng bris/ /7rig ldan dbang mo dbang phyogs 'dzin ma'i char/ /lang tsho'i me tog me nā ka'i bu mor/ /smin pa'i dbang mo dbang gi me tog gi / mdzes sdug 'dab grol 'dab ldan dga' ba mo/ / 7sku tshe mi nub nyi zla'i 'gros/ /mdzad 'phrin mi chad chu bo'i rgyun/ /zhabs zung mi 'gyur mchog rab lhun/ /gtsug tu mi 'bral rtag 'grogs shog/chu bya lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi tshes dge bar khong 'ejam pa'i dbyangs kyi 'dra par gyi rgyab byang du bsam gtan gyi ngor bstan rgyam nas so/177

7'jigs med sgrang 'thung 'bod pa'i chu'i lang tsho/ /'khrul bral bstan pa'i sprang rtsi mngar mo'i zas/ /'gyed slad smra ba'i dbang phyug ngur smrig gi / gar bsgyur drug pa'i zhabs zung 'dab ldan ltor/ /mi phyed dad pa'i 'bru yi bucud ldan pa'i/ / mgo bo'i snye ma dud pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / /sor bcu'i 'dab ma zum pa'i gus pa'i nyams/cho /gcig tu tshogs pa'i rgyud stong dbyangs kyis mchod/ /dpal gdong gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dga' ston dang lhan cig tu gus pa chen pos btegs pa zla 1tshes 1la/be+erter mdangs 'dzin kun gsashā bu mo yi lto ban/ /sna tshogs dbang gzhu'i ri mo rnam bkra yi dbus na/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs dpal ldan bla ma dang gnyis med/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i zhabs pad byang chub bar bsten no/ /ye shes gzhon nu'i lus can— mthon mthing gi lcang lo/ /bsdus te pur rgyal bod kyi 'dren pa ru shar ba/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i phul byungaphyag rjes de dran no/ /rnam 'byed blo yi pad tshal grol byub ru mdzod cig / ༷ stog mthun dngos grub bye ba'i rta bdun gyi tsha zer/ —/sgrub po'i dad gus ngador cig char du lhung tshe/ /nyams rtogs sbrang rtsi 'dzag pa'i zhim mngar gyi ste khas/ /mi shigs gur rtsen rdo rje rnon po de mchod do/ /7bcu phrag drug dang bse ru'i dgongs gegs las yol bas bas mtha'i rgan pos snang sems skyid bro zhig brdung ngo/ /nas 'bras lo yag snye ma ji bzhin du mdzad 'phrin/ / rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor lta bu ru gzugs sku/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i brtan brjid la 'khu ba'i thugs stobs/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel ba'i gnam lo 'di shar tshe/ /tshe mtha' yas ltar zhabs pad g.yung drung gi 'khyil ris/ /ris med bstan 'gro'i dpal du g.yo 178

med du brtan ngos/ /ngos cag re ltos 'cha' ba'i gus ldan gyi slob ma/ /ma lus ma ltar thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis zungs mdzod/ /khyad par blo bzang rgya la ba'i mdo sngags kyi legs bshad/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srog tu chad med du spol mkhas/ / mkhas grub bye ba'i dbus su khyod las lhag ma dmigs/ /dmigs med thugs rjes gang gsol re ba bzhinatsān zhu/ /7bod kyi mi rigs tshom pur bkra ba'i char/ /dbu phreng rtse dga'i shis brjod rma chu'i khar/ /bde skyid khong 'dzum bkra legs rig slob rdzong / /rab 'bring dran dbang bye ba'i blo las yar/ /yun nas yun du slob grwa'i rtsa ba brtan/ /gang nas gang du slob ma'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /mtha' nas mtha' ru rig gnas 'bras bu'i ro/ /mu nas mu ru myang la slar yang smon/ /7thub bstan sa 'dzin mthon por rnam dag mung gi ba dan g.yo/ /sgrub rgyud gangs ri'i spo na nyams rtogs rtsal ldan seng chen 'phyo/ /rgya dang ris su ma chad sna tshogs grub mtha'i nyin byed 'od/ /thugs kyi dpal du bsu ba'i mtsho skyes 'dab ma bzhad pa'i drung / / 7rab dmar ut+pal sar ba'i g.yon mig ma/ /byur dmar khu ba 'thung bas ma ngom par/ /pad rag zhun mar babs pa'i chu gter rum/ /khrus byas gar gyis rtsen na khyod dper 'os/ /7kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi/ /kun phan bstan pa'i gsos su/ /kun nas bzhugs 'dis dga' ba/ /'jigs mdzad mi yi gar bsgyur/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug /179

'jigs mdzad blo bzang rgyal ba'i/ /tshab tu bzhengs 'dis skyid pa/ /gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba'i/ nagaser ltar dag pa'i rang lugs/ /gser khri mkhan rabasaka gdung / kagaser ri'i phreng bas los skyong / / /dpal stug rgyal ba'i zhing khams/ /dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du/ /dpal 'bar thug4kyi rten mchog / dpalagadong gnam lor grub song / / 7rgyal kun gsang gsum mdzes sdug lang tsho 'bum/ /blo gsal yid kyi man shel rtsig ngos su/ /cir yang 'char ba'i g.yu yi na chung ma/ /'di po byang chen de srid gtan gyi skyabs/ /skyabs gcig 'phags ma blo yi gter sbyin ma/ /ma bzang mchog gis deng nas gtan bde'i bar/ /bar chad 'jigs brgyad nyer 'tshe lhag med du/ /du ma'i thabs kyis zhi mdzod lhag pa'i lha/ /de ltar 'phags mar gsol 'debs dbyar skyes rnga/ /ldir ba'i mod la gus ldan mdongs mtha'i mngal/ /dge bcu'i dpal gyis sbrum dang chabs gcig par/ /mchog thun dngos grub gar brgyas brel gyur cig / 'di ltar dam dugatshig gi lcang ma 'i shing / /don gyi cha phra tshig gi lo 'dab can/ /rnga la dbyu gus ji bzhin grogs sdi ngor/ /smyon pa shā sa na yis smyo ne+etam mo/ / 180

mthongasngos mtshan phyed dga' ma'i 'gro hūṃng / rin thang bral ba rin chen rnam gsum gyi zhabs mthil/ /gser sbyangs rtsibs stong gser ldan dga' ma yi phang bar/ /me tog bzhin chags me na ka'i bu mo'i mgo lcog / skye ba'i phreng bar skye ldan skra'i lan bur chongs shig /rma klung klung chen dal gyis rgyun phyogs su babs te/ /dwangs bsil bsil ldan ljongs kyi ske rags su bcings bar/ /'thung chu chu phran stong gi g.yem ma kun sgron myor/ /rum du du ma'i sgyu rtsal ngom pa yi rdzong nas/ /lha mtshams 'tshams bde skar ma'i spen pa'i gza' 'khyud tshe/ /bod zla zla ba bcu gcig tshes gcig gi snga dro/ /chu tshod tshod dang ldan pa bcu tham pa'i steng la/ /lha sa sa yi lte bar chas pa'i mgo tshugs song / /slob ra ra ba'i dkyil na tshar tshar du bsgrigs pa'i/ /na gzhon gzhon nu pho mo rig rig tu bkra bas/ /rnam dasnyod dpyod ldan yid dbang phar phar du 'gugs tshos/ /lang tsho tsho ru chags pa'i thang shing shing ji bzhin/ /rlangs 'khor 'khor shugs kyis 'gro'i bzhon pa ru bsdad pa'i/ /mthun grob/sa grogs po du mas skyel ma rang byas te/ /'brong kha kha ba'i gos gyon lha chen gyi dbu rtser/ /bsang dud dud sprin rtse dga'i sngo bsangs bzhin bkab song / /klung rta rta bzhin rgyug pa bya bye'u yi 'phur ya/ /lha rgyal rgyal kha'i ki bso g.yu 'brug gi ngar sgra/ /rdog rtsa rtsa ba gcig gtad mnyam 'brel gyi 'dra dpar/ /sems 'phred 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur dar 'bod kyi lag g.yug / de nyin nyin der shar bskyod ka ju ru slebs nas/ /mgron khang khangabartsegs ba gam gnyis pa'i thog bsdad 181

skabs/ / gang bde bde rnam nyal khrir lus sems bag phab 'phral/ / yid dbang dbang bral 'dzin pa'i glog gzugs la bltas song / /phyi nyin nyin gung lan gru'u bde mchog gi pho brung / /don kun kun thunasu spyabu hopa'i dga' tshal gyi bsti gnas/ /byine rlabs rlabs phreng brtsegs pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi gzim chung / /dge legs ltegs byas skya rengs shar ba der slebs song / mi ring ring po'i lam —du— me 'khor nang bsdade de/ tre/sa 'dzin 'dzin ma'i sgang gshong yud tsam yun bcad nas/ /mi sdod sdod pa'isngu skabs bral yun ring du sod mthar/ /khrurge 'du 'du rjogs mang ༷'i 3nga chen der thon song / / mkha' lam lam thag ri5 ba k+ṣan gagame ma'i rto —ba/— /gangs dkar dkar mdangs chags pa'i bsil ljojes kyi mkha'e dbyings/ /mkha' lding lding 'khor rlabs kyis skad cig la gshog tshe/ /phyorges me—da med dgag lta— ba'i mal sa der reg song / /lha sa sa khul snyorma sa pa gnam gru —yi 'barba zeng / /thang dkar dkar sdeb rgeshogo rtses mi zin— pa'i sa la/ /la snyer 'ur sgras— babs pa'i ngang tshul la gzhig na/ /dasmregs gtad gtad so mod kyang btechigs tsam zhig yod 'dra/ /yul dbus dbus kyi lha ldano— jo bo yi mardune du/ /'phral sum̐nes phugs bsam bzange po me mid pa'i ngang nas/ /dzastani 'gro 'gro bu'i don la ched du rang dmigs nas/ / bstod smo na smospo— pa'i mtshoms sbyor yang dag cig byes song / /yab rje rje brotsun chos kyi rgyal bo shu'izhal skyin/ /gser gdung gdung rte na byin rlabs drod 'bar ba'i drung duri/tsho /—skye kun kun nas 'khrul bral dge ldan gyilugs la/ /shāgarjegarjes su 'jog pa'i rtse ba yange btsugs yod/ / se'u shing shing gi ra bse yong—sa bzudza gi dgon sde/— / /'bras dkar dkar 'dzamasna spungs po'i ṭ+wāmolen+d+raganyi sa pa/ /dga' ldane sden gyi mtshamase brjid phyag btab kyi chos sder/ /legs tshogs tshogs gnyis mnga' thang thang gcig la rgya bskyed/ /gru 'dzin 'dzin —mar 'gying ba rid—mar po ri'icalha khang / /khing 182

brtsegs brtsegs mar bzos pa sum rtsen gyi yul gru/ /'phags mchog mchog gi bzhugs gnas rten gsum tshor mjal tshe/ /tshe gang gang bsam grub pa'i mjug 'bras mjug dril song / /bsam yas yas mas rten la zhib mjal zhig byas tshe/ /da lta lta bya'i yul na sngar mus su med kyang / /mkhan slob slob mar bcas pa'i phyag rjes la bsam na/— /na zug zug gzer med par mchi ma yang thon la/ /rwa bsgreng rwa ba dkar(bo'i ljongs bstan gyi chu mgo / jo 'brom jo zhal bo dong grub mtha' yi spyi mes/ /shug gseb shug pa gser ldan 'brom rje yi dbu lo/ /byin rten byin chagos grangs mang bzhugs pa 'di ngo mtshar/ /srong btsan btsan po'i ring bzhengs lo rgyus rgyun ring pa'i/ /khra 'brug 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyis phyogs kun du khyab par/ /'jigs brgyad brgyad gnyis bcu drug phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe/ /kun sgrol sgrol ma'i snang brnyan mig dbang gi bdud rtsi/ /bkra shis shis brgya'i phang 'gro'i rang sgra gdangs snyan pa'i/ /lhun stug stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi do ya/ /ya mtshan mtshan gyi me tog bzhad pa yi byams mgon/ /bsod nams nam 'phang mtho ba'i lha chen der mjal song / /sa skya skya bo'i 'dzin mar mig 'phrul du chags pa'i/ /gong ma ma rig mun sel rnam lnga yi bsti gnas/ /rgyang grags grags pa don yod chos dung gis mtshon pa'i/ /gna' rdzas rdzas mang gtibs pa 'dzam gling gi spyi nor/ /zha lu lu ma'i chu yis srog gsos pa'i dgon gnas/ /bu ston ston pa'i gdung 'tshob mchog gis skyed bsring bar/ /mi nyung nyung min rten la zhib mjal zhig byas tshe/ /lag rjes rjes shul snyogs rnams glo thub pa'i dan rtags/ /bal yul bal ldan lug gi bal kha las 'jam zhing / /bzo rtsal bzo yi gnas kun bla lhag tu dar ba'i/ /byin rten byin 'bar rten gyi bzhengs bkod 'di mthong tshe/ /bal mo bal bza'i ring dar lag rtsal de ma nyams/ /rgya gar gar song gar bsdad sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas/ /gnas mchog 183

mchog tu tregrags che bkra shis kyi ṣ+ka rdzong / / gna' rdus dus bzang thub bstan byusrog shing girteyal ga / sto ka gdung gdung 'degs mab ba'i mtshon rtags de mthong song ༈srid zhizhi bde'i ded dpon bca bzhi‘ba'i gser— — ༄ zhal/ /zhal mdzes mdzes sdug nya gang zla ba yi 'dzum zer/ /zer mdangs mdangasgos bkra mig zung kun da mas 'khyud tshe/ /tshe 'diru'adi snang 'ching spyas bcingasadecangalhodasong kyaidalug mabya4sgyid panana'ibarasong ba'i—༄ ske ci /go thos rargas tsame go rim nges med du bsgrigos pas/ /mtha' med 'gro kun mtha' yas smon lam gyi don bzhin/ /bzhi na legs lha sku bzhin dmul rang zhal de mjal smosda/ / rka — — 184 — dzo— tsho rmo —

gnyid kyis bathi ba'i 'khrul lab/dhi li ju ma tha la'i grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs/ /ya mu ya rabs skye bo'i skom sel gyi 'gram du/ /kun byed kun snang sems kyi dar cig gi shar cha/ /shog chene shog bur phab pa sor mo'i khur lci yang / /'ga' zhig 'ga' yi gzigs mor ri mo'i gar 'khrab la/ /la 'ur la nye bzang bos gser snyan zung blags mdzod/ /ka dag sems kyi snang cha ga shal rgyan spungs pa/ /kha dog ci ru ma nges kha ba'i mdangs 'tsher ma/ /ga ler brtags shing gzhig na ga bur dri mnam pa/ /nga yi lha mchog dbyangs can nga mgrin khyim dgyes rol/ /ca re nyal nas bsdad kyang cha tshang ba'i nyams len/ /ja chang sha la rol yang nya gang lha'i tshogs dkyil/ /tā re'i sku gsung las gzhan tha mal gyi snang grags/ /da nas yong ye mi 'dug na ro'i mal zin la/ /pa sangs 'od dkar lham pa'i pha rol gyi byang chub/ /ba be'us nang nub bsgoms pa'i yon tan rtsal rdzogs pa/ /tsa ri mkha' 'gro'i mdzod nas tsha zer brgya'i gzi ldan/ /dza ya gong ma'i dgongs bcud wa ler thon 'di rmad/ /zha smyug mchu ris ma yin za byed kyi rwa bar/ /'a cag sngon 'dris dga' ma'i ya mtshan gyi zhabs sor/ /ra ri'i mtshan ma bral ba la 'ur du bkod des/ /sha khrag 'od skur dwangs pa'i sa 'gag der slebs song / /ha cang snyan pa med kyang a mdo ba zhig gis/ /don ldan glu chung blangs pa'i rgyud mangs kyi sgra 'dis/ /dkar nag rgya bal ris su 185

ma chad pa'i legs tshogs/ / rang snang gnyug ma'i gshis sa 'ub kyis rang ༄'ching shog / spyi lo 94rab rgyan shing khyi'i zla 12tshes kyi cha tshod 6steng shā sa nas rgya ༄gar rgyal sa nas bris/ci ci sto— byu — rwa rī 186 — sdu — —— — — — — — da — — — ci

spyi tho 95rab rgya na zhing phag phogasaraskabasaspul ba'i zhuyig kun byed sems kyi rang mdangs/ hwa dzo— 'jam dpal rnon po'i mkhyen rtsal khong nas cher 'bar ba'i/ /legs bshad smra ba'i nyi ma gnyis pa khyod bzhugs pas/ /snying po'i don la gtod med mun mda' 'phen ma dgos/ /khyad nor lag mthil reg pas sems pa 'di dga' ba/ /gnad lnga'i khyad 'phags mchog thun dngos grub kyi gter mdzod/ /gzhan la ma grags dge ldan rang lugs kyi pha chos/ /'jam mgon longs spyod rdzogs sku bsgrags sgrub kyi gdams zab/ /lta ba'i nyi ma 'bod ba'i skya rengs de los yin/ /'og ma'i grub mtha' 'dzin ma'i sgang gshong las brgal ba'i/ /thogs thug dbus mtha' bral ba klu sgrub kyi dgongs dbyings/ /rnam dpyod shugs kyis 'jal ba'i zla ba khyod shar bas/ /lta ngan mun stug mtha' nas sangs pa 'di skyid pa/ /gna' bo'i mkhas mang bye'u'i gshog rtsal gyis ma zin/ /'bu srin gsod pa'i mchu yis rdo rje'i go ma phigs/ /lta ba'i legs bshad lnga yi sder phreng mthar rkyong ba'i/ /tshul gnyis gshog rtsal ngom pa'i khyung chen khyod brjid pa/ /rgyab rten lung gi lho sprin lang‘long du 'khrigs par/ /sgrub byed thogs bral rigs pa'i glog lce dang 'grogs nas/ /mtha' bral zab mo'i gtam gyi g.yu 'brug stong ldir khyod/ /blo gsal rma bya dga' ba'i dus ston rang los yin/ /klu thogs lung zin shing rta chen po yi dgongs mdzod/ /gangs ljongs gangs ri'i spo na ci dga' ru smra la/ /smra ba'i seng chen 'jam mgon bla ma yi zhal tshab/ /khyod bzhugs dka' gnad stong gi phrang 187

'as/ga la ci'i thogs/ / sna tshogs rigs tshal 'dzings pa'i tshang tshing gi do ༄rar/ / gnad bzhi'i mche rnon gzengs tshe log rtog gi ri dwags/ / kham du bgyid pa'iX dus kyi dge legs dpal gnyis tho/khaṃ /khyod gzhes skabs 'dir lta ba'i dogs don rang los zhu/ /wegs bshad snying po legs par shod mkhan deng dkon zhing / / lcags mda' lcags gzhu lcags ltar mkhregs pas 'gugs dka' yang / /snying po'i don ston snying rje'i gter chen khyod bzhugs pas/ /dka' ba'i gnad kun dka' mor lus don zhig mi 'dug — / phyag na pad+mo'i zhubs tsho—sem ste ba'i phreng gtsag thob/ /yabe rje'i legs bshad ngas kum / phu ཿ1 ri ri sa pa /mgrin pa'i sbrubs legs 'khyil/ /stong dang snying rje'i nyamame len snying bcad stodu chags pa'i/ /srid zhi'i rgud mun mtha' rtsaskyel ba'i dpal thob shog /ces shing phag gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi zla 1tshes 1dge bar gus slob gling sprul ming 'dzin bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung 'dzum pa'i zla rgyan gyis gus pa bla na med pas bris pa skye rkun thugs rje'i phyag gis mi gardong baḍi— /ra gyur cig gu/ —/ 188 wa ci — mo tsā

yan lag bdunapa kun mkhyenadagyes pa'i mchodaspren/kyi li'i rang sgra grags stong gsung gi gdangs/ /khu bas ma bsgyur sor rtog ye shes mdangs/ /ge sar ji bzhin bdud bāzhi dbyings gcod thugs/ /ngo bo ka nas dag pas ngang phyag 'tshal/ /ci snang rgyan du shar ba mchod pa'i sprin / /chu gter rlabs phreng stong gi 'jo sgeg can/ /je mang blo las 'das pa phyi nang rdzas/ /nya gang dkyil 'khor tshom bur gus pas 'bul/ /ti sgro'i brag sogs pad+ma'i sgrub gnas su/ /thu bo snying stobs chen po'i rjes zhugs nas/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings zab mor 'jug ldang gis/ /na rga rgyu bcas dmigs med ngang du bshags/ /pa sangs ltar dkar lhag bams mkha' khyab blos/ /pha rol snang sems 'gugs pa'i kyo ba yis/ /ba yi mig 'dzum yun la brtan g.yo'i ngos/ /ma lus dbang byed mdzad par rjes yi rangs/ /tsa tur rgyud sde'i bang rim las brgal ba'i/ /tsha zer brgya ldan theg mchog rdzogs pa che/ /dza ya'i dgongs bcud tig po ma nor bas/ /wa ler 'khor mtha' de srid chos 'khor skor/ /zhi bsil mya ngan 'das pa'i go 'phang thabs/ /gzu lum ma yin rgyal ba'i rjes zhugs te/ /'e cag 'gro 'di'i 'ub chub de yi bar/ /yo lang gzugs sku'i snang ba mi sdud gsol/ /rwa rtse rno ldan 'jigs rung ya ma'i dpung / /la lung kun nas chu sna bzhin rdol yang / /sha pags mi tsha 'jigs med gdeng ldan blos/ /sa gsum 'gro la dus gsum dge tshogs bsngo/ /ha cang snyigs 'gro'i nyon mongs ches rags shing / /rtsol bcas theg pa'i gdul bar spobs min par/ /a ti rtsol med chos zad blo 'das sbubs/ /le lo can 189

kun 'bad med gzhir grol shog / skye phreng kun tu sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /dgyes yam bde chen rgyal mos rjes bzung nas/ /kun mkhyen dgongs mdzod ༄mtha' ru 'khyol ba la/ /klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ltar gyur cig /kun gzigasi rkyelo ba'i dbang po hūṃ tshe bam̐rtene/ /kurne khyabam̐ thug4rje'i nyin byed 'od stong 'bar/ /kun phan dgongs pa'i gtad so mjug 'bras brtan/ /kun la bde skyid yong —ba'i bkra shis shog /95zla 12—tshes 1ral wa ra ṇa si nas klong chen 'das mchod kyi chos tshogs gzab rgyas grol ba dang chabs gcig rgyal sa ldi li nas klong 4chen rbazhad pa rtsal gyis rtse gcigatshotu gesol ba botab pi skye ṅkun rjes sa 'dzin ༄pa'i rgyur gyur cig sda —— / — wa cho— wa — — — — — — —wa rdak+ṣ-iwa — chi r+sha ci — rī — — ji — wa —190 — rme ca ne

gdung 'bodathugs rje'i gru char 'dzo ba'ispren phung zhes bya ba/ 'jigs med thugs bskyed mkha' klong yangs pa las/ /rig pa'i 'od stong bkye bas nyin mor byed / /gdul bya'i blo gros pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /dpal ldan bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /zla med blo bzang rgyal bstan spel slad du/ /mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes kyi tshul bzung nas/ /dpag med bgrang yas chos tshul 'jig rten du/ /bar med gsal mdzad skyabs gcig snying dbus rol/ /'jam dpal snying po'i gdung 'tshob ngag gi dbang / /dbyangs ldan dpal mo'i rig pa'i mdzod la dbang / /dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'phral yun 'dod 'jo'i gter/ /gter gyur mtshungs pa med pa gang de'i zhabs/ /'tsho gzhes skabs der mdo khams nor 'dzin khyon/ /'jig rten kun dga'i gling bu 'bud la brel/ /da ni lnga bdo'i smag rum cher dkrigs pas/ /lam ston mtshan mo'i mgon de'ang snang med yal/ /kye ma kye hud mgon khyod gang du bzhugs/ /pha mas bor ba'i bu chung su la re/ /skyabs med skye bo'i mgon skyabs su yis byed/ /mi mngon dbyings nas brtse chen thugs rjes dgongs/ /rnam gsum gos kyis klub pa'i zhi dul sku/ /da lta 'dren byed yul du snang ma gyur/ /shes’nyon gnyid mthug sad byed gsung gi gdangs/ /thos 'dzin dpyid du son pa'i go skabs bral/ /chos dbyings gshis su 'gro 'ong ma dmigs kyang / /gzugs sku dbang gzhu'i ri mo yal 'dis skyo/ //da dung 'pho chen ye shes sgyu ma'i —skus/ /dngos nyams rmi lam na'ang rjes su zungs/ /dran dbangangagadengs can bye ba rol ba'i gnas/ /191

gang thugs zab gsang na kra'i grong khyer cher/ /mdo rgyud man ngag gdams pa'i nyal 'gro stong / /gcig tu 'khyil ba'i mtsho chen glo bur bri/ /thugs rje'i sprin sngon g.yo ba'i ba gam las/ /dbang khrid man ngag 'dod pa 'jo ba'i char/ /ci dgar hūṃbacus tsas gozharme denemāṃ rbeka'ardzudrin d+kucan/ 6/bshes gnyen lha dbang gang de yang yang dran/ /rtsod ngag lung rigs 'phrog byed gad rgyangs kyis/ /smre ngan gnyis 'thung myos bum dum bur 'thor/ /legs bshad dbyangs kyime skal bzang mdongasi mtha' yi/ /re ba don ldan mdzad pa'i bka' dri〉ne dran/ /bstan la ston pa gnyis pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /chos 'dul sde bzhi'i dargongs don tshangs pa'i thig / drang bo'i lam nas nam yang3smre 'da'i ba'i/ /nye bar 'khor gyi mched zla'i rname thare dran—/ /bsil ri'i phreng pas bkra ba'i bod ljongs kyi/ / bstan pa'i ka che—na 'gyel la mngon phyogs tshe/ / thugs stobs gzhan 'granadhe med pa'i dpung ba yis/ / bcu phrag rig pa'i khang che na gzhi nas bslangs/ —/rmad cisgyeng mdzad pa'i ga bur jigs pa yis / /bran tsam nyid nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i tshogs/ /lhag med gzhil mdzad 'jig rten dbang phyug gi / thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul 'chang ba'i mgon de dran/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang gangs ri /las 'ong ba'i/ r+sha/gsang chen kha 'bab rnam bzhi'i klung/gi rgyun/ /thugs gsang ma drosi mtsho 0 sim pa yi/ /rig 'dzin gdengs can dbong po slar yang dran/ /phul byung —gsung gi zla zer gyis phye ba'i/ /rig pa'i 'dab phreng 'dzum pa'i gsung skyes tshogs/ /chos grwa ri sul grong khyer yangaso pa'i rgyan/ /rkun da'i phon por srungs pa'i ngo mtshar dran/ /brtse ldan ma yilobor ba'i gachudzogis/ /yus kyis 'bod pa'i ngag 'dir mi dgongs na/ /pongs med gsum gyi gong rol thugs bskyed pa'i/ /gzhig bral dam bca'i ri mo 'jigamin nam/ /'on kyang dbyangasga can mgrin par rol ba las/ /snyan 'gyur chos kyi legs bshad 'bum baṭ+wāṃl ga / mig 192

ngag snying gi dpal du nyams med par/ / bzhag te zhi dbyings gzhol 'di dngos po'i gshis/ /de phyir 'dren mchog gzi brjid rgyal po khyod// / chos dbyings chu lha'i phang bar zhugs lags kyang / /brtse chen 'od dmar 'ching thag dam po yis/ /bdag rgyud chu skyes dga' tshal 'khyud par rigs/ /skye ba'i phreng bar mgon khyod zhabs skyes rdul/ /rdul bral dmar snum zhabs sen nor ba'i phreng / /phreng mdzes bde chen 'khor lor nyer bkod de/ /de bzhin ༄ gshegs pa'i go 'phang lo reg mdzod/ /der ma son pa'i skye rabs kun tu yang / /'jigs sked legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /sgrib gnyis g.yul ngo zil gnon 'dun sa ru/ /lhan cig chos kyi dga' ston myong bar smon/ /zhu tshig tshig gi lo mas ma bsgribs par/ /kun slong kun tu dge ba'i gsong bo'i gtam/ /thugs rjes phyi mig bskul ba'i rjes 'bod 'di/ /rang sems gso ba'i skyo grogs tshal du gleng / /ces bla ma la gdung ba'i smre ngag gis ༄gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rje'i gru char 'jo ba'i sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di yang /7mgon po gang gi slob bu'i gral mthar spyod pa'i bhu su ku bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bka' drin gzhan 'gran med pa gang de'i dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan pa'i dus tshes dge bar gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa 'dis kyang / skye kun dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin cing gsung gi bdud rtsir longs spyod par gyur cig / dge'o/sarba maṅgā lo/ — — ne+e 193

rtse — ‘ — ka rtsom zha tsha'igros 'debs/ 'jigs —sped rnam par dasnyod pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i 'od/ /'gog med rgyu ba'i lus can rmongs mun gnyid/ —/drungs 'byin dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / /'jigs mdzad ngur smig gar bsgyur tsong kha ba'i/ /zla bral bstan pa thur ma brgya yi gdugs/ /phas rgol phyogs las rnam rgyal rūgs stobs kyis/ /bzung ba'i grags snyan phyogs kyi bu dhemos brdung / / ka ye ka dag sems kyi gnas lugs zla/ / /kha dog mtshan ma'i ra ris ma dmigs kyang / /ga nas brtags kyang spros pa'i gra zur bral/ /nga bdag 'joms pa'i gnas lugs e ma rmad/ /ca co'i gtam rnams phug med brag cha'i dbyangs/ /cha lugs phyi tshul bcos yang ri mo'i gzugs/ / ja d+nghachang la sred 'dod yon kyo ba 'dis/ /nya mo bzhin du nam zhig lnga lam bsnyegs/ /ta re'i thugs rjes da lta bstane dang mjal/ /tha rīmal tshul spangs ngur smrig na bzas bklubs/ /da lan shākya'i rjes su zhugs skabs 'dir/ / na spang me tog tshal du rig gnas sbyongs/ /pa sangs skar ma rgyu skar khrod na bzhin/ /pha rol rigs mthun dbus su mngon mtho zhing / /ba lang blun rgan ngan spyod spong 'dod na/ /ma lus 'phags bod gzhung la sbyang ba gnad/ /tsa rir phyin na bde skyid yod skad kyang / /tsha grang dmyal ba'i skye sgo 'gog nus min/ /dza ya gong ma'i rnam thar lhur bzhes na/ /wa ler nyams rtogs nang nas 'char bar nges/ /zhwa lham lta bur med thabs med pa dang / /za tshod la sogs tha 194

shal zas tsam gyis/ /'a cag lang shor song bas 'tsho dka' yang / /ya mtshan kho nar sred la chog shes mdzod/ / ra dang lug gi dbye 'byed mkhas tsam gyis/ /la la rang mthong nga rgyal byed pa dang / /sha thang 'bad pas gsog srang ste ci so ༄la 'bad pa/ /sa — nga phyugs dang khyad par 'dug dzems/ /ha cang mkhas mang 'dus pa'i gral ring du/ /a ru sman ljon dri 'thul mdo sngags gzhung / /gzhung lugs sbyang brtson thos donadzo nyams len la/ /la 'ur 'bad nas dal 'byor don— ldan 'tshal/— /— — tre — — — — byu — — — sa— — 195

bla ma'ijugs rjegand nas bskuphaba'igasopha'adebasagasang gsumasbyin rlabs 'gugasapa'ingaṣ+ṭha rā ga'ilcags kyu zhes bya ba/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i li khri'i mdangs/ /srid gsum 'dren pa'i dpal du legs shar ba/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes grags pa'i/ /snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba der phyag 'tshal/ /mgon de'i gsang gsum 'o ma'i chu gter las/ /legs bltams rang bstan gsal ba'i 'od dkar can/ /'aṭīm dpāl dbyangs can zung gi mkhyen pa'i cha/ /yongs rdzogs mūthu stobyās mgon de gtsug na rgyal/ /rgya bod gzhung bzang stong gi yang snying bcud/ /bcud du 'khyil ba'i blo bzang legs bshad mtsho/ /mtsho byung mgrin par rol ba'i ngag gi dpal/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo gnyis pa gang der 'dud/ /'jam mgon legs bshad lha lam yangs po ru/ /dpal ldan mkhyen rab rlung shugs kyis bgrod de/ /thub bstan gling bzhi gsal ba'i mthu mnga' ba/ /stobs bcu'i dbang phyug smra ba'i nyi ma khyod/ /dpag med bskal ba'i sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang / /dpag yas 'gro ba ma lus sgrol ba'i ched/ /ched du ngur smrig 'chang ba shākya'i sras/ /sras kyi mchog gyur bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs/ /bzung ste mtha' klas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i slad/ /slad ma'i tshe yang sprul ba'i rnam rol gar/ /gar mkhan bzhin du du ma'i thabs tshul mchog /196

mchog tu ston khyod bdag la yud tsam dgongs/ /mdzes mdzes snyan tshig tshig gi la nga tsho mas/ /snyan snyan mgrin glu glu yi rtar drangs te/ /gsal gsal gdung dbyangs dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs na/ /yang yang rjes brtse brtse chen lcags kyus zungs/ /rnam 'dren bu ram shing ba'i lung rtogs bstan/ /rnam par gsal ba'i mkhas dbang nam mkha'i nor/ / rnam dag zhi ba'i dbyings su yongs nub pas/ /rnam kun bdag cag mya ngan khur gyis non/ /yon tan cha shas rdzogs pa'i gzugs sku'i zla/ /zla zer blo gsal kun da bye ba'i gsos/ /gsos gyur 'od gsal chu 'dzin phang ba ru/ /yib tshe mgon bral mgon skyabs su la re/ /mkhyen dpyod kun gsal sgeg mo'i lding khang las/ /las ldan gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /gnyen mchog darma chos bdud rtsi'i gru char 'bum/ /'bum phrag bskal bar 'bebs khyod gang du bzhud/ /'jam mgon 'jam dpal snying po'i thugs kyi bcud/ /klu sgrub klu yi dbang po'i dgongs pa'i mthil/ /rten 'brel rten 'byung brgya phrag rig pa'i mdzod/ /ston pa'i ston pa mchog khyod gang du bzhugs/ /tshe gtsig rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ma chog / mchog tu sgrub byed gsang chen rdo rje theg /theg pa'i yang rtse myur las ches myur lam/ /lam mchog ston pa'i lam ston gang du gshegs/ /khyod gsung legs pa da bshad pa'i dga' ston la/ /'phral phugs longaso su spyod pa'i skal thob kyang / /gzugs sku rags pa'i zhabs sen nor bu'i tog / spyi bor yun ring bsten pa'i skal ba phra/ /de phyir 'dren mchog bsil zer dbang po khyod/ /'od gsal sprin gyi dbyings rum stug po las/ /dgyes spyan ga bur thigs pa 'bum 'thor te/ /bdag blo'i kun da cung zad skyong bar rigs/ /bdag sogs deng nas skye bar shākya'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying 'jam dpal snying po'i lugs/ /lugs bzang mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /zhing mchog kun tu du ma'i 'gro 'dren 197

shog /de yi tshe yang mgon khyod zhabs skyes rdul/ /gus pas gtsug gi rgyan du nyer 'chang ste/ /blo bzang legs bshad mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i bcud/ /ngoms med 'thung ba'i dpal la spyod par shog/dus bzhi phyi ma'i rdzogs ldan nyi ma stong / /lus phan yongs kyi bsod nams mkha' klong du/— /'gog med shar tshe gsang chen sbrang rtsi'i dpal/ /rol ba'i sus kyi thu bor bdag gyur cig /byams mgon rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'jig rten 'dir/ /byon te dam chos sgo brgya 'byed pa'i tshe/ /dpon slob lhan cig gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /spyod pha'i skal bzang nyams pa med par shog /mdor na byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /mgon khyod rigs kyi bdag por legs bstenari te/ /lnga rig nor bu'i phadzod la dbang bsgyur zhing / /kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhod don lhun grub shog /snyigs ma'i rang rtags dus su bdo— ba'i dpung / / gza' klu rgyal 'gong—5dam sri'i gnod pa sogs/ /mi 'dod rgud pa'i tshogs rnams khyod kyi mthus/ / lhag med drungs nas phyungs shig byin rlabs gter/ /bdag gis byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ /'gal rkyenand rims gdon bgegs thams cadadang / /khyad par snying khams dkrugs pa'i nad rigs sogs/ /cikhyod zhabs dran pas myur du zhi bar mdzod/ /lhag bsam྾ rtag tu grogs byed shog / smras pa/dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs gang de la/ —/—gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs dbyar skyes rnga/ /mos ldan rmasbya'i yid la kun dga'i dpal/ /ster 'di bsgrigags pa'i byed po shā sa na'o/ /de dge dri ma med pas yid can kun/ /skye kun theg mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sa/ /yongs bzung srid zhi'i— mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i go 'phang myur thob shog /4 198 tre

brtanagasol tshedapalayongs 'du'isngon ṅge zhes bya ba/ rma su sti/ rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes me long nyid/ /byu ru'i smra ston nyams kyis sgeg pa mo/ /tshe dang dbang gi las la thogs med des/ /legs byin snang ba'i dpal gyis rtag tu skyongs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i zag bral ye shes thugs/ /dge legs yon tan bye ba'i 'byung gnas gang / /'dun ldan rgya mtsho'i dpal du yongs shar ba/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bslab gsum dag pa'i rtsa brtan yongs 'du'i ljon/ /gzhan phan sems kyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs/ /legs bshad me tog 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad rtag brtan shog / 'jam dpal dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje yi/ /zhal skyin mdo sngags gzhung gi dka' ba'i mdud/ /bkrol la rnam dpyod sor rtse sgra ldan ma'i/ /rjes 'gro dam p+ta'i mgon khyod zhabs brtan shog / gzhung don 'chad la 'jam mgon bla ma bzhin/ /rtsod pas rgol ngan gzhom la dge legs dpal/ /sdeb legs snyan 'jebs rtsom la chos dbang grags/ /rnam gsum gcig 'dus mkhas khyod྾/ /'jam mgon snyan rgyud srad dben gdams pa'i bcud/ /stsol la smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs mtho bas/ /dge 'dun gser ri'i dbus na yongs 'phags khyod/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal du྾/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i 'o ma'i bcud/ /bcud ldan lam gtso gsum gyi mar gsar du/ /du ma'i thabs kyis sgril bas dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad rtag brtan shog / 'jam dpal snying po'i rang lugs chu gter che/ / 199

bshad sgrub rlabs phreng stong gi rol rtsed can/ /lus can gdengs can bye ba'i nyer 'tsho ru/ /nyams med 'khyil slad g.yung drung ltar brtan shog / rmad byung bkra shis g.yas 'khyil chos kyi sde/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang thang mar brdal ba'i sde/ /sde snone gsem gyi 'a chad nyane nyams maido sde/ /sde3'di'i dpal du ༄g.yo med rtag brtan gsol/ /tshe yi lha cimachog rnams kyi byin mthu dang / /chos dbyings rang bzhin deg pa'i bden stobaso dang / /gus ldan lhag bsam dag pa'i 'brel ba yis/ /smon pa'i don kyen gegaso med lhun grub shog/—'di'ang bkra r+shas 'khyil gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chin po sang ga'i mtshane can gang— nyid zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas me'i thabs su dmigs te/ 7 gyi na ba bstan 'dzin rgya —mtshos dbang lha'i snang brnyan dang bcas gus pa bla na med pas btegaso pa smon bzhin 'grub par gyustor rdag gu/ — — ri 200 — ci — — r+sha

bshesagarnyan chen po rje sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i zhabasadrungadu phul ba zhu bskul lha rnga'isgra dbyangs ces bya ba/pharme rol phyin pa dang po'i mtshan gyi 'brug / 'brug ltar snyan sgrogs g.yas 'khyil dung gi dbyangs/ /dbyangs snyan phyogs su sgrogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mchog gi drung / /gus pa chen pos zhu 'bras/ blo bzang rgyal bstan srid 'di'i rin chen gcig /gcig tu mdzes pa'i 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog / tog bzhin gtsug tu 'dzin pa'i gyi na ba/ /ba glang rnam thar 'dzin des 'di skad du/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i nyi/ /nyi ltar lung rtogs gzi 'od stong 'bar bas/ /bstan 'gro'i rgud mun sel la rings pa'i tshal/ /tshal gnas dam pas sgrogs raX ra༅pa deng gi char/ /bsod nams bye ba'i legs byas rlan gsher gyis/ /skyed bsring gang sku tsan dan sa mchog ljon/ /bslab gsum dri bsung phyogs su spro ba yi/ / bdag cag mgon bcas 'tsho gzhes mchog tu spro/ / skabs zhu/dkon mchog kun 'dus 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i tshul/ /thub dbang bstan pa'i sgron me tsong kha ba'i/ /thub bstan yang snying gsal byed gzhung gi phu la/ /phul byung bstod 'grel rnam gnyis bshad lung zhu/ /slad kyang zhabs zung 'gyur med g.yung drung khrir/ /g.yo med bkod de mkhyen rab nam mkha'i klong / /brtse chen rdzogs ldan sprin gyi ba gam las/ /mdo sngags zab rgyas chos 201
kyi gru char phobs/ /nyung ngu'i zhu tshig mecetog phreng / /phreng ba lag zung gis btegs te/ /te bor gsol 'di dam pa'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen smra dbang drung du phul/ / 202

bshesaganyen chen po bsamagatan rgya mtsho mchogagi zhabasadrungadu phul ba snyan 'phrinadung zla'i rang mdangs ces bya ba/ 'gro 'di'i legs byas dbyig 'dzin lte bar tshogs zung chu mtsho sngo la dwangs/ /byang chub thugs bskyed rtsa ba rab brtan thos dang bsrum pa'i yal 'dab rdzogs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob gcig gyur 'gro mang gat+tan bder 'god pa'i khur/ /khur 'khyer bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pa 'gro mang kyā mardo'i gtsug na lham/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan rna ba brgyad pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can phang 'gro'i rgyud du nyer bkug te/ /te bor skal bzang dga' ba'i snying gi dpyid/ /dpyid du stsol khyod blo gros mchog sbyin lha/ /lha mchog gang dang mi gnyis dge ba'i bshes/ /bshes gnyen bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po gang / /gang gi bka' drin dran pa'i thol byung tshig /tshig gi phreng b.rartsaspel 'dis dgyes par mdzod/ /ka gdung gis mdzes khang bzang nyams dga' yi nang du/ /kha gting bral ba'i lung rtogs yon tan gyi rgya mtsho/ /ga nas bltas kyang ljang mer 'khyilageyi slob dpon/ /nga khyod med par kun gyi mgon mdzad der 'dud do/ /ca co'i 'khrul ba rnam bral dam chotsokyi sgro dbyangs/ /cha shas man ngag kun tshang lung rigs kyi lam nas/ /jatsholo rgyas pa'i dpal ltar lhug lhug tu 'doms tshe/ /nya lto ba yang skyengs te mkha' spyod du bzhud snyam/ /tā tha ga ta'i bstan 'di bla nas blar 203

rgyas ched/ /tha ma 'bring rab dad ldan slob ma yi tshogs la/ /da res tsam min mdo sngags legs bshad kyi dga' ston/ /na ma'i yul gyur drang srong mgron bzhin du 'gyid do/ /pa tra'i ris bzhin bkra shis g.yas 'khyil gyi chos sde/ /pha rol dgon sde'i nang na gure dkar gyi tog bzhin/ /ba snaspu g.yo bas mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi degrongasi snyan/ /ciyolusazla phyog sa mthar sgrog 'dis sems pa rang skyid do/ / tsa mi dang mtshungs mkhas dbang byin chags kyi gnas 'dir/ /tsha grang sku na smin pa'i 'o brgyal rgyang bskyur te/ dza ya'i bstan spel snying stobs chen po yi rnam thar/ /wa ler bsams na kun mkhyen yab sras kyi bka' drin/ / zhwa ser lugs bzaje datsholta'i dus ngan gyi mtha' 'dir/ —/za zi'i 'dod yon spangame te lag leneske la 'debame 'di/ /'a cag bsod nams che'o da dung yang— 'di bzhin/ ri/ya mtshan dpale la spyod spu'i smon 'dun rang zhu'o/ /ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'di'i pha mes kyikhyade nor/ /la la min par bcu phrag rig gnas kyi gtere kha/ /sha tsha'i thugs kyis slar yang bstsal ba yi bka' grin/ /sa steng gser gyise bekang yang gsab thabs rang mi snang / /ha sa badz+ra yab sras mdo sngags kyi gsudzol/ /a ho sbyangs pa dman yang dad gus kyi gtsug nor/ /nor bu lta bur bkur r+pā'i rten 'ar+bhel gyi mthu las/ —/las can gral du tshud snyam glo ba rang dga'o/ / bsam pa byang chub sims mchogo gru chen la brten nas/ /'gro kun 'khor mtsho las bsgral gtan bde yi skam sar/ rme/'dren pa'i ded dpon rgya chen gzhung brgya yi mdzod 'dzin/ /'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig mtsho byung sras po rang rmad do/ /mi 'ji gas 'jigs bralazab rgyas dam chos kyi sgra dbyangs/ /dbyangs can rgyud mangs mnyen lcug dadagusakyi sor mos/ /bskul tshe dgan bas bro gar 'khrab pa yi dga' ston/ /ston 'bras 'bras bzangaceji bzhin blo gros kyi rtsal las/ /las ldan slob ma'i zhophral yun legs tshogs kyi rtsa lag / lag pad snying gar zum 204

bzhin gtsag rgyan du bsten tshe/ /tshe rabs phreng bar theg mchog dge ba'i ༄bshes mdzad de/ /de nyid gzigs pa'i go 'phang thob pa ru mdzod cig /dam pa'i mgon khyod zhabs pad bskal brgya ru 'tsho zhing / /dam pa gong ma'i zhal skyin mdo sngags kyi gsung rab/ /dam ldan slob ma'i tshogs la ci dga' ru stsol ba'i/ /dam chos dbyar rnga sgrog pa'i sa steng kun khyab shog / skye kum/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying 'dzin la zla bral mgon/ /mgon po gang gi thugs rjes nyer bzung ste/ /'gro khams rgya mtsho'i 'dren par bdag gyur cig /ces gang gi bka' drin dran pa'i gdung shugs nang rkyen gyis bskul tshe sug was su— bgyis te phul ba dge lewas kaphel/ / — ci — — — 4 205

bshesaganyen sabaga'i mtshan can gyidrungadusalgob 'i 'u semase kyide nyidagasatshibhesdoces bya bo/ rab dge bslab gsum rtsa ba reb brtan cing / /'dun ldan mkhas māng gser ri'i phred ba'i dbus/— /phywad rtogs yon tan rgya mtsholī mngon mtho ba/ /bshes rgenyene lhun po rgenyi/ sa pa gang de'i drung / /rnam 'dren dge ba'i bshes kyi bka' drin las/ / rnam dag bstan cipa'i snying por lerges mjal kyang / /rnam g.yeng ngang du mi tshe mthar son pa'i/ /rnam kun sdug la sbyor ba'i rgan pos mchid/ / 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zol/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i legs bshad kun/ /kun nas rgyal ba'i gsung dang gnyis med du/ /du mas lung rigs sgo nas nges pa rnyed/ /de lta na'ang blo dang brtson pa'i mthu/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du zhan gyur bas/ / gzhung bzang chu gter chen po'i 'gram gnas bzhin/ / thos dang bsam pa'i rol min skom grir 'chi/ /'chi chos gsha' ma snying nas bsgrub 'dod tshe/ /tshe 'di'i snang shas mtha' dag rgyab bskyur nas/ 'di dang phyi mar phan pa'i rnam dag chos/ / chos bzhin bsgrub snyam skabs 'gar yang yang sems/ /mdo ru dril na sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig /mdo sngags lam gyi gnad tshang za ma tog / tog bzhin 'phags bod gzhung gi bla na mtho/ /mtho ris dpal kun bsdus 'dra'i legs bshad mchog / tshe thung nyi rgas grib so lta bu 'dir/ / sna tshogs yul la g.yeng long mi 'dug pa'i/ / gzhung mchog 'di nyid gdams pa'i mthil bzung nas/ /tshe mjug don ldan nus par smon lam 2pyi6

'tshal/ /tshe rabs kun tu thub bstan yongs rdzogs lam/ /gdan thog gcig tu 'dzin pa'i snying po'i bstan/ /'khrul bral lta dang gsang chen rdo rje'i theg /'gro khams rgya mtshor spol ba'i dpal thob shog / de lta'i zhu yig rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtam/ /gtam snyan tshig gi zol gyis ma sgrib pa/ /pa —sangs ltar dkar semes kyis bsnyad pa'i dge /dge ldan bstan dang mjal ba'i rgyur gyur cig / lke — — ci rī byu ñca 207

— ñja tsho — tsho — yorngos 'dzinarasga'i mtshan tsasgrugyizhabasadrungadu phul ba 'i 4 — sgyuzhu 'phrin donaldan ngagagilhatogatram̐s bya ba/ tā dge legs yon tan nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngor/ /shādun ldan dga' skyed legs bshad 'od stong can/ /gdul bya rgya mtsho'i blo gros 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /'byed mdzad bshes gnyen nyi ma mchog gi drung / /bstan pa'i ba dan ljongs 'di'i sa 'dzin gtsug / nyams med 'dzin pa'i grags snyan dung gi dbyangs/ /rgya mtsho'i gos khyab drag zhan rna ba'i bcud/ /len pa'i gral mthar spyod pa'i gyi na bas/ /legs smon g.yas 'khyil na kra'i grong khyer cher/legs 'khrungs bshad sgrub skye ba lnga ba'i dung / /legs byas dbugs kyis bus pas mi shes gnyid/ /legs par sad pa'i dus ston dar ba'i char/ /bsod nams bye bas bskrun pa'i sku mchog gi / mtshar sdug 'dzum dkar dmul ba'i ba ku la/ /mi mnyam yon tan mdzes ma'i mkhur chang gis/ / bran tshe mkhas rgu'i me tog mgo bo dud/ /bkra shis 'o ma'i mtsho chen g.yas 'khyil gling / /gling 'di'i dbus na mdzes pa'i phun tshogs gling / /gling 'dir lung chos man ngag snyan pa'i gling / /snyan 'jebs dbyangs kyis 'bud la gcig tu dgongs/ /dpal ldan grags pa rig pa'i seng ge sogs/ /lung rtogs 'od 'khyug skye rabs mut+ta ka'i/ /phreng ldan drug pa'i rigs kyi cod paṇa du/ /lha dang bla mas sbur 'di a ho rmad/ /gser gyi khri la dbang bsgyur gser chos zhes/ /mtshar du brtsi ba dbang gzhu'i mtshar sdug ris/ /ma yin blo bzang snyaspya /spyad ma lus rgyun/ /thugs kyi yol gor bskyil la thugs bsam bzhes/ /

slar yang zhabs zung zla ba gsar pa'i byin/ /byin rlabs ma smad ga bur thigs pa 'bum/ / 'bum phrag yid can kun da'i dpal 'grem bzhin/ /bzhin bzang 'khor dkyil lham‘ mer bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /zhu yig snyan pa'i tshig gi lus dkar zhing / /zhu don 'dab zung g.yo ba'i ngang ba mo zhu tshal gus shing 'dud pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas/ / zhu yul 'o ma'i mtsho chen ༄rī rī bsnyags ta 'phur/ /chu sprel gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dga' ston dang chabs gcig 'bangs tha bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos gus pa chen pos btegs/ /rme zla 1 tshes 1rkyal/209

mkhasadebengadem pa she/ragadod sbrul bakhriskur phul ba re don bung ba'i mgrisko glu zhes bya— ba/ — — bla basnreng 'jam dpal rnon po yi/ /bshud sgruXb shing rta'i srol chen po/ /r+gha mtsho'i gos can mthar spel pa'i/ /thugs stobs zla bral gang gi drung / /yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan dbang gi rgyal/ /gtsug tu 'dzin pa'i go skabs rnyed/ /rgya chen gzhung lugs 'o ma'i mtsho/ /ci dgar longs su spyod la dbang / /'on kyang blo dang brtson pa'i mthu/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin zhan gyur bas/ /'di snang khol bor gyur ba yi/ /'di phyi gnyis med gang des mchid/ /gnam sngon zhun mar dbyig 'dzin ltor/ /babs 'dra'i mtsho sngon khri gshog gi / ming las dras pa'i sum rtsen grong / /sa la 'phos mtshungs zhing chen du/ /du ma'i rig gzhung pad+mo'i tshal// /tshal du dar dir mgrin pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs su len pa'i blo gsal kun/ /kun tu bung ba'i khyu tshogs bzhin/ /de dang de la rang rang blo gros dang / /'tsham zhing 'tshamā pa'i mkhas mang legs bshad bcud/ /mngar zhing mngar ba'i tshim par gyur min pa/ /de srid de ru stsol khyod yi rangs gnas/ /mkhas khyod brtson pa'i mgyogs 'gro la brten nas/ /rnam mang mdo sngags gzhung lugs thang chen du/ /rnam dpyod bang rtsal ches cher ngom pa'i 'bras/ /thugs dam nyams bzhes lhod med 'phel lags sam/ /bcol don sor rtog ye shes nyid/ /rab dmar byu ru'i mdza' na mor/ /nyer shar lha mo'i man ngag gi / glegs bam phyag tu 210

son yod dam/ / klu dbang bang mdzod nas blangs pa'i/ / rgyal gsang rin zhes thordo ri cuchen bye ba 'bam/ / thang mar brdal la mi ngal ba'i/ / brtson ldan 'du phung ༄bde legs sam/ /mol bar5 bya tshob mang mod kyang / / bris na yi ge'i las su che/ /dngos mjal dang bstun don de dag / lhug par mol tshe snyan gsan zhu/ / gnas dang yul gyis bskal na yang / / rta bdun 'od dang pad tshal ltar/ /mdza' brtse'i mdud rgya lhod min pas/ /nang mdajas yi ge'i ris su shar/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du gdong phyogs te/ / /shar mar spel ba'i ngag 'phrin dri za'i glu/ / shar phyogs rig pa'i dpa' bo don rin zhabs/bye /zhabs wad gtsug bsten dran dbang gad dewa phul/ / — ca 211

rtsis rig smra ba'idabanga.ā+o bsam 'grub la phul bdonasnan ngagagi rme phobazhesaci ba/'jam dbyangs rnon po'i byin rlabs snange ba'i 'od/ /snying gi dpal du sim pas gzhung brgya'i bcud/ /myangabs 'uchad rtsom rtsod pa'i mthu mnga' ba'i/ /stobs ldan mgon khyod dus kun gtsug na rgyal/ /de sras mchog gsum bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /gtsug tu bsten pa'i 'dod dgu'i re ba kun/ /'bad med 'grub pa'i mtshungs bral bshes gnyen drung / /shā sa'i ming 'dzin blun pos 'di skad du/ /yongs 'dzin rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha ba'i/ /yongs rdzogs 'khrul bral bstan dang mjal dus 'dir/ /yongs rdzogs gzhung gi bcud bsdus lam rim la/ /yongs su chig sgril nyams len byed snying 'dod/ /de slad de yi gdams pa nor bu'i phreng / /gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i mgul ba'i rgyan/ /kun nas kun las khyad 'phags bgrang yas kyang / /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa mchog de'i gdams pa'i rgyun/ /snyan snyan zol sbyor tshig gis ma spras shing / /mkhas mkhas rtog ge'i ngag la mchel min par/ /zab zab mkhas pa'i zhal chab bdud rtsi'i ro/ /mngar mngar gdams pa'i rgyun bzang stsol bar mdzod/ /de ltar smra ba'i byed po gyi na ba/ /ba lang rnam thar 'dzin pa'i tha shal bdag / bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i spubs rgya yongs bkrol te/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ring min grol gyur cig /212

dpyodasdan tshulakhrims rgya mtsho la phul bdung sems mtshon pa'i gling bu zhes bya ba/ lto lag rdzogs pa'i dal 'byor rten/ /two rabs legs byas sa'i thig ler/ /legs smin hṝl gnas khri1sa ldan pa/ /rgyu mtsho'i mtha' can de yi gam/ /rgyal bstun me tog 'adz+rīn ma'i rgyan/ /rgyu chad phyogs su ma lhung char/ /mtsho ldan mtsho skyes la rol mas/ /mgrin par 'khyud rlom gang des mchid/ /lung rigs ri mo g.yas su 'khyil/ /gur gum phon po thang du brdal/ /bkra shis mtshan mas phyogs kun spa/ /grags pa don gnas mngon dga'i zhing / /de na nang bstan slob pa'i gling / /gzhung mang sbrang rtsi'i bcud rdzogs pa'i/ /bshes gnyen pad+ma dkar po 'gas/ /nyer 'tsho bung ba'i khyu zhig d+kumathong de dbus lung rigs 'dab zung gis/ /gsung rab mkha' la lding 'khor gyis/ / /thos don sbrang rtsi gsog mkhas pa/ /stag chung khyod gcig yi gar 'ong / /da dung brtson pa'i shugs bskyed de/ /de ring las kyang sang bzang bar/ /bar med 'bad pa chu bo'i rgyun/ /rgyun du bsten na de kas 'tsheng / /'jigs med stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sras/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug che'i/ / /zhabs zung lha mis mchod pa'i sdong / /yan lag mchog gi rgyan du zungs/ /smra dbang ngang ba'i ded dpon gyis/ /bzung ba'i gzhung lugs 'o ma'i mtshor/ /zhugs nas lung rigs mgrin pa'i rnga/ /rdungs zhes gsol 'di snying la zhog / thos don rgyud la sbyar ba ni/ /snga phyi'i mkhas rnams mgrin dbyangs gcig / de slad gang thos rgyud thog tu/ /'gel ba thugs kyi ze'u 213

'brur snoms/ /long bas mig ldan la bslabs pa/ /lugs gnyis gang la'ang 'gal bar mthong / /ci slad ce na 'khrid mkhan dang / /khrid bya go rim ldog phyir ro/ /de lta mod kyi pha mes dang / /yang mes gcig gi rgyud yin zhing / /lhag bsam dag pas bder gshegasacekyi/ /dbur brakab mchil lham ma bsal soms/ /de ltar ang gir gnam lo gsar bzhad tshe/ /tshul mthun khrims ldan grogs la bsrings pa'i 'phrin/ /rjod byed lo 'dab khur gyis lci min yang / /brjod don 'bras bus dud phyir dgyis 'os tsam wa14

dran dbangaspakhyuḥ la phul ba lhagrogasadagyes pa'i do shal zhes bya ba/rgya hor gnyis phye hor min pa'i/ /hor tshang tshang tshing stug po'i khrod/ /'jigs pa med par rgyu ba'i stag / rnam dpyod gra 'dzum ngom de'i drung / /bstan bya'i don 'dzin blo gros mthu/ /rgya ru ma khyab bu ga dog / mtsho nas skyes kyang mtshor rgas pa/ /ba rgan slas nyal gang des 'phrin/ /rgyal bstan lung rtogs nyi zla'i byin/ /bsod nams mkha' la rtsen pa'i 'od/ /lus can bde skyid pad+mo'i tshal/ /bzhad pa'i dpal shar deng gi char/ /sngon bsags mi dman rten bzang pad+ma dkar/ /rnam dag bslab gsum sbrang rtsi'i bcud ldan pa 'i/ /blo gsal ra yig gnyis pa'i gsos gyur ba/ /khyod nyid gzhes pas bdag yid dga' bas myos/ /dam pa'i bgrod byed yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal mtshan tog bzhin mgo bo'i do shal du/ /du ma'i thabs kyis bkur ba'i 'bras rtags su/ /su dang bsgrun min legs bshad smra bas mtho/ / /gser ldan thig le gser gyi rgyal khab tu/ /gong du 'phags pa gong ma na rim kun/ /kun tu bsti gnas kun bzang rgyal ba'i zhing / /zhingatshoder legs byas zhing gis mtho lags sam/ /chos srid 'byor ba sna tshogs dbyig gi shal/ /dpyangs pa'i rgyal mtshan gos bzang sham bu can/ /rang rigs dpal du bsgreng la nyams med stobs/ /shugs su rdzogs pas da dung ma btang ngam/ /lugs gnyis lam chen zhugs la med min rung / /long bas lag khrid zha bo'i rkang pa'i rten/ /gna' deng mkhas pa'i shul bzhag bris dpar gyi/ /215

glegs bam lhun stug brag rir 'gran bzod dam/ /dgongs don 'byed pa'i dran dbang gis stong na/ / brgya phrag phyag mdzod brtsegs pa'i gsung rab yang / /phyug po'i do chas 'phyor las ma dmigs phyir/ /'dzin ma sdakhas dgus ma btang dge legs sam/ /khyad par dge ldan lta grub gtsang ma'i srol/ /'dzin la 'jigs med spobs pa dge ba khyod/ /lhod med gus rtag 'dab ma'i shugs bsten nas/ /rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin lags sam/ /'tshams zhu/ — —slad kyang sku lus tsan dan gsar ba'i ljon/ /phyi nang bsrung ba'i rwa ba brtsan po'i bar/ /nyer bcug 'phrod bsten las lam mi g.yel ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil du snying sdug grorges bzhin chongs/ /ngag rig ma nyams sgro ldan stong phrag las/ /dbang phyogs bung par 'phangs pa'i 'dab ldan mda'/ /dri tshig don ldan dri bzang rmenam pa mos/ /reg tshe mchid lan lus phras rnam 'gyur ngom / 216

smra dbang 'jigs med theg mchogaya ulab lha rnga'isgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/mi 'jigs dri med blo bzang lbestan la mi 'jigs spobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /mtho ris thar ba'i them rkas 'dzugs la gus rtags brtson ba'i ba dan g.yo/ /g.yo med theg pa mchog gi bstan la g.yo med thugs stobs btsan po'i mthu/ /mthu chen rgyal ba'i myu gur 'gran bzod khyod la bdag yid ngang gis gus/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul mdzod la dbang bsgyur gsang ba'i thugs sras mchog gcig bu/ /tha snyad gtsug lag ri mor lta la rnam par dpyod pa'i mig gnyis rno/ /nang don bka' bod gzhung don smra la dbyig gnyen gcen po sa gsum brnyes/ 'jigs bral zla med theg mchog don la mar slob ka chen rnam bzhi bzhin/ /dbyangs ldan mdzes zhal 'dzum dang lhan cig rdzogs ldan gtam gyi rang sgra dgod/ /lugs gnyis gtam gyi mdzod kha phye tshe rmug ldan bang mdzod thung ngur btang / /tshig sbyor za 'og rnam bkra'i gzigs mor mes po'i bcu gnyis 'dren byed ngal/ /grogs khyod deng rabs dus kyi rgyan du 'tsho zhing gzhes 'dis bdag yid dwangs/ /'jigs med legs bshad 'brug sgra dgod pa'i phyag bsnams blo bzang rang srol 'di/ /'di na kha ba'i dus kyis g.yog pas stong ba'i dbyings su mnal chags pa/ /pa sangs ltar gsal rnam 'byed blo mnga' khyod kyis dpyid dpal slar bsus te/ /te bor rig pa 'i mkha' nor drod kyis blo gros pad tshal bkra bar mdzod/ /zhabs pad legs brtan kha pad sgros las legs bshad pad+mo'i phreng ba 'bum/ /blo ldan blo dang 217

'tsham par spel bas 'jug pa nam yang mi lhod par/ /dam pa'i lam srol dam par nyer zhugs 'gro kun lam der 'khrid pa la/ /la gor gor ma'i rdo yi ris bzhin mi 'jigs dam bca'i ri mo phris/ /long ba'i mig ldan lag khrid byed pa 'di/ /lugs gnyis gang la'ang rigs min de lta na'ang / /dkyil 'khor gtso bo gcig gi 'bangs yin phyir/ /'gal ba med snyam sha tshas gros 'di btab/ /rong po bde chen chos 'khor gling / /gling 'di'i tog gyur chos kyi sde/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang 'phyur ba'i sar/ /sar gnas chos kyi grogs der springs/ / 218

gnas brtan bathod pa donagrub la phul ba nangagi de rnyad mtshon ba'i zla 'od/ rgya gar chos kyi zhing sa ru/ /rgya chen gzhung la sbyangs pa'i 'bras/ /rgya bod gnyis su yongs smin pa/ /rgya bo dge sbyong gang de la/ /'di na nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu/ /'di zhes nges bzung med pa yi/ /'di snang bya ba'i khol bo ba/ /'di phyi gnyis med gang des mchid/ /khyad 'phags sa yi thig le rdo rje gdan/ /khyad 'phags pad dkar 'chang ba'i 'phrin las kyi/ /khyad 'phags gdugs dkar grib bsil snum po la/ /rnam kun spyod pa'i skal bzang thob pa khyod/ /thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi/ /nyi rgas grib so ltar gyur phyir/ /nyi ma 'phul thabs mi byed par/ /nyi ltar gsal ba'i thugs 'dun mdzod/ /de yang thos bsam sgom pa las/ /gud na 'dzin tshul gzhan med phyir/ /bslab gsum ya bral ma song ba'i/ /gzhung la sbyang brtson gnad du che/ /de las kyang ni dbu phar gnyis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs bshul te/ /mdo sde kun gyi rab dang phul/ /yin phyir mjal la nan tan mdzod/ /des ni thub pa 'jig rten mig /'jig rten 'dir byon dgos pa grub/ /lan gcig thob pa'i dal rten la/ /snying bo chos kyis blang ba yin/ /mtshungs bral dge ba'i bshes kyi zhabs/ /zin pa'i don po'ang 'khyongs pa yin/ /'khrul bral bstan la zhugs pa'i dus/ /dus tshod chud gzon mi byed par/ /dus dang bstun pa'i slob gnyer la/ /dus rnams kun tu 'bad par 'tshal/ /bzod par smra ba'i brtul 219

zhugs la gnas khyod/ /don kun grub pa'i legs gsung snying po'i don/ /don bzhin sems pas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /don gyi 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur mdzod/ /'di ni dmus long dag gis mig ldan la/ /lag khrid byed bzhin dpyod ldan khyed nyid la/ /smra ba rigs min 'on kyang ser ga dang / /khyi tshil dag gi dpe bzhin shar mar spel/ /de lta'i 'phrin yig ngang mo khyod/ /mtshan gyi rol mo phyogs kun tu/ /sgrogs pa'i chos kyi sde chen por/ /ma 'gyangs myur du song shig ang / / 220 —

bstan pa'igaṅgel byed ldong sprul ba'iskur phul ba dribral ngagagi rgyud mangs zhes bya ba/ skal bzang 'gro la phan bde'i lam bzang mchog / mchog tu ston la dge ba'i 'phrin las can/ /rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun ring spel ba'i khur/ /khur 'chang rgyal sras dpa' bo gang gi drung / /lung rigs thur ma brgya yis nyer btegs pa'i/ /'jam mgon lung rtogs bstan pa'i gser gyi gdugs/ /'dzin pa'i gral mthar dbang yang chos brgyad kyi/ /rgya mtshor byings des gsol ba'i snying bo ni/ /deng char mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i lugs/ /lugs mchog zla bral 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying dge ldan lugs bzang zla/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin 'phel ngos nas/ /bskal mang goms pa'i thugs bskyed nam mkha'i nor/ /skye 'gro'i bsod nams bzang po'i mkha' dbyings dang / /nyer 'grogs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las 'od/ /thub bstan pad tshal rgyan du ngom pa khyod/ /gzugs sku'i zla shel byams brtse'i bsil 'od 'bum/ /'bum du spro ba'i skal bzang ku mu ta/ /lhag lhag rgod pa'i lhun grub 'phrin las de/ /mog mog ra ri'i rkyen bral bzhugs lags sam/ / /mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings/ /brgal ba'i ded dpon mchog gyur bshes gnyen gyis/ /yang zab gdams pa'i bcud kyi a sri ta/ /thugs gsang bum pa'i bcud du bskyil lags sam/ /mkhyen dpyod thugs kyi sprin sngon ba gam las/ /skal ldan 'gro 221

la blo bzang legs bshad kyi/ /gru char 'jo bas mtshan snyan gzhan gsos 'phrin/ /las can thos 'dzin bdud rtsir 'grem lags sam/ /ngag la dbang bsgyur blo gros mchog gi gter/ /mugrin 'ukhyud blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal byed mtshan/ /'dzin largya chen mtsho 'jings ltar zab thugs/ / mnga' ba gang de'i thugs bzhed bsgrurbes lagaso sam/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i khams/ /lhun grub gcig tu rdzogs pa bde ldan mgon/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen tshul/ /bzung ba gang de'i'ang bzhed don bsgrub— par 'tshal/ / khyad par blo bzang logs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'jigs med rnam dpyod mchorge gis thub bstan gyi/ /dpal du spel mkhas chos kyi nyi ma che'i/ /thugs bzhed bsgrub pa'i las 'di khyod la 'os/ /de sled mes rgyal rig gzhung dbyig 'dzin ltor/ /'khrungs pa'i lnga rig g.yo ldem pad+ma dkar/ /dkar gsal 'dzum bag khong nas rgod pa'i gnyen/ /gnyen gcig 'od stong ldan pa khyod las su/ /sngon byon rgya bod mkhas pas shul bzhag nor/ /sngon med rig gnas tsirnyi ma ṇi'i phreng / /sngon bzhin skal bzang gdul bya'i mgrin rgyan du/ /sngon bshaṃn kun tu stsol ba'i 'phrin las can/ /gang zhabs lhar bcas gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor/ /nor ba'i rgyan phreng ngom pa'i dmar snum 'od/ /'od brgya'itshodra ba 'byed bzhin g.yung drung khrir/ /gzhom bral bskal brgyar brtane par cis kyang beskul/ /de lta'i zhu yig g.yas 'khyil chos kyi dung / /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas dkar 'od 'phro/ /snyan tshig mdangs lnga'i code paṇa g.yo ba 'di/ /khyod snyan mdzes pa'i mchod par kho bos spel/ /de mthus bdagalhakyang skye kun rgyal ba'i bstan/ /tshang la ma nor 'dzin pa'i spobs pa mchog /thob ste dang sngags kyi chos tshul kun/'gro khams rgya mtshor spel ba'i thugs smono zhu/ /phyogs med sprang 'khyams bdag 'drar 'di lta bu/ /'bri ba'i 'os ma mchis kyang gang nyid kyi/ /rmad byung 222

mdzad pa mchog gis yid drangs te/ / rang gi yid la shar tshul shar mar spel/ / ces zhabs pad yun ring du brtan par dmigs te 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku brnyan dang / gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba'i rang lugs nyams med 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel du zhal ras gser gyi mdangs ldan/ kha che'i gur gum bcas/7 'jam mgon rgyal ba garnyas pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad par nye ba'i dus 1༷tshes rdodage bar rang spyil 'jam dpal rnon po'i gur khyim nas gus pas phul/ / pha 223

— snangagrol 'jam rdor la phulab mkha'alding rgyal po'igezhog rlabs ces bya ba/ snang stong zung 'jug 'dus ma byas kyi darmyengs/ /dbyings rig gnyis med mtha' grol lta ba'i gdengs/ /gdeng tshad mtha' ru 'khyol bas dus gsum kun/ / kun tu sgrib med gzigs pa mchog gi drung / / zhu gsol/'jam pa'i rdo rje'i byin rlabs snang ba'i ga zi/ /gang blos grogs su bkug pa'i rab 'byams gzhung / /gzhung bzang kun la nang byan chud pa 'di/ /'di ltar bsam gyin dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar g.yo/ /g.yo ldan 'khor ba'i ngang tshul la bsam zhing / /zhing 'dir theg mchog bstan pa nub pa'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin dgongs te thos bsam 'o ma'i bcud/ /bcud ldan nyams len mar du bsrub par mdzod/ /mdzod chen bdun du grags pa'i legs bshad don/ /don bzhin bsams na mtha' bral lta ba'i gshis/ /gshis lugs rjen par rtogs te yid can kun/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i sa la 'god dam snyam/ /bdag kyang skye kun 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan/ /bstan pa'i yang snying mdo sngags zung 'brel don/ /don bzhin thos bsam sgom pa'i rtsal rdzogs te/ /mgon de'i drung du skye ba'i smon 'dun 'tshal/ /224

skas tshig legs tshogs bsdu ba'i khab lenazhas bya ba/dge legs nor bu'i mdzod kyis yongs gtams shing / /dge la rab 'dun ljobum phrag dbu phreng rtse/ /dge ldan lung rtogs bstan pa'i rba rlabs stong / /dge bar 'phyo khyod gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /rmad byung sa gsum khyon na 'gran bral ba/ /'jam mgon zhal skyin legs bshad dza hu'i rgyun/ /gang thugs gser gyi bum par yongs gtams te/ /ris bral 'gro bar stsol mkhas gang de rgyal/ /'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang rtser/ /zhabs zung bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gi ris/ /nyer bkod gtan dge zab rgyas chos kyi dbyangs/ /'dun ldan rgya mtsho'i grwa ru sgrog ngos nas/ /tshogs gnyis dbyig ldan dga' ma'i lto ba las/ /las ldan dpal du bskrun pa'i pad+ma dkar/ /dkar mdzes mtshan dpe'i 'dzum bag cher ngom bzhin/ /bzhin bzang yongs kyi dpal du 'tsho gzhes smon/ / —225

gnyanathog sprumu ba'iskurasaldobadre za'i piwang zhes bya ba/blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i lung rtogs bstan/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pas spel la srid pa 'dir/ /'gran bral skye dgu'i phan bde spel ba'i gsos/ /dad ldan gdulasgyubya rgya mtsho'i mgon de'i drung / /yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan dbang gi rgyal po de/ /dad gsum gtsug gi rgyan du nyer 'chang yang / /rgya chen gzhung bzang lta ba'i gzugs 'dzin khyim/ /ldong ba'i dmus long gang des 'di skad du/ /bsod nams legs gyas lha lam yangs po ru/ /lung rtogs rgyal bstan nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od/ /bde skyid pad+ma 'dzum pa'i dpung gnyen du/ /ngo mtshar sprin dris dag pa deng gi char/ /sngon byon dam pa'i mdzad bzab 'od dkar can/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po'i drang thig gi /rjes su nyer 'brang 'chal spyod ra ri'i dris/ /dben pa'i rnam thar skyong la mchog tu dad/ /bdag kyang mi ring skyes mchog pad+mo'i 'dzum/ /mig gi dpyid du smin ched bung ba ltar/ /dga' dad 'dab zung spyod bzhin de phyogs su/ /'phur lding gar gyis slebs la ci cha yod/ /de bar dpon slob mtha' dag bde 'tsho'i ngos/ /chos spyod nyams bzhes lhod med gāng ga'i rgyun/ /chad med brtson pa'i bstan 'gro'i bde skyid khur/ /'dzin pa'i rlabs chen dam bca' nyams med zhu/ /de lta'i zhu mchid pi waṃ rgyud/ /dad gus mnyen lcug sor mo yis/ /bskul tshe don ldan snyan 'gyur 'bum/ /sgrog 'di rten 'byung dngos po'i gshis/ /226

kun byed 'khrib dwangs res mos kyi zhu 'phrin kau ki'i rgyang glu/rigs gsum rigs brgya'i spyi mes chen po ru bzhengs te/ /gangs ljongs gangs ri'i kun khebs lhag med du gzhom la/ /blo chen blo gter bzang po'i grags pa mthar rkyong ba'i/ /tsong kha tsong la'i u dam wa ra de mchod do/ /sngon bsags sngon gyi las smon bzang po yi mthu las/ /lam ston lam khrid dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /bshes gnyen bshes kyi dwangs mar blo gcig gis bltas pas/ /legs lam legs tshogs rtsa ba tshugs pa 'di dga' ba/ /phul gyur phul byung bco brgyad rten bzang gi pad+ma/ /don chen don bzhin lag rtser 'gugs pa yi nor bu/ /phun tshogs phun tshar dpyangs pa stong zad du btang nas/ /mnog chung mnog bral las la gzad pa 'di sdug pa/ /rgan gzhon rgan byis snga gzhug nges med du phyi mar/ /bang chen bang gis mi zin su mgyogs kyis rgyug pa/ /mig mthong mig la thogs kyang de tshul ris bor bas/ /rtag 'dzin phyi bshol gdon gyis gtses pa 'di kyi hud/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bzod blags dang bral zhing / /lha yul lha mi'i dpal la yid brtan rang med pa/ /dam pas dam por gsungs kyang rna rgyab tu 'phen pa'i/ /rang don rang gis mi shes glen rgan rnams sdug pa/ /las 'bras las kas bcos med nges pa ru smin zhing / /'phel ba 'phel kha'i grangs ka rnam mkhyen gyis mi zin/ /ma byas ma lus yid can phyogs log kyang mi smin/ /byas pa byas chud mi za'i 'gag mdo 'di dka' ba/ /'di na 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs/ /gang sa gang du btsal 227

kyang mi rnyed pa'i tshal la/ /tshad ma tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes mtsho rdol sir+shan/ /rgyal bstan rgyal ba'i lam zhugs don po rang 'khyongs snyam/ /blo bzang blo chen grags pa stong 'bar ba'i gang bstan/ /ma god ma bri skal bzang blo'i —yol gosnang bskyil mkhas/ /'jam dbyangs 'jame rba'i 'a dzam gyisadagyes rig —bzhad pa'i legs bshad/ /mos brtson mos pa'i 'ju sa 'chang sa gcig byed khul/ / mtshan gyi ram̐l mo sgrogs pas sa gsam gyi rmongs gnyid/ / sad byed — rangamatshar sdug pad dkar 'chang ba'i lha'i zhabs skyese/ /dri med dung zla bde 'byung lan bu'i rtser chags pas/— /'gro ba'i sa mkhan chen por 'gyur snyam blo'i gus btegs/ /glirīng chen lnga yi ya gyal ya gling gi char skyes/ / rgya chen gzhung mang mthong yang sa rgya ni ma chod/ /bstan pa'i them skas 'dzegs kyang gang bstarne kun bskyud pa'i/ /'dzin mar ldem pa'i mtsho skyes rtag 'dzin mkhan des bris/ / — / — ca bhe / 22 8 — — — — — ji —
