mo smradabang bstan 'dzinayeshes la phul sasgro ma'i gludabyangs ces bya ba/ nyi ma'i gnyen dang dmu rgyal thod dkar sras/ /'jig rten sgron me zung gi mdo sngags bstan/ /'dzin la ye shes lus can ngag gi lha/ /lha mchog ngur smrig zol 'chang gang gi drung / /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ /bstan pa'i snying po dge ldan lugs bzang gdugs/ /gdugs dkar 'dzin la dbang 'byor bshes gnyen dang / /mjal yang chos brgyad rgya mtshor lhung des mchid/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyis legs skrun pa'i/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i khyad nor gang sku'i zla/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe sprin gyi sgrib g.yogs dang / /bral 'dis bstan 'gro'i ku mud mgon dang bcas/ /gshen bstan tā ma la yi klong yangs su/ /chos 'dul glog gi na chung rtse dga' dang / /rab 'grogs rig gnas gru char 'bum 'jo bas/ /gdul bya'i shes rgyud zhing sa brlan ngos nas/ /kun rtog 'khrul ba'i bag chags 'thug po'i nags/ /nags tshal stong nyid ye shes me lce yis/ /bsregs te 'phags lam zab mo'i dbyings klong du/ /su phyin gang de e ma ngo mtshar phul/ /phul byang 'jug shārjeste ༷༷ rigi tsha rilung rigs bye ba'i zhwa dkar bstan/ /bstan pa' ’ na d+nghad lha lam yangs pa' rgyan/ /rgyan gcig srid pa ma stong de srid du/ /du mas thabs kyis 'dzin khyod e ma bsngags/ /bsngags pa don ldan ye shes gzhon nu'i lus/ /lus can dpal du gzhom med g.yung drung khrir/ /rab dmar 'od chags zhabs sen byu ru'i phreng / phreng ba lhar bcas gtsug gi rgyan du stsol/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 229

'dir dus gsam kun/ /kun nas yongs gzigs chos tshal chos kyi lugs/ /༄ ༄lugs bzang mchog gyur spel zhing spel ba'i khur/ / khur 'chang mkhas khyod zhabs pad zhabs brtan shog / de lta'i zhu yig sngo bsangs sgeg mo'i bzhin/ / bzhin legs snyan tshig lhu gyis sgrib min par/ / don gyi rang —snye— bzhin ngom pa'i don ldan tshigaco / tshig c-im min par snying nas gus pas shaṃl/ / — ci —sne — rītsho — — — 230 — — — rtso —

pad+ma rig 'dzin la phul ba bung ba'i gshag rlude zhes bya ba/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rang lugs dus kyi mthar/ /spelal gcig tu dpa' ba rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras mchog rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gang gi drung / /rmongs rtul bhu su ku dego'adi skad du/ /nges gsang rdo rje snying po'i grub pa'i mtha'/ /mtha' brgyad spros pas dben pa yang tig don/ /don bzhin ston la kun mkhyen chos kyi rje/ / dri med 'od zer srid gsum bla na mtho/ /gang de'i bstan pa'i nyin byed 'od po che/ /yid dpyod mtshan 'dzin stug po'i sprin rum nas/ /bton te gangs ljongs dpal du 'grem mkhas mchog / mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer theg mchog bstan pa'i gsos/ /yab sras zung gi zhal lung gang gā ma/ /zab don wu phreng g.yo ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ /man ngag stong gi rin chen phye ma dang / /'grog bzhin gang thugs ma dros mtsho ru bskyil/ /zab las ches zab rdo rje rtse mo'i lam/ /lam mchog gzhan las yang zab rdzogs pa che'i/ /zab don lhug par ston pa mdzod chen bdun/ /thugs gsang bum pa'i bcud du bsten par mdzod/ /gzhan yang kun mkhyen yab sras chu gter las/ /legs par 'ong ba'i man ngag rin chen gling / /myur bar bgrod de ngal gso ya bzhi sogs/ /gdams pa'i yiḍi kyi gru rdzing gang bar mdzod / /231

ka bsgrigasata rtseng bsresapa'i po tsi/ka laba'amaci bsags grong khyer du/ /ka ba med pa'i khang bzang nyams dga'i nang / /ka ri ka nas rgyud rgyalo 'dus pa'i bar/ /ka da 'i ro bcud nyams su myang na 'dod/ /kha ba'i ljongs kyi 'drenahopa zla med zhabs/ /kha gting yongs bral lung rtogs nor buligater/ / kha la 'ja' shar sgur zhum tsam min par/ /kha zhe gnyis med rnamangakun bsten na 'dod/ /ga na 'dug kyang bde 'bol mal khri'i steng / /ga ler sos del ja rgod gter bzhin du/ /ga bur dri bsung mnam pa'i rje'i legs bshad/ /ga tsam ci nus bam klog byed snying 'dod/ /nga khyod ris bral kun la sems snyoms pos/ /nga tsho'i ma 'ongs rgyud 'dzin gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /nga las khyod lhag rig gnas ba gam mkhar/ /nga rjes khyod 'brang mu mthud song na 'dod/ /ca las phyed bcings zi nag skra lomayag /ca yig grwa zur med pa'i gdong gi sgor/ /ca re ri mo gsum pa'i smyug h+phing skad/ /ca co'i snying gtam drug 'gyur nyan na 'dod/ //cha ma cho rigs za zi lang long dang / /cha cha rug rug mig 'brid ci mthong yang / /cha shas rgyu rkyen tshogs par phar btags las/ /cha tsayorang ngos dmigs med ngang skyong 'dod/ /ja 'dab rgyas pa'i dpal spungs bco brgyad rten/ /ja mdong rag shan gcig gi rtsis med par/ /ja yun tsam la'ang snying po mi len pa'i/ /ja lan chu 'jal khyu nas 'bud na 'dod/ /nywa thag chad par 232

yangs pa'i thang brgyugs kyang / / nya gangalazla ba lag tu mi lon pa'i/ /nya sha rul sungs ji bzhin 'di snang gi / nya nyung bsres pa'i spyod ngan bskyur na 'dod/ / /ta re dmar mo'irtsimathus byin rten bzang 'di/ /ta rin lo ka'i chos kyis mi gzon par/ /tā ming yul sogs chags sdang bsring ba'i sar/ /ta la'i lo ma'i gos gyon sgrub snying 'dod/ /tha ma kha sogs mi mkho'i rdzas dor te/ /tha shal rgyug zas rgyug chus srog gsos nas/ /tha chad ma rabs grogs la rgyang bkyed pas/ /tha gru yangs pa'i bas mthar sgom na 'dod/ /da res tshang la ma nor bstan dang mjal/ /da lta des kyang mi tshad mthun rkyen 'grig /da 'di 'dra ba da phyin mi 'dzoms pa'i/ /da nangs do nub gtugs nas 'bad na 'dod/ /na rga 'chi ba nam yong cha mi 'dug / na chung yin kyang mi 'chi'i tshod sus thig / na ning yod mi da lo med mthong des/ /na kha ba yi rnam thar skyong na 'dod/ /pa phas ma bslab ma mas ma bcol bar/ /pa tshab ji bzhin shes par bya ba'i gnas/ /pa ṭu mkhas pa'i thugs dam rma med pa/ /pa sangs mdangs smad ljongs su dar na 'dod/ /pha mtha' mi rig gzhung lugs thang chen mtha'/ /pha rol shags 'byed tsam min gcod pa'i bang pha mtha' yas pa bsnan nas mi rigs 'di/ /pha myes rgan po'i bsam thog bskyod na 'dod/ /ba ma'i dri mag 'dra ba'i rmongs blo yang / /ba 'o lta bur bcos pa'i thabs shes na/ /ba lang ji bzhin blun pa bdag 'dra yang / /ba ri 'jig rten mig grogs ci'i mi 'gyur/ /ma dag sems kyi gang shar rtog pa'i ris/ /ma lus rang snang ye gnas dkyil 'khor du/ /ma btsal lhun rdzogs gdod ma'i btsan sa'i sbubs/ /ma chad 'gro kun slebs na dga' ba la/ /tsa ra na ra ma yin bslab sbyang la/ /tsa na'i 'bru ltar zhib pa'i blo gros kyis/ /tsa mi ji bzhin sbyangs na mkhas pa'i sar/ /tsa ma ra bzhin 'gying la dka' las ci /tsho / tshwa yi ro ldan rgya mtsho chen po'i chu/ /tsha bas gdung tshe 'thung na lhag par skom/ /tsha 233

grang khyad bsad sbyang brtson yon tan 'bras/ /tsha grang nad brgya sel ba'i 'chi sos sman/ /dza lang sems kyi khengs dregs smad pa la/ /dza ya'i gsung rab shig thog sta re'i spun/ /dza dza tsam gyis dgra bo khug min pa'i/ /dza la shes rab me lces bsreg la 'bod/ /wa ra na sir mnyamromed thub dbang gis/ /wa skyes mu stegs klad 'gem 'phrog byed sgras/ /wa kha'i chu bzhin bden bzhi'i chos bstan tshe/ /wa ler bden pa mthong ba'i gtam de snyan/ /zha smyug 'khyug pas bris min rnam dasnyod ris/ /zha nye sne rtul ma yin lung rigs mtshon/ /zhwa ser mdzes rgyan blo bzang rgyal ba'i gzhung / /zha lu bu ston blos kyang dpag dka'i yul/ /tshozwa tshod kyis 'tsho gangs ljongs grub pa'i rje'i/ /zwa 'byed snyan brgyud lde mig lag thogs nas/ /za nyal spangs te bsgoms pa'i 'bras rtags su/ /zatshongoms bgegs kyi cho 'phrul yar 'di mtshar/ /'a 'ur mi tshe gzad pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /'a ma smug long nang du mgo 'khor ba/ /'a tse da dung 'di bzhin 'khor ba la/ /'a ya ci mi snyam pa lug spyon mgo /dzeya nge yang nge'i ngang nas chos ma 'grub/ /ya rabs dam pa'i lugs dang rgyab 'gal 'ga'/ /ya ma pho nya'i sngun nas 'dar na yang / /ya ra ma ra 'bro sa gang nas rnyed/ /rwa lo'i thugs bcud man ngag rnam pa gsum/ /rwa 'bro gcig 'dres gnyis med dus 'khor sogs/ /rwa gdengs gshin rje'i bsu ma ma sleb gong / /ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs su lag len 'dod/ /la lungakun na zab lo ches mang mod/ /la li ta nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i bar/ /la kyog lung kyog med par shad brgyud 'dir/ /la mor 'bad pas chig dril dzebyed na 'dod/ /sha zan gdong dmar yul du skyes pa'i don/ /shwa dang yu mo rtse sa nags ma'i ljongs/ /sha tsha snying nye'i sems kyis pha ma la/ /sha thang chad pas drin lan gzo na 'dod/ ri/sa rgyug rdo rgyug byas kyang mi lon pa'i/ /sa skya'i lcags rir mi 'da'i ya kyal gcig / sa gsum dbang mo'i thugs ba—cud gdams pa'i 234

ro/ /sa la so btab gcig tu myang na 'dod/ /ha cang snyigs lnga'i rang rtags ngom dus 'dir/ /ha sa badz+ra yab sras legs bshad la/ /ha lam tsam gyi go ba chags pa'ang / /ha ri tsan dan zong gis nyo bya min/ /a bh+ya'i mtshan can zhabs sen mu tig 'bru/ /a mdor skyes pa'i 'khos dman mgor nyal phang / /a long 'phrul ldan zhags pas bcings 'di ko / a ho nor bzang lag thob yid 'phrog ma/ /phan tshogs stong gi zong gis nyos pa'i rten/ /rten ༄ bzang gdengs can gtsug rgyan bsam 'phel nor/ /nor 'di 'chi bdag rkun pos ma khyer gong / /gong ma dam pa'i rjes shul snyogs na 'dod/ /'dod 'dod— mang ste 'dod pa thog 'khel dka'/ /bsam bsam mang ste bsam pa lam 'gro dka'/ /brgyugs brgyugs mang ste brgyugs pa don ldan dka'/ /dka' dka' dka' ba'i mjug mthar mi dka' dka'/ /skabs re bsam zhing sngon bsags legs snyam dga'/ /thengs re gzhig gin zhabs tog ma nus sdug / dga' sdug 'thibs dwangs bar bris sug pa'i ris/ /spyan ras bung ba 'khor pa'i rten du'o/ / — — 235

— — brtanagasol tshedapal bum bzang / oṃ su sti/ri rab 'byems rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i zla/ /zla bral bsil ldan mkhas rgu'i gtsug nor du/ /du ma'i gar bsgyud 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ /grags snyan srid pa'i rtser blargal gang des skyongs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /zhal bcud rgyan drug gzhung gi bcud bsdus gang ri/ /brtse chen thugs rjes stsol la zla myed mgon/ / bshes gnyen nyi ma skye rgu'i gtsug na rgyal/ /bslab gsum dag pa'i dkyil 'khorā yongs su rdzogs/ /mkhas btsun ga bur gzegs ma 'bum du 'dzag / zab myas chos tshul ri dwags gzugs rdobarnyan bkra/ / / mkhas dbang smra ba'i zla bar gsol ba 'debs/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed bzang po'i rtsa ba brtan/ /snin sogs rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab g.yo/ / zab gsang rnal 'byor 'bras bu'i khur dud pya/ /gdul bya rgyu mtsho'i mgon du zhabs brtan shog /'jam mgon snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dus ston gyis/ / skal ldan 'gro la mchog thun dngos grub gter/ /lag rtser 'gugs pa'i lam bzang sbyin mkhas pa/ /yab rje'i bstan pa'i dpal du zhabs brtan shog / gzhung don 'chad la thogs med sku mched bzhin/ /rgol ngan gzhom la phyogs glang grags pa'i mched/ /rmad byung legs bshad rtsom la dpa' bo'i grogs/ /thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron mer ྾/ srad dben gdams pa'i dga' ston mchog sbyin pa/ /deng dus 'di na mkhas khyod tsam du bas/ /de slad zhabs zung mi shigs skyi~X 3sbya krung / /bskal ba rgya mtshor g.yo med rtag brtan gsol/ /tshe mtha'

yas dang tshe sbyin 'phags ma'i mthu/ / rnam par rgyal ma bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon/ / lhag pa'i lha dang drang srong bden mthu yis/ / zhabs pad bstan 'gro'i gsos su lhun chags shog /ha sa badz+ra yab sras mdo sngags gzhung / /gzhung bzang bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal bo gang / /gang du skye ba'i phreng bar mgon khyod las/ /las ldan ral ba'i rgyan du ngoms med shog / lhag bsam dag pas — grogs byed shog tsho/ 237

— zhabs brtan smon tshig mya ngan med pa'i yal 'dab ces bya ba/ oṃ su sti/ dpal stug rgyal ba'i sor rtog ye shes mdangs/ /mdangs ldan dmar 'od chags pa'i snang stong sku/ /sku mchog dran pas tshe dang ye shes dpal/ /dpal ster tshe mtha' yas pas dge legs stsol/ /blo bzang 'jigs mdzad dpa' bo dus kyi mthar/ /tshad med thugs rjes rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/'dzin la rgya chen mtsho 'jings ltar zab thugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la phobs/ /'jam dpal snying po'i 'jigs bral ye shes thugs/ /zla med rigs brgya'i mgon du legs shar te/ /blo gros mchog sbyin 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /dbyer med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang dbyangs ldan rig pa'i rgyal mo yis/ /rjes chags thugs rje 'od rnon thur ma yis/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i dgongs zab pad mo'i kha/ /rnam 'byed 'dod 'jo'i mgon khyod zhabs brtan shog / blo gter dbang po'i mkhyen pa'i chu klung 'bum/ /'bum phrag gcig 'dres 'jam mgon legs bshad kun/ /kun tu spel mkhas mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /gang dang mi gnyis mgon khyod zhabs brtan shog /'phags bod gzhung brgya'i dka' gnad kun da'i sbubs/ /mkhyen rab zla zer cha shas reg pas mod/ /rang tshul 'dab ma'i mtshar sdug yongs bkrol te/ /zab gnad ge sar ngom khyod྾/ /rnam dag dran shes bag yod mu khyud dbus/ /g.yo med bslab gsum rin chen lhun po 238

brjid/ /lung rtogs yon tan nyi zla'i rna chas sgeg / bka' gdams rnam thar 'dzin khyod ྾/ /phul byung legs bshad smra la spobs gzengs mtho /rtsod pas rgol ngan gzhom la gnam lcags thog / sdeb legs rtsom pas bsil ljongs mkhas rgu'i yid/ /dbang med 'gugs pa'i mkhas khyod྾/ /thun mong byang chub lam rim nyin byed kyis/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam bzang pad dkar 'dzum/ /phye ste bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs/ / mang thos gdams par shar khyod ྾/ /theg mchog rgyal sras spyod pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /shugs drag snying rje'i sprin dkar gzhon nu rtsen/ /rin chen sems kyi dri bzhon dang 'grogs pas/ / phan bde'i gru char 'bebs khyod྾/ /thun min gsang chen chu gter chen po'i klung / /zhugs nas yang zab man ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ /ci dgar longs su spyod pa'i brtan g.yo kun/ /bde stong phyag rgyas bcings khyod྾/ /rdzogs rim mchog gi thabs mkhas zab mo yis/ /las rlung bag chags bcas kyi rgyu ba kun/ /'od gsal dbyings su dengs pa'i zung 'jug skur/ /yongs bzhengs dang po'i mgon khyod྾/mtha' yas skye 'gro'i bsod nams dbang phyug gi / ral klong las 'ong lesas mdzad 'od dkar gyis/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs chu gter che/ /rgyas phyir khyod zhabs g.yung drung ltar brtan shog / mgon po khyod kyi yon tan pha mtha' yas/ /ji bzhin brjod par rgyas par spobs ma yin/ /'on kyang rang gi bsod nams bsags pa'i slad/ /tshur mthong byis pa'i spyod yul zur tsam gleng / /'di yi dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /dpal mgon bla mas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung mthus/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ /bla med sku bzhi'i sa la reg gyur cig / der ma son pa'i skye phreng kun tu yang / /rgyal bstan spyi dang 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i lugs/ /bstan pa'i yang snying mchog dang nyer mjal te/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas 'da' 239

bar shog/ rnam 'dren tshe dpag med dang rnam rgyal ma/ mo/spyan bdun lha mo 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ /'chi med dpal ster lhag pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /brtan g.yo'i tshe dpal ma lus g.yang du skyil/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' rtags rdo rje'i rgya/ /'bral med gtsug gi rgyan du nyer 'chang ba/ /phyag drug gur zhal la sogs srung mas kyang / /las 'dir rnam kun srung skyob g.yel med mdzod/ /lhag bsam ྾/ /tshangs dang ྾/ /spyan ldan chos srung la sogs྾/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog / ces nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po 7 tshe tan zhabs drung ngag dbang dbyangs ldan rig pa'i 'dod 'jo zhes yongs su grags pa gang gi rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan smon tshig sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dris pa'i chos bco brgyad kyi grangs ldan ngag rtsom byin gyis rlob pa'i ched mjug tu rje bla ma'i gsung / tshig phrad cung zad bsgyur ba bcas/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por cho 'phrul bstan pa'i nyin bcu ba/ 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen po lhums su zhugs pa'i mdzad pa nye bar ston pa'i dus tshes dge bar dbu btsugs/ de'i brdo lngar mjug grub par bgyis kyang g.yeng rkyen du mas rim 'gyangs su lus pa lo de'i lha babs dus chen la slar yang shog ngos su phab pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gral mthar spyod pa'i gyi na ba dge sbyong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bris pa 'disatshotshe rabs kun tu theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes ga nyen gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 240 —

smon chig dge legs char 'bebs/two byār+bhaṭā bzang po'igrugs pa'i ba dan can/ /rījasta dābyangs dbyangs can snyems pya 'phrog pa'i dpāl/ /dpal ldan dpal stug gāzhad rī'idrorje gang / /zhing 'di'i mkhas grub phywa mardo'i gtsug na brjid/ /mtshun gyi 'brug gi dbyangs snyan snyan pa'i sgra/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo'i stong ldan rgyud mangs kyi /glu ru bkug ste sgrogus pa'i chos kyi sde/ /sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan phyogs mthar rgyas/ /sna tshogs chos srid bya ba'i chu bo 'bum/ /'bum phrag gcig 'dus dga' ba brgya ldan mtsho/ /mtsho chen dwakra shiXs g.yas 'khyil sdos grwa 'di/ /'di ru yar zla'i dpal ltar gong 'armāl shog/ l+līng 'dir mngon par mtho ba'i gtsug lag khang / /khang bzang rnam rgyal pho brang la 'gran gang / /gang du srid pa ma stong de srid du/ /du ma'i dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang bar smon/ /zhes 'du khang chen mo gsar grub kyi dga' ston tshe gyi na ba 7kawashā sa na'i ming gis gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ 241

zhugasol mya ngan chedaba'i 'dzum mdangs zhes bya ba/bkra shis lung dang rtogs pa 'i chu bo 'bum/ /'a bum phrag galtas su 'khyil ba'i chos kyi sde/ /sde bzhi'i lang tso ma rnying wu ba'i 'dzum/ /'dzum dkar phyogs su dgod pa gang de rba/ /dal 'bab rmā klung ṇ+ḍa phran stong gi ma/ /ma lus lus can nyer 'tshor dbang phyogs su/ /su dang ma 'grogs 'khyug pa'i sgeg 'gros kyis/ / skyod pa'i khug so'i rig gnas nor bu'i dz+wang / /—de na dbyangs can mgrin mtsho— las bton pa/ /sgo ṭa'i sgyu rtsal mtshon byed snyan 'jebs dbyangs/ /rduXng dang tsholden pa'i bcud bsdus sgra'i srad pu/ /tsho dang rdo ru che dh+wang nges min spungs/ /de naXs 'daXms baglugs ྅sa pa'i sgra thag 'di/ /dri med lha dar dkar po'i lcibs dang bcasga/ /rdu ring gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor phun tshogs nyin/ /dri med sems kyis phywal 'di brtse bas bzhes/ /rab rgyan lcags rta lo'i cozla 5la tshes 4dge bar/ 242

rlabasasgra'i46na tu bres ba'i smon chiga'aphags bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad chu gter gting mtha' mi mngon zab yangs khar/ /gus rtag brtson pa'i gru gzings bcos te yud kyis bgrod pa'i dpa' snying stobs/ /stobs su rdzogs pa'i rang rigs na gzhon rig gnas rin chen spungs pa'i sar/ /mi ring byin thabs rtsom rig las gzhan srid zhi'i khyon 'dir su yis rnyed/ /rmā med lhag bsam ṇ+ḍa dwangs nor bu'i shal/ /rdzung 'di'i dz+wad rigs l+līb gā 'asbying chung gi/ /mdun lam lus phra'i mtshar sdug ngom pa'i slad/ /slad mar bag 'khum rnyog pa bgrung ched spud/ /zla ba'i zer dang 'grogs pa'i kun da bzhin/ /lnga rig 'dab ma'i khong 'dzum bags kyis phye/ /slob pa'i grwa 'dir rig gzhung 'o ma'i mtsho/ /phyi mtha'i bar du mer ba'i smon 'dun zhu/ /lcags rta lo'i zla 1rkyatshes 5la rma chu'i rlabs sgra'i thog tu bris/ / 243

zla zeragasar skrunaskubs bris pa'i shis tshig nywak+ṣi/sa tshogs rdzugu/ zla zer zhesabya ming dang don mtshungs mtshungasamed snyan ngag bye ba'i zla/ /blo dbang snye mas pa cig cha ra 'phrog byed byedahopo'i blo rtsal spungs pa'i zla/ /zla bral ngag gi dpal mo'i rjes zhugs zhugs chen tsha zer 'bar ba'i zla/ /zla ba 'bum phrag 'char wa'itshordzings bu bu mo dga' ba'i do shal zla/ /dzimadzes ma sa mdzes sdug lang tshos mngon sgeg pa'i/ /snyan snyan snyan ngag glu ru len pa la/ /mkhas mkhas mkhaso dbang darnyi sa 'di ru/ /myur myur myur du 'ong snyem 'a phyang mo nyug /mkhas mang mang po'i blo gros phyogs gcig tu/ / du mar mar me'i phreng bzhin tshar bsgrigs pa'i/ /mes rgyel rgyal khams yangs pa'i rigre/ gzhung dpal/5 /dpal stug stugajipo'i nags tshal bzhin du rgyas/ /gnam sngon bzhus pa'i khu ba 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /'khyil ba'i minge las dras pa mtsho sngon du/ /grags pa'i mu khyud g.yo ba'i mkhas mang gi / phyag rjes srid pa 'di yi bla na 'bar/ /kan su'i lho phyogs kan lho zhes grags par/ /mtha' yas rig gzhung mtha' mi mngon pa'i gtam/ /gtam snyan don bzang gtam gyi mdza' na mo/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten yangs par lhang lhang grags/ /de na dpal ldan bkra shis g.yas 'khyil sde/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang 'gran bzhin 'phel ba'i rlabs/ /rlabs phreng dgung dar bkyags pa'i ngang tshul 'di/ /'di na rlabs chen mes rgyal dpal du brjid/ /mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i rol gnas gang / /bkra shis klung brgya 'khyil ba'i ma dros mtshor/ /mkhas 244

dbang gser mig lung rigs gar bsgyur ba'i/ / gzigs mo 'jig rten 'di na mtshar du che/ / mtshar sdug lang tshos sgeg pa'i mig yangs mas/ /'dod ldan yid dbang 'phrog la mtshar du ci/ /rna bar son pa'i bskal mang 'thib pa'i mun/ / drung 'byin lnga rig snang byed yi gar 'ong / / bltar mi mngon zhing ljang mer 'khyil ba'i rig gzhung snyog med dwangs pa'i mtsho mtsho yi nang gi pad+mo'i 'dzam bag ji bzhin mdzes byed mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs ༄ kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu byed don ldan gtam gyi skyes bzang 'di/ /'di nas lhag bsam dag pas bsrings 'di bzhes rla mdzad bzang 'phro skyongs zhu/ /rab dkar zla zer zer gyis phye ba yi/ /rab dkar kun da kun yid dga' skyed pa/ /rab dkar lhag bsam bsam pa rnam dag gis/ /rab dkar zla tshes tshes grangs dge bar phul/ / — 245

ji cu d+ku sto tre mkhasadabad nam mkharasal badza ti'i me tog cesabya ba/ rna gzhan phan snying rje ༵na wa'i thugs skye nyi/ /ṅgeṅge yang dus las yol sdin mkha' khyab 'gror/ / rtag shar phan bde'i pad tshal 'dzum pa'i gnyen/ ji /gnyen gyur bshes khyod gshen bstan nam mkha'i rgyan/ /rnam dpyod 'od rnon thur ma brgyas/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i pad tshal 'bum/ /rnam par 'byed mkhas khyod gcig ces/ /rnam kun bsngags pa'i smra dbang drung / /rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro 'du las/ /rnam par shar ba'i kun rtog 'phreng / /rnam mang yi ge'i ngos 'bri ba/ /rnam par blun pa'i rtags su nges/ /de lta na'ang zab mo'i don/ /don bzhin sems pa smos ci 'tshal/ /the tshom tsam gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa/ /rtsa ba drul po byed gsungs pa'i/ /don der mno bsam legs gzhig nas/ /thos dang bsam pa'i zab mo'i lta/ /lta ba'i yang rtse dbu ma'i gshis/ /gshis la ma reg de srid du/ /du ma'i rigs pas dpyad pa gnad/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin rjen par mthong ba'i tshe/ /yin min spu ris 'byed dang ched 'dzin blo/ /zhig pa'i nam mkha' lta ba'i stong nyid ngang / /byar med 'jog pa skyong thabs man ngag gnad/ /rjes thob gang snang gang shar chos/ /chos nyid rig pa'i cho 'phrul las/ /las 'bras bslu med rgyal ba'i bka'/ / bka' bzhin spang blang byed pa gnad/ / de ltar gnad gsum gdams pa'i khog phubs shing / /de bzhin nyid dbyings gzhol bar bskul ba'i gtam/ /gtam snyan sprin gyi rnga gsang 'khrol ba'i dbyangs/ /dbyangs can mgrin pa'i pad 246

mtshor rol las so/ /'di smras dge bas bstan gnyis nyi zla zung / /ma rig smag tu dub pa'i yid can 'gro'i/ /gtan bde'i dpal du 'dzin pa'i mkhas mang gis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab thugawa smon 'tshal/ /— 6 — 247

smon ཿga lhag bsam glog 'od/dge mtshan brgya ldan bkra shis mtshan ma 'bum/ /'bum phrag gcig tu 'khyil ba'i rlabs kyi phreng / /phreng par bsgrigs pa'i zhi bde rgya mtsho che/ /che rlom snying la 'jigs ster gang de'i ngogs/ /mar gad khu bas lan brgyar byugs pa lta'i/ /nor 'dzin ne tso'i gshog ltar ljang ba'i ltor/ /sum rtsen grong khyer sa la babs 'dra ba'i/ /pe cing rgyal sa ya gling gling na brjid/ /de mthar grong dang grong khyer tshom bu ru/ /spungs dang brdal ba'i pha mtha' rig min pa'i/ /yangs pa'i sa chen dog por byas pa'i tshul/ /tshul 'di smra brjod bsam pa'i yul las 'gongs/ /phyogs mtshams lag pa'i ri mo ltar bris pas/ /bas mtha'i khengs pa 'phrog pa'i gzhung lam du/ /me 'khor rlangs 'khor 'khor lo'i bgrod shugs kyis/ /lo lam nyin gyis chod pa 'di ko ci/ /dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i yid 'ong khang brtsegs nang / /sna mang dbang gzhu'i ri mo'i dpal 'phrog pa'i/ /dar gos la sogs tshong rdzas cha ma chos /'dod rgu'i re ba skong bas rin thang bral/ /dgra dpung cham la 'bebs pa'i dpa' rtsal gyis/rnam par bsgyings pa rgyal srung bcings 'grol dmag /skam mtsho mkha' yi dpung gi zil shugs la/ /stobs chen sus kyang stobarme kyi do zlas dben/ /sna 'dus 'bru rigs sa ru btab pa'i 'bras/ /bang ba phyur bur gtams pa'i 'bru yi mdzod/ /rmugs 'dzin nor bu'i gan mdzod ri mo'i sar/ /bkod pa'i zhing ba'i byas rjes 'di ci zhig / rang rgyal can bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched/ /rang ral mkho ba'i dngos po yod tshad kun/ /248

rang las gzhan bcol mi dgos lag rtsal can/ / /rang stobs rang spel bzo ba'i lag rjes mtshar/ /mtshar sdug ri klung sngo ljang gos kyis bklubs/ /gnag phyugs ma bu skyid pa'i rtse bro rdung / /'o zho mar phyur dgos rgu'i thon khungs bzang / /dpyid dpal 'thung ba'i phyugs las sems pa skyid/ /khyad par mes rgyal rig gzhung pad+mo'i mtsho/ /mtsho byung dgyes pa'i 'dzum 'chor mda' yi grangs/ /grangs dang rtsis kyis mi lang shes bya kun/ /kun nas dar 'dis kun yid dga' bdes khyab/ /mdzes mdzes lang tshos dregs pa'i gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /gsal gsal rig pa'i rtse mo rno skabs 'dir/ /'bad 'bad mkhas bya'i gnas kun ma sbyangs na/ /na rgas non tshe dran yang ci byar yod/ /'dren byed thos 'dzin dar la babs pa'i skabs/ /skabs bstun yon tan phyogs la ma 'bad na/ /lus sems 'gran bzhin rgud pa'i dus byung tshe/ /tshe yi pha mthar gtugs pas bya thabs bral/ /sngon byon mkhan slob lo paṇa dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal thabs 'chang ba grangs mang gis/ /phyi rabs btsas bzhag gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i nor/ /nor 'di blo dang brtson pas bdag gir mdzod/ /mes dbon rnam gsum phyag rjes srid pa'i mig / mig gi dpyid du smin pa deng gi char/ /tshe gang dman pa'i las la mi bkol bar/ /bar 'dir mkhas pa'i rjes su mig yangs gtod/ /rang nyid skyed bsring rang re'i rgyal khab 'dir/ /bde dga'i dpal la bde bar spyod spyod nas/ /rang dgar song na rang la rigs min pas/ /rang rang bab bstun byas rjes rjes su zhog / sa 'di sngon chad dran dbang bye bas bzung / /lung rigs sgra yis nyin mtshan mi phyed pa/ /da ni nam langs skar ltar re gnyis 'di/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag lags de 'ju bar mdzod/ /de ltar blo gsar don gnyer tshogs rnams la/ /la lung nyul ba'i rgan pos bsnyad pa'i gtam/ /gtam snyan khu byug myos pa'i rgyang glu 'di/ /'di bzhin lag tu blang na 'di phyir dge /249

dge legs 'dzad med rig gzhung gzhon nu yis/ /mgrin pa'i mig yangs 'khyud pa'i mkhas rgu'i tshogs/ /tshogs gsum rmang gzhir bcu phrag rig pa'i mkhar/ /srid pa'i gtos dang mnyam par gsol zhes bskyal/ /zhu tshig lhag bsam skad kyi gdangs snyan cing / /bslab tshig don ldan gtam gyi dbyar rnga'i sgra/ /bskul tshig glog gi rtse dga' dang 'grogasi 'dis/ /smon tshig re ba'i gru char 'jo bar smon/ / deb 'di'i par rin la rma chu rdzong nor khul bzo grwa nas dpal 'byor zhal 'debs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba/ ——250 —

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring rgyal/ dbang chen/r+sālko1rmamo thogarte'ime0 rwapo'ibyer+sāmadzes cha jus 'god pa/ karma rdo rje tshe ring /〉/khro.i kā༈ cha snre snyan chig sems kyi me tog /jigling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos brtsams pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbrag ang 100013)mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gi skul 'od par sgrig khang nas par bsgrigs/ti zhin par khang nas par btab/2000lo'i zla dang por par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2000lo'i zla dang por pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad/ 850྾1168ha'o smi'i/ 1(32 dpar shog 8 25dpar grangs/ 0001da 1000 deb rer sgor 10 00
